title: Dodson Greek-English Lexicon of the New Testament, G1 to G227
source: Jeffrey Dodson, Greek-English Lexicon of the New Testament (public domain), data prepared by Ulrik Sandborg-Petersen. Each entry: Strong number, Greek word, short meaning, fuller meaning.
body:
G1 ἄλφα: the first letter of the Greek alphabet. alpha; the first letter of the Greek alphabet.

G2 Ἀαρών, ὁ: Aaron. Aaron, son of Amram and Jochebed, brother of Moses.

G3 Ἀβαδδών, ὁ: Abaddon. Abaddon, Destroyer (i.e. Destroying Angel) or "place of destruction" (personified).

G4 ἀβαρής, ες: not burdensome. not burdensome, bringing no weight or oppression upon.

G5 Ἀββά: Father. Abba, Father.

G6 Ἄβελ, ὁ: Abel. Abel, second son of Adam and Eve, brother of Cain.

G7 Ἀβιά, ὁ: Abijah. Abijah, (a) a king, son of Rehoboam, (b) founder of the eighth class of priests.

G8 Ἀβιαθάρ, ὁ: Abiathar. Abiathar, a priest in King David's time.

G9 Ἀβιληνή, ῆς, ἡ: Abilene. the Abilenian territory, the territory of Abila (in Syria), a small principality in the mountains of Damascus.

G10 Ἀβιούδ, ὁ: Abiud. Abiud, son of Zerubbabel and father of Eliakim.

G11 Ἀβραάμ, ὁ: Abraham. Abraham, progenitor of the Hebrew race.

G12 ἄβυσσος, ου, ἡ: the abyss, the unfathomable depth. the abyss, unfathomable depth, an especially Jewish conception, the home of the dead and of evil spirits.

G13 Ἅγαβος, ου, ὁ: Agabus. Agabus, a Christian prophet.

G14 ἀγαθοεργέω: I perform good deeds. I work that which is good, perform good deeds.

G15 ἀγαθοποιέω: I do that which is good. I do that which is good.

G16 ἀγαθοποιΐα, ας, ἡ: the doing of that which is good. the doing of that which is good, well-doing.

G17 ἀγαθοποιός, οῦ, ὁ: a doer of that which is good. a doer of that which is good.

G18 ἀγαθός, ή, όν: good. intrinsically good, good in nature, good whether it be seen to be so or not, the widest and most colorless of all words with this meaning.

G19 ἀγαθωσύνη, ης, ἡ: goodness. intrinsic goodness, especially as a personal quality, with stress on the kindly (rather than the righteous) side of goodness.

G20 ἀγαλλίασις, εως, ἡ: exultation, exhilaration. wild joy, ecstatic delight, exultation, exhilaration.

G21 ἀγαλλιάω: I exult, am full of joy. I exult, am full of joy.

G22 ἄγαμος, οῦ, ὁ, ἡ: unmarried. unmarried, of a person not in a state of wedlock, whether he or she has formerly been married or not.

G23 ἀγανακτέω: I am angry, am incensed. I am angry, incensed.

G24 ἀγανάκτησις, εως, ἡ: indignation. feeling of anger, indignation, vexation.

G25 ἀγαπάω: I love. I love, wish well to, take pleasure in, long for; denotes the love of reason, esteem.

G26 ἀγάπη, ης, ἡ: love. love, benevolence, good will, esteem; plur: love-feasts.

G27 ἀγαπητός, ή, όν: loved, beloved. loved, beloved, with two special applications: the Beloved, a title of the Messiah (Christ), as beloved beyond all others by the God who sent Him; of Christians, as beloved by God, Christ, and one another.

G28 Ἁγάρ, ἡ: Hagar. Hagar, the servant of Sarah, concubine of Abraham.

G29 ἀγγαρεύω: I impress, send. I impress (into my service), send (on an errand).

G30 ἀγγεῖον, ου, τό: a vessel, flask, can. a vessel, flask.

G31 ἀγγελία, ας, ἡ: a message. a message.

G518 ἀγγέλλω: I announce, report. I announce, report.

G32 ἄγγελος, ου, ὁ: an angel, messenger. a messenger, generally a (supernatural) messenger from God, an angel, conveying news or behests from God to men.

G30 ἄγγος, -εος, τό: a vessel. a vessel.

G34 ἀγέλη, ης, ἡ: a flock, herd. a flock, herd.

G35 ἀγενεαλόγητος, ον: of unrecorded genealogy. of unrecorded genealogy, whose descent cannot be traced.

G36 ἀγενής, ές: without family, ignoble. lit: without family, hence: ignoble, base.

G37 ἁγιάζω: I make holy, sanctify. I make holy, treat as holy, set apart as holy, sanctify, hallow, purify.

G38 ἁγιασμός, οῦ, ὁ: sanctification, holiness. the process of making or becoming holy, set apart, sanctification, holiness, consecration.

G40 ἅγιος, ία, ον: set apart, holy, sacred. set apart by (or for) God, holy, sacred.

G41 ἁγιότης, ητος, ἡ: holiness. holiness, sanctity, as an abstract quality.

G42 ἁγιωσύνη, ης, ἡ: a holy or sanctified state. a holy or sanctified state.

G43 ἀγκάλη, ης, ἡ: an arm. an arm, especially as bent to receive a burden.

G44 ἄγκιστρον, ου, τό: a fish-hook. a fish-hook.

G45 ἄγκυρα, ας, ἡ: an anchor. an anchor.

G46 ἄγναφος, ον: unshrunken, new. unshrunken, new.

G47 ἁγνεία, ας, ἡ: purity, chastity. purity, chastity.

G48 ἁγνίζω: I cleanse, purify. I cleanse, purify, either ceremonially, actually, or morally.

G49 ἁγνισμός, οῦ, ὁ: purification. (ceremonial) purification.

G50 ἀγνοέω: I do not know, am ignorant of. I do not know, am ignorant of (a person, thing, or fact), sometimes with the idea of willful ignorance.

G51 ἀγνόημα, ατος, τό: an offence committed through ignorance. an offence committed through ignorance, an error due to (willful or culpable) ignorance.

G52 ἄγνοια, ας, ἡ: ignorance. ignorance, inadvertence, sometimes with the idea of willful blindness.

G53 ἁγνός, ή, όν: pure, chaste. (originally, in a condition prepared for worship), pure (either ethically, or ritually, ceremonially), chaste.

G54 ἁγνότης, τητος, ἡ: purity, chastity. purity, chastity.

G55 ἁγνῶς: purely, sincerely. purely, sincerely, with pure motives, honestly.

G56 ἀγνωσία, ας, ἡ: ignorance. ignorance; specifically: willful ignorance.

G57 ἄγνωστος, ον: unknown. unknown, unknowable.

G58 ἀγορά, ᾶς, ἡ: market-place. market-place, forum, public place of assembly.

G59 ἀγοράζω: I buy. I buy.

G60 ἀγοραῖος, ον: a lounger in the market-place. a lounger in the market-place, perhaps with the idea of agitator.

G61 ἄγρα, ας, ἡ: catching, a catch. catching, a catch.

G62 ἀγράμματος, ον: uneducated. unlettered, illiterate, uneducated, perhaps with the narrower idea: unacquainted with Rabbinic teaching.

G63 ἀγραυλέω: I spend the night in the open. I spend the night in the open, bivouac.

G64 ἀγρεύω: I catch, capture. I catch, capture.

G65 ἀγριέλαιος, ου, ἡ: a wild olive tree. a wild olive tree, oleaster.

G66 ἄγριος, ία, ιον: wild, fierce. wild, fierce.

G67 Ἀγρίππας, α, ὁ: Agrippa. Agrippa, i.e. Herod Agrippa II.

G68 ἀγρός, οῦ, ὁ: a field, the country. a field, especially as bearing a crop; the country, lands, property in land, a country estate.

G69 ἀγρυπνέω: I am awake. I am not asleep, am awake; especially: I am watchful, careful.

G70 ἀγρυπνία, ας, ἡ: sleeplessness, watching. the state of being awake (at night), sleeplessness, watching.

G71 ἄγω: I lead. I lead, lead away, bring (a person, or animal), guide, spend a day, go.

G72 ἀγωγή, ῆς, ἡ: conduct. a leading, guiding; hence: mode of life, conduct.

G73 ἀγών, ῶνος, ὁ: a contest. an (athletic) contest; hence, a struggle (in the soul).

G74 ἀγωνία, ας, ἡ: contest, agony. (properly the feeling of the athlete before a contest), great fear, terror, of death; anxiety, agony.

G75 ἀγωνίζομαι: I strive, contend. I am struggling, striving (as in an athletic contest or warfare); I contend, as with an adversary.

G76 Ἀδάμ, ὁ: Adam. Adam, the first man, the first parent of the human race.

G77 ἀδάπανος, ον: without expense, free. without expense, for which nothing has to be paid.

G78 Ἀδδί, ὁ: Addi. Addi, son of Cosam, and father of Melchi, one of the ancestors of Jesus.

G79 ἀδελφή, ῆς, ἡ: a sister. a sister, a woman (fellow-)member of a church, a Christian woman.

G80 ἀδελφός, οῦ, ὁ: a brother. a brother, member of the same religious community, especially a fellow-Christian.

G81 ἀδελφότης, τητος, ἡ: brotherhood. brotherhood (in the collective sense), the members of the Christian Church, Christendom.

G82 ἄδηλος, ον: unseen, not obvious. unseen, not obvious, inconspicuous, indistinct.

G83 ἀδηλότης, τητος, ἡ: uncertainty. the quality of being unseen (of disappearing), indefiniteness, uncertainty.

G84 ἀδήλως: out of sight, uncertainly. out of sight, obscurely, inconspicuously, uncertainly, without certain aim.

G85 ἀδημονέω: I am troubled, distressed. I feel fear, lack courage, am distressed, troubled.

G86 ᾍδης, ου, ὁ: Hades. Hades, the unseen world.

G87 ἀδιάκριτος, ον: unambiguous. without uncertainty, unambiguous, undivided, whole-hearted.

G88 ἀδιάλειπτος, ον: unceasing, unremitting. unceasing, unremitting.

G89 ἀδιαλείπτως: unceasingly. unceasingly, without remission.

G90 ἀδιαφθορία, ας, ἡ: incorruptibility, soundness, integrity. incorruptibility, soundness, integrity, purity.

G91 ἀδικέω: I act unjustly towards. I act unjustly towards, injure, harm.

G92 ἀδίκημα, ατος, τό: a crime, misdeed. a legal wrong, crime (with which one is charged), misdeed, crime against God, a sin.

G93 ἀδικία, ας, ἡ: unrighteousness. injustice, unrighteousness, hurt.

G94 ἄδικος, ον: unjust, unrighteous. unjust, unrighteous, wicked.

G95 ἀδίκως: unjustly. unjustly, undeservedly.

G96 ἀδόκιμος, ον: failing to pass the test. failing to pass the test, unapproved, counterfeit.

G97 ἄδολος, ον: pure. unadulterated, pure, guileless.

G98 Ἀδραμυττηνός, ή, όν: belonging to Adramyttium. belonging to Adramyttium, a port in Mysia, in Asia Minor.

G99 Ἀδρίας, ου, ὁ: the Adriatic Sea. the Hadria, a name given by sailors not merely to the Adriatic Sea, to which it properly belonged, but also to the open Mediterranean to the south-east of Italy, to the sea that lay between Malta, Italy, Greece, and Crete.

G100 ἁδρότης, τητος, ἡ: lavishness. lavishness, lavish generosity, abundance, bounty.

G101 ἀδυνατέω: to be impossible. to be impossible; I am unable.

G102 ἀδύνατος, ον: incapable, impossible. of persons: incapable; of things: impossible; either the inability, or that which is impossible.

G103 ᾄδω: I sing. I sing.

G104 ἀεί: always. always, unceasingly, perpetually; on every occasion.

G105 ἀετός, οῦ, ὁ: an eagle, bird of prey. an eagle, bird of prey.

G106 ἄζυμος, ον: unleavened, the paschal feast, uncorrupted. unleavened, the paschal feast (a feast of the Hebrews); fig: uncorrupted, sincere.

G107 Ἀζώρ, ὁ: Azor. Azor, son of Eliakim and father of Zadok, an ancestor of Jesus.

G108 Ἄζωτος, ου, ἡ: Azotus, Ashdod. Azotus, Ashdod, a coast town of Palestine belonging to the ancient Philistia, and part of Herod's kingdom.

G109 ἀήρ, ἀέρος, ὁ: air. air, the lower air we breathe.

G110 ἀθανασία, ας, ἡ: immortality. immortality, imperishability, freedom from death.

G111 ἀθέμιτος, ον: illegal, unlawful. illegal, unlawful, criminal, lawless.

G112 ἄθεος, ον: godless. without god, without (the only true) God, godless.

G113 ἄθεσμος, ον: lawless. lawless, unrestrained, licentious.

G114 ἀθετέω: I annul. I annul, make of no effect, set aside, ignore, slight; I break faith with.

G115 ἀθέτησις, εως, ἡ: nullification, abrogation. annulment, nullification, abrogation.

G116 Ἀθῆναι, ῶν, αἱ: Athens. Athens, the intellectual capital of Greece.

G117 Ἀθηναῖος, α, ον: Athenian. Athenian, belonging to Athens.

G118 ἀθλέω: I compete. I engage, compete, in an (athletic) contest.

G119 ἄθλησις, εως, ἡ: a contest. a struggling (as in an athletic contest).

G120 ἀθυμέω: I lose heart. I lose heart, am despondent, am disheartened.

G121 ἀθῷος, ον: guiltless. (sometimes: unpunished), guiltless, innocent.

G122 αἴγειος, α, ον: of a goat. of a goat.

G123 αἰγιαλός, οῦ, ὁ: sea-coast, beach. sea-coast, (sandy) beach; shore (of sea or lake), land.

G124 Αἰγύπτιος, α, ον: Egyptian. Egyptian.

G125 Αἴγυπτος, ου, ἡ: Egypt. Egypt.

G126 ἀΐδιος, ον: eternal. eternal, everlasting.

G127 αἰδώς, οῦς, ἡ: shame, modesty. shame, modesty.

G128 Αἰθίοψ, οπος, ὁ: an Ethiopian. an Ethiopian, Abyssinian.

G129 αἷμα, ατος, τό: blood. blood (especially as shed).

G130 αἱματεκχυσία, ας, ἡ: a shedding or pouring forth of blood. a shedding or pouring forth of blood (in sacrifice).

G131 αἱμορροέω: I suffer from a continual flow (oozing) of blood. I suffer from a continual flow (oozing) of blood.

G132 Αἰνέας, α, ὁ: Aeneas. Aeneas, a citizen of Lydda.

G133 αἴνεσις, εως, ἡ: praise. praise, commendation.

G134 αἰνέω: I praise. I praise.

G135 αἴνιγμα, ατος, τό: a riddle, an enigma. a riddle, an enigma.

G136 αἶνος, ου, ὁ: praise. praise.

G137 Αἰνών, ἡ: Aenon. Aenon; Eusebius and Jerome place this site 8 (Roman) miles south of Scythopolis near the Jordan.

G138 αἱρέω: I choose, prefer. I choose, prefer.

G139 αἵρεσις, εως, ἡ: a self-chosen opinion, a sect. a self-chosen opinion, a religious or philosophical sect, discord or contention.

G140 αἱρετίζω: I choose. I choose.

G141 αἱρετικός, ή, όν: factious. disposed to form sects, sectarian, heretical, factious.

G142 αἴρω: I raise, lift up. I raise, lift up, take away, remove.

G143 αἰσθάνομαι: I perceive. I perceive, understand.

G144 αἴσθησις, εως, ἡ: perception. perception, understanding, discernment.

G145 αἰσθητήριον, ου, τό: perceptive faculty. perceptive faculty.

G146 αἰσχροκερδής, ες: greedy. greedy, fond of base gain.

G147 αἰσχροκερδῶς: greedily. greedily, in a spirit of eagerness for base gain.

G148 αἰσχρολογία, ας, ἡ: filthy speech. filthy speech, foul language.

G150 αἰσχρός, ά, όν: base, disgraceful. base, disgraceful.

G151 αἰσχρότης, τητος, ἡ: obscenity, indecency, baseness. obscenity, indecency, baseness.

G152 αἰσχύνη, ης, ἡ: shame. shame, shamefacedness, shameful deeds.

G153 αἰσχύνομαι: I am ashamed, am put to shame. I am ashamed, am put to shame.

G154 αἰτέω: I ask, request, beg, petition. I ask, request, petition, demand.

G155 αἴτημα, ατος, τό: a petition, request. a petition, request.

G156 αἰτία, ας, ἡ: a cause, reason, charge. a cause, reason, excuse; a charge, accusation; guilt; circumstances, case.

G157 αἰτίωμα, ατος, τό: a charge, accusation. a charge, accusation.

G158 αἴτιον, ου, τό: cause, crime. cause, crime, guilt, criminality.

G159 αἴτιος, ου, ὁ: the cause of, the originator of. the cause, author; the culprit, the accused; the crime.

G160 αἰφνίδιος, ον: unexpected, sudden. unexpected, sudden.

G161 αἰχμαλωσία, ας, ἡ: captivity. captivity; a captive multitude.

G162 αἰχμαλωτεύω: I take captive. I take captive, captivate.

G163 αἰχμαλωτίζω: I take captive, subdue, ensnare. I take captive (in war); I subdue, ensnare.

G164 αἰχμάλωτος, ου, ὁ: a captive, prisoner. a captive (in war), a prisoner.

G165 αἰών, ῶνος, ὁ: an age, a cycle of time. an age, a cycle (of time), especially of the present age as contrasted with the future age, and of one of a series of ages stretching to infinity.

G166 αἰώνιος, ία, ιον: eternal, unending. age-long, and therefore: practically eternal, unending; partaking of the character of that which lasts for an age, as contrasted with that which is brief and fleeting.

G167 ἀκαθαρσία, ας, ἡ: uncleanness, impurity. uncleanness, impurity.

G169 ἀκάθαρτος, ον: unclean, impure. unclean, impure.

G170 ἀκαιρέομαι: I am without a suitable opportunity. I am without a suitable opportunity.

G171 ἀκαίρως: unseasonably. unseasonably, out of due season, inopportunely.

G172 ἄκακος, ον: innocent, guileless, simple. innocent, guileless, simple.

G173 ἄκανθα, ης, ἡ: a thorn-bush. a thorn-bush, prickly plant; a thorn.

G174 ἀκάνθινος, η, ον: made of thorns. made of thorns.

G175 ἄκαρπος, ον: unfruitful, barren. unfruitful, barren, profitless.

G176 ἀκατάγνωστος, ον: uncondemned, unimpeachable. not open to just rebuke; irreprehensible.

G177 ἀκατακάλυπτος, ον: not veiled, unveiled. unveiled, uncovered.

G178 ἀκατάκριτος, ον: uncondemned. uncondemned, not yet tried.

G179 ἀκατάλυτος, ον: indissoluble, that cannot be broken up. indissoluble, that cannot be broken up.

G180 ἀκατάπαυστος, ον: not ceasing from, not abandoning. not ceasing from, not abandoning (giving up).

G181 ἀκαταστασία, ας, ἡ: disturbance, upheaval, revolution. disturbance, upheaval, revolution, almost anarchy, first in the political, and thence in the moral sphere.

G182 ἀκατάστατος, ον: unsettled, unstable. unsettled, unstable (though these are hardly strong enough equivalents), almost anarchic.

G183 ἀκατάσχετος, ον: unrestrainable, unruly, untamable. unrestrainable, unruly, untamable.

G184 Ἀκελδαμά: Akeldama. Akeldama (in Aramaic: field of blood).

G185 ἀκέραιος, ον: simple, unsophisticated, innocent. (lit: unmixed) simple, unsophisticated, sincere, blameless.

G186 ἀκλινής, ες: unbent, unyielding, resolute. unbent, unyielding, resolute, firm.

G187 ἀκμάζω: I reach maturity, become ripe. I reach maturity, become ripe, am in full vigor.

G188 ἀκμήν: even now. even now.

G189 ἀκοή, ῆς, ἡ: hearing, faculty of hearing, ear. hearing, faculty of hearing, ear; report, rumor.

G190 ἀκολουθέω: I accompany, attend, follow. I accompany, attend, follow.

G191 ἀκούω: I hear, listen. I hear, listen, comprehend by hearing; pass: is heard, reported.

G192 ἀκρασία, ας, ἡ: incontinence, intemperance, lack of restraint. incontinence, intemperance (in wide sense), lack of restraint.

G193 ἀκρατής, ές: lacking self-control, inclined to excess. lacking self-control, powerless, inclined to excess.

G194 ἄκρατος, ον: unmixed, undiluted. unmixed, undiluted, pure.

G195 ἀκρίβεια, ας, ἡ: strictness, accuracy. strictness, accuracy, exactness, attention to detail, scrupulousness.

G196 ἀκριβέστατος: most exact, strict. most exact, strict.

G198 ἀκριβόω: I examine carefully, inquire strictly. I learn carefully, inquire with exactness.

G199 ἀκριβῶς: carefully, exactly, strictly. carefully, exactly, strictly, distinctly.

G200 ἀκρίς, ίδος, ἡ: a locust. a locust.

G201 ἀκροατήριον, ίου, τό: auditorium, recitation hall, court room. auditorium, recitation hall, court room (for hearing cases).

G202 ἀκροατής, οῦ, ὁ: a hearer of, a listener to. a hearer of, a listener to.

G203 ἀκροβυστία, ας, ἡ: foreskin. (a technical word of Jewish use) foreskin, prepuce: used sometimes as a slang term by Jews, of Gentiles.

G204 ἀκρογωνιαῖος, α, ον: in the corner, cornerstone. in the corner (of a building); subst: corner-(stone).

G205 ἀκροθίνιον, ίου, τό: spoil, treasure. (lit: top of a heap), first-fruits, spoil, treasure (taken in war).

G206 ἄκρον, ου, τό: the end, extremity. the end, extremity.

G207 Ἀκύλας, ου, ὁ: Aquila. the Greek way of writing the Latin Aquila, a male proper name; the husband of Priscilla (Prisca), and a Jew, of a family belonging to (Sinope in ?) Pontus.

G208 ἀκυρόω: I annul, make of no effect, cancel. I annul, make of no effect, cancel.

G209 ἀκωλύτως: freely, without hindrance. (characteristic of legal documents), without hindrance, freely.

G210 ἄκων, ἄκουσα, ἆκον: unwilling. unwilling, generally used where English would express by an adverb: unwillingly.

G211 ἀλάβαστρον, ου, τό: an alabaster phial or bottle. a phial or bottle of perfumed ointment, usually of alabaster.

G212 ἀλαζονεία, ας, ἡ: boasting, show, arrogant display. boasting, show, arrogant display, ostentation; plur: occasions of ostentation.

G213 ἀλαζών, όνος, ὁ: a boaster. a boaster, one who gives one's self airs in a loud and flaunting way.

G214 ἀλαλάζω: I cry aloud, a clanging or clashing cymbal. I cry aloud, raise a war-cry; a clanging or clashing cymbal.

G215 ἀλάλητος, ον: unutterable, that baffles words. unutterable, that baffles words, unexpressed.

G216 ἄλαλος, ον: unable to speak. unable to speak or articulate; speechless.

G217 ἅλας, ατος, τό: salt. salt.

G218 ἀλείφω: I anoint. I anoint: festivally, in homage, medicinally, or in anointing the dead.

G219 ἀλεκτοροφωνία, ας, ἡ: cockcrow. the cockcrow, as a period of time, between midnight and 3 a.m.

G220 ἀλέκτωρ, ορος, ὁ: a cock, rooster. a cock, rooster.

G221 Ἀλεξανδρεύς, έως, ὁ: an Alexandrian. an Alexandrian, a native (or resident) of Alexandria in Egypt.

G222 Ἀλεξανδρῖνος, η, ον: Alexandrian. Alexandrian, belonging to Alexandria in Egypt.

G223 Ἀλέξανδρος, ου, ὁ: Alexander. Alexander, a name of Greek origin, (a) son of Simon of Cyrene, (b) the High Priest's kinsman, (c) an Ephesian Jew, (d) the coppersmith.

G224 ἄλευρον, ου, τό: meal, flour. meal, flour.

G225 ἀλήθεια, ας, ἡ: truth. truth, but not merely truth as spoken; truth of idea, reality, sincerity, truth in the moral sphere, divine truth revealed to man, straightforwardness.

G226 ἀληθεύω: I say, speak truth, I do truth. I say (speak) truth, do truth, maintain truth (the truth).

G227 ἀληθής, ές: unconcealed, true. unconcealed, true, true in fact, worthy of credit, truthful.

title: Dodson Greek-English Lexicon of the New Testament, G228 to G439
source: Jeffrey Dodson, Greek-English Lexicon of the New Testament (public domain), data prepared by Ulrik Sandborg-Petersen. Each entry: Strong number, Greek word, short meaning, fuller meaning.
body:
G228 ἀληθινός, η, ον: true, real, genuine. true (lit: made of truth), real, genuine.

G229 ἀλήθω: I grind. I grind.

G230 ἀληθῶς: truly, really, certainly. truly, really, certainly, surely.

G231 ἁλιεύς, έως, ὁ: a fisherman. a fisherman.

G232 ἁλιεύω: I fish. I fish.

G233 ἁλίζω: I salt, sprinkle with salt, keep fresh and sound. I salt, sprinkle with salt (of sacrifices or of those who offer sacrifice), keep fresh and sound, and so acceptable to God.

G234 ἀλίσγημα, ατος, τό: pollution, perhaps a polluted thing. pollution, perhaps a polluted thing (especially of food).

G235 ἀλλά: but, except. but, except, however.

G236 ἀλλάσσω: I change, alter. I change, alter, exchange, transform.

G237 ἀλλαχόθεν: from another quarter, by another way. from another place, by another way.

G238 ἀλληγορέω: I speak allegorically. I speak allegorically.

G239 Ἁλληλούϊα: Hallelujah, Praise the Lord. Hallelujah, Praise the Lord.

G240 ἀλλήλων: one another. one another, each other.

G241 ἀλλογενής, ες: of another nation, a foreigner. of another nation, a foreigner.

G242 ἅλλομαι: I leap, bubble up. I leap, leap up; of water: I spring up, bubble up.

G243 ἄλλος, η, ον: other, another, different. other, another (of more than two), different.

G244 ἀλλοτριοεπίσκοπος, ου, ὁ: a prier into other men's affairs. one who meddles in things alien to his calling or in matters belonging to others; factious.

G245 ἀλλότριος, ία, ιον: belonging to another person, foreign. belonging to another person, belonging to others, foreign, strange.

G246 ἀλλόφυλος, ον: foreign. foreign, of another tribe or race.

G247 ἄλλως: otherwise. otherwise, things that are otherwise.

G248 ἀλοάω: I thresh. I thresh (wheat).

G249 ἄλογος, ον: unreasonable, senseless. without reason, irrational; contrary to reason, absurd.

G250 ἀλόη, ης, ἡ: aloes. aloes, the powdered fragrant aloe wood.

G251 ἅλς, ἁλός, ὁ: salt. salt.

G252 ἁλυκός, ή, όν: salty, saltine, bitter. salty, saltine, bitter.

G253 ἄλυπος, ον: free from pain, grief, trouble. free from pain (grief, trouble).

G254 ἅλυσις, εως, ἡ: a light chain. a (light) chain, bond.

G255 ἀλυσιτελής, ές: profitless, unprofitable. profitless, unprofitable, ruinous, detrimental.

G256 Ἀλφαίος, ου, ὁ: Alphaeus. Alphaeus; apparently two persons, (a) father of Levi, and (b) father of James.

G257 ἅλων, ωνος, ἡ: a threshing-floor. a threshing-floor.

G258 ἀλώπηξ, εκος, ἡ: a fox. a fox; a fox-like, crafty person.

G259 ἅλωσις, εως, ἡ: capture, capturing. capture, capturing.

G260 ἅμα: at the same time, along with. at the same time, therewith, along with, together with.

G261 ἀμαθής, ές: unlearned, ignorant. unlearned, ignorant.

G262 ἀμαράντινος, η, ον: unfading, fadeless. unfading, fadeless, enduring.

G263 ἀμάραντος, ον: unfading. unfading, enduring.

G264 ἁμαρτάνω: I sin. originally: I miss the mark, hence (a) I make a mistake, (b) I sin, commit a sin (against God); sometimes the idea of sinning against a fellow-creature is present.

G265 ἁμάρτημα, ατος, τό: a fault, sin, evil deed. a fault, sin, evil deed.

G266 ἁμαρτία, ας, ἡ: a sin. prop: missing the mark; hence: (a) guilt, sin, (b) a fault, failure (in an ethical sense), sinful deed.

G267 ἀμάρτυρος, ον: without witness, untestified to. without witness, untestified to.

G268 ἁμαρτωλός, ον: sinning, sinful, a sinner. sinning, sinful, depraved, detestable.

G269 ἄμαχος, ον: not quarrelsome, peaceable. peaceable, abstaining from fighting, not contentious.

G270 ἀμάω: I mow, reap. I mow, reap, collect.

G271 ἀμέθυστος, ου, ἡ: amethyst. amethyst (a kind of rock crystal: the best specimens are the color of unmixed wine, whence perhaps the name), believed to stave off drunkenness.

G272 ἀμελέω: I neglect. I neglect, am careless of, disregard.

G273 ἄμεμπτος, ον: blameless. blameless, free from fault or defect.

G274 ἀμέμπτως: blamelessly. blamelessly.

G275 ἀμέριμνος, ον: free from anxiety. free from anxiety (though anxiety is rather too strong a word) or care.

G276 ἀμετάθετος, ον: unchanged, unchangeable. unchanged, unchangeable.

G277 ἀμετακίνητος, ον: immovable, firm. immovable, firm.

G278 ἀμεταμέλητος, ον: not to be repented of. not to be repented of, about which no change of mind can take place, not affected by change of mind.

G279 ἀμετανόητος, ον: unrepentant. unrepentant, impenitent.

G280 ἄμετρος, ον: not measurable, immeasurable. not measurable, immeasurable, to a limitless degree.

G281 ἀμήν: verily, truly, amen, so let it be. verily, truly, amen; at the end of sentences may be paraphrased by: So let it be.

G282 ἀμήτωρ, ορος: whose mother's name is not recorded or known. (lit: motherless), whose mother's name is not recorded (or known).

G283 ἀμίαντος, ον: undefiled, untainted. undefiled, untainted, free from contamination.

G284 Ἀμιναδάβ, ὁ: Amminadab. Amminadab, son of Ram and father of Nahshon, one of the ancestors of Jesus.

G285 ἄμμος, ου, ἡ: sand. sand, sandy ground.

G286 ἀμνός, οῦ, ὁ: a lamb. a lamb (as a type of innocence, and with sacrificial connotation).

G287 ἀμοιβή, ῆς, ἡ: a change, an exchange. a change, an exchange; hence plur: reciprocal good deeds (services), a fitting requital.

G288 ἄμπελος, ου, ἡ: a vine. a vine, grape-vine.

G289 ἀμπελουργός, οῦ, ὁ: a vine-dresser. a vine-dresser, gardener.

G290 ἀμπελών, ῶνος, ὁ: a vineyard. a vineyard.

G291 Ἀμπλίας, ου, ὁ: Ampliatus. Ampliatus (Amplias), a male member of the church at Rome, probably of the imperial household.

G292 ἀμύνομαι: I defend. I ward off, defend myself against, resist, defend, assist.

G293 ἀμφίβληστρον, ου, τό: a fishing net, drag-net. prop: something thrown around; a fishing-net, drag-net.

G294 ἀμφιέννυμι: I put on, clothe. I put on, clothe.

G295 Ἀμφίπολις, εως, ἡ: Amphipolis. Amphipolis, a leading city of Macedonia.

G296 ἄμφοδον, ου, τό: a street, quarter, block. prop: a road around anything; the street of a village.

G297 ἀμφότεροι, αι, α: both of two. both (of two).

G298 ἀμώμητος, ον: without blame or fault. without blame or fault, unblemished.

G299 ἄμωμος, ον: blameless. blameless, without blemish, unblemished, faultless.

G300 Ἀμών, ὁ: Amon. Amon (Amos), son of Manasseh and father of Josiah, an ancestor of Jesus.

G301 Ἀμώς, ὁ: Amos. Amos, son of Manasseh and father of Josiah, an ancestor of Jesus.

G302 ἄν: an untranslatable word that makes a statement contingent. an untranslatable word (under the circumstances, in that case, anyhow), the general effect of which is to make a statement contingent, which would otherwise be definite: it is thus regularly used with the subjunctive mood.

G303 ἀνά: and, apiece, by, each, every, in, through. prep. Rare in NT; prop: upwards, up; among, between; in turn; apiece, by; as a prefix: up, to, anew, back.

G304 ἀναβαθμός, οῦ, ὁ: a step, a flight of steps. a step, a flight of steps; the well-known "stairs" leading up from the temple to the tower of Antonia at Jerusalem.

G305 ἀναβαίνω: I go up, mount, ascend. I go up, mount, ascend; of things: I rise, spring up, come up.

G306 ἀναβάλλω: I postpone, defer. I postpone, defer, especially: I postpone the trial of.

G307 ἀναβιβάζω: I draw up. I draw up, as a net to shore.

G308 ἀναβλέπω: I look up, recover my sight. I look up, recover my sight.

G309 ἀνάβλεψις, εως, ἡ: recovery of sight. recovery of sight.

G310 ἀναβοάω: I shout upwards, cry out, raise my voice. I shout upwards, cry out, raise my voice.

G311 ἀναβολή, ῆς, ἡ: postponement, delay, putting off. postponement, delay, putting off.

G312 ἀναγγέλλω: I announce, make known, report. I bring back word, report; I announce, declare.

G313 ἀναγεννάω: I beget again, beget into a new life. I beget again, beget into a new life.

G314 ἀναγινώσκω: I read. I read, know again, know certainly, recognize, discern.

G315 ἀναγκάζω: I force, compel. I force, compel, constrain, urge.

G316 ἀναγκαῖος, α, ον: necessary, essential. necessary, essential, intimate, right, proper.

G317 ἀναγκαστῶς: by force, necessarily. by way of compulsion, unwillingly, by force, necessarily.

G318 ἀνάγκη, ης, ἡ: necessity, constraint, compulsion. necessity, constraint, compulsion; there is need to; force, violence.

G319 ἀναγνωρίζω: I make known to again, make to be recognized. I recognize; pass: I am made known, cause myself to be recognized.

G320 ἀνάγνωσις, εως, ἡ: reading. recognition, reading; public reading (of the law and prophets in synagogue or church).

G321 ἀνάγω: I lead up, put to sea, set sail. I lead up, bring up, offer, produce, put to sea, set sail.

G322 ἀναδείκνυμι: I show forth, show clearly, proclaim, appoint. I show forth, show clearly; hence: I proclaim (a person's appointment to an office), appoint.

G323 ἀνάδειξις, εως, ἡ: the proclamation of an appointment. the proclamation of an appointment (to an office); perhaps rather admission to membership of a society.

G324 ἀναδέχομαι: I welcome, receive kindly, undertake. I welcome, receive kindly; I undertake, assume the responsibility of.

G325 ἀναδίδωμι: I send up, deliver, hand over. I send up, deliver, hand over, yield.

G326 ἀναζάω: I come to life again, revive. I come to life again, revive, regain life.

G327 ἀναζητέω: I seek out, search for. I seek out, search for (implying the difficulty of the task).

G328 ἀναζώννυμι: I gird up, brace up. I gird up, brace up (with a view to active exertion); a metaphor from the girding of the flowing tunic, to prevent its hampering one in active work.

G329 ἀναζωπυρέω: I stir up the fire, fan the flame of. I stir up the fire, fan the flame of.

G330 ἀναθάλλω: I thrive or flourish again. I thrive or flourish again, revive.

G331 ἀνάθεμα, ατος, τό: a curse, a cursed thing. a votive offering, a thing devoted to God; a curse, the thing cursed.

G332 ἀναθεματίζω: I curse, invoke curses. I curse, invoke curses, devote to destruction.

G333 ἀναθεωρέω: I look at attentively, consider. I look at attentively, gaze at, consider.

G334 ἀνάθημα, ατος, τό: an offering dedicated by a worshipper. an offering dedicated (hung up in a temple) by a worshipper; a gift or offering consecrated to God.

G335 ἀναίδεια, ας, ἡ: shamelessness, shameless persistence. shamelessness, shameless persistence (e.g. in greed).

G336 ἀναίρεσις, εως, ἡ: killing, slaying, murder. taking away (of life), killing, slaying, murder.

G337 ἀναιρέω: I take up, abolish, murder. I take up, take away the life of, make an end of, murder.

G338 ἀναίτιος, ον: guiltless. guiltless, innocent.

G339 ἀνακαθίζω: I sit up. I sit up.

G340 ἀνακαινίζω: I renew, restore. I make fresh again, renew, restore.

G341 ἀνακαινόω: I renew, amend, change. I renew, make new again.

G342 ἀνακαίνωσις, εως, ἡ: renewing. renewing; a renewal or change of heart and life.

G343 ἀνακαλύπτω: I unveil. I unveil, uncover.

G344 ἀνακάμπτω: I return. I bend or turn back; I return.

G345 ἀνάκειμαι: I recline, especially at a dinner-table. I recline, especially at a dinner-table.

G346 ἀνακεφαλαιόω: I sum up, summarize, recapitulate, gather up in one. I sum up, summarize, recapitulate, gather up in one.

G347 ἀνακλίνω: I make to recline, I recline at a table. I lay upon, lean against, lay down, make to recline; pass: I lie back, recline.

G349 ἀνακράζω: I shout aloud. I shout aloud, cry out.

G350 ἀνακρίνω: I examine, inquire into. I examine, inquire into, investigate, question.

G351 ἀνάκρισις, εως, ἡ: judicial examination, preliminary inquiry. judicial examination, preliminary inquiry.

G352 ἀνακύπτω: I raise myself, look up. I raise myself, look up, am elated.

G353 ἀναλαμβάνω: I take up, raise. I take up, raise; I pick up, take on board; I carry off, lead away.

G354 ἀνάληψις, εως, ἡ: a taking up, lifting up. a taking up, lifting up.

G355 ἀναλίσκω: I destroy, annihilate. I destroy, annihilate, expend, consume.

G356 ἀναλογία, ας, ἡ: proportion, measure. proportion, measure, analogy.

G357 ἀναλογίζομαι: I think upon, consider attentively. I think upon, consider attentively.

G358 ἄναλος, ον: saltless, tasteless, flat. saltless, tasteless, flat.

G359 ἀνάλυσις, εως, ἡ: departing, departure from this life. a loosing, departing, departure (from this life); (Probably a metaphor from the yoking and unyoking of transport animals).

G360 ἀναλύω: I depart, return. I unloose, unloose for departure, depart, return.

G361 ἀναμάρτητος, ον: without blame, faultless. without blame, faultless, unerring.

G362 ἀναμένω: I await. I await (one whose coming is expected).

G363 ἀναμιμνήσκω: I remind, admonish, remember. I remind, admonish, am reminded, remind myself; pass: I remember, recall.

G364 ἀνάμνησις, εως, ἡ: a recalling, remembrance, memory. a recalling, remembrance, memory.

G365 ἀνανεόω: I renew. I renew; mid: I renew myself, am renewed.

G366 ἀνανήφω: I become sober again, recover sound sense. I become sober again, recover sound sense.

G367 Ἀνανίας, α, ὁ: Ananias. Ananias, (a) husband of Sapphira, a member of the early church at Jerusalem, (b) a member of the church at Damascus, (c) the high priest at Jerusalem.

G368 ἀναντίρρητος, ον: indisputable, not to be contradicted. indisputable, undeniable, not to be contradicted.

G369 ἀναντιρρήτως: without contradiction. without contradiction, without hesitation, promptly.

G370 ἀνάξιος, ον: unworthy, inadequate. unworthy, inadequate.

G371 ἀναξίως: unworthily, in an unworthy manner. unworthily, in an unworthy manner.

G372 ἀνάπαυσις, εως, ἡ: rest, cessation from labor, refreshment. rest, cessation from labor, refreshment.

G373 ἀναπαύω: I make to rest, give rest to, rest, take my ease. I make to rest, give rest to; mid. and pass: I rest, take my ease.

G374 ἀναπείθω: I urge by evil persuasion, I tempt. I persuade, incite, seduce, tempt.

G375 ἀναπέμπω: I send up to a higher tribunal, I send back. I send up (to a higher tribunal), send back.

G376 ἀνάπηρος, ον: crippled, maimed. crippled, maimed.

G377 ἀναπίπτω: I lie down, recline, fall back upon. I lie down, recline (at a dinner-table), fall back upon (the breast of another person reclining at dinner).

G378 ἀναπληρόω: I fill up, make up, fulfill. I fill up, make up, complete the measure of, fulfill, carry out the commands (provisions, etc.) of.

G379 ἀναπολόγητος, ον: indefensible, inexcusable. without (ground of) defense, indefensible, inexcusable.

G380 ἀναπτύσσω: I unroll. I unroll, roll back, unfold.

G381 ἀνάπτω: I kindle, set on fire. I kindle, set on fire, light.

G382 ἀναρίθμητος, ον: uncountable, innumerable. uncountable, innumerable, that cannot be numbered.

G383 ἀνασείω: I shake up, stir up, excite. I shake up, stir up, excite.

G384 ἀνασκευάζω: I pervert, unsettle, destroy. I pervert, subvert, dismantle, unsettle, overthrow, destroy.

G385 ἀνασπάω: I drag up, pull up. I drag up, pull up, draw up, draw out.

G386 ἀνάστασις, εως, ἡ: a rising again, resurrection. a rising again, resurrection.

G387 ἀναστατόω: I turn upside down, upset, unsettle. (perhaps a political metaphor), I turn upside down, upset, unsettle.

G388 ἀνασταυρόω: I crucify again. I impede, crucify (again).

G389 ἀναστενάζω: I groan or sigh deeply. I groan or sigh deeply.

G390 ἀναστρέφω: I overturn, turn upside down, return, mid. and pass: I conduct myself, live. I overturn; I turn back, return; I turn hither and thither; pass: I turn myself about; I sojourn, dwell; I conduct myself, behave, live.

G391 ἀναστροφή, ῆς, ἡ: behavior, manner of life. dealing with other men, conduct, life, behavior, manner of life.

G392 ἀνατάσσομαι: I arrange, draw up, compose. I arrange, draw up, compose, but perhaps: I set down from memory, restore from memory.

G393 ἀνατέλλω: I make to rise, I rise, shine. I make to rise, I rise, shine (generally of the sun, and hence met.).

G394 ἀνατίθημι: I lay a case before, impart, communicate, relate. I lay (a case) before, impart, communicate, declare, relate (with a view to consulting).

G395 ἀνατολή, ῆς, ἡ: rising of the sun, the East. (a) rising of the sun, hence (b) (sing. and plur.) the quarter whence the sun rises, the East.

G396 ἀνατρέπω: I subvert, overturn, overthrow. I overturn (lit. or met.), subvert, overthrow, corrupt.

G397 ἀνατρέφω: I rear, bring up. I rear, bring up, nourish, educate.

G398 ἀναφαίνω: I sight, I appear. (a) a nautical term: I sight (a place), (b) mid: I appear (as it were, out of the unseen), (c) I bring to light, make to appear.

G399 ἀναφέρω: I carry up, lead up, offer up. (a) I carry up, lead up, (b) I offer up (on a high altar) as a sacrifice, offer up to God on high.

G400 ἀναφωνέω: I call out, shout. I call out, shout, exclaim.

G401 ἀνάχυσις, εως, ἡ: outpouring, excess. outpouring, excess, overflow, a pouring out.

G402 ἀναχωρέω: I return, retire, depart, withdraw. I return, retire, withdraw, depart (underlying idea perhaps of taking refuge from danger or of going into retirement).

G403 ἀνάψυξις, εως, ἡ: refreshing, refreshment. a refreshing, refreshment.

G404 ἀναψύχω: I refresh, revive, comfort. I refresh, revive, comfort.

G405 ἀνδραποδιστής, οῦ, ὁ: an enslaver, a kidnapper. an enslaver, one who forcibly enslaves, a kidnapper.

G406 Ἀνδρέας, ου, ὁ: Andrew. Andrew, brother of Simon Peter, and one of the apostles of Jesus, belonging to Bethsaida.

G407 ἀνδρίζομαι: I act like a man, am brave. I act like a man, am brave.

G408 Ἀνδρόνικος, ου, ὁ: Andronicus. Andronicus, a member of the Roman church, and a kinsman or fellow-tribesman of Paul.

G409 ἀνδροφόνος, ου, ὁ: a murderer. a murderer, man-slayer.

G410 ἀνέγκλητος, ον: irreproachable, blameless. irreproachable, blameless.

G411 ἀνεκδιήγητος, ον: indescribable, that cannot be thoroughly related. indescribable, that cannot be thoroughly related, inexpressible.

G412 ἀνεκλάλητος, ον: unspeakable. unspeakable.

G413 ἀνέκλειπτος, ον: unfailing. unfailing.

G414 ἀνεκτός, ή, όν: endurable, tolerable. endurable, tolerable.

G415 ἀνελεήμων, ον: without compassion, cruel. unpitying, unmerciful, without compassion, cruel.

G416 ἀνεμίζω: I am blown with the wind. I am blown with the wind (referring to the gentler motions of the air).

G417 ἄνεμος, ου, ὁ: the wind. the wind; fig: applied to empty doctrines.

G418 ἀνένδεκτος, ον: impossible. impossible, inadmissible.

G419 ἀνεξερεύνητος, ον: that cannot be searched into, inscrutable. that cannot be searched into, inscrutable, unfathomable.

G420 ἀνεξίκακος, ον: enduring evil, patient of evil. enduring evil, patient of evil, patiently forbearing.

G421 ἀνεξιχνίαστος, ον: incomprehensible. that cannot be explored, incomprehensible.

G422 ἀνεπαίσχυντος, ον: having no cause to be ashamed. having no cause to be ashamed.

G423 ἀνεπίληπτος, ον: irreproachable. irreproachable, never caught doing wrong.

G424 ἀνέρχομαι: I come up, go up. I come up, go up, ascend.

G425 ἄνεσις, εως, ἡ: relief, remission, indulgence, freedom, rest. relief, remission, indulgence, freedom, rest.

G426 ἀνετάζω: I examine judicially. I examine (a person on trial, a witness) judicially (frequently by the aid of torture).

G427 ἄνευ: without, without the cooperation or knowledge of. without, without the cooperation (or knowledge) of.

G428 ἀνεύθετος, ον: unsuitable, inconvenient. unfitted, unsuitable, inconvenient, not well placed.

G429 ἀνευρίσκω: I find by seeking out. I find by seeking out, discover.

G430 ἀνέχομαι: I endure, bear with. I endure, bear with, have patience with, suffer, admit, persist.

G431 ἀνεψιός, οῦ, ὁ: a cousin. a cousin, nephew.

G432 ἄνηθον, ου, τό: anise, dill. anise, dill.

G433 ἀνήκω: is due, becoming, suitable, proper. is due, becoming, suitable, proper.

G434 ἀνήμερος, ον: not tame, fierce. not tame, fierce, savage.

G435 ἀνήρ, ἀνδρός, ὁ: a male human being, a man. a male human being; a man, husband.

G436 ἀνθίστημι: I take a stand against, oppose, resist. I set against; I withstand, resist, oppose.

G437 ἀνθομολογέομαι: I confess, give thanks to. I make a mutual agreement; I confess, acknowledge, formally admit, give thanks to.

G438 ἄνθος, ους, τό: bloom, flower. bloom, possibly a reference to the bright flowers, such as poppies (among the grass).

G439 ἀνθρακιά, ᾶς, ἡ: a heap of burning coals. a coal-fire, a heap of burning coals.

title: Dodson Greek-English Lexicon of the New Testament, G440 to G650
source: Jeffrey Dodson, Greek-English Lexicon of the New Testament (public domain), data prepared by Ulrik Sandborg-Petersen. Each entry: Strong number, Greek word, short meaning, fuller meaning.
body:
G440 ἄνθραξ, ακος, ὁ: a coal. coal, charcoal, a burning coal.

G441 ἀνθρωπάρεσκος, ον: desirous of pleasing men. desirous of pleasing men, a renderer of service to human beings (as opposed to God).

G442 ἀνθρώπινος, η, ον: belonging to human beings, human. belonging to human beings (especially as contrasted with God), human (as contrasted with divine).

G443 ἀνθρωποκτόνος, ου, ὁ: a murderer. a murderer, man-slayer.

G444 ἄνθρωπος, ου, ὁ: a man, one of the human race. a man, one of the human race.

G445 ἀνθυπατεύω: to act as proconsul, be a deputy. to act as proconsul, be a deputy.

G446 ἀνθύπατος, ου, ὁ: a proconsul. a proconsul.

G447 ἀνίημι: I let go, loosen, release, give up, neglect. I send up, produce, send back; I let go; I relax, loosen, hence met: I give up, desist from.

G448 ἀνέλεος, ον: without mercy. without mercy, merciless.

G449 ἄνιπτος, ον: unwashed. unwashed, ceremonially unclean.

G450 ἀνίστημι: I raise up, set up, rise from. I raise up, set up; I rise from among (the) dead; I arise, appear.

G451 Ἅννα, ας, ἡ: Anna. Anna, a prophetess, who visited the infant Jesus.

G452 Ἄννας, α, ὁ: Annas. Annas, high priest at Jerusalem.

G453 ἀνόητος, ον: foolish, thoughtless. foolish, thoughtless.

G454 ἄνοια, ας, ἡ: folly, madness. folly, madness, foolishness.

G455 ἀνοίγω: I open. I open.

G456 ἀνοικοδομέω: I rebuild, build up, build. I rebuild, build up (what has fallen or been razed to the ground), sometimes merely: I build.

G457 ἄνοιξις, εως, ἡ: the act of opening. the act of opening.

G458 ἀνομία, ας, ἡ: lawlessness, iniquity. lawlessness, iniquity, disobedience, sin.

G459 ἄνομος, ον: lawless, sinful, illegal. lawless, wicked, without law.

G460 ἀνόμως: without law. without law, lawlessly.

G461 ἀνορθόω: I make straight again, rear again, restore. I make upright (straight) again, rear again, restore.

G462 ἀνόσιος, ον: regarding nothing as holy. unholy, profane.

G463 ἀνοχή, ῆς, ἡ: forbearance. forbearance, suspense or delay (of punishment), patience.

G464 ἀνταγωνίζομαι: I resist, strive against. I resist, strive against, contend.

G465 ἀντάλλαγμα, ατος, τό: an exchange, purchasing price. an exchange, purchasing price.

G466 ἀνταναπληρόω: I fill up in place of someone else. I fill up in place of someone else, complete, supply.

G467 ἀνταποδίδωμι: I give in return. I give in return, recompense.

G468 ἀνταπόδομα, ατος, τό: a gift in return, a return, a recompense. a gift in return (for another), a return, recompense, requital.

G469 ἀνταπόδοσις, εως, ἡ: a reward, recompense. a reward, recompense.

G470 ἀνταποκρίνομαι: I contradict. I contradict, reply against, give a hostile answer.

G471 ἀντεῖπον: I speak or say in opposition, I contradict. I speak or say in opposition, contradict (oppose, resist).

G472 ἀντέχομαι: I hold fast to. trans: I hold against; intrans: I withstand; mid: I hold out against, hold firmly to, cleave to.

G473 ἀντί: instead of, for. (a) instead of, in return for, over against, opposite, in exchange for, as a substitute for, (b) on my behalf, (c) wherefore, because.

G474 ἀντιβάλλω: I throw at in opposition, exchange words with. I throw at in opposition, exchange (words) with, perhaps: I compare.

G475 ἀντιδιατίθεμαι: I oppose. I set myself against, oppose.

G476 ἀντίδικος, ου, ὁ: an opponent, adversary. an opponent (at law), an adversary.

G477 ἀντίθεσις, εως, ἡ: opposition. a proposition, tenet, opinion advanced by one party against another; opposition.

G478 ἀντικαθίστημι: I resist. I resist, supersede, replace, oppose.

G479 ἀντικαλέω: I invite in return. I invite in return.

G480 ἀντίκειμαι: I resist, oppose. I resist, oppose, withstand, lie opposite to.

G481 ἀντικρύ: right opposite, over against. right opposite, off (nautical sense), over against.

G482 ἀντιλαμβάνομαι: I take hold of, help, share in. I take hold of, help, share in, partake of, enjoy.

G483 ἀντιλέγω: I speak or say in opposition, contradict. I speak or say in opposition, contradict (oppose, resist).

G484 ἀντίληψις, εως, ἡ: help, ministration. help, ministration; one who aids.

G485 ἀντιλογία, ας, ἡ: contradiction, contention, rebellion. contradiction, contention, rebellion.

G486 ἀντιλοιδορέω: I abuse in return, give abuse for abuse. I abuse in return, give abuse for abuse.

G487 ἀντίλυτρον, ου, τό: a ransom. a ransom.

G488 ἀντιμετρέω: I measure in return, give equivalent measure. I measure in return, give equivalent measure.

G489 ἀντιμισθία, ας, ἡ: a reward, recompense. a reward, recompense, retribution.

G490 Ἀντιόχεια, ας, ἡ: Antioch. Antioch, (a) Antioch on the river Orontes, capital of the Province Syria, (b) "Pisidian" Antioch, not in Pisidia, but near Pisidia, in the Roman Province Galatia.

G491 Ἀντιοχεύς, έως, ὁ: an Antiochian. an Antiochian, an inhabitant of Antioch.

G492 ἀντιπαρέρχομαι: I pass opposite. I pass opposite, on the opposite side of the road.

G493 Ἀντίπας, α, ὁ: Antipas. Antipas, a Christian martyr of Pergamum.

G494 Ἀντιπατρίς, ίδος, ἡ: Antipatris. Antipatris, a town, where was a Roman colony, on the road between Caesarea and Jerusalem.

G495 ἀντιπέραν: on the opposite side or shore. on the opposite side or shore.

G496 ἀντιπίπτω: I fall foul of, resist, oppose. I resist, oppose, fall against or upon.

G497 ἀντιστρατεύομαι: I campaign against, war against. I campaign against, war against.

G498 ἀντιτάσσομαι: I set myself against, resist. I set myself against, resist (the attack of).

G499 ἀντίτυπος, ον: typical of, representing by type or pattern. typical of, representing by type (or pattern), corresponding to, an image.

G500 ἀντίχριστος, ου, ὁ: antichrist. antichrist, either one who puts himself in the place of, or the enemy (opponent) of the Messiah.

G501 ἀντλέω: I draw, draw out. I draw (generally water from a deep well in the ground); perhaps: I draw out.

G502 ἄντλημα, ατος, τό: a pail. what is drawn; a vessel or bucket to draw with.

G503 ἀντοφθαλμέω: I face, resist. I face (lit: "I present my eye to"), resist, withstand; as nautical term: I bear up against the wind.

G504 ἄνυδρος, ον: without water, dry. without water, dry; subst: dry places, desert.

G505 ἀνυπόκριτος, ον: unfeigned, without hypocrisy. unfeigned, without hypocrisy, sincere.

G506 ἀνυπότακτος, ον: unruly. not subject to rule, unruly.

G507 ἄνω: up, above, things above, heaven. up, above, up to the top, up to the brim, things above, heaven, the heavenly region.

G508 ἀνώγεον, ου, τό: an upper room. an upper room.

G509 ἄνωθεν: from above, from the beginning, again. (a) from above, from heaven, (b) from the beginning, from their origin (source), from of old, (c) again, anew.

G510 ἀνωτερικός, ή, όν: upper, higher-lying. upper, higher-lying, inland.

G511 ἀνώτερον: higher, to a more honorable place, previously, above. higher, to a more honorable place (at the dinner table); previously, in an earlier passage (or a book), above.

G512 ἀνωφελής, ές: useless, unprofitable. useless, unprofitable.

G513 ἀξίνη, ης, ἡ: an axe. an axe.

G514 ἄξιος, ία, ιον: worthy, worthy of, deserving. worthy, worthy of, deserving, comparable, suitable.

G515 ἀξιόω: I account or treat as worthy. I account or treat as worthy.

G516 ἀξίως: worthily, in a manner worthy of. worthily, in a manner worthy of.

G517 ἀόρατος, ον: unseen, invisible. unseen, invisible.

G518 ἀπαγγέλλω: I report, bring a report, announce. I report (from one place to another), bring a report, announce, declare.

G519 ἀπάγχω: I choke, strangle. I choke, strangle; mid: I strangle or hang myself.

G520 ἀπάγω: I lead, carry, take away. I lead, carry, take away; met: I am led astray, seduced.

G521 ἀπαίδευτος, ον: untrained, uneducated. untrained, uneducated, showing a want of training or education, ignorant.

G522 ἀπαίρω: I take away, remove. I take away, remove; pass: I am taken away, withdrawn.

G523 ἀπαιτέω: I ask back, ask what is my due. I ask back, ask what is my due, demand back.

G524 ἀπαλγέω: I am past feeling, cease to care, become callous. (lit: I cease to feel [my] pain), am past feeling, cease to care (suggesting sometimes despair, sometimes recklessness), become callous, reckless.

G525 ἀπαλλάσσω: I free from. I free (a person) from (anything), oftener in the middle voice: I am released from, am rid of (a person or thing), depart.

G526 ἀπαλλοτριόομαι: I estrange, alienate. I estrange, alienate; pass: I am alienated from.

G527 ἁπαλός, ή, όν: tender. soft, tender, as a shoot of a tree.

G528 ἀπαντάω: I meet, encounter. I go to meet, meet, encounter.

G529 ἀπάντησις, εως, ἡ: the act of meeting, to meet. the act of meeting, to meet (a phrase seemingly almost technical for the reception of a newly arrived official).

G530 ἅπαξ: once, once for all. once, once for all.

G531 ἀπαράβατος, ον: inviolable, unchangeable. inviolable, unchangeable.

G532 ἀπαρασκεύαστος, ον: unprepared. unprepared.

G533 ἀπαρνέομαι: I deny, disown, disregard. I deny, disown, repudiate (either another person or myself), disregard.

G535 ἀπαρτισμός, οῦ, ὁ: completion, perfection.. 0568

G536 ἀπαρχή, ῆς, ἡ: the first-fruits. the first-fruits, the earliest crop of the year, hence also met., for example, of the earliest converts in a district; there is evidence in favor of rendering in some passages merely by: sacrifice, gift.

G537 ἅπας, ασα, αν: all, the whole. all, the whole, altogether.

G538 ἀπατάω: I deceive, lead into error. I deceive, cheat, lead into error.

G539 ἀπάτη, ης, ἡ: deceit, deception. deceit, deception, deceitfulness, delusion.

G540 ἀπάτωρ, ορος, τό: without father, of unknown father. without (recorded) father, of unknown father.

G541 ἀπαύγασμα, ατος, τό: a light flashing forth, radiation, gleam. a light flashing forth (from), radiation, gleam.

G543 ἀπείθεια, ας, ἡ: willful unbelief, obstinacy, disobedience. willful unbelief, obstinacy, disobedience.

G544 ἀπειθέω: I disobey, rebel, am disloyal. I disobey, rebel, am disloyal, refuse conformity.

G545 ἀπειθής, ές: unbelieving, disobedient. unbelieving, disobedient, who will not be persuaded.

G546 ἀπειλέω: I threaten, forbid by threatening. I threaten, forbid by threatening.

G547 ἀπειλή, ῆς, ἡ: a threatening, threat. a threatening, threat.

G548 ἄπειμι: I am absent. I am absent.

G549 ἄπειμι: I go away, depart. I go away, depart.

G550 ἀπεῖπον: I renounce, disown. I renounce, disown, forbid, refuse.

G551 ἀπείραστος, ον: untried, inexperienced, incapable of being tempted. untried, inexperienced, untempted, incapable of being tempted.

G552 ἄπειρος, ον: inexperienced, unskillful. inexperienced, unskillful, ignorant.

G553 ἀπεκδέχομαι: I expect eagerly, wait for eagerly. I expect eagerly, wait for eagerly, look for.

G554 ἀπεκδύομαι: I strip, divest, renounce. I strip, divest, renounce.

G555 ἀπέκδυσις, εως, ἡ: a putting off, casting off. a putting off (as of a garment), a casting off.

G556 ἀπελαύνω: I drive away. I drive away.

G557 ἀπελεγμός, οῦ, ὁ: refutation, rejection, disrepute. refutation, rejection, hence: disrepute, contempt.

G558 ἀπελεύθερος, ου, ὁ: a freedman. a freedman, one who has been a slave but has been manumitted by his master.

G559 Ἀπελλῆς, οῦ, ὁ: Apelles. Apelles, a Christian (man) in Rome.

G560 ἀπελπίζω: I despair. I give up in despair, despair of; I hope to receive from or in return.

G561 ἀπέναντι: over against, opposite, in view of, in the presence of. against, over against, opposite, in view of, in the presence of.

G562 ἀπέραντος, ον: unaccomplished, unending, endless. unaccomplished, unending, endless.

G563 ἀπερισπάστως: without distraction, without being distracted. without distraction, without being distracted.

G564 ἀπερίτμητος, ον: uncircumcised, unclean. uncircumcised.

G565 ἀπέρχομαι: I come or go away from, depart, return. I come or go away from, depart, return, arrive, go after, follow.

G567 ἀπέχομαι: I abstain from. I abstain from, keep myself away from.

G568 ἀπέχω: I have in full, am far, it is enough. I have in full, am far, it is enough.

G569 ἀπιστέω: I am unfaithful, I disbelieve. I am unfaithful, disbelieve, refuse belief, prove false.

G570 ἀπιστία, ας, ἡ: unbelief, unfaithfulness, distrust. unbelief, unfaithfulness, distrust.

G571 ἄπιστος, ον: unbelieving, incredulous, unchristian, unbeliever. unbelieving, incredulous, unchristian; sometimes subst: unbeliever.

G572 ἁπλότης, τητος, ἡ: simplicity, sincerity, purity. simplicity, sincerity, purity, graciousness.

G573 ἁπλοῦς, ῆ, οῦν: single, simple, sound. single, simple, sound, perfect.

G574 ἁπλῶς: simply, sincerely. simply, sincerely, graciously, bountifully.

G575 ἀπό: from, away from. from, away from.

G576 ἀποβαίνω: I go or come out of, disembark, result. I go or come out of, disembark, turn out, result, become, happen.

G577 ἀποβάλλω: I throw away from, throw overboard. I throw away from, throw overboard, cast aside.

G578 ἀποβλέπω: I look away from, turn my attention to. I look away from all else at one object, look steadfastly.

G579 ἀπόβλητος, ον: worthy to be cast away, worthless. worthy to be cast away, worthless, regarded as vile.

G580 ἀποβολή, ῆς, ἡ: a casting away, rejection, loss. a casting away, rejection, a loss.

G581 ἀπογίνομαι: I go out of being, cease to be, die. I am away, am removed from, depart life, die.

G582 ἀπογραφή, ῆς, ἡ: an enrollment, census-taking, record. an enrollment, census-taking, record.

G583 ἀπογράφω: I enroll, inscribe in a register. I enroll, inscribe in a register; mid: I give my name for registration (or census-taking).

G584 ἀποδείκνυμι: I show by proof, demonstrate, set forth. I show by proof, demonstrate, set forth, proclaim to an officer.

G585 ἀπόδειξις, εως, ἡ: demonstration, proof. demonstration, proof; a showing off.

G586 ἀποδεκατόω: I take off a tenth part, pay tithe. I take off (deduct) a tenth part (of my property) (and give it away), pay tithe.

G587 ἀπόδεκτος, ον: worthy to be received, acceptable, welcome. worthy to be received (welcomed), acceptable, welcome, pleasant.

G588 ἀποδέχομαι: I receive, welcome, entertain. I receive, welcome, entertain (with hospitality), embrace.

G589 ἀποδημέω: I go into another country. I am away from home, go into another country, am away, am abroad.

G590 ἀπόδημος, ον: away from home. away from home, sojourning in another country.

G591 ἀποδίδωμι: I give back, return, sell. (a) I give back, return, restore, (b) I give, render, as due, (c) mid: I sell.

G592 ἀποδιορίζω: I make a distinction. I make a logical distinction, make an invidious distinction.

G593 ἀποδοκιμάζω: I reject after testing, I disqualify. I reject after testing (examination), disqualify.

G594 ἀποδοχή, ῆς, ἡ: acceptance, appreciation, approbation. (properly: reception, welcome, of guests), acceptance, appreciation, approbation.

G595 ἀπόθεσις, εως, ἡ: a putting off, a laying down. a putting off, a laying down.

G596 ἀποθήκη, ης, ἡ: a repository, granary, barn, storehouse. a repository, granary, barn, storehouse.

G597 ἀποθησαυρίζω: I store up, treasure up. I store up, treasure up.

G598 ἀποθλίβω: I jostle. (lit: I rub), jostle, press hard, crowd.

G599 ἀποθνῄσκω: I am dying, am about to die. I am dying, am about to die, wither, decay.

G600 ἀποκαθίστημι: I restore, give back. I set up again, restore to its original position or condition; hence: I restore, give back.

G601 ἀποκαλύπτω: I uncover, bring to light, reveal. I uncover, bring to light, reveal.

G602 ἀποκάλυψις, εως, ἡ: an unveiling, uncovering, revealing. an unveiling, uncovering, revealing, revelation.

G603 ἀποκαραδοκία, ας, ἡ: eager expectation. eager expectation.

G604 ἀποκαταλλάσσω: I reconcile. I reconcile, change from one state of feeling to another.

G605 ἀποκατάστασις, εως, ἡ: restitution, reestablishment, restoration. restitution, reestablishment, restoration.

G606 ἀπόκειμαι: I have been put away, am stored, am reserved for. I have been put away, am stored, am reserved for.

G607 ἀποκεφαλίζω: I behead. I behead.

G608 ἀποκλείω: I shut. I shut fast, close, shut up.

G609 ἀποκόπτω: I smite, cut off, emasculate. I smite, cut off, cut loose; mid: I emasculate, castrate, mutilate myself.

G610 ἀπόκριμα, ατος, τό: an answer, a judicial decision. an answer, a judicial decision.

G611 ἀποκρίνομαι: I answer, reply. I answer, reply, take up the conversation.

G612 ἀπόκρισις, εως, ἡ: an answer, reply. an answer, reply.

G613 ἀποκρύπτω: I hide away, conceal. I hide away, conceal, keep secret.

G614 ἀπόκρυφος, ον: hidden away, secret. hidden away, secret, stored up.

G615 ἀποκτείνω: I put to death, kill. I put to death, kill; fig: I abolish.

G616 ἀποκυέω: I bring forth, give birth to. I bring forth, give birth to (a child), a medical or physical word, marking the close of pregnancy.

G617 ἀποκυλίω: I roll away. I roll away.

G618 ἀπολαμβάνω: I get back, receive back. (a) I get back, receive back, (b) I get (receive) as due (deserved), (c) mid: I draw aside, separate.

G619 ἀπόλαυσις, εως, ἡ: the faculty or experience of enjoyment. the faculty or experience of enjoyment.

G620 ἀπολείπω: I leave, leave behind, desert, am reserved. I leave, leave behind; pass: I am reserved, remain; I desert, abandon.

G621 ἀπολείχω: I lick off, lick clean. I lick off, lick clean, lick up.

G622 ἀπόλλυμι: I destroy, lose, am perishing. (a) I kill, destroy, (b) I lose, mid: I am perishing (the resultant death being viewed as certain).

G623 Ἀπολλύων, ονος, ὁ: Apollyon, Destroyer. Apollyon, The Destroying One, a Greek translation of the Hebrew: Abaddon.

G624 Ἀπολλωνία, ας, ἡ: Apollonia. Apollonia, a city of Macedonia.

G625 Ἀπολλώς, ώ, ὁ: Apollos. Apollos, a Jew of Alexandria.

G626 ἀπολογέομαι: I give a defense, defend myself. I give a defense, defend myself (especially in a law court): it can take an object of what is said in defense.

G627 ἀπολογία, ας, ἡ: a verbal defense. a verbal defense (particularly in a law court).

G628 ἀπολούω: I wash off, wash away. I wash off, mid: I wash away (my sins, in baptism).

G629 ἀπολύτρωσις, εως, ἡ: redemption, deliverance. release effected by payment of ransom; redemption, deliverance.

G630 ἀπολύω: I release, let go, send away, divorce. I release, let go, send away, divorce, am rid; mid: I depart.

G631 ἀπομάσσω: I wipe off. I wipe off, wipe clean; mid: I wipe myself off.

G632 ἀπονέμω: I apportion, render as due. I assign, apportion, render (as due).

G633 ἀπονίπτω: I wash dirt off. I wash dirt off.

G634 ἀποπίπτω: I fall away from, fall off. I fall away (from), fall off.

G635 ἀποπλανάω: I cause to wander astray, have wandered away. I cause to go astray; pass: I am led astray.

G636 ἀποπλέω: I sail away. I sail away.

G637 ἀποπλύνω: I wash, rinse. I wash, rinse.

G638 ἀποπνίγω: I suffocate, choke, drown, stop the growth of. (a) I suffocate, choke, drown, (b) I stop the growth of.

G639 ἀπορέω: I am in difficulties, am at my wits end. I am at a loss, am perplexed; mid: I am in doubt.

G640 ἀπορία, ας, ἡ: perplexity, anxiety. perplexity, anxiety, doubt.

G641 ἀπορρίπτω: I throw away from, throw overboard. I throw away from, throw overboard.

G642 ἀπορφανίζω: I separate from some one, bereave. I separate from some one, am bereaved.

G643 ἀποσκευάζομαι: I prepare for a journey, depart. I prepare for a journey, depart.

G644 ἀποσκίασμα, ατος, τό: a shadow, a faint image or copy. either a shadow cast by an object, or a faint image or copy of an object.

G645 ἀποσπάω: I wrench away from, drag away, withdraw. lit: I wrench away from, drag away, but perhaps sometimes in the well-attested weakened sense: I am parted or withdrawn.

G646 ἀποστασία, ας, ἡ: defection, apostasy. defection, apostasy, revolt.

G647 ἀποστάσιον, ου, τό: repudiation, divorce. repudiation, divorce; met: bill of divorce.

G648 ἀποστεγάζω: I unroof, take the roof off. I unroof, take the roof off.

G649 ἀποστέλλω: I send forth, send, send away, dismiss. I send forth, send (as a messenger, commission, etc.), send away, dismiss.

G650 ἀποστερέω: I deprive one of something, rob. I defraud, deprive of, despoil; mid: I endure deprivation; pass: I am bereft of.

title: Dodson Greek-English Lexicon of the New Testament, G651 to G872
source: Jeffrey Dodson, Greek-English Lexicon of the New Testament (public domain), data prepared by Ulrik Sandborg-Petersen. Each entry: Strong number, Greek word, short meaning, fuller meaning.
body:
G651 ἀποστολή, ῆς, ἡ: commission, duty of apostle, apostleship. commission, duty of apostle, apostleship.

G652 ἀπόστολος, ου, ὁ: an apostle, a messenger, an envoy, a delegate. a messenger, envoy, delegate, one commissioned by another to represent him in some way, especially a man sent out by Jesus Christ Himself to preach the Gospel; an apostle.

G653 ἀποστοματίζω: I draw out by questioning. I draw out by questioning.

G654 ἀποστρέφω: I turn away, restore, reject. I turn away, pervert, remove; I restore, replace; mid: I desert, reject.

G655 ἀποστυγέω: I detest, abhor. I detest, abhor.

G656 ἀποσυνάγωγος, ον: away from the synagogue, excommunicated. away from the synagogue, expelled from the synagogue, excommunicated.

G657 ἀποτάσσομαι: I withdraw from, take leave of, renounce, send away. I withdraw from, take leave of, renounce, send away.

G658 ἀποτελέω: I complete, accomplish, form fully, perfect. I complete, accomplish, form fully, perfect, bring to maturity.

G659 ἀποτίθημι: I lay off or aside, renounce. I lay off or aside, renounce, stow away, put.

G660 ἀποτινάσσω: I shake off. I shake off.

G661 ἀποτίνω: I repay, pay what is due. I repay, pay what is due (by way of punishment or fine), make good.

G662 ἀποτολμάω: I assume boldness. I assume boldness.

G663 ἀποτομία, ας, ἡ: harshness, severity. (lit: sheerness, of a rock), abruptness, harshness, severity, rigor.

G664 ἀποτόμως: sharply, severely. sharply, severely.

G665 ἀποτρέπω: I turn away from, shun. I turn away from, shun.

G666 ἀπουσία, ας, ἡ: absence. absence, deficiency, waste.

G667 ἀποφέρω: I carry, bear away. I carry, bear away (sometimes with violence).

G668 ἀποφεύγω: I flee from, escape. I flee from, escape.

G669 ἀποφθέγγομαι: I speak out, declare. I speak out, declare.

G670 ἀποφορτίζομαι: I unload, discharge. I unload, discharge.

G671 ἀπόχρησις, εως, ἡ: using up. using up, abuse, misuse.

G672 ἀποχωρέω: I go away, depart. I go away, depart, withdraw.

G673 ἀποχωρίζω: I separate from. I separate from; mid: I part; pass: I am swept aside.

G674 ἀποψύχω: I faint, breathe out life, die. I faint, breathe out life, die, am dismayed.

G675 Ἄππιος, ου, ὁ: Appius. the township Appi Forum on the Appian Way, 43 Roman miles from Rome, was named.

G676 ἀπρόσιτος, ον: unapproachable. unapproachable.

G677 ἀπρόσκοπος, ον: not offending, not causing offence, blameless. (free from hurt or harm, hence) not offending, not causing offence, blameless.

G678 ἀπροσωπολήπτως: impartially. (literary and Jewish), without any preference (undue favor, partiality) for a person.

G679 ἄπταιστος, ον: without stumbling or falling. without stumbling or falling, sure-footed.

G680 ἅπτομαι: I touch or handle. prop: I fasten to; I lay hold of, touch, know carnally.

G681 ἅπτω: I kindle, light. I kindle, light.

G682 Ἀπφία, ας, ἡ: Apphia. Apphia, a Christian lady of Colossae, either wife or sister of Philemon.

G683 ἀπωθέω: I push or thrust away, reject. I push (thrust) away, repulse, reject, refuse.

G684 ἀπώλεια, ας, ἡ: destruction, ruin, loss. destruction, ruin, loss, perishing; eternal ruin.

G685 ἀρά, ᾶς, ἡ: a prayer or prayer for evil, a curse, imprecation. a prayer; more commonly: a prayer for evil, a curse, imprecation.

G686 ἄρα: then, therefore, since. then, therefore, since.

G687 ἆρα: a particle asking a question, expecting a negative response. a particle asking a question, to which a negative answer is expected.

G688 Ἀραβία, ας, ἡ: Arabia. Arabia, the district south of Palestine.

G689 Ἀράμ, ὁ: Ram. Ram, son of Hezron and father of Amminadab.

G690 Ἄραψ, Ἄραβος, ὁ: an Arabian. an Arabian.

G691 ἀργέω: I linger, delay, am idle. I linger, delay, am idle.

G692 ἀργός, ή, όν: idle, lazy, thoughtless. idle, lazy, thoughtless, unprofitable, injurious.

G693 ἀργυροῦς, ᾶ, οῦν: made of silver. made of silver.

G694 ἀργύριον, ου, τό: silver, a shekel, money in general. silver, a piece of silver, a shekel, money in general.

G695 ἀργυροκόπος, ου, ὁ: a silversmith. (lit: silver-cutter), a silversmith.

G696 ἄργυρος, ου, ὁ: silver as a metal. silver as a metal.

G697 Ἄρειος πάγος, ου, ὁ: the Areopagus. Areopagus, or Mar's Hill, an open space on a hill in Athens where the supreme court was held.

G698 Ἀρεοπαγίτης, ου, ὁ: member of the Council of the Areopagus. member of the Council of the Areopagus, an Areopagite.

G699 ἀρέσκεια, ας, ἡ: pleasing, willing service. pleasing, willing service.

G700 ἀρέσκω: I please, serve. I please, with the idea of willing service rendered to others; hence almost: I serve.

G701 ἀρεστός, ή, όν: pleasing, satisfactory, acceptable. pleasing, satisfactory, acceptable.

G702 Ἀρέτας, α, ὁ: Aretas. Aretas IV, King of the Nabataeans.

G703 ἀρετή, ῆς, ἡ: virtue, moral excellence, perfection. goodness, a gracious act, virtue, uprightness.

G704 ἀρήν, ἀρνός, ὁ: a lamb. a lamb, sheep.

G705 ἀριθμέω: I number, count. I number, count.

G706 ἀριθμός, οῦ, ὁ: a number, total. a number, total.

G707 Ἀριμαθαία, ας, ἡ: Arimathea. Arimathea, a place in Palestine.

G708 Ἀρίσταρχος, ου, ὁ: Aristarchus. Aristarchus, a Christian, belonging to Thessalonica in Macedonia.

G709 ἀριστάω: I breakfast, dine. I breakfast, dine.

G710 ἀριστερός, ά, όν: on the left hand. on the left hand.

G711 Ἀριστόβουλος, ου, ὁ: Aristobulus. Aristobulus, a Christian in Rome.

G712 ἄριστον, ου, τό: breakfast or a mid-day meal. breakfast or a mid-day meal.

G713 ἀρκετός, ή, όν: sufficient. sufficient, enough.

G714 ἀρκέω: I am sufficient, I suffice, am content, satisfied. I keep off, assist; I suffice; pass: I am satisfied.

G715 ἄρκος, ου, ὁ, ἡ: a bear. a bear.

G716 ἅρμα, ατος, τό: a chariot. a chariot, vehicle.

G717 Ἁρμαγεδών: Armageddon. Armageddon.

G718 ἁρμόζω: I fit, join. I fit, join; mid: (the middle indicating deep personal interest) I espouse, betroth; mid: I take a wife, give in marriage.

G719 ἁρμός, οῦ, ὁ: a joint of the body. a joint of the body.

G720 ἀρνέομαι: I deny, repudiate. (a) I deny (a statement), (b) I repudiate (a person, or belief).

G721 ἀρνίον, ου, τό: a lamb. (originally: a little lamb, but diminutive force was lost), a lamb.

G722 ἀροτριάω: I plow. I plow.

G723 ἄροτρον, ου, τό: a plow. a plow.

G724 ἁρπαγή, ῆς, ἡ: the act of plundering, plunder, spoil. the act of plundering; plunder, spoil, robbery.

G725 ἁρπαγμός, οῦ, ὁ: spoil, an object of eager desire, a prize. spoil, an object of eager desire, a prize.

G726 ἁρπάζω: I seize, snatch, obtain by robbery. I seize, snatch, obtain by robbery.

G727 ἅρπαξ, αγος, ὁ: rapacious, ravenous, a robber, an extortioner. rapacious, ravenous; a robber, an extortioner.

G728 ἀρραβών, ῶνος, ὁ: an earnest, earnest-money. an earnest, earnest-money, a large part of the payment, given in advance as a security that the whole will be paid afterwards.

G729 ἄραφος, ον: not sewed, seamless. not sewed, seamless.

G730 ἄρσην, ενος, εν: male. male.

G731 ἄρρητος, ον: not to be uttered, secret. not to be uttered (because too sacred), secret, unspeakable, unspoken.

G732 ἄρρωστος, ον: infirm, sick, ill. infirm, sick, ill, feeble, sickly.

G733 ἀρσενοκοίτης, ου, ὁ: a male engaging in same-gender sexual activity. a male engaging in same-gender sexual activity; a sodomite, pederast.

G734 Ἀρτεμᾶς, ᾶ, ὁ: Artemas. Artemas, a Christian in Rome.

G735 Ἄρτεμις, ιδος, ἡ: the Persian or Ephesian Artemis. Artemis, a goddess, worshipped principally at Ephesus, typifying fertility (she had no relation with the other Artemis, the maiden huntress, to whom corresponded the Latin Diana).

G736 ἀρτέμων, ονος, ὁ: a foresail, set on the bow. a foresail, set on the bow.

G737 ἄρτι: now, just now. now, just now, at this moment.

G738 ἀρτιγέννητος, ον: newly begotten, newly born. newly begotten, newly born.

G739 ἄρτιος, ια, ον: perfect, complete. perfect, complete, fitted, ready.

G740 ἄρτος, ου, ὁ: bread, a loaf, food. bread, a loaf, food.

G741 ἀρτύω: I season, flavor. prop: I arrange, make ready; I season, flavor.

G742 Ἀρφαξάδ, ὁ: Arphaxad. Arphaxad, son of Shem, and father of Cainan.

G743 ἀρχάγγελος, ου, ὁ: a ruler of angels, a superior angel, an archangel. a ruler of angels, a superior angel, an archangel.

G744 ἀρχαῖος, αία, αῖον: original, primitive, ancient. original, primitive, ancient.

G745 Ἀρχέλαος, ου, ὁ: Archelaus. Archelaus, Herod Archelaus, son and successor of Herod I, reigned over Judea from 4 B.C. to A.D. 6 and died before A.D. 18.

G746 ἀρχή, ῆς, ἡ: ruler, beginning. (a) rule (kingly or magisterial), (b) plur: in a quasi-personal sense, almost: rulers, magistrates, (c) beginning.

G747 ἀρχηγός, οῦ, ὁ: originator, author, founder. originator, author, founder, prince, leader.

G748 ἀρχιερατικός, ή, όν: high priestly, to which the chief priest belongs. high priestly, to which the chief priest belongs.

G749 ἀρχιερεύς, έως, ὁ: high priest, chief priest. high priest, chief priest.

G750 ἀρχιποίμην, ενος, ὁ: the chief shepherd. the chief shepherd.

G751 Ἄρχιππος, ου, ὁ: Archippus. Archippus, a Christian of Colossae.

G752 ἀρχισυνάγωγος, ου, ὁ: a leader of the synagogue. a leader of the synagogue, a leader connected with the synagogue: sometimes there was only one, and the name was in some cases merely honorary.

G753 ἀρχιτέκτων, ονος, ὁ: master-builder. master-builder, architect.

G754 ἀρχιτελώνης, ου, ὁ: head of a custom-house, chief tax-gatherer. head of a custom-house, chief tax-gatherer or publican.

G755 ἀρχιτρίκλινος, ου, ὁ: master of the feast. master of ceremonies at a dinner, master of the feast.

G756 ἄρχομαι: I begin. I begin.

G757 ἄρχω: I reign, rule. I reign, rule.

G758 ἄρχων, οντος, ὁ: a ruler, prince, leader. a ruler, governor, leader, leading man; with the Jews, an official member (a member of the executive) of the assembly of elders.

G759 ἄρωμα, ατος, τό: spice, perfume. spice, perfume.

G760 Ἀσά, ὁ: Asa. Asa, son of Abijah and father of Jehoshaphat, king of Judah about 900 B.C. for 41 years.

G761 ἀσάλευτος, ον: unshaken, immovable. unshaken, immovable.

G762 ἄσβεστος, ον: inextinguishable, unquenchable. inextinguishable, unquenchable.

G763 ἀσέβεια, ας, ἡ: impiety, irreverence, wickedness. impiety, irreverence, ungodliness, wickedness.

G764 ἀσεβέω: I am impious, irreverent, do impiously. I am ungodly, act profanely.

G765 ἀσεβής, ές: impious, ungodly, wicked. impious, ungodly, wicked.

G766 ἀσέλγεια, ας, ἡ: wantonness, lewdness. (outrageous conduct, conduct shocking to public decency, a wanton violence), wantonness, lewdness.

G767 ἄσημος, ον: undistinguished, obscure. (lit: unmarked, unstamped), undistinguished, obscure, unknown.

G768 Ἀσήρ, ὁ: Asher. Asher, one of the sons of Jacob, and founder of one of the Twelve Tribes.

G769 ἀσθένεια, ας, ἡ: want of strength, weakness, illness. want of strength, weakness, illness, suffering, calamity, frailty.

G770 ἀσθενέω: I am weak, sick. I am weak (physically: then morally), I am sick.

G771 ἀσθένημα, ατος, τό: weakness, infirmity. weakness, infirmity, doubt, hesitation.

G772 ἀσθενής, ές: weak, infirm, sick. (lit: not strong), (a) weak (physically, or morally), (b) infirm, sick.

G773 Ἀσία, ας, ἡ: roughly the western third of Asia Minor. the Roman province of Asia, roughly the western third of Asia Minor.

G774 Ἀσιανός, οῦ, ὁ: belonging to the Roman province Asia. belonging to the Roman province Asia.

G775 Ἀσιάρχης, ου, ὁ: an Asiarch. an Asiarch, an official connected with the worship of Rome and the Emperor in the Roman province Asia.

G776 ἀσιτία, ας, ἡ: abstinence, a fast. either: lack or wheat, lack of food (the literal meaning), or: abstinence from food, a fast, loss of appetite, sea-sickness (the extended meaning).

G777 ἄσιτος, ον: fasting. fasting, without eating.

G778 ἀσκέω: I train, practice, exercise. I train, practice, exercise.

G779 ἀσκός, οῦ, ὁ: a wine-skin. a wine-skin, leather bottle.

G780 ἀσμένως: joyfully, with delight. joyfully, with delight, gladly.

G781 ἄσοφος, ον: unskilled, unwise, foolish. unskilled, unwise, foolish.

G782 ἀσπάζομαι: I greet, salute, pay my respects to. I greet, salute, pay my respects to, welcome.

G783 ἀσπασμός, οῦ, ὁ: a greeting, salutation. a greeting, salutation.

G784 ἄσπιλος, ον: unstained, undefiled. unstained, undefiled, spotless, pure.

G785 ἀσπίς, ίδος, ἡ: an asp. an asp (hooded-snake, cobra).

G786 ἄσπονδος, ον: implacable. implacable, "not to be bound by truce".

G787 ἀσσάριον, ίου, τό: a small coin. a small coin equal to the tenth part of a drachma.

G788 ἆσσον: nearer, close by. nearer, close by.

G789 Ἄσσος, ου, ἡ: Assos. Assos, a port of Mysia, in the Roman province Asia.

G790 ἀστατέω: I am unsettled, have no fixed abode. I am unsettled, have no fixed abode, lead a vagabond life.

G791 ἀστεῖος, α, ον: elegant, pretty, fair, fine, beautiful. (lit: belonging to the city; then: witty, clever), elegant, pretty, fair, fine, beautiful.

G792 ἀστήρ, έρος, ὁ: a star. a star.

G793 ἀστήρικτος, ον: unsteady, unstable. (lit: unpropped), unsteady, unstable, unsettled.

G794 ἄστοργος, ον: unloving, devoid of affection. unloving, devoid of affection.

G795 ἀστοχέω: I miss the mark, miss my aim, make a false aim. I miss the mark, miss my aim, make a false aim, fail.

G796 ἀστραπή, ῆς, ἡ: a flash of lightning, brightness, luster. a flash of lightning, brightness, luster.

G797 ἀστράπτω: I flash, am lustrous. I flash (with, then like, lightning), am lustrous.

G798 ἄστρον, ου, τό: a star. a star.

G799 Ἀσύγκριτος, ου, ὁ: Asyncritus. Asyncritus, a Christian in Rome.

G800 ἀσύμφωνος, ον: dissonant, discordant. dissonant, discordant; met: at variance.

G801 ἀσύνετος, ον: unintelligent, unwise, undiscerning. unintelligent, without wisdom, unwise, undiscerning (implying probably moral defect).

G802 ἀσύνθετος, ον: untrue to an agreement, treacherous. not covenanting, untrue to an agreement, treacherous.

G803 ἀσφάλεια, ας, ἡ: safety, security, reliability. safety, security, reliability, firmness.

G804 ἀσφαλής, ές: safe, reliable, trustworthy. (lit: unfailing), safe, reliable, trustworthy, certain, sure.

G805 ἀσφαλίζω: I make safe. I make safe (secure, fast).

G806 ἀσφαλῶς: safely, securely, assuredly. safely, securely, assuredly, certainly.

G807 ἀσχημονέω: I act improperly, unseemly. I act improperly, am unseemly, behave unbecomingly (or even dishonorably); perhaps: I consider (something) unseemly.

G808 ἀσχημοσύνη, ῆς, ἡ: unseemliness, shame, nakedness. unseemly behavior, unseemliness, indecency, shame, nakedness, an indecent (lewd) act.

G809 ἀσχήμων, ον: unseemly, indecent. unseemly, indecent.

G810 ἀσωτία, ας, ἡ: wantonness, profligacy. wantonness, profligacy, wastefulness.

G811 ἀσώτως: prodigally, with prodigal living. prodigally, with prodigal living, wastefully.

G812 ἀτακτέω: I behave disorderly. (lit: I march out of order; then: I riot, rebel), behave disorderly, neglect my duty, am careless (or idle) in habits.

G813 ἄτακτος, ον: disorderly, slack. (lit: out of order), disorderly, slack (in performance of duty).

G814 ἀτάκτως: in a disorderly manner. in a disorderly manner, irregularly.

G815 ἄτεκνος, ον: childless. childless.

G816 ἀτενίζω: I direct my gaze, look steadily. I direct my gaze, look steadily.

G817 ἄτερ: apart from, without. apart from, without.

G818 ἀτιμάζω: I disgrace, dishonor. I disgrace, treat disgracefully, dishonor, insult; I despise.

G819 ἀτιμία, ας, ἡ: disgrace, dishonor. disgrace, dishonor; a dishonorable use.

G820 ἄτιμος, ον: without honor, despised. without honor, despised.

G821 ἀτιμόω: I dishonor, treat shamefully. I dishonor, treat shamefully.

G822 ἀτμίς, ίδος, ἡ: breath, steam, vapor. breath, steam, vapor.

G823 ἄτομος, ον: an indivisible part of time, a moment. (lit: that cannot be cut), an indivisible part of time, a moment.

G824 ἄτοπος, ον: improper, unrighteous, perverse. (lit: out of place, unusual, unbecoming), improper, unrighteous, perverse.

G825 Ἀττάλεια, ας, ἡ: Attalia. Attalia, the port of Perga in Pamphylia.

G826 αὐγάζω: I shine forth. I flash, gleam, shine forth, appear white, bright; but perhaps: I see, see clearly, discern.

G827 αὐγή, ῆς, ἡ: light of day. brightness, daylight, dawn.

G828 Αὐγούστος, ου, ὁ: Augustus. Augustus, a title conferred on the first Roman Emperor, C. Iulius Octauianus, denoting sanctity (almost divinity).

G829 αὐθάδης, ες: self-satisfied, arrogant. self-satisfied, arrogant, stubborn.

G830 αὐθαίρετος, ον: of one's own accord. of one's own accord, self-chosen.

G831 αὐθεντέω: I domineer over. I domineer, govern, have mastery over.

G832 αὐλέω: I play the flute, pipe. I play the flute, pipe.

G833 αὐλή, ῆς, ἡ: court-yard, fore-court, palace, house. court-yard, fore-court, sheep-fold; but it may be understood as: palace, house.

G834 αὐλητής, οῦ, ὁ: a flute-player. a flute-player.

G835 αὐλίζομαι: I lodge, pass the night. I lodge in the open, lodge, pass the night.

G836 αὐλός, οῦ, ὁ: a flute, pipe. a flute, pipe.

G837 αὐξάνω: I cause to increase, become greater, grow. (a) I cause to increase, become greater (b) I increase, grow.

G838 αὔξησις, εως, ἡ: increasing, increase, growth. increasing, increase, growth.

G839 αὔριον: tomorrow. tomorrow.

G840 αὐστηρός, ά, όν: grim, severe, strict, exacting. grim, severe, strict, exacting, harsh, rigid.

G841 αὐτάρκεια, ας, ἡ: self-sufficiency, independence. self-sufficiency, independence, contentment.

G842 αὐτάρκης, ες: self-sufficient, contented, satisfied. self-sufficient, contented, satisfied, independent.

G843 αὐτοκατάκριτος, ον: self-condemned. (perhaps a new coinage), self-condemned.

G844 αὐτόματος, η, ον: of its own accord. of its own accord.

G845 αὐτόπτης, ου, ὁ: an eye-witness. an eye-witness.

G846 αὐτός, αὐτή, αὐτό: he, she, it, they, them, same. he, she, it, they, them, same.

G847 αὐτοῦ: here, there. here, there.

G849 αὐτόχειρ, ρος, ὁ: with one's own hand. with one's own hand.

G850 αὐχμηρός, ά, όν: dingy, dusky, obscure, dark, funereal. (poetical, lit: dry and parched; then: squalid and rough), dingy, murky, obscure, dark, funereal.

G851 ἀφαιρέω: I take away, smite off. I take away, smite off.

G852 ἀφανής, ές: invisible. invisible, unseen, hidden.

G853 ἀφανίζω: I cause to disappear, I hide, remove, disfigure. I cause to disappear, hide, remove; I disfigure (probably by leaving unwashed for a long period), destroy.

G854 ἀφανισμός, οῦ, ὁ: disappearing, disappearance. disappearing, disappearance, obliteration.

G855 ἄφαντος, ον: disappearing, invisible, hidden. disappearing, invisible, hidden.

G856 ἀφεδρών, ῶνος, ὁ: a drain, latrine. a drain, latrine.

G857 ἀφειδία, ας, ἡ: severity. severity, severe treatment.

G858 ἀφελότης, τητος, ἡ: simplicity, sincerity. simplicity, sincerity.

G859 ἄφεσις, εως, ἡ: deliverance, pardon, complete forgiveness. a sending away, a letting go, a release, pardon, complete forgiveness.

G860 ἁφή, ῆς, ἡ: a band, fastening, a ligament. a band, fastening (hence, possibly: a ligament), joint.

G861 ἀφθαρσία, ας, ἡ: indestructibility, incorruptibility, immortality. indestructibility, incorruptibility; hence: immortality.
