G862 ἄφθαρτος, ον: imperishable, incorruptible. indestructible, imperishable, incorruptible; hence: immortal.

G863 ἀφίημι: I send away, release, remit, forgive, permit. (a) I send away, (b) I let go, release, permit to depart, (c) I remit, forgive, (d) I permit, suffer.

G864 ἀφικνέομαι: I arrive at, reach. I arrive at, reach, come to.

G865 ἀφιλάγαθος, ον: not loving that which is good. not loving that which is good.

G866 ἀφιλάργυρος, ον: not loving money, not avaricious. not loving money, not avaricious.

G867 ἄφιξις, εως, ἡ: arrival, departure. arrival, departure.

G868 ἀφίστημι: I lead away, seduce, depart, abstain from. I make to stand away, draw away, repel, take up a position away from, withdraw from, leave, abstain from.

G869 ἄφνω: suddenly. suddenly.

G870 ἀφόβως: fearlessly. fearlessly, shamelessly, securely, tranquilly.

G871 ἀφομοιόω: I assimilate, make like to. I assimilate, make like to.

G872 ἀφοράω: I look away from. I look away from (something else) to, see distinctly.

title: Dodson Greek-English Lexicon of the New Testament, G873 to G1108
source: Jeffrey Dodson, Greek-English Lexicon of the New Testament (public domain), data prepared by Ulrik Sandborg-Petersen. Each entry: Strong number, Greek word, short meaning, fuller meaning.
body:
G873 ἀφορίζω: I rail off, separate, place apart. I rail off, separate, place apart.

G874 ἀφορμή, ῆς, ἡ: an occasion, opportunity. (a) a starting, a start, (b) cause, occasion, opportunity.

G875 ἀφρίζω: I foam at the mouth. I foam (at the mouth), froth.

G876 ἀφρός, οῦ, ὁ: foam, froth. foam, froth.

G877 ἀφροσύνη, ῆς, ἡ: want of sense, foolishness. want of sense, foolishness, impiety, wickedness.

G878 ἄφρων, ονος, ον: senseless, foolish, inconsiderate. senseless, foolish, inconsiderate.

G879 ἀφυπνόω: I fall asleep. I fall asleep.

G880 ἄφωνος, ον: soundless, voiceless, speechless, dumb. soundless, voiceless, speechless, dumb.

G881 Ἄχαζ, ὁ: Ahaz. Ahaz, son of Jotham and father of Hezekiah.

G882 Ἀχαϊα, ας, ἡ: Achaia. the Roman Province Achaia, governed by a proconsul, and practically conterminous with modern Greece before 1912.

G883 Ἀχαϊκός, οῦ, ὁ: Achaicus. Achaicus, a Corinthian Christian.

G884 ἀχάριστος, ον: ungrateful. ungrateful, ungracious, unpleasing.

G885 Ἀχείμ, ὁ: Achim. Achim, son of Zadok and father of Eliud.

G886 ἀχειροποίητος, ον: not made by hand, not handmade. not made with hands.

G887 ἀχλύς, ύος, ἡ: a mist, dimness. a mist, dimness, darkening.

G888 ἀχρεῖος, ον: unprofitable, useless, unworthy. unprofitable, useless, unworthy.

G889 ἀχρειόω: I am good for nothing. (lit: I become sour, I turn, of milk), I am good for nothing, render useless; met: I become corrupt.

G890 ἄχρηστος, ον: unprofitable, useless. unprofitable, useless, detrimental.

G891 ἄχρι: as far as, up to, until. as far as, up to, until, during.

G892 ἄχυρον, ου, τό: chaff. chaff.

G893 ἀψευδής, ές: not guilty of falsehood, truthful. not guilty of falsehood, truthful.

G894 ἄψινθος, οῦ, ὁ: wormwood. wormwood.

G895 ἄψυχος, ον: lifeless. lifeless, inanimate.

G896 Βάαλ, ὁ: Baal. Baal, chief deity of the Phoenicians and other Semitic nations.

G897 Βαβυλών, ῶνος, ἡ: Babylon. (a) Babylon, the ancient city on the Euphrates, to which the people of Jerusalem, etc., were transported, (b) hence allegorically of Rome, from the point of view of the Christian people.

G898 βαθμός, οῦ, ὁ: a step, a stage, a position. a step (of a stairway); hence: a stage in a career, a position.

G899 βάθος, ους, τό: depth, a depth, a deep. depth; deep water; met: fullness, immensity; an extreme degree; profundities, deep-laid plans.

G900 βαθύνω: I deepen. I deepen, excavate.

G901 βαθύς, εῖα, ύ: deep, early, profound. deep (lit. and met.); in the depths of the early morning, while still very early; profound.

G902 βαΐον, ου, τό: a palm branch. a palm branch.

G903 Βαλαάμ, ὁ: Balaam. Balaam, son of Beor of Pethor on the Euphrates, a soothsayer in the Old Testament.

G904 Βαλάκ, ὁ: Balak. Balak, son of Zippor, King of Moab.

G905 βαλάντιον, ου, τό: a purse, money-bag. a purse, money-bag.

G906 βάλλω: I cast, throw, rush, put, place, drop. (a) I cast, throw, rush, (b) often, in the weaker sense: I place, put, drop.

G907 βαπτίζω: I dip, submerge, baptize. lit: I dip, submerge, but specifically of ceremonial dipping; I baptize.

G908 βάπτισμα, ατος, τό: the rite or ceremony of baptism. the rite or ceremony of baptism.

G909 βαπτισμός, οῦ, ὁ: dipping, washing. dipping, washing (of a ceremonial character).

G910 βαπτιστής, οῦ, ὁ: the baptizer, the Baptist. the baptizer, the Baptist, epithet used only of John, the son of Zechariah and Elizabeth, forerunner of Jesus.

G911 βάπτω: I dip, dye. (a) I dip, (b) I dye.

G912 Βαραββᾶς, ᾶ, ὁ: Barabbas. Barabbas.

G913 Βαράκ, ὁ: Barak. Barak, one of the judges of Israel.

G914 Βαραχίας, ου, ὁ: Barachiah. Barachiah; his identity is uncertain, perhaps father of the Zechariah killed by the Zealots in the last Jewish War.

G915 βάρβαρος, ου, ὁ: a foreigner who speaks neither Greek nor Latin. a foreigner, one who speaks neither Greek nor Latin; as adj: foreign.

G916 βαρέω: I weight, load, burden. I weight, load, burden, lit. and met.

G917 βαρέως: heavily, with difficulty. heavily, with difficulty.

G918 Βαρθολομαῖος, ου, ὁ: Bartholomew. Bartholomew, surname of Nathanael, one of the twelve apostles of Jesus.

G919 Βαρϊησοῦς, οῦ, ὁ: Bar-Jesus. Bar-Jesus, the name of the magician and false prophet at Paphos in Cyprus; he is also called Elymas.

G920 Βαριωνᾶς, ᾶ, ὁ: Bar-Jonas. Bar-Jonas, son of Jonas, the surname of Simon Peter.

G921 Βαρνάβας, α, ὁ: Barnabas. Barnabas, a Cypriote Jew, uncle of John Mark; his other name was Joseph.

G922 βάρος, ους, τό: a weight, burden. a weight, burden, lit. or met.

G923 Βαρσαββᾶς, ᾶ, ὁ: Barsabbas. Barsabbas, son of Sabbas, a surname of Joseph and Judas.

G924 Βαρτίμαιος, ου, ὁ: Bartimaeus. Bartimaeus, son of (?) Timaeus.

G926 βαρύς, εῖα, ύ: heavy, weighty, burdensome. heavy, weighty, burdensome, lit. and met; violent, oppressive.

G927 βαρύτιμος, ον: of great price. of great price.

G928 βασανίζω: I torment, torture, buffet. I examine, as by torture; I torment; I buffet, as of waves.

G929 βασανισμός, οῦ, ὁ: torture, torment. torture, torment.

G930 βασανιστής, οῦ, ὁ: one who tortures, a tormentor, jailor. one who tortures, a tormentor, jailor.

G931 βάσανος, ου, ἡ: torture, torment. torture, torment, examination by torture.

G932 βασιλεία, ας, ἡ: kingship, sovereignty, authority, rule, kingdom. kingship, sovereignty, authority, rule, especially of God, both in the world, and in the hearts of men; hence: kingdom, in the concrete sense.

G934 βασίλειος, ον: courtiers, palaces, a body of kings, royal. courtiers, palaces, a body of kings, royal.

G935 βασιλεύς, έως, ὁ: a king, ruler, emperor. a king, ruler, but in some passages clearly to be translated: emperor.

G936 βασιλεύω: I rule, reign, reign over. (a) I rule, reign, (b) I reign over.

G937 βασιλικός, ή, όν: connected with a king, royal, regal. connected with a king, royal, regal, (a) an officer in the service of the king, (b) the king's country.

G938 βασίλισσα, ης, ἡ: a queen. a queen.

G939 βάσις, εως, ἡ: the foot. a step; hence: a foot.

G940 βασκαίνω: I give the evil eye to, fascinate, bewitch, overpower. I give the evil eye to, fascinate, bewitch, overpower.

G941 βαστάζω: I carry, carry away, bear. (a) I carry, bear, (b) I carry (take) away.

G942 βάτος, ου, ὁ, ἡ: a thorn bush or bramble. a thorn bush or bramble.

G943 βάτος, ου, ὁ: a "bath," a liquid measure between eight and nine gallons. a "bath," a liquid measure among the Jews, containing 72 sextarii, that is, between eight and nine gallons.

G944 βάτραχος, ου, ὁ: a frog. a frog.

G945 βαττολογέω: I chatter, utter empty words. I chatter, am long-winded, utter empty words, stammer, repeat.

G946 βδέλυγμα, ατος, τό: an abominable thing, an accursed thing. an abominable thing, an accursed thing.

G947 βδελυκτός, ή, όν: abominable, detestable. abominable, detestable.

G948 βδελύσσομαι: I abhor, detest. I abhor, detest, loathe.

G949 βέβαιος, α, ον: firm, steadfast, enduring. firm, steadfast, enduring, sure, certain.

G950 βεβαιόω: I confirm, ratify. I confirm, ratify, secure, establish; pass: I guarantee.

G951 βεβαίωσις, εως, ἡ: confirmation, ratification, establishment. confirmation, ratification, establishment.

G952 βέβηλος, ον: profane, secular, unspiritual, godless, worldly. permitted to be trodden, accessible.

G953 βεβηλόω: I profane. I profane, pollute, violate.

G954 Βεελζεβούλ, ὁ: Beelzebul. Beelzebul, a name of Satan, the chief of evil spirits.

G955 Βελίαρ, ὁ: Beliar. Belial, a demon, and in fact a name for Satan.

G956 βέλος, ους, τό: a missile, dart, javelin. a missile, dart, javelin, arrow.

G957 βελτίων, ον: better. better; adv: very well.

G958 Βενιαμίν, ὁ: Benjamin. Benjamin, youngest son of Jacob, founder of one of the twelve tribes of Israel.

G959 Βερνίκη, ης, ἡ: Bernice. Bernice, daughter of Agrippa I and Kypros, and sister of M. Julius Agrippa II.

G960 Βέροια, ας, ἡ: Berea. Berea, a town of the province Macedonia.

G961 Βεροιαῖος, α, ον: belonging to Berea, Berean. belonging to Berea, Berean.

G963 Βηθανία, ας, ἡ: Bethany. (a) Bethany, the home of Lazarus, Martha, and Mary, near Jerusalem, (b) Bethany, beyond Jordan.

G964 Βηθεσδά, ἡ: Bethesda. Bethesda, name of a pool in Jerusalem.

G965 Βηθλεέμ, ἡ: Bethlehem. Bethlehem, a town of Judea.

G966 Βηθσαϊδά, ἡ: Bethsaida. Bethsaida, (a) a city of Galilee, (b) a city east of the Jordan.

G967 Βηθφαγή, ἡ: Bethphage. Bethphage, a village in the neighborhood of Jerusalem, on the Mt. of Olives.

G968 βῆμα, ατος, τό: the space covered by a step of the foot, a tribunal. an elevated place ascended by steps, a throne, tribunal.

G969 βήρυλλος, ου, ὁ: a beryl. a beryl, a precious stone of various colors, the best known being sea-green.

G970 βία, ας, ἡ: force, violence. force, violence, strength.

G971 βίαζομαι: I use force, violence, suffer violence. (a) mid: I use force, force my way, come forward violently, (b) pass: I am forcibly treated, suffer violence.

G972 βίαιος, α, ον: strong, violent. strong, violent.

G973 βιαστής, οῦ, ὁ: a forceful, violent man. a forceful, violent man; one who is eager in pursuit.

G974 βιβλιδάριον, ου, τό: a little papyrus roll. a little papyrus roll.

G975 βιβλίον, ου, τό: a papyrus roll. a papyrus roll.

G976 βίβλος, ου, ἡ: a written book, roll, or volume. a written book, roll, or volume, sometimes with a sacred connotation.

G977 βιβρώσκω: I eat. I eat.

G978 βιθυνία, ας, ἡ: Bithynia. Bithynia, a Roman province, north-west of Asia Minor and south-west of the Black Sea.

G979 βίος, ου, ὁ: life, manner of life, livelihood. (a) life, (b) manner of life; livelihood.

G980 βιόω: I live, pass my life. I live, pass my life.

G981 βίωσις, εως, ἡ: manner of life. manner of life.

G982 βιωτικός, ή, όν: belonging to ordinary life. belonging to ordinary life, worldly.

G983 βλαβερός, ά, όν: injurious, hurtful. injurious, hurtful.

G984 βλάπτω: I hurt, injure. I hurt, injure.

G985 βλαστάνω: I sprout, cause to sprout, make to grow up. intrans: I sprout; trans: I cause to sprout, make to grow up.

G986 Βλάστος, ου, ὁ: Blastus. Blastus, chamberlain of King Herod Agrippa I.

G987 βλασφημέω: I speak evil against, blaspheme. I speak evil against, blaspheme, use abusive or scurrilous language about (God or men).

G988 βλασφημία, ας, ἡ: abusive or scurrilous language, blasphemy. abusive or scurrilous language, blasphemy.

G989 βλάσφημος, ον: slanderous. slanderous; subst: a blasphemer.

G990 βλέμμα, ατος, τό: look, the faculty of looking. a look, glance; sight and hearing.

G991 βλέπω: I look, see. (primarily physical), I look, see, perceive, discern.

G992 βλητέος, α, ον: that ought to be put. a verbal adj: one must put, that ought to be put.

G993 Βοανεργές: Boanerges. Boanerges, "sons of thunder".

G994 βοάω: I shout, call aloud. I shout, call aloud, proclaim.

G995 βοή, ῆς, ἡ: a shout. a shout, cry.

G996 βοήθεια, ας, ἡ: assistance, a help. (a) abstr: assistance, (b) concr: (a technical term of nautical language), a help.

G997 βοηθέω: I come to the rescue of. I come to the rescue of, come to help, help.

G998 βοηθός, οῦ, ὁ, ἡ: a helper. a helper.

G999 βόθυνος, ου, ὁ: a pit, ditch. a pit, ditch.

G1000 βολή, ῆς, ἡ: a casting, throw. a casting, throw; in acc: as measure of distance.

G1001 βολίζω: I cast the line for sounding, I sound. I cast the line (for sounding), I sound.

G1003 Βοόζ, ὁ: Boaz. Boaz, son of Salmon and Rahab, husband of Ruth, father of Obed.

G1004 βόρβορος, ου, ὁ: mud, mire, filth. mud, mire, filth.

G1005 βορρᾶς, ᾶ, ὁ: the north wind, the North. the north wind, hence: the North.

G1006 βόσκω: I feed. I feed, pasture.

G1007 Βοσόρ, ὁ: Bosor. Bosor, father of Balaam.

G1008 βοτάνη, ῆς, ἡ: fodder, food. fodder, food, herbage.

G1009 βότρυς, υος, ὁ: a cluster of grapes. a cluster (bunch) of grapes.

G1010 βουλευτής, οῦ, ὁ: a member of a city council, of the Sanhedrin. a member of a city council, in NT of the Sanhedrin at Jerusalem.

G1011 βουλεύω: I deliberate, take counsel. I deliberate, take counsel, determine.

G1012 βουλή, ῆς, ἡ: counsel, deliberate wisdom. counsel, deliberate wisdom, decree.

G1013 βούλημα, ατος, τό: will, counsel, purpose. will, counsel, purpose.

G1014 βούλομαι: I will, intend, desire. I will, intend, desire, wish.

G1015 βουνός, οῦ, ὁ: a hillock, hill. a hillock, hill.

G1016 βοῦς, βοός, ὁ: an ox. an ox, cow, bull.

G1017 βραβεῖον, ου, τό: a prize. a prize.

G1018 βραβεύω: I rule, arbitrate. (lit: to act as arbiter in the games), I rule, arbitrate.

G1019 βραδύνω: I am slow, I delay. I am slow, I delay, tarry.

G1020 βραδυπλοέω: I sail slowly. I sail slowly.

G1021 βραδύς, εῖα, ύ: slow. slow, slow of understanding.

G1022 βραδυτής, τῆτος, ἡ: tardiness, slowness. tardiness, slowness, delay.

G1023 βραχίων, ονος, ὁ: the arm, strength. the arm, strength.

G1024 βραχύς, εῖα, ύ: short, little. short, little, few.

G1025 βρέφος, ους, τό: infant, babe. infant, babe, child in arms.

G1026 βρέχω: I moisten, rain, send rain. I moisten, rain, send rain.

G1027 βροντή, ῆς, ἡ: thunder. thunder.

G1028 βροχή, ῆς, ἡ: a heavy rain. a heavy rain.

G1029 βρόχος, ου, ὁ: a noose or snare. a noose or snare; a cord.

G1030 βρυγμός, οῦ, ὁ: a grinding or gnashing. a grinding or gnashing.

G1031 βρύχω: I grind or gnash. I grind or gnash, as with the teeth for rage or pain.

G1032 βρύω: I cause to gush forth, send forth. I cause to gush forth, send forth.

G1033 βρῶμα, ατος, τό: food of any kind. food of any kind.

G1034 βρώσιμος, ον: eatable, suitable for food. eatable, suitable for food.

G1035 βρῶσις, εως, ἡ: eating, food, a meal, rust. (a) abstr: eating, (b) food, a meal, (c) rust.

G1036 βυθίζω: I cause to sink, sink. I cause to sink; mid: I sink, submerge, drown.

G1037 βυθός, οῦ, ὁ: the deep sea. the deep sea, the bottom.

G1038 βυρσεύς, έως, ὁ: a tanner. a tanner.

G1039 βύσσινος, η, ον: of fine linen, cotton. of fine linen, cotton.

G1040 βύσσος, ου, ἡ: fine linen, cotton. fine linen, cotton.

G1041 βωμός, οῦ, ὁ: an altar. an altar, platform; a slightly-elevated spot.

G1042 Γαββαθᾶ, ἡ: Gabbatha. Gabbatha, a sort of paved square, on which the procurator had his judgment seat.

G1043 Γαβριήλ, ὁ: Gabriel. the angel Gabriel, a messenger of God.

G1044 γάγγραινα, ης, ἡ: gangrene, mortification. gangrene, mortification.

G1045 Γάδ, ὁ: Gad. Gad, one of the twelve tribes of Israel.

G1046 Γαδαρηνός, ή, όν: Gadarene, belonging to Gadara. Gadarene, belonging to Gadara (an important Hellenized town, one of the Decapolis, and south-east of the Sea of Galilee).

G1047 γάζα, ης, ἡ: treasure. treasure, treasury.

G1048 Γάζα, ης, ἡ: Gaza. Gaza, an old town in the south of Palestine, on the sea-coast.

G1049 γαζοφυλάκιον, ου, τό: a treasury. a treasury.

G1050 Γάϊος, ου, ὁ: Gaius. Gaius, (a) a Corinthian, (b) a Macedonian, (c) a citizen of Derbe, (d) an Ephesian.

G1051 γάλα, ακτος, τό: milk. milk.

G1052 Γαλάτης, ου, ὁ: a Galatian. a Galatian (meaning any inhabitant of the Roman province Galatia).

G1053 Γαλατία, ας, ἡ: Galatia. Galatia, a large Roman province in central Asia Minor, comprising the districts of Paphlagonia, Pontus Galaticus, Galatia (in the narrower sense, which some still think is intended in the NT), Phrygia Galatica, Lycaonia Galatica, Pisidia and Isaurica.

G1054 Γαλατικός, ή, όν: belonging to the province Galatia. Galatic, belonging to the province Galatia.

G1055 γαλήνη, ης, ἡ: a calm. a calm.

G1056 Γαλιλαία, ας, ἡ: Galilee. Galilee, a district towards the southern end of the Roman province Syria; the northern division of Palestine.

G1057 Γαλιλαῖος, αία, αῖον: a Galilean. a Galilean, an inhabitant of Galilee.

G1058 Γαλλίων, ωνος, ὁ: Gallio. Gallio, Lucius Iunius Gallio, who received this name by adoption into another family, but was born brother of the philosopher Seneca and originally named L. Annaeus Nouatus; proconsul of the Roman province Achaia from spring A.D. 52 to spring 53.

G1059 Γαμαλιήλ, ὁ: Gamaliel. Gamaliel, a noted Pharisee, teacher of Saul.

G1060 γαμέω: I marry. I marry, used of either sex.

G1061 γαμίσκω: I give in marriage. I give in marriage.

G1062 γάμος, ου, ὁ: a marriage, wedding, wedding-feast. a marriage, wedding, wedding-ceremony; plur: a wedding-feast.

G1063 γάρ: for. for.

G1064 γαστήρ, γαστρός, ἡ: the womb, stomach, to be pregnant. the womb, stomach; of a woman: to be with child (lit: to have [a child] in the belly).

G1065 γε: at least, indeed, really. an enclitic, emphasizing particle: at least, indeed, really, but generally too subtle to be represented in English.

G1066 Γεδεών, ὁ: Gideon. Gideon, one of the Judges of Israel.

G1067 γέεννα, ης, ἡ: Gehenna. Gehenna, and originally the name of a valley or cavity near Jerusalem, a place underneath the earth, a place of punishment for evil.

G1068 Γεθσημανῆ, ἡ: Gethsemane. Gethsemane, a small place between the brook Kidron and the Mount of Olives near Jerusalem.

G1069 γείτων, ονος, ὁ, ἡ: a neighbor. a neighbor.

G1070 γελάω: I laugh. I laugh, smile.

G1071 γέλως, ωτος, ὁ: laughter. laughter.

G1072 γεμίζω: I fill, load. I fill, load.

G1073 γέμω: I am full of. I am full of.

G1074 γενεά, ᾶς, ἡ: a generation. a generation; if repeated twice or with another time word, practically indicates infinity of time.

G1075 γενεαλογέω: I put into a genealogy, reckon my descent. I put into a genealogy, reckon my descent.

G1076 γενεαλογία, ας, ἡ: genealogy. genealogy.

G1077 γενέσια, ίων, τά: a birthday celebration. a birthday celebration.

G1078 γένεσις, εως, ἡ: birth, lineage. birth, lineage, descent.

G1079 γενετή, ῆς, ἡ: birth. birth.

G1080 γεννάω: I beget, bring forth, give birth to. I beget (of the male), (of the female) I bring forth, give birth to.

G1081 γέννημα, ατος, τό: offspring, child, fruit. offspring, child, fruit.

G1082 Γεννησαρέτ, ἡ: Gennesaret. Gennesaret, a fertile district by the lake of Tiberias, which was in consequence sometimes called the Lake of Gennesaret.

G1083 γέννησις, εως, ἡ: nativity, birth. nativity, birth.

G1084 γεννητός, ή, όν: begotten, born. begotten, born.

G1085 γένος, ους, τό: offspring, family, race, kind. offspring, family, race, nation, kind.

G1086 Γεργεσηνός, ή, όν: from Gerasene. from Gerasene.

G1087 γερουσία, ας, ἡ: body of elders. the assembly or body of elders.

G1088 γέρων, οντος, ὁ: an old man. an old man.

G1089 γεύομαι: I taste, experience. (a) I taste, (b) I experience.

G1090 γεωργέω: I work the soil, cultivate the earth. I work the soil, cultivate the earth.

G1091 γεώργιον, ου, τό: a tilled field. a tilled field, cultivation, husbandry.

G1092 γεωργός, οῦ, ὁ: a worker of the soil, husbandman, vine-dresser. a worker of the soil, husbandman, farmer, farm-laborer, vine-dresser.

G1093 γῆ, γῆς, ἡ: the earth, soil, land. the earth, soil, land, region, country, inhabitants of a region.

G1094 γῆρας, ρως, τό: old age. old age.

G1095 γηράσκω: I become old, grow old. I become old, grow old.

G1096 γίνομαι: I come into being, am born. I come into being, am born, become, come about, happen.

G1097 γινώσκω: I come to know, learn, realize. I am taking in knowledge, come to know, learn; aor: I ascertained, realized.

G1098 γλεῦκος, ους, τό: sweet wine. the unfermented juice of grapes; hence: sweet new wine.

G1099 γλυκύς, εῖα, ύ: sweet. sweet.

G1100 γλῶσσα, ης, ἡ: the tongue, a language, nation. the tongue, a language, a nation (usually distinguished by their speech).

G1101 γλωσσόκομον, ου, τό: bag, purse, box, chest. (a vernacular word), bag, purse; some prefer to take as: box, chest.

G1102 γναφεύς, έως, ὁ: a fuller, cloth-dresser. a fuller, cloth-dresser.

G1103 γνήσιος, α, ον: real, true, genuine. (lit: born in wedlock), hence: real, true, genuine; with definite article: the true, genuine element.

G1104 γνησίως: truly, genuinely, honorably, sincerely. truly, genuinely, honorably, sincerely.

G1105 γνόφος, ου, ὁ: darkness, gloom. darkness, gloom; a thick cloud.

G1106 γνώμη, ης, ἡ: opinion, counsel, judgment, intention. opinion, counsel, judgment, intention, decree.

G1107 γνωρίζω: I make known, declare, know. I make known, declare, know, discover.

G1108 γνῶσις, εως, ἡ: knowledge, doctrine, wisdom. knowledge, doctrine, wisdom.

title: Dodson Greek-English Lexicon of the New Testament, G1109 to G1335
source: Jeffrey Dodson, Greek-English Lexicon of the New Testament (public domain), data prepared by Ulrik Sandborg-Petersen. Each entry: Strong number, Greek word, short meaning, fuller meaning.
body:
G1109 γνώστης, ου, ὁ: one who knows, an expert. one who knows, an expert.

G1110 γνωστός, ή, όν: known, an acquaintance. known, an acquaintance.

G1111 γογγύζω: I whisper, murmur, grumble. I whisper, murmur, grumble (generally of smoldering discontent).

G1112 γογγυσμός, οῦ, ὁ: murmuring, grumbling. murmuring, grumbling.

G1113 γογγυστής, οῦ, ὁ: a murmurer, grumbler. a murmurer, grumbler.

G1114 γόης, ητος, ὁ: a conjurer, deceiver, imposter. a conjuror, juggler, sorcerer; a tricky (crafty) deceiver, imposter.

G1115 Γολγοθᾶ, ἡ: Golgotha. Golgotha, a knoll outside the wall of Jerusalem.

G1116 Γόμορρα, ας, ἡ: Gomorrah. Gomorrah, one of the destroyed cities on the Dead Sea.

G1117 γόμος, ου, ὁ: a cargo, freight. a cargo, freight.

G1118 γονεύς, έως, ὁ: a parent. a begetter, father; plur: parents.

G1119 γόνυ, ατος, τό: a knee. the knee.

G1120 γονυπετέω: I fall on my knees before, supplicate, entreat. I fall on my knees before (in supplication), supplicate, entreat.

G1121 γράμμα, ατος, τό: a letter, writings, learning. a letter of the alphabet; collectively: written (revelation); (a) a written document, a letter, an epistle, (b) writings, literature, learning.

G1122 γραμματεύς, έως, ὁ: a scribe, town-clerk, man of learning. (a) in Jerusalem, a scribe, one learned in the Jewish Law, a religious teacher, (b) at Ephesus, the town-clerk, the secretary of the city, (c) a man of learning generally.

G1123 γραπτός, ή, όν: written. written.

G1124 γραφή, ῆς, ἡ: a writing, passage of scripture, the scriptures. (a) a writing, (b) a passage of scripture; plur: the scriptures.

G1125 γράφω: I write. I write; pass: it is written, it stands written (in the scriptures).

G1126 γραώδης, ες: belonging to old women, such as old women tell. belonging to old women, such as old women tell.

G1127 γρηγορέω: I am awake, am vigilant, watch. (a) I am awake (in the night), watch, (b) I am watchful, on the alert, vigilant.

G1128 γυμνάζω: I train by physical exercise. I train by physical exercise; hence: train, in the widest sense.

G1129 γυμνασία, ας, ἡ: physical exercise. (physical) exercise, in a wide sense.

G1130 γυμνητεύω: I am poorly clad. I am poorly clad; I am habitually wearing an under-garment only.

G1131 γυμνός, ή, όν: wearing only the under-garment, bare. rarely: stark-naked; generally: wearing only the under-garment; bare, open, manifest; mere.

G1132 γυμνότης, ητος, ἡ: nakedness. nakedness.

G1133 γυναικάριον, ου, τό: a woman, a poor weak woman. a woman, with all a woman's weakness, a poor weak woman, a silly woman.

G1134 γυναικεῖος, α, ον: belonging to woman, of woman. belonging to woman, of woman, female.

G1135 γυνή, αικός, ἡ: a woman, wife, my lady. a woman, wife, my lady.

G1136 Γώγ, ὁ: Gog. Gog, in Ezekiel a king of Magog, a land of the remote north; hence, in Revelation, of a people far remote from Palestine.

G1137 γωνία, ας, ἡ: a corner, a secret place. a corner; met: a secret place.

G1138 Δαυίδ, ὁ: David. David, King of Israel.

G1139 δαιμονίζομαι: I am demon-possessed. I am possessed, am under the power of an evil-spirit or demon.

G1140 δαιμόνιον, ου, τό: an evil-spirit, demon. an evil-spirit, demon; a heathen deity.

G1141 δαιμονιώδης, ες: demon-like. demon-like, such as demons have.

G1142 δαίμων, ονος, ὁ: an evil-spirit, demon. an evil-spirit, demon.

G1143 δάκνω: I bite, backbite, harm seriously. I bite; hence: I backbite, harm seriously.

G1144 δάκρυον, ου, τό: a tear. a tear.

G1145 δακρύω: I shed tears, week. I shed tears, weep.

G1146 δακτύλιος, ου, ὁ: a finger-ring. a finger-ring.

G1147 δάκτυλος, ου, ὁ: a finger. a finger.

G1148 Δαλμανουθά, ἡ: Dalmanutha. Dalmanutha, a town or village near Magdala.

G1149 Δαλματία, ας, ἡ: Dalmatia. Dalmatia, a province of the Roman Empire, east of the Adriatic, a later name for part of what was earlier called Illyricum.

G1150 δαμάζω: I tame, subdue. I tame, subdue, involving obedience and restraint.

G1151 δάμαλις, εως, ἡ: a heifer. a heifer, young cow.

G1152 Δάμαρις, ιδος, ἡ: Damaris. Damaris, an Athenian woman.

G1153 Δαμασκηνός, ή, όν: an inhabitant of Damascus. a Damascene, an inhabitant of Damascus.

G1154 Δαμασκός, οῦ, ἡ: Damascus. Damascus.

G1155 δανείζω: I lend, borrow. I lend; mid: I borrow.

G1156 δάνειον, ου, τό: a loan, debt. a loan, debt.

G1157 δανειστής, οῦ, ὁ: a lender, creditor. a money-lender, creditor.

G1158 Δανιήλ, ὁ: Daniel. Daniel.

G1159 δαπανάω: I spend, bear expense, waste. I spend, bear expense, waste, squander.

G1160 δαπάνη, ης, ἡ: cost, expense. cost, expense.

G1161 δέ: but, on the other hand, and. a weak adversative particle, generally placed second in its clause; but, on the other hand, and.

G1162 δέησις, εως, ἡ: supplication, prayer. supplication, prayer, entreaty.

G1163 δεῖ: it is necessary, inevitable. it is necessary, inevitable; less frequently: it is a duty, what is proper.

G1164 δεῖγμα, ατος, τό: an example, type. an example, type; a thing shown.

G1165 δειγματίζω: I hold up as an example. I hold up as an example, make a show of, expose.

G1166 δείκνυμι: I point out, show. I point out, show, exhibit; met: I teach, demonstrate, make known.

G1167 δειλία, ας, ἡ: cowardice. cowardice, timidity.

G1168 δειλιάω: I shrink, am fearful. I shrink, am fearful, timid, cowardly.

G1169 δειλός, ή, όν: cowardly, timid. cowardly, timid, fearful.

G1170 δεῖνα, ὁ, ἡ, τό: so and so, such a one. so and so, such a one, where the name of the person is known but not used.

G1171 δεινῶς: vehemently, terribly. vehemently, terribly, grievously.

G1172 δειπνέω: I dine. I dine, sup, eat.

G1173 δεῖπνον, ου, τό: a dinner, an afternoon or evening meal. a dinner, an afternoon or evening meal.

G1174 δεισιδαίμων, ον: respectful of what is divine, religious. respectful of what is divine; religious, perhaps, rather than superstitious (the usual meaning).

G1175 δεισιδαιμονία, ας, ἡ: religion in general, superstition. religion in general; in a bad sense: superstition.

G1176 δέκα: ten. ten.

G1177 δεκαδύο: twelve. twelve.

G1178 δεκαπέντε: fifteen. fifteen.

G1179 Δεκάπολις, εως, ἡ: Decapolis. Decapolis, meaning a group or district of ten cities (of the Greek type) in Palestine, mostly south-east of the Lake of Tiberias; the names and number vary in ancient authorities.

G1180 δεκατέσσαρες, ων: fourteen. fourteen.

G1181 δεκάτη, ης, ἡ: a tenth part, a tithe. a tenth part, a tithe.

G1182 δέκατος, η, ον: tenth. tenth.

G1183 δεκατόω: I tithe, collect tithe from. I tithe, collect tithe from.

G1184 δεκτός, ή, όν: acceptable, accepted. acceptable, accepted.

G1185 δελεάζω: I allure, entice by a bait. I allure, entice (by a bait).

G1186 δένδρον, ου, τό: a tree. a tree.

G1187 δεξιόλαβος, ου, ὁ: one posted on the right hand, a spear-man. one posted on the right hand, a spear-man.

G1188 δεξιός, ά, όν: on the right hand, right hand, right. on the right hand, right hand, right.

G1189 δέομαι: I request, beg. I want for myself; I want, need; I beg, request, beseech, pray.

G1190 Δερβαῖος, α, ον: belonging to Derbe. Derbean, belonging to Derbe.

G1191 Δέρβη, ης, ἡ: Derbe. Derbe, a town in Lycaonia and in the southern part of the Roman province Galatia.

G1192 δέρμα, ατος, τό: a hide, skin. the skin or hide of an animal.

G1193 δερμάτινος, η, ον: made of hide, leathern. made of hide, leathern.

G1194 δέρω: I flay, flog, scourge, beat. I flay, flog, scourge, beat.

G1195 δεσμεύω: I bind, put in chains. I bind, put in chains, tie together.

G1196 δεσμέω: I bind. I bind, confine.

G1197 δέσμη, ης, ἡ: a bundle. a bundle.

G1198 δέσμιος, ου, ὁ: one bound, a prisoner. one bound, a prisoner.

G1199 δεσμός, οῦ, ὁ: a bond, chain. a bond, chain, imprisonment; a string or ligament, an impediment, infirmity.

G1200 δεσμοφύλαξ, ακος, ὁ: a keeper of a prison, a jailer. a keeper of a prison, a jailer.

G1201 δεσμωτήριον, ου, τό: a prison. a prison.

G1202 δεσμώτης, ου, ὁ: a prisoner, captive. a prisoner, captive.

G1203 δεσπότης, ου, ὁ: a lord, master, or prince. a lord, master, or prince.

G1204 δεῦρο: come, now, the present. (originally: hither, hence) (a) exclamatory: come, (b) temporal: now, the present.

G1205 δεῦτε: come hither, come, hither. come hither, come, hither, an exclamatory word.

G1206 δευτεραῖος, αία, αῖον: on the second day, on the next day. adj. where English requires an adv., on the second day, on the next day.

G1207 δευτερόπρωτος, ον: second-first. second-first, a word of uncertain meaning.

G1208 δεύτερος, α, ον: second, in the second place, for the second time. second; with the article: in the second place, for the second time.

G1209 δέχομαι: I take, receive, accept, welcome. I take, receive, accept, welcome.

G1210 δέω: I bind. I bind, tie, fasten; I impel, compel; I declare to be prohibited and unlawful.

G1211 δή: so, then, indeed, truly. (a) in a clause expressing demand: so, then, (b) indeed, (c) truly.

G1212 δῆλος, η, ον: clear, manifest, evident. clear, manifest, evident.

G1213 δηλόω: I show, make clear, reveal. I show, make clear, reveal.

G1214 Δημᾶς, ᾶ, ὁ: Demas. Demas, a helper of Paul in Rome.

G1215 δημηγορέω: I make a public speech, address a multitude. I make a public speech, address a multitude.

G1216 Δημήτριος, ου, ὁ: Demetrius. Demetrius, a silversmith of Ephesus.

G1217 δημιουργός, οῦ, ὁ: an artisan, builder. an artisan, builder, maker; one who labors for the public.

G1218 δῆμος, οῦ, ὁ: the people, multitude, rabble. properly: the people, especially citizens of a Greek city in popular assembly, but in NT, multitude, rabble.

G1219 δημόσιος, α, ον: public, publicly. public, publicly.

G1220 δηνάριον, ου, τό: a denarius. a denarius, a small Roman silver coin.

G1221 δήποτε: even at that time, whenever. even at that time, whenever.

G1222 δήπου: of course, indeed. of course, indeed, qualifying and yet strengthening the assertion.

G1223 διά: through, on account of. (a) gen: through, throughout, by the instrumentality of, (b) acc: through, on account of, by reason of, for the sake of, because of.

G1224 διαβαίνω: I cross, pass through. I cross, pass through, step across.

G1225 διαβάλλω: I slander, complain of, accuse. I thrust through, slander, complain of, accuse.

G1226 διαβεβαιόομαι: I assert emphatically. I assert emphatically.

G1227 διαβλέπω: I see through, see clearly. I see through, see clearly.

G1228 διάβολος, ον: slanderous, the Slanderer, the Devil. (adj. used often as a noun), slanderous; with the article: the Slanderer (par excellence), the Devil.

G1229 διαγγέλλω: I announce throughout, spread the news of. I announce throughout (the world), spread the news of, give notice of, teach.

G1230 διαγίνομαι: I pass, elapse time. I pass (of time); I continue through, intervene.

G1231 διαγινώσκω: I know accurately, examine, decide. I know accurately, examine, decide.

G1232 διαγνωρίζω: I tell abroad, make known. I tell abroad, make known.

G1233 διάγνωσις, εως, ἡ: judicial examination, decision. judicial examination, decision; an act of discernment.

G1234 διαγογγύζω: I murmur greatly, continue murmuring. I murmur greatly, continue murmuring.

G1235 διαγρηγορέω: I awake out of sleep, am thoroughly awake. I awake out of sleep, am thoroughly awake.

G1236 διάγω: I spend time, pass time, live. (either trans. or intrans.), I spend time, pass time, live.

G1237 διαδέχομαι: I receive in my turn. I receive in my turn, receive through another.

G1238 διάδημα, ατος, τό: a head-wreath, crown. a head-wreath, crown, diadem.

G1239 διαδίδωμι: I offer here and there, distribute, divide. I offer here and there, distribute, divide, hand over.

G1240 διάδοχος, ου, ὁ: a successor. a successor.

G1241 διαζώννυμι: I gird, tie around. I gird, tie around; mid: I gird round myself.

G1242 διαθήκη, ης, ἡ: a covenant, will, testament. (a) a covenant between two parties, (b) (the ordinary, everyday sense [found a countless number of times in papyri]) a will, testament.

G1243 διαίρεσις, εως, ἡ: division, distribution, difference, distinction. division, distribution, difference, distinction.

G1244 διαιρέω: I divide, distribute. I divide into parts, cut asunder, distribute.

G1245 διακαθαρίζω: I cleanse thoroughly. I cleanse thoroughly.

G1246 διακατελέγχομαι: I utterly refute. I effectively (utterly) refute.

G1247 διακονέω: I wait at table, serve. I wait at table (particularly of a slave who waits on guests); I serve (generally).

G1248 διακονία, ας, ἡ: waiting at table, service, ministration. waiting at table; in a wider sense: service, ministration.

G1249 διάκονος, οῦ, ὁ, ἡ: a waiter, servant, administrator. a waiter, servant; then of any one who performs any service, an administrator.

G1250 διακόσιοι, αι, α: two hundred. two hundred.

G1251 διακούω: I hear throughout, of a judicial hearing. I hear throughout, of a judicial hearing.

G1252 διακρίνω: I distinguish, discern, doubt, hesitate. I separate, distinguish, discern one thing from another; I doubt, hesitate, waver.

G1253 διάκρισις, εως, ἡ: distinguishing, deciding, passing sentence on. distinguishing; hence: deciding, passing sentence on; the act of judgment, discernment.

G1254 διακωλύω: I obstinately prevent, hinder. I obstinately prevent, hinder.

G1255 διαλαλέω: I converse together, talk of. I converse together, talk of; of conversation passing from mouth to mouth.

G1256 διαλέγομαι: I converse, address, preach, lecture. I converse, address, preach, lecture; I argue, reason.

G1257 διαλείπω: I cease, give over, give up. I cease, give over, give up.

G1258 διάλεκτος, ου, ἡ: language, speech. language, speech, conversation, manner of speaking.

G1259 διαλλάσσομαι: I become reconciled to, reconcile myself with. I change, exchange; I reconcile, change enmity for friendship.

G1260 διαλογίζομαι: I reason, debate, consider. I reason (with), debate (with), consider.

G1261 διαλογισμός, οῦ, ὁ: a calculation, reasoning, thought, plotting. a calculation, reasoning, thought, movement of thought, deliberation, plotting.

G1262 διαλύω: I break up, disperse. I break up, disperse, dissolve.

G1263 διαμαρτύρομαι: I give solemn evidence, testify solemnly. I give solemn evidence, testify (declare) solemnly.

G1264 διαμάχομαι: I strive greatly, contend fiercely. I strive greatly, contend fiercely.

G1265 διαμένω: I remain, continue. I remain, continue.

G1266 διαμερίζω: I divide up into parts, break up, distribute. I divide up into parts, break up; I distribute.

G1267 διαμερισμός, οῦ, ὁ: breaking up, discord, hostility. breaking up; discord, hostility.

G1268 διανέμω: I divide into portions, distribute. I divide into portions, distribute; pass: I am spread about.

G1269 διανεύω: I nod continually, beckon. I nod continually, beckon.

G1270 διανόημα, ατος, τό: a reasoning, thought, cogitation. a reasoning, thought, cogitation.

G1271 διάνοια, ας, ἡ: understanding, intellect, mind. understanding, intellect, mind, insight.

G1272 διανοίγω: I open fully. I open fully.

G1273 διανυκτερεύω: I spend the whole night. I spend the whole night.

G1274 διανύω: I finish, complete. I finish, complete, accomplish fully.

G1276 διαπεράω: I cross over. I cross over, pass over.

G1277 διαπλέω: I sail over. I sail over (across).

G1278 διαπονέομαι: I am greatly troubled. I am greatly troubled.

G1279 διαπορεύομαι: I journey through. I journey through (past).

G1280 διαπορέω: I am in trouble, doubt, difficulty. I am in trouble, doubt, difficulty; I am at a loss.

G1281 διαπραγματεύομαι: I gain by business. I gain by business (trading).

G1282 διαπρίω: I cut to the quick. (lit: I saw through), I cut to the quick (with indignation and envy).

G1283 διαρπάζω: I plunder, rob thoroughly. I plunder, rob thoroughly.

G1284 διαρρήσσω: I tear asunder. I tear asunder, burst, rend.

G1285 διασαφέω: I make clear, explain. I make clear, explain fully.

G1286 διασείω: I blackmail, extort from. I blackmail, extort from, intimidate.

G1287 διασκορπίζω: I scatter, winnow, disperse, waste. I scatter, winnow, disperse, waste.

G1288 διασπάω: I tear apart, burst. I tear apart, burst.

G1289 διασπείρω: I scatter like seed. I scatter (like seed), disperse.

G1290 διασπορά, ᾶς, ἡ: dispersion. lit: scattering abroad of seed by the sower, hence: dispersion, used especially of the Jews who had migrated and were scattered over the ancient world.

G1291 διαστέλλομαι: I give a commission, order. I give a commission (instructions), order; I admonish, prohibit.

G1292 διάστημα, ατος, τό: an interval of time. an interval of time, distance.

G1293 διαστολή, ῆς, ἡ: distinction, difference, separation. distinction, difference, separation.

G1294 διαστρέφω: I pervert, corrupt, oppose. I pervert, corrupt, oppose, distort.

G1295 διασώζω: I save, bring safely to. I save (rescue) through (some danger), bring safely to, escaped to.

G1296 διαταγή, ῆς, ἡ: ordaining, ordinance, disposition. ordaining, ordinance, disposition.

G1297 διάταγμα, ατος, τό: a mandate, decree. a mandate, decree, edict.

G1298 διαταράσσω: I trouble greatly, agitate. I trouble greatly, agitate.

G1299 διατάσσω: I give orders to, prescribe. I give orders to, prescribe, arrange.

G1300 διατελέω: I continue. I continue, persevere, finish.

G1301 διατηρέω: I keep safe, hold fast. I keep safe, hold fast.

G1303 διατίθεμαι: I appoint, make. (a) I appoint, make (of a covenant), (b) I make (a will).

G1304 διατρίβω: I tarry, continue, stay. I tarry, continue, stay in a place.

G1305 διατροφή, ῆς, ἡ: nourishment, food. nourishment, food.

G1306 διαυγάζω: I shine through, dawn. I shine through, dawn (of the light coming through the shadows).

G1307 διαυγής, ές: transparent. through which light passes, transparent.

G1308 διαφέρω: I carry through, differ, surpass, excel. (a) trans: I carry through, hither and thither, (b) intrans: I am different, differ, and sometimes: I surpass, excel.

G1309 διαφεύγω: I escape by flight. I escape by flight.

G1310 διαφημίζω: I report, publish abroad. I report, publish abroad.

G1311 διαφθείρω: I destroy, waste, corrupt. I destroy, waste; hence met: I corrupt.

G1312 διαφθορά, ας, ἡ: destruction, decay, corruption. destruction, decay, corruption.

G1313 διάφορος, ον: differing, different, excellent. differing, different; hence: excellent.

G1314 διαφυλάσσω: I guard carefully, protect, defend. I guard carefully, protect, defend.

G1315 διαχειρίζομαι: I lay my hands upon, slay, kill. I lay my hands upon, and so: I slay, kill.

G1316 διαχωρίζομαι: I separate myself from, part from. I separate myself from, part from, go away.

G1317 διδακτικός, ή, όν: able to teach, apt to teach. able to teach, apt to teach.

G1318 διδακτός, ή, όν: taught, instructed. taught, instructed.

G1319 διδασκαλία, ας, ἡ: instruction, teaching. instruction, teaching.

G1320 διδάσκαλος, ου, ὁ: a teacher. a teacher, master.

G1321 διδάσκω: I teach. I teach, direct, admonish.

G1322 διδαχή, ῆς, ἡ: teaching, doctrine. teaching, doctrine, what is taught.

G1323 δίδραχμον, ου, τό: a double-drachma, two drachmae. a double-drachma, two drachmae, a Greek silver coin.

G1324 Δίδυμος, ου, ὁ: the Twin, Didymus, Thomas. the Twin; Didymus, the Greek name equivalent to Thomas.

G1325 δίδωμι: I offer, give. I offer, give; I put, place.

G1326 διεγείρω: I wake out of sleep, I arouse. I wake out of sleep, arouse in general, stir up.

G1327 διέξοδος, ου, ἡ: a public spot in a city. a meeting-place of roads, a public spot in a city.

G1328 διερμηνευτής, ου, ὁ: an interpreter. an interpreter.

G1329 διερμηνεύω: I translate, interpret, explain. I translate, interpret, explain.

G1330 διέρχομαι: I pass through, spread a report. I pass through, spread (as a report).

G1331 διερωτάω: I find by inquiry. I find by inquiry.

G1332 διετής, ές: two years old. two years old, lasting two years.

G1333 διετία, ας, ἡ: two years. a period of two years, two years; according to ancient practice this means any period between one and two years.

G1334 διηγέομαι: I relate in full, describe. I relate in full, describe, narrate.

G1335 διήγησις, εως, ἡ: a narrative. a narrative.

title: Dodson Greek-English Lexicon of the New Testament, G1336 to G1591
source: Jeffrey Dodson, Greek-English Lexicon of the New Testament (public domain), data prepared by Ulrik Sandborg-Petersen. Each entry: Strong number, Greek word, short meaning, fuller meaning.
body:
G1336 διηνεκής, ές: continuous, continually. continuous, continually, unbroken.

G1337 διθάλασσος, ον: between two seas. between two seas, which has sea on both sides.

G1338 διϊκνέομαι: I pass through, pierce. I pass through (to), come through (to), pierce.

G1339 διΐστημι: I put apart, separate, put some distance between. I put apart, separate, put some distance between.

G1340 διϊσχυρίζομαι: I assert emphatically. I assert emphatically, lean upon.

G1341 δικαιοκρισία, ας, ἡ: just judgment. just judging, just judgment.

G1342 δίκαιος, ία, ιον: just, righteous, impartial. just; especially, just in the eyes of God; righteous; the elect (a Jewish idea).

G1343 δικαιοσύνη, ης, ἡ: justice, justness, righteousness. (usually if not always in a Jewish atmosphere), justice, justness, righteousness, righteousness of which God is the source or author, but practically: a divine righteousness.

G1344 δικαιόω: I make righteous, defend the cause of, justify. I make righteous, defend the cause of, plead for the righteousness (innocence) of, acquit, justify; hence: I regard as righteous.

G1345 δικαίωμα, ατος, τό: a thing pronounced to be just. a thing pronounced (by God) to be righteous (just, the right); or the restoration of a criminal, a fresh chance given him; a righteous deed, an instance of perfect righteousness.

G1346 δικαίως: justly, righteously. justly, righteously.

G1347 δικαίωσις, εως, ἡ: acquittal, justification. acquittal, justifying, justification, a process of absolution.

G1348 δικαστής, οῦ, ὁ: a judge. a judge.

G1349 δίκη, ης, ἡ: justice, judicial hearing, punishment. (a) (originally: custom, usage) right, justice, (b) process of law, judicial hearing, (c) execution of sentence, punishment, penalty, (d) justice, vengeance.

G1350 δίκτυον, ου, τό: a fishing-net. a fishing-net.

G1351 δίλογος, ον: double-tongued, deceitful. double-tongued, deceitful.

G1352 διό: wherefore. wherefore, on which account, therefore.

G1353 διοδεύω: I journey through, go about. I journey through, go about.

G1354 Διονύσιος, ου, ὁ: Dionysius. Dionysius, an Athenian.

G1355 διόπερ: wherefore. wherefore (emphatically), for which very reason.

G1356 διοπετής, ές: fallen from the sky. fallen from the sky.

G1357 διόρθωσις, εως, ἡ: improvement, reformation. amendment, improvement, reformation.

G1358 διορύσσω: I dig through, break through. I dig through, break through.

G1359 Διόσκουροι, ων, οἱ: the Dioscuri, Castor and Pollux. the Dioscuri, Castor and Pollux, sons of Zeus and Leda, and patrons of sailors.

G1360 διότι: on this account, because, for. on this account, because, for.

G1361 Διοτρεφής, ους, ὁ: Diotrephes. Diotrephes.

G1362 διπλοῦς, ῆ, οῦν: double, two-fold. double, two-fold.

G1363 διπλόω: I double. I double, render back double.

G1364 δίς: twice. twice, entirely, utterly.

G1365 διστάζω: I waver, doubt. I waver, doubt, hesitate.

G1366 δίστομος, ον: two-edged. (lit: twain-mouthed; hence: of a sword, as a drinker of blood), two-edged.

G1367 δισχίλιοι, αι, α: two thousand. two thousand.

G1368 διϋλίζω: I strain, put through a sieve. I strain, put through a sieve.

G1369 διχάζω: I set at variance, make to be hostile. I cut asunder; met: I set at variance, make to be hostile.

G1370 διχοστασία, ας, ἡ: division, dissension. division, dissension, standing apart.

G1371 διχοτομέω: I cut in two, scourge severely. I cut in two, perhaps: scourge severely.

G1372 διψάω: I thirst for, desire earnestly. I thirst for, desire earnestly.

G1373 δίψος, ους, τό: thirst. thirst.

G1374 δίψυχος, ον: double-minded, wavering. (lit: of two souls, of two selves), double-minded, wavering.

G1375 διωγμός, οῦ, ὁ: persecution. chase, pursuit; persecution.

G1376 διώκτης, ου, ὁ: a persecutor. a persecutor.

G1377 διώκω: I pursue, persecute. I pursue, hence: I persecute.

G1378 δόγμα, ατος, τό: a decree, edict, ordinance. a decree, edict, ordinance.

G1379 δογματίζω: I subject to regulations, decree. I subject to regulations, decree; mid: I subject myself to regulations, am decree-ridden.

G1380 δοκέω: I think, seem, appear, it seems. I think, seem, appear, it seems.

G1381 δοκιμάζω: I put to the test, prove, examine. I put to the test, prove, examine; I distinguish by testing, approve after testing; I am fit.

G1382 δοκιμή, ῆς, ἡ: a trial, proof; tried, approved character. a trial, proof; tried, approved character.

G1383 δοκίμιον, ου, τό: a test, trial, what is genuine. a test, trial, what is genuine.

G1384 δόκιμος, ον: approved, acceptable. approved, acceptable, tried.

G1385 δοκός, οῦ, ἡ: a beam. a beam or spar of timber.

G1386 δόλιος, ία, ιον: treacherous, deceitful. treacherous, deceitful, fraudulent.

G1387 δολιόω: I act deceitfully, deceive. I act deceitfully, deceive, use fraud.

G1388 δόλος, ου, ὁ: deceit, guile, treachery. deceit, guile, treachery.

G1389 δολόω: I adulterate, corrupt. I adulterate, corrupt, ensnare.

G1390 δόμα, ατος, τό: a gift. a gift, present.

G1391 δόξα, ης, ἡ: honor, renown, glory splendor. honor, renown; glory, an especially divine quality, the unspoken manifestation of God, splendor.

G1392 δοξάζω: I glorify, honor, bestow glory on. I glorify, honor, bestow glory on.

G1393 Δορκάς, άδος, ἡ: Dorcas. Dorcas, the Greek name of Tabitha.

G1394 δόσις, εως, ἡ: a giving, gift.. a giving, gift, donation.

G1395 δότης, ου, ὁ: a giver. a giver.

G1396 δουλαγωγέω: I enslave. I bring into subjection, enslave, treat as a slave.

G1397 δουλεία, ας, ἡ: slavery, bondage. slavery, bondage.

G1398 δουλεύω: I am a slave, am subject to, obey. I am a slave, am subject to, obey, am devoted.

G1399 δούλη, ης, ἡ: a female slave, bonds-maid. a female slave, bonds-maid.

G1401 δοῦλος, ου, ὁ: a male slave. (a) (as adj.) enslaved, (b) (as noun) a (male) slave.

G1402 δουλόω: I enslave. I enslave.

G1403 δοχή, ῆς, ἡ: a reception, party. a feast, banquet, reception.

G1404 δράκων, οντος, ὁ: a dragon or huge serpent. a dragon or huge serpent; met: Satan.

G1405 δράσσομαι: I take hold of, grasp. I take hold of, grasp, catch.

G1406 δραχμή, ῆς, ἡ: a drachma. a drachma, a Greek silver coin.

G1407 δρέπανον, ου, τό: a sickle. a sickle, pruning-hook.

G1408 δρόμος, ου, ὁ: a running, course, career. a running, course, career, race.

G1409 Δρούσιλλα, ης, ἡ: Drusilla. Drusilla (born A.D. 39), daughter of Herod Agrippa I.

G1410 δύναμαι: I am powerful, am able. (a) I am powerful, have (the) power, (b) I am able, I can.

G1411 δύναμις, εως, ἡ: might, power, marvelous works. (a) physical power, force, might, ability, efficacy, energy, meaning (b) plur: powerful deeds, deeds showing (physical) power, marvelous works.

G1412 δυναμόω: I empower, fill with power. I empower, fill with power, strengthen.

G1413 δυνάστης, ου, ὁ: a ruler, potentate. (lit: a man who rules by force), a ruler, potentate; also: courtier, member of the court.

G1414 δυνατέω: I am powerful, able. I am powerful, have power, am able, am mighty.

G1415 δυνατός, ή, όν: powerful, able, possible. (a) of persons: powerful, able, (b) of things: possible.

G1416 δύνω: I sink, set. I sink, set (as the sun).

G1417 δύο: two. two.

G1419 δυσβάστακτος, ον: difficult to carry. difficult to carry, oppressive.

G1420 δυσεντερία, ας, ἡ: dysentery. dysentery.

G1421 δυσερμήνευτος, ον: difficult to interpret. difficult to interpret, hard to be understood.

G1422 δύσκολος, ον: difficult. difficult, hard; of persons: hard to please.

G1423 δυσκόλως: with difficulty, hardly. with difficulty, hardly.

G1424 δυσμή, ῆς, ἡ: a setting of the sun, the West. a setting (of the sun), hence: the West.

G1425 δυσνόητος, ον: hard to understand. hard to understand.

G1426 δυσφημία, ας, ἡ: evil report, defamation. evil report, defamation, words of ill omen.

G1427 δώδεκα: twelve. twelve; the usual way in which the Twelve apostles of Jesus are referred to.

G1428 δωδέκατος, η, ον: twelfth. twelfth.

G1429 δωδεκάφυλον, ου, τό: the Twelve Tribes of Israel. the Twelve Tribes (of Israel).

G1430 δῶμα, ατος, τό: the top of the house. the roof (of a house), the top of the house.

G1431 δωρεά, ᾶς, ἡ: a free gift. a (free) gift, a gift (without repayment).

G1432 δωρεάν: as a free gift, without payment, freely. as a free gift, without payment, freely.

G1433 δωρέομαι: I give, grant, donate. I give, grant, donate.

G1434 δώρημα, ατος, τό: a gift, bounty. a gift, bounty.

G1435 δῶρον, ου, τό: a gift, present. a gift, present.

G1436 ἔα: an interjection: ho!. an interjection, Ho! Ah! Ha! It is supposed to imply surprise, fear and indignation.

G1437 ἐάν: if. if.

G1438 ἑαυτοῦ, ῆς, οῦ: himself, herself, itself. himself, herself, itself.

G1439 ἐάω: I allow, permit, leave. I allow, permit, let alone, leave.

G1440 ἑβδομήκοντα: seventy. seventy.

G1441 ἑβδομηκοντάκις: seventy times. seventy times.

G1442 ἕβδομος, η, ον: seventh. seventh.

G1443 Ἕβερ, ὁ: Eber. Eber, father of Peleg and son of Shelah.

G1444 Ἑβραϊκός, ή, όν: Hebrew. Hebrew.

G1445 Ἑβραῖος, ου, ὁ: a Hebrew. a Hebrew, particularly one who speaks Hebrew (Aramaic).

G1446 Ἑβραΐς, ΐδος, ἡ: the Hebrew language, Aramaic. the Hebrew language, or rather: Aramaic.

G1447 Ἑβραϊστί: in the Hebrew or Aramaic dialect. in the Hebrew, or rather, in the Aramaic dialect.

G1448 ἐγγίζω: I come near, approach. trans: I bring near; intrans: I come near, approach.

G1449 ἐγγράφω: I write, inscribe. I write, inscribe.

G1450 ἔγγυος, ου, ὁ, ἡ: a surety, security. a surety, security.

G1451 ἐγγύς: near. near.

G1452 ἐγγύτερον: nearer. nearer.

G1453 ἐγείρω: I wake, arouse, raise up. (a) I wake, arouse, (b) I raise up.

G1454 ἔγερσις, εως, ἡ: a waking up, resurrection. a waking up, resurrection.

G1455 ἐγκάθετος, ου, ὁ, ἡ: a spy. a spy.

G1456 ἐγκαίνια, ίων, τά: a renewal, dedication. a renewal, dedication; the feast of rededication.

G1457 ἐγκαινίζω: I consecrate, dedicate. I consecrate, dedicate, renovate.

G1458 ἐγκαλέω: I bring a charge against, accuse. I bring a charge against, accuse.

G1459 ἐγκαταλείπω: I abandon, desert. I leave in the lurch, abandon (one who is in straits), desert.

G1460 ἐγκατοικέω: I dwell in, among. I dwell in, among.

G1461 ἐγκεντρίζω: I graft in. I graft in, ingraft.

G1462 ἔγκλημα, ατος, τό: an accusation, charge. an accusation, charge.

G1463 ἐγκομβόομαι: I clothe myself. I clothe myself (originally: I tie round in a knot).

G1464 ἐγκοπή, ῆς, ἡ: an impediment, hindrance. an incision, a cutting, break; met: an interruption, a hindrance.

G1465 ἐγκόπτω: I interrupt, hinder. I interrupt, hinder.

G1466 ἐγκράτεια, ας, ἡ: self-mastery, self-control. self-mastery, self-restraint, self-control, continence.

G1467 ἐγκρατεύομαι: I exercise self-control. I exercise self-control, am continent.

G1468 ἐγκρατής, ές: self-controlled. self-controlled.

G1469 ἐγκρίνω: I count among. I count among.

G1470 ἐγκρύπτω: I hide in, mix with. I hide in, mix with.

G1471 ἔγκυος, ον: with child, pregnant. with child, pregnant.

G1472 ἐγχρίω: I rub in, anoint. I rub in, anoint.

G1473 ἐγώ: I. I, the first-person pronoun.

G1474 ἐδαφίζω: I dash to the ground. I dash to the ground, level with the ground.

G1475 ἔδαφος, ους, τό: the base, ground. the base, ground, bottom.

G1476 ἑδραῖος, αία, αῖον: firm, steadfast. sitting, seated; steadfast, firm.

G1477 ἑδραίωμα, ατος, τό: a foundation, stay, support. a foundation, stay, support.

G1478 Ἑζεκίας, ου, ὁ: Hezekiah. Hezekiah, son of Ahaz, father of Manasseh, and king of Judah (727-686 [?] B.C.).

G1479 ἐθελοθρησκεία, ας, ἡ: arbitrary worship. arbitrary worship, self-imposed worship.

G1480 ἐθίζω: I accustom. I accustom.

G1481 ἐθνάρχης, ου, ὁ: an ethnarch, tribal lord. an ethnarch, tribal lord, a subordinate ruler.

G1482 ἐθνικός, ή, όν: pagan, heathen, gentile; a Gentile, non-Jew. pagan, heathen, gentile; subst: a Gentile, non-Jew.

G1483 ἐθνικῶς: in the manner of Gentiles. in the manner of Gentiles, like the rest of the world.

G1484 ἔθνος, ους, τό: a race, people, the Gentiles. a race, people, nation; the nations, heathen world, Gentiles.

G1485 ἔθος, ους, τό: a custom. a custom, habit; an institute, rite.

G1486 εἴωθα: I am accustomed, custom, what was customary. I am accustomed, custom, what was customary.

G1487 εἰ: if. if.

G1489 εἴγε: if indeed, seeing that, unless. if indeed, seeing that, unless.

G1490 εἰ δὲ μήγε: but if not, else, otherwise. but if not, else, otherwise.

G1491 εἶδος, ους, τό: visible form, shape, appearance, kind. visible form, shape, appearance, outward show, kind, species, class.

G1492 οἶδα: I know, remember. I know, remember, appreciate.

G1493 εἰδωλεῖον, ου, τό: a temple for an image. a temple for (containing) an image (an idol).

G1494 εἰδωλόθυτος, ον: sacrificed to an image. (of meat), sacrificed to an image (or an idol).

G1495 εἰδωλολατρεία, ας, ἡ: worship or service of an image. service (worship) of an image (an idol).

G1496 εἰδωλολάτρης, ου, ὁ: a worshipper of an image. a server (worshipper) of an image (an idol).

G1497 εἴδωλον, ου, τό: an idol, false god. an idol, false god.

G1500 εἰκῇ: without purpose, in vain. without a cause, purpose; purposelessly, in vain, for nothing.

G1501 εἴκοσι: twenty. twenty.

G1502 εἴκω: I give way, yield. I give way, yield, submit.

G1503 ἔοικα: I am like, resemble. I am like, resemble.

G1504 εἰκών, όνος, ἡ: an image, likeness, bust. an image, likeness, bust.

G1505 εἰλικρίνεια, ας, ἡ: clearness, sincerity, purity. clearness, sincerity, purity.

G1506 εἰλικρινής, ές: pure, uncontaminated, sincere. (originally: unmixed), pure, uncontaminated, sincere.

G1510 εἰμί: I am, exist. I am, exist.

G1512 εἴπερ: if indeed, if so. if indeed, if so.

G1514 εἰρηνεύω: I am peaceful, keep the peace, am at peace. I am peaceful, keep the peace, am at peace.

G1515 εἰρήνη, ης, ἡ: peace, peace of mind. peace, peace of mind; invocation of peace a common Jewish farewell, in the Hebraistic sense of the health (welfare) of an individual.

G1516 εἰρηνικός, ή, όν: peaceable, disposed to peace. peaceable, disposed to peace, profitable.

G1517 εἰρηνοποιέω: I make peace, reconcile. I make peace, reconcile.

G1518 εἰρηνοποιός, όν: pacific, loving peace, a peace-maker. pacific, loving peace, a peace-maker.

G1519 εἰς: into, in, among, till, for. into, in, unto, to, upon, towards, for, among.

G1520 εἷς, μία, ἕν: one. one.

G1521 εἰσάγω: I lead in, bring in. I lead in, bring in, introduce.

G1522 εἰσακούω: I hear, listen to. I hear, listen to, heed.

G1523 εἰσδέχομαι: I welcome in. I welcome in, admit, receive.

G1524 εἴσειμι: I go in, enter. I go in, enter (originally: I shall go in).

G1525 εἰσέρχομαι: I go in, come in, enter. I go in, come in, enter.

G1528 εἰσκαλέομαι: I call in, invite. I call in (to my house), invite.

G1529 εἴσοδος, ου, ἡ: entering, entrance, entry. (act of) entering, an entrance, entry.

G1530 εἰσπηδάω: I leap into, rush into. I leap into, rush into.

G1531 εἰσπορεύομαι: I journey into, go into. I journey in(to), I go in(to), enter, intervene.

G1532 εἰστρέχω: I run in. I run in, run into.

G1533 εἰσφέρω: I lead into, bring in. I lead into, bring in, announce.

G1534 εἶτα: then, thereafter, next. then, thereafter, next (marking a fresh stage); therefore, then, furthermore.

G1535 εἴτε: and if, whether. and if, whether.

G1537 ἐκ, ἐξ: from out, out from among, from. from out, out from among, from, suggesting from the interior outwards.

G1538 ἕκαστος, η, ον: each, every one. each (of more than two), every one.

G1539 ἑκάστοτε: at every time, always. at every time, always.

G1540 ἑκατόν: one hundred. one hundred.

G1541 ἑκατονταέτης, ες: a hundred years old. a hundred years old.

G1542 ἑκατονταπλασίων, ον: a hundredfold. a hundredfold.

G1543 ἑκατοντάρχης, ου, ὁ: a centurion. a centurion of the Roman army.

G1544 ἐκβάλλω: I throw, cast, put out, banish, bring forth, produce. I throw (cast, put) out; I banish; I bring forth, produce.

G1545 ἔκβασις, εως, ἡ: a way out, escape, result. (a) a way out, escape, (b) result, issue.

G1546 ἐκβολή, ῆς, ἡ: a throwing out, a jettisoning. a throwing out, a jettisoning of cargo to lighten a ship.

G1547 ἐκγαμίζω: I give in marriage, marry. I give in marriage, marry.

G1548 ἐκγαμίσκω: I give in marriage. I give in marriage.

G1549 ἔκγονος, ον: descended, a descendant. descended, subst: a descendant.

G1550 ἐκδαπανάω: I spend completely. I spend (give out) completely, exhaust.

G1551 ἐκδέχομαι: I wait for, expect. I wait for, expect.

G1552 ἔκδηλος, ον: perfectly evident, manifest. perfectly evident, manifest.

G1553 ἐκδημέω: I go abroad, am absent. I go abroad, am absent.

G1554 ἐκδίδωμι: I give out, let, let out for my own advantage. I give out, let; middle: I let out for my own advantage.

G1555 ἐκδιηγέομαι: I narrate at length, declare. I narrate at length, declare.

G1556 ἐκδικέω: I give justice over, defend, avenge, vindicate. I give justice over, defend, avenge, vindicate.

G1557 ἐκδίκησις, εως, ἡ: a defense, vengeance, full punishment. (a) a defense, avenging, vindication, vengeance, (b) full (complete) punishment.

G1558 ἔκδικος, ον: avenging, an avenger. avenging, subst: an avenger (the word occurs frequently in the sense of a special advocate [champion] of a city).

G1559 ἐκδιώκω: I persecute, expel by persecuting. I persecute, expel by persecuting, drive out, vex, harass.

G1560 ἔκδοτος, ον: given up, delivered up. given up, delivered up.

G1561 ἐκδοχή, ῆς, ἡ: a waiting for, expectation. a waiting for, expectation.

G1562 ἐκδύω: I put off, take off, strip off. I put off, take off, strip off, with acc. of person or garment or both.

G1563 ἐκεῖ: there, yonder, thither. (a) there, yonder, in that place, (b) thither, there.

G1564 ἐκεῖθεν: thence, from that place. thence, from that place.

G1565 ἐκεῖνος, η, ο: that, that one there, yonder. that, that one there, yonder.

G1566 ἐκεῖσε: thither, there. thither, there, at that place.

G1567 ἐκζητέω: I seek out, require. I seek out, seek out after, require.

G1568 ἐκθαμβέομαι: I am greatly astonished. I am greatly astonished, am awe-struck.

G1569 ἔκθαμβος, ον: full of astonishment, amazed. full of astonishment, amazed.

G1570 ἔκθετος, ον: cast out, exposed. cast out, exposed (to the elements), abandoned.

G1571 ἐκκαθαίρω: I clean out, clean thoroughly. I clean (cleanse) out, clean thoroughly.

G1572 ἐκκαίομαι: I burn with lust. I blaze out, am inflamed.

G1573 ἐκκακέω: I am faint, am weary. I am faint, am weary.

G1574 ἐκκεντέω: I pierce through, transfix. I pierce through (or deeply), transfix.

G1575 ἐκκλάω: I break off. I break off.

G1576 ἐκκλείω: I shut out, exclude. I shut out, exclude, separate.

G1577 ἐκκλησία, ας, ἡ: an assembly, congregation, church. an assembly, congregation, church; the Church, the whole body of Christian believers.

G1578 ἐκκλίνω: I fall away from, turn away. (lit: I bend away from), I fall away from, turn away (from), deviate.

G1579 ἐκκολυμβάω: I swim out. I swim out (of the water).

G1580 ἐκκομίζω: I carry out. I carry out (of the city gate for burial).

G1581 ἐκκόπτω: I cut out, cut off. I cut out (off, away), remove, prevent.

G1582 ἐκκρεμάννυμι: I hang out, hang upon. I hang out, mid: I hang upon.

G1583 ἐκλαλέω: I speak out, disclose. I speak out, disclose, divulge.

G1584 ἐκλάμπω: I shine forth. I shine forth (out).

G1585 ἐκλανθάνομαι: I forget entirely. I forget entirely, make to forget.

G1586 ἐκλέγομαι: I choose, elect. I pick out for myself, choose, elect, select.

G1587 ἐκλείπω: I fail utterly, cease, die. I fail, die out, come to an end, am defunct.

G1588 ἐκλεκτός, ή, όν: chosen, elect, choice, select. chosen out, elect, choice, select, sometimes as subst: of those chosen out by God for the rendering of special service to Him (of the Hebrew race, particular Hebrews, the Messiah, and the Christians).

G1589 ἐκλογή, ῆς, ἡ: a choosing out, selecting, choice by God. a choosing out, selecting, choice (by God).

G1590 ἐκλύω: I am unstrung, become weak, fail. I loose, release, unloose (as a bow-string), relax, enfeeble; pass: I am faint, grow weary.

G1591 ἐκμάσσω: I wipe, wipe off thoroughly. I wipe, wipe (off) thoroughly.

title: Dodson Greek-English Lexicon of the New Testament, G1592 to G1823
source: Jeffrey Dodson, Greek-English Lexicon of the New Testament (public domain), data prepared by Ulrik Sandborg-Petersen. Each entry: Strong number, Greek word, short meaning, fuller meaning.
body:
G1592 ἐκμυκτηρίζω: I deride, scoff at, mock greatly. I deride, scoff at, mock greatly.

G1593 ἐκνεύω: I retire, withdraw. I escape, get clear of, deviate, withdraw.

G1594 ἐκνήφω: I return to soberness of mind. I return to soberness of mind.

G1595 ἑκούσιος, ία, ιον: willing, voluntary, spontaneous. willing, with right good will, voluntary, spontaneous.

G1596 ἑκουσίως: willingly. willingly, of one's own accord, spontaneously.

G1597 ἔκπαλαι: from of old, long since. from of old, long since.

G1598 ἐκπειράζω: I put to the test, make trial of, tempt. I put to the test, make trial of, tempt, try.

G1599 ἐκπέμπω: I send out. I send out, send forth.

G1600 ἐκπετάννυμι: I spread or stretch out. I spread (stretch) out, expand, extend.

G1601 ἐκπίπτω: I fall out, fall off, fall away, fade away, wither away. I fall out, fall off, fall away; hence in nautical language: I fall off from the straight course; of flowers: I fade away, wither away; I fall from, lose, forfeit; I am cast ashore; I am fruitless.

G1602 ἐκπλέω: I sail out, sail away. I sail out (of harbor), sail away.

G1603 ἐκπληρόω: I fill completely, fulfill in every particular. I fill completely, fulfill in every particular (to the utmost), make good.

G1604 ἐκπλήρωσις, εως, ἡ: completion, fulfillment. a completion, fulfillment, accomplishment.

G1605 ἐκπλήσσω: I am thunderstruck, astounded. I strike with panic or shock; I amaze, astonish.

G1606 ἐκπνέω: I breathe my last, expire. (lit: I breathe out), I breathe my last, expire.

G1607 ἐκπορεύομαι: I journey out, come forth. I depart from; I am voided, cast out; I proceed from, am spoken; I burst forth, flow out, am spread abroad.

G1608 ἐκπορνεύω: I am guilty of fornication. I am guilty of fornication.

G1609 ἐκπτύω: I spit upon, disdain, reject, loathe. I spit out, disdain, reject, loathe.

G1610 ἐκριζόω: I root out, root up. I root out, pluck up by the roots.

G1611 ἔκστασις, εως, ἡ: bewilderment, amazement. (properly: distraction or disturbance of mind caused by shock), bewilderment, amazement; a trance.

G1612 ἐκστρέφω: I change for the worse, corrupt, pervert. I change for the worse, corrupt, pervert.

G1613 ἐκταράσσω: I disturb greatly. I disturb (trouble) greatly (exceedingly).

G1614 ἐκτείνω: I stretch out, cast forth. I stretch out (forth), cast forth (as of an anchor), lay hands on.

G1615 ἐκτελέω: I complete, perform. I complete, bring to completion, carry out, perform.

G1616 ἐκτένεια, ας, ἡ: earnestness, strenuousness, intentness. earnestness, strenuousness, intentness, zeal.

G1617 ἐκτενέστερον: more earnestly. more earnestly.

G1618 ἐκτενής, ές: intent, constant, strenuous, intense. intent, constant, strenuous, intense; met: earnest, zealous.

G1619 ἐκτενῶς: earnestly, strenuously. earnestly, strenuously, fervently.

G1620 ἐκτίθημι: I put out or expose a child, set forth, explain. (a) I put out or expose a child, (b) mid: I set forth, expound, explain.

G1621 ἐκτινάσσω: I shake off. I shake off; mid: I shake off from myself.

G1622 ἐκτός: without, outside, except, the outside, apart from. (a) adv: (1) without, outside, beyond, (2) except, (3) subst: the outside, (b) prep: outside, apart from.

G1623 ἕκτος, η, ον: sixth. sixth.

G1624 ἐκτρέπω: I turn aside, wander, forsake. (lit: I turn out from); mid. and pass: I turn aside (from the right road), wander, forsake, and with an object: I remove from myself, shun, avoid.

G1625 ἐκτρέφω: I nourish, nurture, bring up. I nourish, nurture, bring up.

G1626 ἔκτρωμα, ατος, τό: an untimely birth. (strictly: a lifeless abortion) an untimely birth.

G1627 ἐκφέρω: I bring out, carry out. I bring out, carry out, sometimes out of the city for burial; I bring forth, bear, produce.

G1628 ἐκφεύγω: I flee out, away, I escape. I flee out, away, escape; with an acc: I escape something.

G1629 ἐκφοβέω: I terrify exceedingly. I frighten away, terrify.

G1630 ἔκφοβος, ον: greatly terrified. greatly terrified, horrified.

G1631 ἐκφύω: I put forth, cause to sprout. I put forth, cause to sprout.

G1632 ἐκχέω: I pour out, shed. I pour out (liquid or solid); I shed, bestow liberally.

G1633 ἐκχωρέω: I go out, depart from. I go out, depart from, withdraw, flee.

G1634 ἐκψύχω: I breathe my last, die, expire. I breathe my last, die, expire.

G1635 ἑκών, ἑκοῦσα, ἑκόν: willing, willingly. willing, willingly, voluntarily.

G1636 ἐλαία, ας, ἡ: an olive tree. an olive tree; the Mount of Olives.

G1637 ἔλαιον, ου, τό: olive oil. olive oil, oil.

G1638 Ἐλαιών, ῶνος, ὁ: Olive-grove, Olive-yard, the mount Olivet. Olive-grove, Olive-yard, the mount Olivet.

G1639 Ἐλαμίτης, ου, ὁ: an Elamite. an Elamite, one of a people living to the north of the Persian Gulf in the southern part of Persia.

G1640 ἐλάσσων, ον: less, smaller, inferior. less, smaller; poorer, inferior.

G1641 ἐλαττονέω: I have less, lack. I have less, lack.

G1642 ἐλαττόω: I make less, make inferior. I make less (inferior).

G1643 ἐλαύνω: I drive on, propel, row. (a) trans: I drive (on), propel, (b) intrans: I row.

G1644 ἐλαφρία, ας, ἡ: levity, fickleness. levity, fickleness, lightness.

G1645 ἐλαφρός, ά, όν: light, not burdensome. light, not burdensome.

G1646 ἐλάχιστος, ίστη, ιστον: least, smallest, very little. least, smallest, but perhaps oftener in the weaker sense: very little, very small.

G1647 ἐλαχιστότερος, α, ον: the smallest, least important. the smallest, least important.

G1648 Ἐλεάζαρ, ὁ: Eleazar. Eleazar, son of Eliud, and father of Matthan.

G1649 ἔλεγξις, εως, ἡ: rebuke, reproof, refutation. rebuke, reproof, refutation.

G1650 ἔλεγχος, ου, ὁ: a proof, persuasion, reproof. a proof, possibly: a persuasion; reproof.

G1651 ἐλέγχω: I rebuke, expose. (a) I reprove, rebuke, discipline, (b) I expose, show to be guilty.

G1652 ἐλεεινός, ή, όν: merciful, pitiful. merciful, pitiful, miserable.

G1653 ἐλεέω: I pity, have mercy on. I pity, have mercy on.

G1654 ἐλεημοσύνη, ῆς, ἡ: alms-giving, charity. abstr: alms-giving, charity; concr: alms, charity.

G1655 ἐλεήμων, ον: full of pity, merciful. full of pity, merciful, compassionate.

G1656 ἔλεος, ους, τό: pity, mercy. pity, mercy, compassion.

G1657 ἐλευθερία, ας, ἡ: freedom, liberty. freedom, liberty, especially: a state of freedom from slavery.

G1658 ἐλεύθερος, έρα, ερον: free, delivered from obligation. free, delivered from obligation.

G1659 ἐλευθερόω: I free, set free, liberate. I free, set free, liberate.

G1660 ἔλευσις, εως, ἡ: a coming, arrival, advent. a coming, arrival, advent.

G1661 ἐλεφάντινος, η, ον: made of ivory. made of ivory, subst: ivory.

G1662 Ἐλιακείμ, ὁ: Eliakim. Eliakim, son of Abiud and father of Azor; son of Melea and father of Jonam.

G1663 Ἐλιέζερ, ὁ: Eliezer. Eliezer, son of Joram and father of Joshua.

G1664 Ἐλιούδ, ὁ: Eliud. Eliud, son of Achim, and father of Eleazar.

G1665 Ἐλισάβετ, ἡ: Elisabeth. Elizabeth, mother of John the Baptizer.

G1666 Ἐλισσαῖος, ου, ὁ: Elisha. Elisha.

G1667 ἑλίσσω: I roll, roll up. I roll, roll up, fold up.

G1668 ἕλκος, ους, τό: a festering sore. a (festering) sore, a wound.

G1669 ἑλκόω: I afflict with sores. I afflict with sores; pass: I am afflicted with sores.

G1670 ἑλκύω: I drag, draw, pull, persuade. I drag, draw, pull, persuade, unsheathe.

G1671 Ἑλλάς, άδος, ἡ: Hellas, Greece. Hellas, the native name for Greece.

G1672 Ἕλλην, ηνος, ὁ: a Hellene, a Greek. a Hellene, the native word for a Greek; it is, however, a term wide enough to include all Greek-speaking (i.e. educated) non-Jews.

G1673 Ἑλληνικός, ή, όν: Greek, the Greek language. Greek, the Greek language.

G1674 Ἑλληνίς, ίδος, ἡ: a female Greek. a female Greek.

G1675 Ἑλληνιστής, ου, ὁ: a Hellenist, Grecian Jew. a Hellenist, Grecian Jew, a Greek-speaking Jew, that is one who can speak Greek only and not Hebrew (or Aramaic).

G1676 Ἑλληνιστί: in the Greek language. in the Greek language.

G1677 ἐλλογέω: I charge to, put to one's account. I charge to, put to one's account, impute.

G1678 Ἐλμωδάμ, ὁ: Elmadam. Elmadam, father of Cosam, son of Er.

G1679 ἐλπίζω: I hope, hope for, expect. I hope, hope for, expect, trust.

G1680 ἐλπίς, ίδος, ἡ: hope, expectation. hope, expectation, trust, confidence.

G1681 Ἐλύμας, ᾶ, ὁ: Elymas. Elymas, the name of the sorcerer at Paphos.

G1682 ἐλωΐ: Aramaic for my God. (Aramaic), my God.

G1683 ἐμαυτοῦ, ῆς, οῦ: of myself. of myself.

G1684 ἐμβαίνω: I embark. I step in; I go onboard a ship, embark.

G1685 ἐμβάλλω: I cast in, throw in. I cast in, throw in.

G1686 ἐμβάπτω: I dip into. I dip into.

G1687 ἐμβατεύω: I enter, set foot on. I enter, set foot on, intrude, pry into.

G1688 ἐμβιβάζω: I embark, put on board. trans: I embark, put on board, step into.

G1689 ἐμβλέπω: I look into, look upon. I look into (upon); met: I consider; I see clearly.

G1690 ἐμβριμάομαι: I snort, express indignant displeasure. I snort (with the notion of coercion springing out of displeasure, anger, indignation, antagonism), express indignant displeasure with some one; I charge sternly.

G1692 ἐμέω: I vomit forth. I vomit forth.

G1693 ἐμμαίνομαι: I am madly enraged with. I am madly enraged with.

G1694 Ἐμμανουήλ, ὁ: Emmanuel. Emmanuel, a Messianic title derived from Isaiah 7:14 = God with us.

G1695 Ἐμμαούς, ἡ: Emmaus. Emmaus, a village not far from Jerusalem.

G1696 ἐμμένω: I remain or abide in, abide by, maintain. I remain (abide) in, abide by, maintain, persevere in.

G1697 Ἐμμόρ, ὁ: Hamor. Hamor, a man whose sons sold a field at Shechem to Jacob.

G1699 ἐμός, ή, όν: mine. my, mine.

G1701 ἐμπαιγμός, οῦ, ὁ: mockery. mockery, scoffing, scorn.

G1702 ἐμπαίζω: I mock. I mock, ridicule.

G1703 ἐμπαίκτης, ου, ὁ: a mocker. a mocker, scoffer.

G1704 ἐμπεριπατέω: I walk about in a place. I walk about in a place, live among, am conversant with.

G1705 ἐμπίπλημι: I fill up, satisfy. I fill up, satisfy.

G1706 ἐμπίπτω: I fall in, am cast in. I fall in, am cast in, am involved in.

G1707 ἐμπλέκω: I enfold, entangle. I enfold, entangle; pass: I am involved in.

G1708 ἐμπλοκή, ῆς, ἡ: a plaiting, braiding. a plaiting, braiding.

G1709 ἐμπνέω: I breathe, breathe into, inhale. I breathe, breathe into, inhale.

G1710 ἐμπορεύομαι: I travel as a merchant, engage in trade. I travel as a merchant, engage in trade; I traffic in, make gain or business of.

G1711 ἐμπορία, ας, ἡ: trading, trade, trafficking, business. trading, trade, trafficking, business.

G1712 ἐμπόριον, ου, τό: market, market-house. a place of traffic, mart, market, market-house.

G1713 ἔμπορος, ου, ὁ: a merchant, trader. a merchant, trader; one on a journey.

G1714 ἐμπρήθω: I burn, set on fire, suffer inflammation. I burn, set on fire, suffer inflammation.

G1715 ἔμπροσθεν: in front, before the face. in front, before the face; sometimes made a subst. by the addition of the article: in front of, before the face of.

G1716 ἐμπτύω: I spit upon. I spit upon.

G1717 ἐμφανής, ές: manifest, visible. manifest, visible, comprehended.

G1718 ἐμφανίζω: I make visible, report against, appear before. I make visible (manifest); hence: I report (inform) against; pass: I appear before.

G1719 ἔμφοβος, ον: full of fear, terrified. full of fear, terrified.

G1720 ἐμφυσάω: I breathe into, breathe upon. I breathe into, breathe upon.

G1721 ἔμφυτος, ον: inborn, ingrown, congenital, natural. inborn, ingrown, congenital, natural, rooted, implanted.

G1722 ἐν: in, on, among. in, on, among.

G1723 ἐναγκαλίζομαι: I take in my arms. I take (fold) in my arms.

G1724 ἐνάλιος, ον: living in the sea. marine, living in the sea.

G1725 ἔναντι: before, in the presence of. before, in the presence of.

G1726 ἐναντίον: before, in the presence of, in the eyes of. before, in the presence of, in the eyes of.

G1727 ἐναντίος, α, ον: opposite, opposed, contrary, the adversary. opposite, opposed, contrary; the adversary.

G1728 ἐνάρχομαι: I begin. I begin (in), make a beginning, commence.

G1729 ἐνδεής, ές: in need, needy. in need, needy, poor.

G1730 ἔνδειγμα, ατος, τό: a plain token, sign, proof. (a thing proved, hence) a plain token (sign, proof).

G1731 ἐνδείκνυμι: I show forth. I show forth, prove.

G1732 ἔνδειξις, εως, ἡ: a showing, proof, demonstration, sign. a showing, proof, demonstration, sign, token.

G1733 ἕνδεκα, οἱ, αἱ, τά: eleven. eleven.

G1734 ἑνδέκατος, η, ον: eleventh. eleventh.

G1735 ἐνδέχομαι: I allow, it is possible. I allow, it is possible.

G1736 ἐνδημέω: I am at home. I am at home, live in a place.

G1737 ἐνδιδύσκω: I put on, clothe. (somewhat rare) (of clothing: I put on another); mid: I put on (myself).

G1738 ἔνδικος, ον: righteous, just. righteous, just.

G1739 ἐνδόμησις, εως, ἡ: the material of a building, a structure. the material of a building, a structure.

G1740 ἐνδοξάζω: I glorify. I glorify, acknowledge the glory belonging to, recognize as glorious; pass: I am glorified in.

G1741 ἔνδοξος, ον: highly esteemed, splendid, glorious. highly esteemed, splendid, glorious.

G1742 ἔνδυμα, ατος, τό: a garment, raiment. a garment, raiment, clothing.

G1743 ἐνδυναμόω: I fill with power, strengthen. I fill with power, strengthen, make strong.

G1744 ἐνδύνω: I clothe, enter, creep into. I clothe; mid: I enter, creep into.

G1745 ἔνδυσις, εως, ἡ: a putting on of clothing. a putting on of clothing.

G1746 ἐνδύω: I put on, clothe. I put on, clothe (another).

G1747 ἐνέδρα, ας, ἡ: an ambush, plot, treachery, fraud. an ambush, plot, treachery, fraud.

G1748 ἐνεδρεύω: I lie in wait for, seek to entrap, defraud, deceive. I lie in wait (ambush) for, seek to entrap (hence: I defraud, deceive).

G1749 ἔνεδρον, ου, τό: ambush. ambush.

G1750 ἐνειλέω: I wrap up, roll up in something. I wrap up, roll up in (something), wind in.

G1751 ἔνειμι: I am in, within. I am in, within.

G1752 ἕνεκεν: for the sake of, on account of, wherefore. for the sake of, on account of, on account of which, wherefore, on account of what, why.

G1753 ἐνέργεια, ας, ἡ: working, activity. working, action, productive work, activity; in the NT, confined to superhuman activity.

G1754 ἐνεργέω: I work, accomplish, am operative. I work, am operative, am at work, am made to work, accomplish; mid: I work, display activity.

G1755 ἐνέργημα, ατος, τό: a working, an effect. a working, an effect, operation.

G1756 ἐνεργής, ές: effective. effective, productive of due result, at work.

G1757 ἐνευλογέω: I bless. I bless (of God).

G1758 ἐνέχω: I am angry with, entangle. (a) I have a grudge against, am angry (with), (b) pass. or mid: I am entangled, entangle myself.

G1759 ἐνθάδε: here, in this place. here, in this place.

G1760 ἐνθυμέομαι: I meditate upon, reflect upon. I meditate upon, reflect upon, ponder.

G1761 ἐνθύμησις, εως, ἡ: inward thought, reflection, thoughts. inward thought, reflection, plur: thoughts.

G1762 ἔνι: there is in, is present. there is in, is present.

G1763 ἐνιαυτός, οῦ, ὁ: a year. a year, cycle of time.

G1764 ἐνίστημι: I place in or upon, am at hand, am present, threaten. I place in or upon; only in the intrans. tenses: I impend, am at hand, am present, threaten; as adj: present.

G1765 ἐνισχύω: I invigorate, strengthen. I invigorate, strengthen.

G1766 ἔνατος, η, ον: ninth. ninth.

G1767 ἐννέα: nine. nine.

G1768 ἐνενήκοντα: ninety. ninety.

G1769 ἐνεός, ά, όν: dumb, speechless. dumb, speechless (as with amazement).

G1770 ἐννεύω: I make a sign to by nodding. I make a sign to by nodding.

G1771 ἔννοια, ας, ἡ: thought, intention, purpose. thinking, consideration; a thought, purpose, design, intention.

G1772 ἔννομος, ον: legal, obedient to the law. (a) legal, statutory, duly constituted, (b) under the law, obedient to the law.

G1773 ἔννυχος, ον: in the night. in the night.

G1774 ἐνοικέω: I dwell in, am settled in. I dwell in, am settled (stationary) in; met: I am indwelling.

G1775 ἑνότης, ητος, ἡ: oneness, unity. oneness, unity, unanimity.

G1776 ἐνοχλέω: I disturb, cause tumult. I disturb, cause tumult, trouble, annoy.

G1777 ἔνοχος, ον: involved in, liable. involved in, held in, hence: liable, generally with dat. (or gen.) of the punishment.

G1778 ἔνταλμα, ατος, τό: an injunction, ordinance, precept. an injunction, ordinance, precept.

G1779 ἐνταφιάζω: I embalm, prepare for burial. I embalm, prepare for burial.

G1780 ἐνταφιασμός, οῦ, ὁ: embalming, preparation of a body for burial. embalming, preparation of a body for burial.

G1781 ἐντέλλομαι: I give orders, command. I give orders (injunctions, instructions, commands).

G1782 ἐντεῦθεν: hence, from this place, on this side and on that. hence, from this place, on this side and on that.

G1783 ἔντευξις, εως, ἡ: a petition, prayer, intercession. (lit: approaching the king, hence a technical term), a petition, prayer, intercession.

G1784 ἔντιμος, ον: precious, honored, honorable. (held precious, hence) precious, honored, honorable in rank.

G1785 ἐντολή, ῆς, ἡ: an ordinance, injunction, command. an ordinance, injunction, command, law.

G1786 ἐντόπιος, ία, ιον: belonging to the place, native, resident. belonging to the place, native, resident; subst: a citizen.

G1787 ἐντός: within, inside, the inside. within, inside, the inside.

G1788 ἐντρέπω: I turn to confusion, put to shame, reverence. (a) I turn to confusion, put to shame, (b) mid: I reverence, regard.

G1789 ἐντρέφω: I nourish on, am educated in. I nourish (sustain) on, am educated in.

G1790 ἔντρομος, ον: trembling through fear. trembling with fear, terrified.

G1791 ἐντροπή, ῆς, ἡ: shame. shame.

G1792 ἐντρυφάω: I revel in, live luxuriously. I revel (in), live luxuriously, riot.

G1793 ἐντυγχάνω: I meet, encounter, call upon, make a petition. (a) I meet, encounter, hence: (b) I call (upon), make a petition, make suit, supplication.

G1794 ἐντυλίσσω: I wrap up, roll round, envelop. I wrap up, roll round, envelop.

G1795 ἐντυπόω: I engrave. I engrave, imprint.

G1796 ἐνυβρίζω: I insult, outrage, treat contemptuously. I insult, outrage, treat contemptuously, mock at.

G1797 ἐνυπνιάζομαι: I dream. I dream (see visions) in my sleep.

G1798 ἐνύπνιον, ου, τό: a dream, vision. a dream, vision.
