G1799 ἐνώπιον: before the face of, in the presence of. before the face of, in the presence of, in the eyes of.

G1800 Ἐνώς, ὁ: Enosh. Enosh (also Enos), son of Seth, and father of Cainan.

G1801 ἐνωτίζομαι: I take into my ear, listen to. I take into my ear, give ear to, listen to.

G1802 Ἐνώχ, ὁ: Enoch. Enoch, son of Jared and father of Methuselah.

G1803 ἕξ, οἱ, αἱ, τά: six. six.

G1804 ἐξαγγέλλω: I announce publicly, proclaim. I announce publicly, proclaim.

G1805 ἐξαγοράζω: I ransom, redeem. I buy out, buy away from, ransom; mid: I purchase out, buy, redeem, choose.

G1806 ἐξάγω: I lead out. I lead out, sometimes to death, execution.

G1807 ἐξαιρέω: I remove, choose, rescue. I take out, remove; sometimes (mid): I choose, sometimes: I rescue.

G1808 ἐξαίρω: I lift up, remove. I lift up, remove, eject.

G1809 ἐξαιτέω: I demand of, ask for. I demand of, ask for, beg earnestly for.

G1810 ἐξαίφνης: suddenly, unexpectedly. suddenly, unexpectedly.

G1811 ἐξακολουθέω: I follow after, imitate. I follow after, imitate.

G1812 ἑξακόσιοι, αι, α: six hundred. six hundred.

G1813 ἐξαλείφω: I wipe away, obliterate. I plaster, wash over; I wipe off, wipe out, obliterate.

G1814 ἐξάλλομαι: I leap up. I leap up (for joy).

G1815 ἐξανάστασις, εως, ἡ: a resurrection. a rising up and out, resurrection.

G1816 ἐξανατέλλω: I spring up out. I rise (spring) up out (of the ground).

G1817 ἐξανίστημι: I raise up, rise up. (a) in trans. tenses: I raise up, cause to grow, (b) in intrans. tenses: I rise up from.

G1818 ἐξαπατάω: I deceive thoroughly. I deceive thoroughly.

G1819 ἐξάπινα: suddenly. suddenly, unexpectedly.

G1820 ἐξαπορέομαι: I am utterly without resource, am in despair. I am utterly without resource, am in despair.

G1821 ἐξαποστέλλω: I send forth. I send away, send forth (a person qualified for a task).

G1822 ἐξαρτίζω: I completely furnish, equip, finish. (a) I fit up, completely furnish, equip, furnish, supply, (b) I accomplish, finish.

G1823 ἐξαστράπτω: I flash forth like lightning. I flash forth like lightning, gleam, am radiant.

title: Dodson Greek-English Lexicon of the New Testament, G1824 to G2046
source: Jeffrey Dodson, Greek-English Lexicon of the New Testament (public domain), data prepared by Ulrik Sandborg-Petersen. Each entry: Strong number, Greek word, short meaning, fuller meaning.
body:
G1824 ἐξαυτῆς: immediately, instantly. immediately, instantly, at once.

G1825 ἐξεγείρω: I raise up, arouse. I raise up, arouse.

G1826 ἔξειμι: I go out, depart. (originally: I shall go out), I go out (away), depart.

G1828 ἐξέλκω: I entice. (lit: I draw out of the right place, or I draw aside out of the right way), I entice.

G1829 ἐξέραμα, ατος, τό: vomit. vomit.

G1830 ἐξερευνάω: I search diligently, examine carefully. I search diligently, I examine carefully (minutely).

G1831 ἐξέρχομαι: I go out, come out. I go out, come out.

G1832 ἔξεστιν: it is permitted, lawful, possible. it is permitted, lawful, possible.

G1833 ἐξετάζω: I examine, question, search out. I examine, question, inquire at, search out.

G1834 ἐξηγέομαι: I explain, make declaration. I lead, show the way; met: I unfold, narrate, declare.

G1835 ἑξήκοντα, οἱ, αἱ, τά: sixty. sixty.

G1836 ἑξῆς: next in order, the next day. next in order, the next day, the following day, at the period immediately following.

G1837 ἐξηχέω: I sound out. I sound out (forth) (referring either to the clearness or to the loudness of the sound).

G1838 ἕξις, εως, ἡ: condition, state, habit. condition, state, habit, use, especially: good condition of body or soul.

G1839 ἐξίστημι: I astonish, am astonished. (lit: I remove from a standing position), (a) in trans. tenses: I astonish, amaze, (b) in intrans. tenses: I am astonished, amazed; I am out of my mind, am mad.

G1840 ἐξισχύω: I have strength for, am perfectly able. I have strength for (a difficult task), am perfectly able.

G1841 ἔξοδος, ου, ἡ: an exit, departure, death. (a) an exit, going out, departure from a place; the exodus, (b) death.

G1842 ἐξολοθρεύω: I destroy utterly, annihilate. I destroy utterly, annihilate, exterminate, root out.

G1843 ἐξομολογέω: I consent fully, confess. (a) I consent fully, agree out and out, (b) I confess, admit, acknowledge (cf. the early Hellenistic sense of the middle: I acknowledge a debt), (c) I give thanks, praise.

G1844 ἐξορκίζω: I adjure, put to oath. I adjure, put to oath; I exorcise.

G1845 ἐξορκιστής, οῦ, ὁ: an exorcist. an exorcist, a caster out of evil spirits by the use of names or spells.

G1846 ἐξορύσσω: I dig out, gouge. (a) I dig out, hence: I open up, (b) I gouge.

G1847 ἐξουδενόω: I ignore, despise. I set at naught, ignore, despise.

G1848 ἐξουθενέω: I ignore, despise. I set at naught, ignore, despise.

G1849 ἐξουσία, ας, ἡ: power, authority, weight. (a) power, authority, weight, especially: moral authority, influence, (b) in a quasi-personal sense, derived from later Judaism, of a spiritual power, and hence of an earthly power.

G1850 ἐξουσιάζω: I exercise authority. I exercise (wield) power (authority), pass: I am ruled, am held under authority.

G1851 ἐξοχή, ῆς, ἡ: eminence, distinction. eminence, distinction, excellence.

G1852 ἐξυπνίζω: I wake out of sleep. I wake out of sleep.

G1853 ἔξυπνος, ον: roused out of sleep. roused out of sleep.

G1854 ἔξω: without, outside. without, outside.

G1855 ἔξωθεν: from without, outside. (a) from outside, from without, (b) outside, both as adj. and prep; with article: the outside.

G1856 ἐξωθέω: I drive out, expel, propel. I drive out, expel, propel, thrust out; I drive out of the sea, drive on shore.

G1857 ἐξώτερος, α, ον: outmost, outer. outmost, outer, external.

G1858 ἑορτάζω: I keep a feast. I take part in a festival, keep a feast (allegorically).

G1859 ἑορτή, ῆς, ἡ: a festival, feast. a festival, feast, periodically recurring.

G1860 ἐπαγγελία, ας, ἡ: a promise. a promise.

G1861 ἐπαγγέλλομαι: I promise, profess. I promise, profess.

G1862 ἐπάγγελμα, ατος, τό: a promise. a promise.

G1863 ἐπάγω: I bring upon. I bring upon; met: I cause to be imputed to.

G1864 ἐπαγωνίζομαι: I contend earnestly for. I contend earnestly for.

G1865 ἐπαθροίζω: I gather together, crowd upon, press around. I gather together, pass: I crowd upon (some one), press around.

G1866 Ἐπαίνετος, ου, ὁ: Epaenetus. Epaenetus, a Christian of Rome.

G1867 ἐπαινέω: I praise, commend. I praise, commend, applaud.

G1868 ἔπαινος, ου, ὁ: commendation, praise. commendation, praise, approval.

G1869 ἐπαίρω: I raise, lift up. I raise, lift up.

G1870 ἐπαισχύνομαι: I am ashamed. I am ashamed, am ashamed of.

G1871 ἐπαιτέω: I beg, ask alms. I beg, am a beggar, ask alms.

G1872 ἐπακολουθέω: I follow close after, endorse. I follow close after, accompany, dog; I imitate, pursue, am studious of.

G1873 ἐπακούω: I listen to, hear favorably. I listen to, hear favorably.

G1874 ἐπακροάομαι: I listen to, hear. I listen to, hear, hearken to.

G1875 ἐπάν: after, when. after, when, as soon as.

G1876 ἐπάναγκες: necessarily. necessarily; as subst: necessary things.

G1877 ἐπανάγω: I put out, go up. (a) nautical: I put out (from the shore), (lit: I take up a ship on to the high seas), (b) I go up, possibly: I go up again, return.

G1878 ἐπαναμιμνήσκω: I remind. I remind, possibly: I remind again.

G1879 ἐπαναπαύομαι: I rest upon, rely on, trust in. I rest upon, rely on, trust in.

G1880 ἐπανέρχομαι: I return, come back again. I return, come back again.

G1881 ἐπανίστημι: I rise up against. intrans. tenses: I rise up against.

G1882 ἐπανόρθωσις, εως, ἡ: correction, reformation. correction, reformation, setting straight (right) again.

G1883 ἐπάνω: on the top, above, superior to. (a) adv: on the top, above, (b) prep: on the top of, above, over, on, above, more than, superior to.

G1884 ἐπαρκέω: I aid, relieve, do service, render help. I aid, relieve, do service, render help, am strong enough for.

G1885 ἐπαρχία, ας, ἡ: sphere of duty, province. sphere of duty, province.

G1886 ἔπαυλις, εως, ἡ: a farm, estate, dwelling. a farm, estate, dwelling, habitation.

G1887 ἐπαύριον: tomorrow. tomorrow.

G1888 αὐτόφωρος, ον: in the very act. in the very act.

G1889 Ἐπαφρᾶς, ᾶ, ὁ: Epaphras. Epaphras, Epaphroditus, a Colossian Christian, in captivity with Paul in Rome.

G1890 ἐπαφρίζω: I foam out. I foam out (a metaphor from the seaweed and refuse borne on the crest of waves), vomit forth.

G1891 Ἐπαφρόδιτος, ου, ὁ: Epaphroditus. Epaphras, Epaphroditus, a Colossian Christian, in captivity with Paul in Rome.

G1892 ἐπεγείρω: I arouse, stimulate, excite against. I arouse, stimulate, excite against.

G1893 ἐπεί: after, for, since, otherwise. of time: when, after; of cause: since, because; otherwise: else.

G1894 ἐπειδή: when, since. of time: when, now, after that; of cause: seeing that, forasmuch as.

G1895 ἐπειδήπερ: since. since, forasmuch as.

G1896 ἐπεῖδεν: I looked upon, regarded. I looked upon, regarded.

G1897 ἐπείπερ: since indeed, seeing that. since indeed, seeing that.

G1898 ἐπεισαγωγή, ῆς, ἡ: bringing in, introduction, importation. bringing in (besides or in addition), introduction, importation.

G1899 ἔπειτα: then, thereafter, afterwards. then, thereafter, afterwards.

G1900 ἐπέκεινα: beyond. beyond, on yonder side.

G1901 ἐπεκτείνομαι: I strain after. I strain after, stretch forward.

G1902 ἐπενδύομαι: I put on over. I have on over (as a garment); mid: I put on myself in addition.

G1903 ἐπενδύτης, ου, ὁ: a coat, outer wrap. a coat, outer wrap or tunic.

G1904 ἐπέρχομαι: I approach, overtake, attack. I come to, arrive, come on, come upon, attack.

G1905 ἐπερωτάω: I interrogate, question, demand of. I interrogate, question, demand of.

G1906 ἐπερώτημα, ατος, τό: inquiry, request, appeal. inquiry, request, appeal, demand; a profession, pledge.

G1907 ἐπέχω: I hold forth, pay attention, note, delay. (a) trans: I hold forth, (b) intrans: I mark, pay attention (heed), note; I delay, stay, wait.

G1908 ἐπηρεάζω: I insult, treat wrongfully, molest. I insult, treat wrongfully, molest, revile.

G1909 ἐπί: on, to, against, on the basis of, at. on, to, against, on the basis of, at.

G1910 ἐπιβαίνω: I step on, mount, board. (a) I set foot on, step on, (b) I mount (a horse), board (a vessel).

G1911 ἐπιβάλλω: I throw upon, lay, strike upon. (a) I throw upon, cast over, (b) I place upon, (c) I lay, (d) intrans: I strike upon, rush.

G1912 ἐπιβαρέω: I burden. I put a burden on, am burdensome.

G1913 ἐπιβιβάζω: I place upon. I place upon (a horse, mule).

G1914 ἐπιβλέπω: I look with favor on. I look with favor on, regard.

G1915 ἐπίβλημα, ατος, τό: a patch on a garment. a patch on a garment.

G1916 ἐπιβοάω: I cry out to or against. I cry out to or against.

G1917 ἐπιβουλή, ῆς, ἡ: a plot, design against. a plot, design against.

G1918 ἐπιγαμβρεύω: I marry a deceased brother's wife. I take to wife after, marry a deceased brother's wife.

G1919 ἐπίγειος, ον: earthly. (a) on the earth, belonging to the earth (as opposed to the sky), (b) in a spiritual sense, belonging to the earthly sphere, earthly (as opposed to heavenly).

G1920 ἐπιγίνομαι: I arise, spring up. I arise, spring up, arrive, come on.

G1921 ἐπιγινώσκω: I come to know, discern, recognize. I come to know by directing my attention to him or it, I perceive, discern, recognize; aor: I found out.

G1922 ἐπίγνωσις, εως, ἡ: knowledge, discernment, recognition. knowledge of a particular point (directed towards a particular object); perception, discernment, recognition, intuition.

G1923 ἐπιγραφή, ῆς, ἡ: an inscription, title. an inscription, title, label.

G1924 ἐπιγράφω: I write upon, inscribe. I write upon, inscribe, imprint a mark on.

G1925 ἐπιδείκνυμι: I show, prove. I show, display, point out, indicate; I prove, demonstrate.

G1926 ἐπιδέχομαι: I accept, admit, welcome. I accept, admit, welcome.

G1927 ἐπιδημέω: I sojourn, am resident. I sojourn, am resident (temporarily, in a foreign city).

G1928 ἐπιδιατάσσομαι: I furnish with additions. I make an additional testamentary disposition, I furnish with additions.

G1929 ἐπιδίδωμι: I hand in, give up, give way. (a) trans: I hand in, give up, (b) intrans: I give way (to the wind).

G1930 ἐπιδιορθόω: I put in order. I set in order besides, put in order, correct.

G1931 ἐπιδύω: I sink, set. I sink, set, set during, go down.

G1932 ἐπιείκεια, ας, ἡ: considerateness, forbearance, fairness. considerateness, forbearance, fairness, gentleness, mildness.

G1933 ἐπιεικής, ές: gentle, mild, forbearing, fair, reasonable. gentle, mild, forbearing, fair, reasonable, moderate.

G1934 ἐπιζητέω: I seek after, desire, search for. I seek after, desire, search for, make inquiries about.

G1935 ἐπιθανάτιος, ον: at the point of death, condemned to death. at the point of death, condemned to death.

G1936 ἐπίθεσις, εως, ἡ: laying on. a laying on; an attack, assault.

G1937 ἐπιθυμέω: I long for, covet, lust after. I long for, covet, lust after, set the heart upon.

G1938 ἐπιθυμητής, οῦ, ὁ: an eager desirer of. an eager desirer of.

G1939 ἐπιθυμία, ας, ἡ: desire, eagerness for, inordinate desire, lust. desire, eagerness for, inordinate desire, lust.

G1940 ἐπικαθίζω: I sit upon. I sit upon, cause to sit upon.

G1941 ἐπικαλέω: I call by an additional name, appeal to. (a) I call (name) by a supplementary (additional, alternative) name, (b) mid: I call upon, appeal to, address.

G1942 ἐπικάλυμμα, ατος, τό: a covering, cloak, pretext. a covering, cloak, veil, pretext.

G1943 ἐπικαλύπτω: I cover up. I put a cover on, cover up.

G1944 ἐπικατάρατος, ον: accursed. on whom a curse has been invoked, accursed, doomed to destruction.

G1945 ἐπίκειμαι: I lie upon, am insistent. (a) dat: I am placed upon, am laid upon, lie upon, am imposed; I press upon, (b) absol: I press hard, am insistent, insist.

G1946 Ἐπικούρειος, ου, ὁ: an Epicurean. an Epicurean, one who holds the tenets of Epicurus.

G1947 ἐπικουρία, ας, ἡ: help, aid. succor (against foes), help, aid, assistance.

G1948 ἐπικρίνω: I decree, give sentence. I decree, give sentence, decide.

G1949 ἐπιλαμβάνομαι: I seize, take hold of. I lay hold of, take hold of, seize (sometimes with beneficent, sometimes with hostile, intent).

G1950 ἐπιλανθάνομαι: I forget, neglect. I forget, neglect.

G1951 ἐπιλέγω: I call, choose for myself, am named. I call; mid: I choose for myself; pass: I am named.

G1952 ἐπιλείπω: I fail, fall short. I fail, fall short.

G1953 ἐπιλησμονή, ῆς, ἡ: forgetfulness. forgetfulness, oblivion.

G1954 ἐπίλοιπος, ον: remaining, that is left over. remaining, that is left over, still left.

G1955 ἐπίλυσις, εως, ἡ: solution, explanation, interpretation. solution, explanation, interpretation; release.

G1956 ἐπιλύω: I explain, interpret, decide. I loose, release; I solve, settle, explain, interpret, decide.

G1957 ἐπιμαρτυρέω: I testify earnestly. I testify earnestly, bear witness to.

G1958 ἐπιμέλεια, ας, ἡ: care, attention. care, attention.

G1959 ἐπιμελέομαι: I take care of, attend to. I take care of, attend to.

G1960 ἐπιμελῶς: carefully, diligently. carefully, diligently.

G1961 ἐπιμένω: I remain, tarry, persist in. (a) I remain, tarry, (b) I remain in, persist in.

G1962 ἐπινεύω: I nod to, assent. I nod to, assent to, consent.

G1963 ἐπίνοια, ας, ἡ: thought, purpose. thought, purpose, design, intent.

G1964 ἐπιορκέω: I take an oath, swear falsely. I take an oath, swear falsely.

G1965 ἐπίορκος, ον: perjured. perjured, sworn falsely.

G1966 ἐπιοῦσα, ης, ἡ: the next day. the next day.

G1967 ἐπιούσιος, ον: for the morrow, necessary, sufficient. for the morrow, necessary, sufficient.

G1968 ἐπιπίπτω: I fall upon, press upon. I fall upon, press upon, light upon, come over.

G1969 ἐπιπλήσσω: I rebuke, chide, reprove. I rebuke, chide, reprove, strike at.

G1971 ἐπιποθέω: I long for, strain after, desire greatly. I long for, strain after, desire greatly, have affection for.

G1972 ἐπιπόθησις, εως, ἡ: eager longing, desire. eager longing (desire), strong affection.

G1973 ἐπιπόθητος, ον: longed for, missed. longed for, missed, greatly desired.

G1974 ἐπιποθία, ας, ἡ: longing, eager desire. longing, eager desire.

G1975 ἐπιπορεύομαι: I journey to. I travel, journey (to).

G1976 ἐπιρράπτω: I sew on. I sew (on).

G1977 ἐπιρρίπτω: I throw upon, cast upon. I throw (cast) (upon), as of cares.

G1978 ἐπίσημος, ον: notable, conspicuous. notable, conspicuous.

G1979 ἐπισιτισμός, οῦ, ὁ: provision, nourishment, food. provision, nourishment, food.

G1980 ἐπισκέπτομαι: I look upon, visit, look out, select. I look upon, visit, look out, select.

G1981 ἐπισκηνόω: I raise a tent over, dwell. I raise a tent (over), dwell, spread a tabernacle over.

G1982 ἐπισκιάζω: I overshadow, envelop. I overshadow, envelop.

G1983 ἐπισκοπέω: I exercise oversight, care for. I exercise oversight, care for, visit.

G1984 ἐπισκοπή, ῆς, ἡ: visitation of judgment, oversight. (a) visitation (of judgment), (b) oversight, supervision, overseership.

G1985 ἐπίσκοπος, ου, ὁ: overseer, supervisor, ruler. (used as an official title in civil life), overseer, supervisor, ruler, especially used with reference to the supervising function exercised by an elder or presbyter of a church or congregation.

G1986 ἐπισπάομαι: I become uncircumcised. (lit: I draw over), mid: I become as uncircumcised.

G1987 ἐπίσταμαι: I know, understand. I know, know of, understand.

G1988 ἐπιστάτης, ου, ὁ: master, teacher. master, teacher, chief, commander.

G1989 ἐπιστέλλω: I write, send by letter to.. 2182

G1990 ἐπιστήμων, ον: skillful, experienced. skillful, experienced, knowing.

G1991 ἐπιστηρίζω: I prop up, uphold, confirm. I prop up, uphold, support, confirm, make stronger.

G1992 ἐπιστολή, ῆς, ἡ: a letter, dispatch, epistle. a letter, dispatch, epistle, message.

G1993 ἐπιστομίζω: I muzzle, silence. I muzzle, silence, stop the mouth.

G1994 ἐπιστρέφω: I turn back to. (a) trans: I turn (back) to (towards), (b) intrans: I turn (back) (to [towards]); I come to myself.

G1995 ἐπιστροφή, ῆς, ἡ: a turning to God. a turning (to God), conversion.

G1996 ἐπισυνάγω: I collect, gather together. I collect, gather together, assemble.

G1997 ἐπισυναγωγή, ῆς, ἡ: a gathering together. a gathering (collecting) together, assembling.

G1998 ἐπισυντρέχω: I run together to. I run together again.

G1999 ἐπισύστασις, εως, ἡ: a gathering, concourse, tumult. a gathering, concourse, tumult.

G2000 ἐπισφαλής, ές: dangerous, likely to fall. dangerous, likely to fall.

G2001 ἐπισχύω: I persist, insist. I persist, insist, am more urgent.

G2002 ἐπισωρεύω: I heap up, obtain a multitude of. I heap up, obtain a multitude of.

G2003 ἐπιταγή, ῆς, ἡ: instruction, command, order, authority. instruction, command, order, authority.

G2004 ἐπιτάσσω: I give order, command. I give order, command, charge.

G2005 ἐπιτελέω: I complete, accomplish, perfect. I complete, accomplish, perfect.

G2006 ἐπιτήδειος, α, ον: necessary. necessary, suitable, fit.

G2007 ἐπιτίθημι: I put, place upon, lay on. I put, place upon, lay on; I add, give in addition.

G2008 ἐπιτιμάω: I rebuke, chide, admonish, warn. (a) I rebuke, chide, admonish, (b) I warn.

G2009 ἐπιτιμία, ας, ἡ: punishment. punishment, penalty.

G2010 ἐπιτρέπω: I allow, permit. I turn to, commit, entrust; I allow, yield, permit.

G2011 ἐπιτροπή, ῆς, ἡ: commission, full power. power to decide, authority, commission.

G2012 ἐπίτροπος, ου, ὁ: a steward, guardian. (a) (procurator) a steward, (b) (tutor) a guardian (appointed for an "infant" [under 14 perhaps] by the father or by a magistrate).

G2013 ἐπιτυγχάνω: I attain, obtain, acquire. I attain, obtain, acquire.

G2014 ἐπιφαίνω: I appear, shine upon. I appear (as of a light in the heavens or from the heavens), shine upon.

G2015 ἐπιφάνεια, ας, ἡ: appearing, manifestation. appearing, manifestation, glorious display.

G2016 ἐπιφανής, ές: manifest, glorious, illustrious. manifest, glorious, illustrious.

G2017 ἐπιφαύω: I shine upon, give light to. I shine upon, give light to.

G2018 ἐπιφέρω: I bring forward against. I bring forward (against), impose, inflict.

G2019 ἐπιφωνέω: I call out, shout. I call out, shout, clamor at.

G2020 ἐπιφώσκω: I dawn, am near commencing. I dawn, am near commencing.

G2021 ἐπιχειρέω: I take in hand, attempt. I take in hand, attempt.

G2022 ἐπιχέω: I pour upon. I pour upon.

G2023 ἐπιχορηγέω: I supply, provide. I supply, provide (perhaps lavishly), furnish.

G2024 ἐπιχορηγία, ας, ἡ: supply, provision, equipment. supply, provision, equipment, support.

G2025 ἐπιχρίω: I spread on, anoint. I spread on, anoint.

G2026 ἐποικοδομέω: I build upon a foundation. I build upon (above) a foundation.

G2027 ἐποκέλλω: I force forward, run aground. I force forward, run (a ship) aground.

G2028 ἐπονομάζω: I name, impose a name on. I name, impose a name on; pass: am named.

G2029 ἐποπτεύω: I am an eyewitness of, behold. I am an eyewitness of, behold, look upon.

G2030 ἐπόπτης, ου, ὁ: an eyewitness. an eyewitness, spectator, looker-on.

G2031 ἔπος, ους, τό: a word, so to speak. a word, so to speak.

G2032 ἐπουράνιος, ον: heavenly, celestial. heavenly, celestial, in the heavenly sphere, the sphere of spiritual activities; met: divine, spiritual.

G2033 ἑπτά, οἱ, αἱ, τά: seven. seven.

G2034 ἑπτάκις: seven times. seven times.

G2035 ἑπτακισχίλιοι, αι, α: seven thousand. seven thousand.

G2037 Ἔραστος, ου, ὁ: Erastus. Erastus, steward of Corinth, a Christian.

G2038 ἐργάζομαι: I word, trade, do. I work, trade, perform, do, practice, commit, acquire by labor.

G2039 ἐργασία, ας, ἡ: working, activity, trade, performance. working, activity, work, service, trade, business, gains of business, performance, practice.

G2040 ἐργάτης, ου, ὁ: a field-laborer, workman. a field-laborer; then: a laborer, workman in general.

G2041 ἔργον, ου, τό: work, labor, action, deed. work, task, employment; a deed, action; that which is wrought or made, a work.

G2042 ἐρεθίζω: I stir up, provoke. I stir up, arouse to anger, provoke, irritate, incite.

G2043 ἐρείδω: I stick fast. I stick fast, prop, fix firmly.

G2044 ἐρεύγομαι: I utter, declare. (lit: I belch forth, hence) I utter, declare.

G2045 ἐρευνάω: I search diligently. I search diligently, examine.

G2046 ἐρεῶ: I say, speak. (denoting speech in progress), (a) I say, speak; I mean, mention, tell, (b) I call, name, especially in the pass., (c) I tell, command.

title: Dodson Greek-English Lexicon of the New Testament, G2047 to G2287
source: Jeffrey Dodson, Greek-English Lexicon of the New Testament (public domain), data prepared by Ulrik Sandborg-Petersen. Each entry: Strong number, Greek word, short meaning, fuller meaning.
body:
G2047 ἐρημία, ας, ἡ: a desert place. a desert place, desert, uninhabited region.

G2048 ἔρημος, ον: deserted, desolate, a desert. as an adj: deserted, desolate, waste; hence: the desert, to the east and south of Palestine; of a person: deserted, abandoned, desolate.

G2049 ἐρημόω: I destroy, strip, rob. (a) I make desolate, bring to desolation, destroy, waste, (b) of a person: I strip, rob.

G2050 ἐρήμωσις, εως, ἡ: desolation, devastation. a desolation, devastation.

G2051 ἐρίζω: I contend, dispute. I contend, dispute, wrangle, strive.

G2052 ἐριθεία, ας, ἡ: ambition, rivalry. (the seeking of followers and adherents by means of gifts, the seeking of followers, hence) ambition, rivalry, self-seeking; a feud, faction.

G2053 ἔριον, ου, τό: wool. wool.

G2054 ἔρις, ιδος, ἡ: contention, strife. contention, strife, wrangling.

G2055 ἐρίφιον, ου, τό: a goat, kid. a goat, kid.

G2056 ἔριφος, ου, ὁ: a goat. a goat.

G2057 Ἑρμᾶς, ᾶ, ὁ: Hermas. Hermas, a Roman Christian.

G2058 ἑρμηνεία, ας, ἡ: translation, interpretation. translation, interpretation, explanation.

G2059 ἑρμηνεύω: I translate, interpret. (a) I translate, explain, (b) I interpret the meaning of.

G2060 Ἑρμῆς, οῦ, ὁ: Hermes. (a) Hermes, the messenger and herald of the Greek gods, or rather the corresponding Lycaonian deity, (b) Hermes, a Roman Christian.

G2061 Ἑρμογένης, ους, ὁ: Hermogenes. Hermogenes, a man of Rome.

G2062 ἑρπετόν, οῦ, τό: a creeping creature, reptile. a creeping creature, reptile, especially a serpent.

G2063 ἐρυθρός, ά, όν: red. red.

G2064 ἔρχομαι: I come, go. I come, go.

G2065 ἐρωτάω: I ask, question, request. (a) I ask (a question), question, (b) I request, make a request to, pray.

G2066 ἐσθής, ῆτος, ἡ: clothing, raiment. clothing, raiment, vestment, robe.

G2067 ἔσθησις, εως, ἡ: clothing, a garment. clothing, a garment.

G2068 ἐσθίω: I eat. I eat, partake of food; met: I devour, consume (e.g. as rust does).

G2069 Ἐσλί, ὁ: Esli. Esli, son of Naggai and father of Nahum.

G2072 ἔσοπτρον, ου, τό: a mirror. a mirror, looking-glass (made of highly polished metal).

G2073 ἑσπέρα, ας, ἡ: evening. evening.

G2074 Ἑσρώμ, ὁ: Hezron. Hezron, son of Perez, father of Ram.

G2078 ἔσχατος, η, ον: last, at the last, finally. last, at the last, finally, till the end.

G2079 ἐσχάτως: to be at the extremity. extremely, utterly; to be at the extremity, to be "in extremis," to be at the last grasp.

G2080 ἔσω: within, inside. within, inside, with verbs either of rest or of motion; prep: within, to within, inside.

G2081 ἔσωθεν: from within, inside. (a) from within, from inside, (b) within, inside; with the article: the inner part, the inner element, (c) the mind, soul.

G2082 ἐσώτερος, α, ον: inner. inner; with the article: the part that is within.

G2083 ἑταῖρος, ου, ὁ: a companion, comrade. a companion, comrade, friend.

G2084 ἑτερόγλωσσος, ον: speaking another language. speaking another language; subst: one who speaks another language.

G2085 ἑτεροδιδασκαλέω: I teach different things. I teach different things, that is, different from the true or necessary teaching.

G2086 ἑτεροζυγέω: I am yoked with one different from myself. I am yoked with one different from myself, unequally yoked.

G2087 ἕτερος, α, ον: another, different. (a) of two: another, a second, (b) other, different, (c) one's neighbor.

G2088 ἑτέρως: otherwise, differently. otherwise, differently.

G2089 ἔτι: still, yet, even now. (a) of time: still, yet, even now, (b) of degree: even, further, more, in addition.

G2090 ἑτοιμάζω: I make ready, prepare. I make ready, prepare.

G2091 ἑτοιμασία, ας, ἡ: preparation, readiness. foundation, firm footing; preparation, readiness.

G2092 ἕτοιμος, η, ον: ready, prepared. ready, prepared.

G2093 ἑτοίμως: readily. readily.

G2094 ἔτος, ους, τό: a year. a year.

G2095 εὖ: well, well done. well, well done, good, rightly; also used as an exclamation.

G2096 Εὔα, ας, ἡ: Eve. Eve, the first woman; wife of first man Adam.

G2097 εὐαγγελίζω: I bring good news, preach good tidings. I bring good news, preach good tidings, with or without an object, expressing either the persons who receive the good news or the good news itself (the good news being sometimes expressed as a person).

G2098 εὐαγγέλιον, ου, τό: the good news, the gospel. the good news of the coming of the Messiah, the gospel; the gen. after it expresses sometimes the giver (God), sometimes the subject (the Messiah, etc.), sometimes the human transmitter (an apostle).

G2099 εὐαγγελιστής, οῦ, ὁ: an evangelist, bearer of good tidings. an evangelist, a missionary, bearer of good tidings.

G2100 εὐαρεστέω: I please. I give pleasure to, please (perhaps with the added idea of: rendering good service to).

G2101 εὐάρεστος, ον: acceptable, well-pleasing. acceptable, well-pleasing (especially to God), grateful.

G2102 εὐαρέστως: acceptably. acceptably, in a well-pleasing way.

G2103 Εὔβουλος, ου, ὁ: Eubulus. Eubulus, a Christian with Paul in Rome.

G2104 εὐγενής, ές: of noble birth, noble. (a) of noble birth, of high birth, (b) noble in nature.

G2105 εὐδία, ας, ἡ: good weather. fair weather, good weather.

G2106 εὐδοκέω: I am resolved, well-pleased. I am well-pleased, think it good, am resolved.

G2107 εὐδοκία, ας, ἡ: good-will, favor. (a) good-will (good-pleasure), favor, feeling of complacency of God to man, (b) good-pleasure, satisfaction, happiness, delight of men.

G2108 εὐεργεσία, ας, ἡ: good action, kind service. good action, well-doing, benefiting, kind service.

G2109 εὐεργετέω: I do good deeds, benefit. I do good deeds, perform kind service, benefit.

G2110 εὐεργέτης, ου, ὁ: a benefactor. a benefactor, well-doer.

G2111 εὔθετος, ον: suitable, fit, useful. suitable, fit, useful.

G2112 εὐθέως: immediately, soon. immediately, soon, at once.

G2113 εὐθυδρομέω: I run a straight course. I run a straight course.

G2114 εὐθυμέω: I am cheerful. I keep up spirit, am cheerful, am of good courage.

G2115 εὔθυμος, ον: cheerful, having good courage. cheerful, having good courage.

G2116 εὐθύνω: I make straight, guide, steer. (a) I make straight (of the direction, not the surface, of a road), (b) I guide, steer.

G2117 εὐθύς, εῖα, ύ: straight, immediately. adj: (a) straight of direction, as opposed to crooked, (b) upright; adv: immediately.

G2118 εὐθύτης, ητος, ἡ: straightness, uprightness. straightness, uprightness.

G2119 εὐκαιρέω: I have a good opportunity, have leisure. I have a good (favorable) opportunity, have leisure; I devote my leisure to.

G2120 εὐκαιρία, ας, ἡ: a convenient time, opportunity. a convenient time, opportunity.

G2121 εὔκαιρος, ον: timely, suitable. opportune, timely, suitable; perhaps sometimes: holiday, festival.

G2122 εὐκαίρως: in season, conveniently. opportunely, in season, conveniently.

G2123 εὐκοπώτερον: easier. easier.

G2124 εὐλάβεια, ας, ἡ: reverence, piety. reverence, fear of God, piety.

G2125 εὐλαβέομαι: I fear, am anxious. I fear, am anxious, am cautious; I reverence.

G2126 εὐλαβής, ές: cautious, pious. (lit: handling well, hence) cautious, circumspect; hence: God-fearing, pious.

G2127 εὐλογέω: I bless. (lit: I speak well of) I bless; pass: I am blessed.

G2128 εὐλογητός, ή, όν: worthy of praise, blessed. (used only of God), blessed (as entitled to receive blessing from man), worthy of praise.

G2129 εὐλογία, ας, ἡ: adulation, praise, blessing. adulation, praise, blessing, gift.

G2130 εὐμετάδοτος, ον: willingly sharing, ready to impart. willingly sharing, ready to impart, generous.

G2131 Εὐνίκη, ῆς, ἡ: Eunice. Eunice, mother of Timothy.

G2132 εὐνοέω: I have good-will. I am favorable, am kindly-disposed.

G2133 εὔνοια, ας, ἡ: good-will. good-will, kindliness; enthusiasm.

G2134 εὐνουχίζω: emasculate, castrate. I make into a eunuch, emasculate, castrate.

G2135 εὐνοῦχος, ου, ὁ: a eunuch, keeper of the bed-chamber. (a) a chamberlain, keeper of the bed-chamber of an eastern potentate, eunuch, (b) a eunuch, castrated person, or one who voluntarily abstains from marriage.

G2136 Εὐοδία, ας, ἡ: Euodia. Euodia, or rather Euhodia, a Christian woman of Philippi.

G2137 εὐοδόω: I cause to prosper, have a happy journey. I cause to prosper, pass: I have a happy (successful) journey, hence: I prosper.

G2138 εὐπειθής, ές: compliant. compliant, ready to obey.

G2139 εὐπερίστατος, ον: easily encircling. easily surrounding, encircling, easily distracted.

G2140 εὐποιΐα, ας, ἡ: doing of good. good-doing, doing of good.

G2141 εὐπορέω: I have means, am prosperous. I have means, am prosperous, enjoy plenty.

G2142 εὐπορία, ας, ἡ: wealth, gain. wealth, gain, plenty.

G2143 εὐπρέπεια, ας, ἡ: beauty, gracefulness. beauty, gracefulness, comeliness.

G2144 εὐπρόσδεκτος, ον: well-received, acceptable. well-received, acceptable, welcome, pleasing.

G2145 εὐπρόσεδρος, ον: devoted. constantly attending to, devoted.

G2146 εὐπροσωπέω: I make a fair outward appearance. I look well, make a fair show (a good outward appearance, and so win good opinion).

G2147 εὑρίσκω: I find. I find, learn, discover, especially after searching.

G2148 Εὐροκλύδων, ωνος, ὁ: an east-north-east wind. an east-north-east wind.

G2149 εὐρύχωρος, ον: broad, spacious. broad, spacious, wide.

G2150 εὐσέβεια, ας, ἡ: piety, godliness. piety (towards God), godliness, devotion, godliness.

G2151 εὐσεβέω: I am dutiful, pious. I am dutiful, pious, show piety towards, worship.

G2152 εὐσεβής, ές: pious, God-fearing. pious, God-fearing, devout.

G2153 εὐσεβῶς: piously, religiously. piously, religiously.

G2154 εὔσημος, ον: with clear meaning, intelligible. with clear meaning, intelligible, clear to the understanding.

G2155 εὔσπλαγχνος, ον: tender-hearted, merciful. tender-hearted, merciful, compassionate.

G2156 εὐσχημόνως: becomingly, decorously. becomingly, decorously, decently.

G2157 εὐσχημοσύνη, ῆς, ἡ: decorum, becomingness. decorum, becomingness, embellishment.

G2158 εὐσχήμων, ον: comely, honorable. (a) comely, seemly, decorous, (b) of honorable position (in society), wealthy, influential.

G2159 εὐτόνως: vehemently, powerfully. vehemently, powerfully, vigorously.

G2160 εὐτραπελία, ας, ἡ: low jesting, ribaldry. low jesting, ribaldry.

G2161 Εὔτυχος, ου, ὁ: Eutychus. Eutychus, a young hearer of Paul at Troas.

G2162 εὐφημία, ας, ἡ: commendation, good report. commendation, good report, praise.

G2163 εὔφημος, ον: well reported of, spoken in a kindly spirit. well reported of, spoken in a kindly spirit, laudable, reputable.

G2164 εὐφορέω: I bear well, bring a good harvest. I bear well, bring a good harvest, yield abundantly.

G2165 εὐφραίνω: I cheer, am glad, make merry. I cheer, make glad; generally mid. or pass: I am glad, make merry, revel, feast.

G2166 Εὐφράτης, ου, ὁ: the Euphrates. the Euphrates, boundary river of the province Syria.

G2167 εὐφροσύνη, ης, ἡ: joy, gladness. joy, gladness, rejoicing.

G2168 εὐχαριστέω: I thank, give thanks. I thank, give thanks; pass. 3 sing: is received with thanks.

G2169 εὐχαριστία, ας, ἡ: thankfulness, gratitude. thankfulness, gratitude; giving of thanks, thanksgiving.

G2170 εὐχάριστος, ον: thankful, grateful. thankful, grateful.

G2171 εὐχή, ῆς, ἡ: a prayer, vow. a prayer comprising a vow; a prayer, vow.

G2172 εὔχομαι: I pray, wish. I pray, wish.

G2173 εὔχρηστος, ον: useful, serviceable. useful, serviceable, very profitable.

G2174 εὐψυχέω: I am of good cheer. I am of good cheer.

G2175 εὐωδία, ας, ἡ: a sweet smell. a sweet smell, fragrance.

G2176 εὐώνυμος, ον: on the left-hand side, left. (lit: well-named, to avoid the evil omen attaching to the left), on the left-hand side, left.

G2177 ἐφάλλομαι: I leap upon. I leap upon, assault.

G2178 ἐφάπαξ: once, once for all. once, once for all; at once.

G2180 Ἐφέσιος, α, ον: Ephesian. Ephesian, of Ephesus.

G2181 Ἔφεσος, ου, ἡ: Ephesus. Ephesus, a coast city, capital of the Roman province Asia.

G2182 ἐφευρετής, οῦ, ὁ: an inventor, contriver, discoverer. an inventor, contriver, discoverer.

G2183 ἐφημερία, ας, ἡ: a class of priests. a class of priests who served for a stated number of days.

G2184 ἐφήμερος, ον: for the day, daily. for the day, daily, necessary for every day.

G2185 ἐφικνέομαι: I come to, reach as far as. I come to, reach as far as.

G2186 ἐφίστημι: I stand by, am urgent, befall one, impend. I stand by, am urgent, befall one (as of evil), am at hand, impend.

G2187 Ἐφραΐμ, ὁ: Ephraim. Ephraim, a city.

G2188 ἐφφαθά: be opened up. (Aramaic, meaning) be opened up.

G2189 ἔχθρα, ας, ἡ: enmity, hostility. enmity, hostility, alienation.

G2190 ἐχθρός, ά, όν: hated, hostile, an enemy. hated, hostile; subst: an enemy.

G2191 ἔχιδνα, ης, ἡ: a serpent, snake, viper. a serpent, snake, viper.

G2192 ἔχω: I have, hold, possess. I have, hold, possess.

G2193 ἕως: until, as far as. (a) conj: until, (b) prep: as far as, up to, as much as, until.

G2194 Ζαβουλών, ὁ: Zebulon. Zebulon, one of the sons of Jacob, and founder of one of the twelve tribes.

G2195 Ζακχαῖος, ου, ὁ: Zacchaeus. Zacchaeus, a Jewish tax-gatherer.

G2196 Ζαρά, ὁ: Zerah. Zerah, son of Judah and Tamar.

G2197 Ζαχαρίας, ου, ὁ: Zechariah. Zechariah, (a) a priest referred to as a son of Jehoiada, (b) another priest, father of John the Baptist.

G2198 ζάω: I live. I live, am alive.

G2199 Ζεβεδαῖος, ου, ὁ: Zebedee. Zebedee, father of the apostles James and John.

G2200 ζεστός, ή, όν: boiling hot. boiling hot; met: fervent.

G2201 ζεῦγος, ους, τό: a yoke, team, pair. a yoke, team; hence: a pair.

G2202 ζευκτηρία, ας, ἡ: a band, fastening. a band, fastening.

G2203 Ζεύς, Διός, Δία (acc.), ὁ: Zeus. Zeus, the Greek god of the sky in all its manifestations, corresponding to the Roman Jupiter and to the leading god of the native Lycaonians.

G2204 ζέω: I burn in spirit. (lit: I boil, am boiling), I burn (in spirit), am fervent.

G2205 ζῆλος, ου, ὁ: eagerness, zeal, rivalry. (a) eagerness, zeal, enthusiasm, (b) jealousy, rivalry.

G2206 ζηλόω: I am jealous, eager for. (a) intrans: I am jealous, (b) trans: I am jealous of, with acc. of a person; I am eager for, am eager to possess, with acc. of a thing.

G2207 ζηλωτής, οῦ, ὁ: a zealot. one who is eagerly devoted to a person or a thing, a zealot.

G2209 ζημία, ας, ἡ: damage, loss. damage, loss, detriment.

G2210 ζημιόω: I inflict loss upon, punish. I inflict loss (damage) upon, fine, punish, sometimes with the acc. of the penalty, even when the verb is passive.

G2211 Ζηνᾶς, ᾶν, ὁ: Zenas. Zenas, a lawyer in Rome.

G2212 ζητέω: I seek, search for, desire. I seek, search for, desire, require, demand.

G2213 ζήτημα, ατος, τό: a question, dispute. a question, subject of inquiry, dispute.

G2214 ζήτησις, εως, ἡ: a question, debate, controversy. a question, debate, controversy; a seeking, search.

G2215 ζιζάνιον, ου, τό: spurious wheat, darnel. spurious wheat, darnel; a plant that grows in Palestine which resembles wheat in many ways but is worthless.

G2216 Ζοροβάβελ, ὁ: Zerubbabel. Zerubbabel, son of Shealtiel (Salathiel) and father of Abiud and Rhesa.

G2217 ζόφος, ου, ὁ: darkness, murkiness. darkness, murkiness, gloom.

G2218 ζυγός, οῦ, ὁ: a yoke, heavy burden, pair of scales. a yoke; hence met: (a Jewish idea) of a heavy burden, comparable to the heavy yokes resting on the bullocks' necks; a balance, pair of scales.

G2219 ζύμη, ης, ἡ: leaven, ferment. leaven, ferment, both lit. and met.

G2220 ζυμόω: I leaven, ferment. I leaven, ferment.

G2221 ζωγρέω: I capture alive. I capture alive, capture for life, enthrall.

G2222 ζωή, ῆς, ἡ: life. life, both of physical (present) and of spiritual (particularly future) existence.

G2223 ζώνη, ῆς, ἡ: a girdle, belt, purse. a girdle, belt, waistband; because the purse was kept there, also: a purse.

G2224 ζώννυμι: I gird. I gird, put on the girdle, especially as preparatory to active work.

G2225 ζωογονέω: I preserve alive. I preserve alive (lit: bring to birth), save.

G2226 ζῷον, ου, τό: an animal. an animal, living creature.

G2227 ζῳοποιέω: I make to live. I make that which was dead to live, cause to live, quicken.

G2228 ἤ: or, than. or, than.

G2229 ἦ: truly, surely. truly, surely.

G2230 ἡγεμονεύω: I govern. I govern.

G2231 ἡγεμονία, ας, ἡ: rule, authority. rule, authority, sovereignty; a reign.

G2232 ἡγεμών, όνος, ὁ: a governor. a leader, guide; a commander; a governor (of a province); plur: leaders.

G2233 ἡγέομαι: I lead, think. (a) I lead, (b) I think, am of opinion, suppose, consider.

G2234 ἡδέως: gladly, pleasantly. gladly, pleasantly, with pleasure.

G2235 ἤδη: now, already. already; now at length, now after all this waiting.

G2236 ἥδιστα: most gladly, pleasantly. most gladly, most pleasantly.

G2237 ἡδονή, ῆς, ἡ: pleasure, lust, strong desire. pleasure, a pleasure, especially sensuous pleasure; a strong desire, passion.

G2238 ἡδύοσμον, ου, τό: mint, peppermint. mint, peppermint.

G2239 ἦθος, ους, τό: habit, manner, custom, morals. habit, manner, custom, morals.

G2240 ἥκω: I have come, am present. I have come, am present, have arrived.

G2241 Ἠλί: Eli. Eli, my God (Hebrew).

G2242 Ἡλί, ὁ: Heli. Heli, an ancestor of Jesus.

G2243 Ἠλίας, ου, ὁ: Elijah. Elijah, the prophet.

G2244 ἡλικία, ας, ἡ: age, stature. age, term of life; full age, maturity; stature.

G2245 ἡλίκος, η, ον: of what size, how much. of which size, of what size, how small, how much.

G2246 ἥλιος, ου, ὁ: the sun, sunlight. the sun, sunlight.

G2247 ἧλος, ου, ὁ: a nail. a nail.

G2250 ἡμέρα, ας, ἡ: a day. a day, the period from sunrise to sunset.

G2251 ἡμέτερος, α, ον: our, our own. our, our own.

G2253 ἡμιθανής, ές: half-dead. half-dead.

G2255 ἥμισυς, εια, υ: half. half.

G2256 ἡμιώριον, ου, τό: half an hour. half an hour.

G2259 ἡνίκα: when, whenever. when, whenever, at which time.

G2260 ἤπερ: than. than.

G2261 ἤπιος, α, ον: placid, gentle. placid, gentle, mild.

G2262 Ἤρ, ὁ: Er. Er, son of Joshua and father of Elmadam.

G2263 ἤρεμος, ον: quiet, tranquil. quiet, tranquil.

G2264 Ἡρῴδης, ου, ὁ: Herod. Herod; four persons are called by this name: Herod the Great, Herod Antipas, Herod Agrippa, and Herod Agrippa the younger.

G2265 Ἡρῳδιανοί, ῶν, οἱ: the Herodians, the partisans of Herod Antipas. the Herodians, the partisans of Herod (Antipas).

G2266 Ἡρῳδιάς, άδος, ἡ: Herodias. Herodias (died after A.D. 40), daughter of Aristobulus and granddaughter of Herod I, wife, first, of her uncle Herod, second, of his half-brother, her uncle Herod Antipas.

G2267 Ἡρῳδίων, ωνος, ὁ: Herodion. Herodion, a Christian in Rome, a relative of Paul.

G2268 Ἠσαΐας, ου, ὁ: Isaiah. Isaiah, the prophet.

G2269 Ἠσαῦ, ὁ: Esau. Esau, elder son of Isaac the patriarch, brother of Jacob.

G2270 ἡσυχάζω: I rest, am silent, live quietly. I rest from work, cease from altercation, am silent, live quietly.

G2271 ἡσυχία, ας, ἡ: quietness, silence. quietness, stillness, silence.

G2272 ἡσύχιος, α, ον: quiet, tranquil. quiet, tranquil, peaceful.

G2273 ἤτοι: or of course. whether.

G2274 ἡττάομαι: I am defeated, made inferior. I am defeated, am overcome, am made inferior.

G2275 ἥττημα, ατος, τό: a defeat, failure. defect, loss, defeat, failure, shortcoming.

G2276 ἧττων, ον: lesser, inferior, weaker. lesser, inferior, weaker.

G2278 ἠχέω: I make a sound, sound when struck. I make a sound, give forth a sound, sound (when struck); I roar (as the sea).

G2279 ἦχος, ου, ὁ: a sound, rumor. (a) a sound, noise, (b) a rumor, report.

G2280 Θαδδαῖος, ου, ὁ: Thaddaeus. Thaddaeus, one of the twelve apostles.

G2281 θάλασσα, ης, ἡ: the sea, lake. (a) the sea, in contrast to the land, (b) a particular sea or lake, e.g. the sea of Galilee (Tiberias), the Red Sea.

G2282 θάλπω: I cherish, nourish. (properly: I warm, then) I cherish, nourish, foster, comfort.

G2283 Θάμαρ, ἡ: Tamar. Tamar, mother of Perez and Zerah by Judah, son of Jacob.

G2284 θαμβέω: I amaze. I amaze; pass: I am amazed (almost terrified).

G2285 θάμβος, ους, τό: astonishment. astonishment, amazement (allied to terror or awe).

G2286 θανάσιμος, ον: deadly, mortal. deadly, mortal, fatal.

G2287 θανατηφόρος, ον: death-bringing, deadly. death-bringing, deadly.

title: Dodson Greek-English Lexicon of the New Testament, G2288 to G2512
source: Jeffrey Dodson, Greek-English Lexicon of the New Testament (public domain), data prepared by Ulrik Sandborg-Petersen. Each entry: Strong number, Greek word, short meaning, fuller meaning.
body:
G2288 θάνατος, ου, ὁ: death. death, physical or spiritual.

G2289 θανατόω: I put to death, subdue. I put to death, subdue; pass: I am in danger of death, am dead to, am rid of, am parted from.

G2290 θάπτω: I bury. I bury.

G2291 Θάρα, ὁ: Terah. Terah, the father of Abraham.

G2292 θαρρέω: I am courageous, of good cheer. I am courageous, confident, of good cheer.

G2293 θαρσέω: be of good cheer. I am of good courage, good cheer, am bold.

G2294 θάρσος, ους, τό: courage. courage, confidence.

G2295 θαῦμα, ατος, τό: a marvel, wonder. (a) concr: a marvel, wonder, (b) abstr: wonder, amazement.

G2296 θαυμάζω: I wonder, admire. (a) intrans: I wonder, marvel, (b) trans: I wonder at, admire.

G2297 θαυμάσιος, α, ον: wonderful. wonderful, admirable; subst: a wonder.

G2298 θαυμαστός, ή, όν: wonderful, marvelous. to be wondered at, wonderful, marvelous.

G2299 θεά, ᾶς, ἡ: a goddess. a goddess.

G2300 θεάομαι: I see, behold, contemplate, visit. I see, behold, contemplate, look upon, view; I see, visit.

G2301 θεατρίζω: I make a public show of. I make a public show of, expose to public shame.

G2302 θέατρον, ου, τό: a theatre, spectacle. (a) a theatre, a semi-circular stone building, generally open to the sky, (b) a spectacle, show.

G2303 θεῖον, ου, τό: brimstone, sulfur. brimstone, sulfur.

G2304 θεῖος, α, ον: divine. divine; subst: the Deity.

G2305 θειότης, ητος, ἡ: divinity. divinity, divine nature.

G2306 θειώδης, ες: of brimstone, sulfurous. of brimstone, sulfurous.

G2307 θέλημα, ατος, τό: will, wish, desire. an act of will, will; plur: wishes, desires.

G2308 θέλησις, εως, ἡ: a willing, will. a willing, will.

G2309 θέλω: I will, wish, desire. I will, wish, desire, am willing, intend, design.

G2310 θεμέλιος, ον: belonging to the foundation. (properly, an adj: belonging to the foundation), a foundation stone.

G2311 θεμελιόω: I found, lay the foundation. I found, lay the foundation (lit. and met.).

G2312 θεοδίδακτος, ον: taught by God. taught by God, divinely instructed.

G2313 θεομαχέω: I fight against God. I fight against God.

G2314 θεομάχος, ον: fighting against God. fighting against God.

G2315 θεόπνευστος, ον: God-breathed, inspired by God. God-breathed, inspired by God, due to the inspiration of God.

G2316 θεός, οῦ, ὁ: God, a god. (a) God, (b) a god, generally.

G2317 θεοσέβεια, ας, ἡ: reverence for God. reverence for God, fear of God, godliness, piety.

G2318 θεοσεβής, ές: devout, pious. devout, pious, God-fearing.

G2319 θεοστυγής, ές: hating God, hateful to God. hating God, hateful to God.

G2320 θεότης, ητος, ἡ: deity, Godhead. deity, Godhead.

G2321 Θεόφιλος, ου, ὁ: Theophilus. Theophilus, a friend of Luke of equestrian rank, to whom the Gospel and Acts are dedicated.

G2322 θεραπεία, ας, ἡ: care, attention, healing. care, attention, especially medical attention (treatment); hence almost: healing; meton: those who render service.

G2323 θεραπεύω: I care for, attend, serve, heal. I care for, attend, serve, treat, especially of a physician; hence: I heal.

G2324 θεράπων, οντος, ὁ: a servant, attendant. a servant, attendant, minister.

G2325 θερίζω: I reap, gather. I reap, gather, harvest.

G2326 θερισμός, οῦ, ὁ: reaping, harvest. reaping, harvest; met: the harvest, crop.

G2327 θεριστής, οῦ, ὁ: a reaper, harvester. a reaper, harvester.

G2328 θερμαίνω: I warm. I warm; mid: I warm myself.

G2329 θέρμη, ης, ἡ: heat. heat.

G2330 θέρος, ους, τό: summer. summer.

G2331 Θεσσαλονικεύς, έως, ὁ: Thessalonian. a Thessalonian.

G2332 Θεσσαλονίκη, ης, ἡ: Thessalonica. Thessalonica (modern Saloniki), an important city of the Roman province Macedonia.

G2333 Θευδᾶς, ᾶ, ὁ: Theudas. Theudas, a Jewish pretender of date about 4 B.C., otherwise unknown.

G2334 θεωρέω: I behold, look at, experience. I look at, gaze, behold; I see, experience, discern; I partake of.

G2335 θεωρία, ας, ἡ: a sight, spectacle. a sight, spectacle.

G2336 θήκη, ῆς, ἡ: a scabbard, sheath, receptacle. a repository, receptacle; a case, sheath, scabbard.

G2337 θηλάζω: I give suck, suck. (a) I give suck, (b) I suck.

G2338 θῆλυς, εια, υ: female. female.

G2339 θήρα, ας, ἡ: hunting, entrapping. hunting, entrapping; prey, game; a net, means of capture.

G2340 θηρεύω: I hunt, seek to catch. I hunt, seek to catch or entrap; met: I lay hold of.

G2341 θηριομαχέω: I fight with wild beasts. I fight with wild beasts (i.e. wild beasts in human form); met: I am exposed to fierce hostility.

G2342 θηρίον, ου, τό: a wild beast, animal. properly: a wild beast, hence: any animal; met: a brute.

G2343 θησαυρίζω: I store up, treasure up, save. I store up, treasure up, save, lay up.

G2344 θησαυρός, οῦ, ὁ: a treasure, store. a store-house for precious things; hence: a treasure, a store.

G2345 θιγγάνω: I touch, handle. I touch, handle, injure, harm.

G2346 θλίβω: I make narrow, persecute, press hard. (a) I make narrow (strictly: by pressure); I press upon, (b) I persecute, press hard.

G2347 θλῖψις, εως, ἡ: persecution, affliction, distress. persecution, affliction, distress, tribulation.

G2348 θνῄσκω: I am dying, am dead. I die, am dying, am dead.

G2349 θνητός, ή, όν: mortal. mortal, subject to death.

G2350 θορυβέω: I disturb greatly, terrify, strike with panic. I disturb greatly, terrify, strike with panic; mid: I show agitation of mind.

G2351 θόρυβος, ου, ὁ: confused noise, riot, disturbance. (a) din, hubbub, confused noise, outcry, (b) riot, disturbance.

G2352 θραύω: I crush, break, shatter. I crush, break, shatter; met: I break down.

G2353 θρέμμα, ατος, τό: cattle. (lit: a nursling, hence probably) plur: cattle.

G2354 θρηνέω: I wail, lament. intrans: I lament, wail; trans: I bewail.

G2355 θρῆνος, ου, ὁ: wailing, lamentation. wailing, lamentation, dirge.

G2356 θρησκεία, ας, ἡ: ritual worship, religion. (underlying sense: reverence or worship of the gods), worship as expressed in ritual acts, religion.

G2357 θρῆσκος, ον: religious. (refers probably to a careful observance of religious restrictions), religious (probably in a limited sense), devout.

G2358 θριαμβεύω: I lead around, make a spectacle of. (properly: I lead one as my prisoner in a triumphal procession, hence) I lead around, make a show (spectacle) of, cause to triumph.

G2359 θρίξ, τριχός, ἡ: a hair. hair (of the head or of animals).

G2360 θροέω: I disturb, agitate. I disturb, agitate; pass: I am troubled, alarmed.

G2361 θρόμβος, ου, ὁ: a clot, large drop. a clot, large drop (of blood).

G2362 θρόνος, ου, ὁ: a throne, seat. a (king's) throne, seat; meton: power, dominion; a potentate.

G2363 Θυάτειρα, ων, τά: Thyatira. Thyatira, a city of the old district Lydia, in the Roman province Asia.

G2364 θυγάτηρ, τρός, ἡ: a daughter. a daughter; hence (Hebraistic?), of any female descendent, however far removed; even of one unrelated: my young lady.

G2365 θυγάτριον, ου, τό: a little daughter. a little (young) daughter.

G2366 θύελλα, ης, ἡ: a storm, tempest. a storm, tempest, whirlwind.

G2367 θύϊνος, η, ον: of the citron tree. of the sandarach (so-called citron) tree.

G2368 θυμίαμα, ατος, τό: incense. incense.

G2369 θυμιατήριον, ου, τό: altar of incense. (ordinarily: censer, but) either the altar of incense, or the shovel, on which the high-priest poured the coals, when he entered the Holy of Holies on the Day of Atonement.

G2370 θυμιάω: I burn incense. I burn incense.

G2371 θυμομαχέω: I am furiously angry with. (lit: I fight desperately, hence) I am furiously angry with.

G2372 θυμός, οῦ, ὁ: an outburst of passion, wrath. an outburst of passion, wrath.

G2373 θυμόω: I provoke to anger, am full of angry passion. I provoke to anger; pass: I am wroth or very angry.

G2374 θύρα, ας, ἡ: a door, opportunity. (a) a door, (b) met: an opportunity.

G2375 θυρεός, οῦ, ὁ: a large shield. the heavy oblong Roman shield.

G2376 θυρίς, ίδος, ἡ: a window-sill. a small opening, window.

G2377 θυρωρός, οῦ, ὁ, ἡ: a door-keeper, porter. a door-keeper, porter.

G2378 θυσία, ας, ἡ: a sacrifice. abstr. and concr: sacrifice; a sacrifice, offering.

G2379 θυσιαστήριον, ου, τό: an altar. an altar (for sacrifice).

G2380 θύω: I sacrifice, kill. I sacrifice, generally an animal; hence: I kill.

G2381 Θωμᾶς, ᾶ, ὁ: Thomas. Thomas, also called Didymus, one of the Twelve.

G2382 θώραξ, ακός, ὁ: a breast-plate. a breast-plate, corslet, cuirass.

G2383 Ἰάειρος, ου, ὁ: Jairus. Jairus, a Jewish ruler of the synagogue.

G2384 Ἰακώβ, ὁ: Jacob. (Hebrew), Jacob, (a) the patriarch, son of Isaac, (b) father of Joseph, the husband of Mary.

G2385 Ἰάκωβος, ου, ὁ: James. James, (a) the Small, son of Alphaeus, and one of the Twelve, (b) half-brother of Jesus, (c) father (?) of Jude, (d) son of Zebedee, and brother of John, one of the Twelve, killed A.D. 44.

G2386 ἴαμα, ατος, τό: healing, curing. healing, curing, remedy.

G2387 Ἰαμβρῆς, ου, ὁ: Jambres. Jambres, a sorcerer at the court of the Pharaoh.

G2388 Ἰαννά, ὁ: Jannai. Jannai, an ancestor of Jesus; Jannai was the son of Joseph, and father of Melchi.

G2389 Ἰαννῆς, ου, ὁ: Jannes. Jannes, a sorcerer at the court of the Pharaoh.

G2390 ἰάομαι: I heal. I heal, generally of the physical, sometimes of spiritual, disease.

G2391 Ἰαρέδ, ὁ: Jared. (Hebrew), Jared, son of Mahalalel and father of Enoch.

G2392 ἴασις, εως, ἡ: a cure, healing. a cure, healing.

G2393 ἴασπις, ιδος, ἡ: jasper. jasper; a precious stone.

G2394 Ἰάσων, ονος, ὁ: Jason. Jason, a Christian of Thessalonica, perhaps the same as the "relative" of Paul.

G2395 ἰατρός, οῦ, ὁ: a physician. a physician.

G2396 ἴδε: See! Lo! Behold! Look!. See! Lo! Behold! Look!.

G2397 ἰδέα, ας, ἡ: form, outward appearance. form, outward appearance.

G2398 ἴδιος, α, ν: one's own, private, personal. one's own, belonging to one, private, personal; one's own people, one's own family, home, property.

G2399 ἰδιώτης, ου, ὁ: an amateur, layman. (unofficial, hence) an amateur, an unprofessional man, a layman; an ungifted person.

G2400 ἰδού: See! Lo! Behold! Look!. See! Lo! Behold! Look!.

G2401 Ἰδουμαία, ας, ἡ: Idumea, Edom. Idumea, Edom, a district of Arabia, immediately south of Judea.

G2402 ἱδρώς, ῶτος, ὁ: sweat, perspiration. sweat, perspiration.

G2403 Ἰεζάβελ, ἡ: Jezebel. Jezebel, name given to a false prophetess of Thyatira, possibly borrowed from the name of Ahab's wife, queen of Israel.

G2404 Ἱεράπολις, εως, ἡ: Hierapolis. Hierapolis, a city of the Lycus valley in Phrygia, near Laodicea and Colossae.

G2405 ἱερατεία, ας, ἡ: the duty of a priest. the duty (office) of a priest, priesthood.

G2406 ἱεράτευμα, ατος, τό: the act or office of priesthood. the act or office of priesthood.

G2407 ἱερατεύω: I serve as priest. I serve as priest.

G2408 Ἰερεμίας, ου, ὁ: Jeremiah. Jeremiah, Hebrew prophet.

G2409 ἱερεύς, έως, ὁ: a priest. a priest, one who offers sacrifice to a god (in Jewish and pagan religions; of Christians only met.).

G2410 Ἰεριχώ, ἡ: Jericho. Jericho, a city a little north of the Dead Sea.

G2411 ἱερόν, οῦ, τό: a temple. a temple, either the whole building, or specifically the outer courts, open to worshippers.

G2412 ἱεροπρεπής, ές: suitable to a sacred character, reverent. suitable to a sacred character, reverent.

G2413 ἱερός, ά, όν: sacred, holy. sacred, holy, set apart.

G2414 Ἱεροσόλυμα, ατος, τά, ἡ: Jerusalem. the Greek form of the Hebrew name: Jerusalem.

G2415 Ἱεροσολυμίτης, ου, ὁ: an inhabitant of Jerusalem. an inhabitant of Jerusalem.

G2416 ἱεροσυλέω: I commit sacrilege. I commit sacrilege, rob a temple.

G2417 ἱερόσυλος, ον: robbing temples, sacrilegious. robbing temples, but possibly simply: sacrilegious.

G2418 ἱερουργέω: I minister in holy things. I minister in holy things.

G2419 Ἱερουσαλήμ, ἡ: Jerusalem. (Aramaic form), Jerusalem, the capital of Palestine: hence Judaism, and allegorically, Christendom, the Christian Church.

G2420 ἱερωσύνη, ης, ἡ: the priestly office. the abstract notion of the priestly office.

G2421 Ἰεσσαί, ὁ: Jesse. (Hebrew), Jesse, son of Obed, and father of King David.

G2422 Ἰεφθάε, ὁ: Jephthah. (Hebrew), Jephthah, one of the Judges of Israel.

G2423 Ἰεχονίας, ου, ὁ: Jechoniah. (Hebrew), Jechoniah, son of Josiah and father of Salathiel.

G2424 Ἰησοῦς, οῦ, ὁ: Jesus. Jesus; the Greek form of Joshua; Jesus, son of Eliezer; Jesus, surnamed Justus.

G2425 ἱκανός, ή, όν: sufficient, worthy, many, much. (a) considerable, sufficient, of number, quantity, time, (b) of persons: sufficiently strong (good, etc.), worthy, suitable, with various constructions, (c) many, much.

G2426 ἱκανότης, ητος, ἡ: sufficiency, ability, power. sufficiency, ability, power, fitness.

G2427 ἱκανόω: I make sufficient. I make sufficient, render fit, qualify.

G2428 ἱκετηρία, ας, ἡ: supplication, entreaty. (originally: the olive branch held in the hand of the suppliant), supplication, entreaty.

G2429 ἰκμάς, άδος, ἡ: moisture. moisture.

G2430 Ἰκόνιον, ου, τό: Iconium. Iconium, a Phrygian city of the Roman province Galatia (modern Konia).

G2431 ἱλαρός, ά, όν: joyous, cheerful. joyous, cheerful, not grudging.

G2432 ἱλαρότης, ητος, ἡ: cheerfulness. cheerfulness, graciousness.

G2433 ἱλάσκομαι: I have mercy on, forgive. (a) I have mercy on, show favor to, (b) trans. with object of sins: I forgive, pardon.

G2434 ἱλασμός, οῦ, ὁ: a propitiation, atoning sacrifice. a propitiation (of an angry god), atoning sacrifice.

G2435 ἱλαστήριον, ου, τό: a sin offering, covering. (a) a sin offering, by which the wrath of the deity shall be appeased; a means of propitiation, (b) the covering of the ark, which was sprinkled with the atoning blood on the Day of Atonement.

G2436 ἵλεως: propitious, forgiving. propitious, forgiving, merciful.

G2437 Ἰλλυρικόν, οῦ, τό: Illyricum. Illyricum, a Roman province, afterwards called Dalmatia, bounded by Pannonia on the north, Macedonia on the south, Moesia on the east, and the Adriatic Sea on the west.

G2438 ἱμάς, άντος, ὁ: a thong, strap. a thong, strap, (a) for binding a man who is to be flogged, (b) for fastening a sandal or shoe.

G2439 ἱματίζω: I clothe. I clothe, provide clothing for; pass: I am clothed.

G2440 ἱμάτιον, ου, τό: outer garment. a long flowing outer garment, tunic.

G2441 ἱματισμός, οῦ, ὁ: raiment, clothing. a collective word: raiment, clothing.

G2442 ὁμείρομαι: I long for, love fervently. I desire earnestly, long for; I have a strong affection for, love fervently.

G2443 ἵνα: in order that, so that. in order that, so that.

G2445 Ἰόππη, ης, ἡ: Joppa. Joppa, a coast town of Judea, west-north-west of Jerusalem.

G2446 Ἰορδάνης, ου, ὁ: the Jordan. the Jordan, a great river flowing due south and bounding Galilee, Samaria, and Judea on the east.

G2447 ἰός, οῦ, ὁ: poison, rust. poison, rust; an arrow.

G2448 Ἰούδα, ὁ: Judah, Judas, Jude. Judah, Judas, Jude.

G2449 Ἰουδαία, ας, ἡ: Judea. Judea, a Roman province, capital Jerusalem.

G2450 Ἰουδαΐζω: I live as a Jew. I live as a Jew (in religion, ceremonially).

G2451 Ἰουδαϊκός, ή, όν: Jewish, Judaic. Jewish, Judaic.

G2452 Ἰουδαϊκῶς: in the manner of Jews. in the manner of Jews (religiously, ceremonially).

G2453 Ἰουδαῖος, αία, αῖον: Jewish. Jewish.

G2454 Ἰουδαϊσμός, οῦ, ὁ: the Jewish religion, Judaism. the Jewish religion, Judaism.

G2455 Ἰούδας, α, ὁ: Judah, Judas, Jude. Judah, Judas, Jude.

G2456 Ἰουλία, ας, ἡ: Julia. Julia, a Roman Christian, probably a slave or freed from the Imperial household.

G2457 Ἰούλιος, ου, ὁ: Julius. Julius, a Roman centurion on special service.

G2458 Ἰουνιᾶς, ᾶ, ὁ: Junia. Junia, Junias, a Roman Christian.

G2459 Ἰοῦστος, ου, ὁ: Justus. Justus, (a) a surname of Joseph Barsabbas, one of the two nominated to fill Judas' place as apostle, (b) Titius Justus, a Corinthian Christian, (c) surname of Jesus, a Christian with Paul in Rome.

G2460 ἱππεύς, έως, ὁ: a mounted soldier. a horse-soldier, a mounted soldier, a cavalryman.

G2462 ἵππος, ου, ὁ: a horse. a horse.

G2463 ἶρις, ιδος, ἡ: a rainbow. a rainbow or halo.

G2464 Ἰσαάκ, ὁ: Isaac. (Hebrew), Isaac, the patriarch.

G2465 ἰσάγγελος, ον: like the angels. equal to or like the angels.

G2466 Ἰσαχάρ, ὁ: Issachar. Issachar, a proper name.

G2469 Ἰσκαριώτης, ου, ὁ: Iscariot, a man of Kerioth. Iscariot, surname of Judas.

G2470 ἴσος, η, ον: equal, identical. equal, equivalent, identical.

G2471 ἰσότης, ητος, ἡ: equality. equality; equality of treatment, fairness.

G2472 ἰσότιμος, ον: equally privileged, equal. equally privileged, equal in honor.

G2473 ἰσόψυχος, ον: like-minded. like-minded, of the same mind or spirit.

G2474 Ἰσραήλ, ὁ: Israel. (Hebrew), Israel, surname of Jacob, then the Jewish people, the people of God.

G2475 Ἰσραηλίτης, ου, ὁ: an Israelite. an Israelite, one of the chosen people of Israel, a Jew.

G2476 ἵστημι: I cause to stand, stand. trans: (a) I make to stand, place, set up, establish, appoint; mid: I place myself, stand, (b) I set in balance, weigh; intrans: (c) I stand, stand by, stand still; met: I stand ready, stand firm, am steadfast.

G2477 ἱστορέω: I get acquainted with, visit. I get acquainted with, visit.

G2478 ἰσχυρός, ά, όν: strong, mighty, powerful. strong (originally and generally of physical strength); mighty, powerful, vehement, sure.

G2479 ἰσχύς, ύος, ἡ: strength, power. strength (absolutely), power, might, force, ability.

G2480 ἰσχύω: I am strong, able. I have strength, am strong, am in full health and vigor, am able; meton: I prevail.

G2481 ἴσως: perhaps. perhaps, equally; it may be that.

G2482 Ἰταλία, ας, ἡ: Italy. Italy.

G2483 Ἰταλικός, ή, όν: Italian. Italian.

G2484 Ἰτουραῖος, α, ον: Ituraean. Ituraean, an adjective applied to a district also called Trachonitis, about 60 miles east of the Sea of Galilee, and partly inhabited by the nomad tribe called Ituraeans.

G2485 ἰχθύδιον, ου, τό: a little fish. a small fish.

G2486 ἰχθύς, ύος, ὁ: a fish. a fish.

G2487 ἴχνος, ους, τό: a track, footstep. a track, footstep.

G2488 Ἰωάθαμ, ὁ: Jotham. Jotham, son of Uzziah and father of Ahaz.

G2489 Ἰωάννα, ας, ἡ: Joanna. (Hebrew), Joanna, Johanna, wife of Chuza, Herod's steward.

G2490 Ἰωανάν, ὁ: Joanan. Joanan, a proper name.

G2491 Ἰωάννης, ου, ὁ: John. John: the Baptist, the apostle, a member of the Sanhedrin, or John Mark.

G2492 Ἰώβ, ὁ: Job. (Hebrew), Job, the hero of the book of that name in the Old Testament.

G2493 Ἰωήλ, ὁ: Joel. Joel, the Hebrew prophet.

G2494 Ἰωνάν, ὁ: Jonam. (Hebrew), Jonam, an ancestor of Jesus.

G2495 Ἰωνᾶς, ᾶ, ὁ: Jonah. (Hebrew), Jonah, the Hebrew prophet.

G2496 Ἰωράμ, ὁ: Joram, Jehoram. (Hebrew), Joram, Jehoram, son of Jehoshaphat and father of Uzziah.

G2497 Ἰωρείμ, ὁ: Jorim. (Hebrew), Jorim, an ancestor of Jesus.

G2498 Ἰωσαφάτ, ὁ: Jehoshaphat. (Hebrew), Jehoshaphat, king of Judah, son of Asaph, father of Joram, an ancestor of Jesus.

G2499 Ἰωσῆ: gen. of Joses. (Hebrew), gen. case of Joses (a) son of Eliezer, (b) son of Mary, brother of Jesus, (c) surnamed Barnabas (also called Joseph).

G2500 Ἰωσῆς, ῆτος, ὁ: Joses. (Hebrew), Joses (a) son of Eliezer, (b) son of Mary, half-brother of Jesus, (c) surnamed Barnabas (also called Joseph).

G2501 Ἰωσήφ, ὁ: Joseph. Joseph, a proper name.

G2502 Ἰωσίας, ου, ὁ: Josiah. (Hebrew), Josiah, king of Judah.

G2503 ἰῶτα, τό: a small letter of the Greek alphabet. iota, a small letter of the Greek alphabet, used in the NT (like yod, the Hebrew or rather Aramaic letter which was the smallest of all) to indicate the smallest part.

G2504 κἀγώ: I also, I too. I also, I too, but I.

G2505 καθά: as. just as.

G2506 καθαίρεσις, εως, ἡ: taking down, destroying. taking down, razing, destroying.

G2507 καθαιρέω: I take down, depose, destroy. (a) I take down, pull down, depose, destroy.

G2508 καθαίρω: I cleanse, purify, prune. I cleanse, purify, prune.

G2509 καθάπερ: even as. even as, just as.

G2510 καθάπτω: I lay hold of, fasten on to. I lay hold of, fasten on to, seize, attack.

G2511 καθαρίζω: I make clean. I cleanse, make clean, literally, ceremonially, or spiritually, according to context.

G2512 καθαρισμός, οῦ, ὁ: cleansing, purifying, purification. cleansing, purifying, purification, literal, ceremonial, or moral; met: expiation.

title: Dodson Greek-English Lexicon of the New Testament, G2513 to G2740
source: Jeffrey Dodson, Greek-English Lexicon of the New Testament (public domain), data prepared by Ulrik Sandborg-Petersen. Each entry: Strong number, Greek word, short meaning, fuller meaning.
body:
G2513 καθαρός, ά, όν: clean, pure, unstained. clean, pure, unstained, either literally or ceremonially or spiritually; guiltless, innocent, upright.

G2514 καθαρότης, ητος, ἡ: cleanness, purity. cleanness, purity.

G2515 καθέδρα, ας, ἡ: a seat, chair. a seat, chair.

G2516 καθέζομαι: I am sitting, sit, am seated. I am sitting, sit down, am seated.

G2517 καθεξῆς: in order, just after. in order, in succession, in the time immediately after, just after.

G2518 καθεύδω: I sleep, am sleeping. I sleep, am sleeping.

G2519 καθηγητής, ου, ὁ: a leader, teacher, guide. a leader, teacher, guide, master.

G2520 καθήκω: it is fitting. I come down, come to; I am unfit, proper.

G2521 κάθημαι: I sit, am seated. I sit, am seated, enthroned; I dwell, reside.

G2522 καθημερινός, ή, όν: daily. daily, day-by-day.

G2523 καθίζω: I set, make to sit. (a) trans: I make to sit; I set, appoint, (b) intrans: I sit down, am seated, stay.

G2524 καθίημι: I let down. I send, let down, lower.

G2525 καθίστημι: I set, establish, appoint, conduct. I set down, bring down to a place; I set in order, appoint, make, constitute.

G2526 καθό: as, according as. according to which thing, as, according as.

G2527 καθόλου: entirely, at all. one the whole, in general, altogether.

G2528 καθοπλίζω: I arm completely. I arm completely.

G2529 καθοράω: I see clearly. I see clearly, perceive, discern.

G2530 καθότι: according as, because. (a) in proportion as, according as, (b) because.

G2531 καθώς: just as, as. according to the manner in which, in the degree that, just as, as.

G2532 καί: and, even, also, namely. and, even, also, namely.

G2533 Καϊάφας, ᾶ, ὁ: Caiaphas. Caiaphas, Jewish high priest.

G2535 Κάϊν, ὁ: Cain. (Hebrew), Cain, son of Adam and Eve and brother of Abel.

G2536 Καϊνάν, ὁ: Cainan. (Hebrew), Cainan, one of the ancestors of Jesus.

G2537 καινός, ή, όν: fresh, new. fresh, new, unused, novel.

G2538 καινότης, ητος, ἡ: freshness, newness. freshness, newness, novelty.

G2539 καίπερ: although. although, though.

G2540 καιρός, οῦ, ὁ: fitting season, opportunity, time. fitting season, season, opportunity, occasion, time.

G2541 Καῖσαρ, αρος, ὁ: Caesar. Caesar, a surname of the gens Iulia, which became practically synonymous with the Emperor for the time being; in the Gospels it always refers to Tiberias.

G2542 Καισάρεια, ας, ἡ: Caesarea. Two cities of Palestine: one in Galilee (Caesarea Philippi), the other on the coast of the Mediterranean.

G2543 καίτοι: and yet, although. and yet, although, though.

G2544 καίτοιγε: and yet, although. and yet, although, indeed.

G2545 καίω: I ignite, light, burn. I ignite, light, burn, lit. and met; I consume with fire.

G2546 κἀκεῖ: and there, and yonder. and there, and yonder, there also.

G2547 κἀκεῖθεν: and thence, and from there. and thence, and from there; and then afterwards.

G2548 κἀκεῖνος, η, ο: and he, she, it, and that. and he, she, it, and that.

G2549 κακία, ας, ἡ: evil, wickedness, malice. (a) evil (i.e. trouble, labor, misfortune), (b) wickedness, (c) vicious disposition, malice, spite.

G2550 κακοήθεια, ας, ἡ: evil-mindedness. evil-mindedness, malignity, malevolence.

G2551 κακολογέω: I speak evil of, curse. I speak evil of, curse, revile, abuse.

G2552 κακοπάθεια, ας, ἡ: suffering. experience of evil, suffering, distress, affliction, perseverance.

G2553 κακοπαθέω: I suffer evil, endure affliction. I suffer evil, endure affliction.

G2554 κακοποιέω: I do harm, do wrong. I do harm, do wrong, do evil, commit sin.

G2555 κακοποιός, όν: an evil-doer. doing evil; subst: an evil-doer.

G2556 κακός, ή, όν: bad, evil. bad, evil, in the widest sense.

G2557 κακοῦργος, ον: a criminal. (lit: an evil-worker), a criminal.

G2558 κακουχέω: I treat evilly. I treat evilly, hurt, torment.

G2559 κακόω: I treat badly. I treat badly, afflict, embitter, make angry.

G2560 κακῶς: badly, evilly. badly, evilly, wrongly.

G2561 κάκωσις, εως, ἡ: affliction, ill-treatment. affliction, ill-treatment, oppression, misery.

G2562 καλάμη, ῆς, ἡ: stubble. stubble, straw, the stalk.

G2563 κάλαμος, ου, ὁ: a reed, reed-pen. a reed; a reed-pen, reed-staff, measuring rod.

G2564 καλέω: I call, invite, name. (a) I call, summon, invite, (b) I call, name.

G2565 καλλιέλαιος, οῦ, ἡ: a cultivated olive tree. a cultivated olive tree.

G2566 κάλλιον: very well. very well.

G2567 καλοδιδάσκαλος, ου, ὁ, ἡ: a teacher of that which is noble. a teacher of that which is noble (honorable) and good.

G2569 καλοποιέω: I act uprightly. I do well, act honorably, do what is right.

G2570 καλός, ή, όν: beautiful, good, worthy. beautiful, as an outward sign of the inward good, noble, honorable character; good, worthy, honorable, noble, and seen to be so.

G2571 κάλυμμα, ατος, τό: a veil. a covering, especially a covering of head and face, a veil.

G2572 καλύπτω: I veil, hide, conceal, envelop. I veil, hide, conceal, envelop.

G2573 καλῶς: well, nobly, rightly. well, nobly, honorably, rightly.

G2574 κάμηλος, ου, ὁ, ἡ: a camel. a camel or dromedary.

G2575 κάμινος, ου, ἡ: a furnace. a furnace, oven, kiln.

G2576 καμμύω: I close. I close, shut the eyes.

G2577 κάμνω: I am weary, ill. I work, am weary, am sick.

G2578 κάμπτω: I bend, bow. I bend, bow.

G2579 κἄν: and if, even if. and if, even if, even, at least.

G2580 Κανᾶ, ἡ: Cana. Cana, a town in Galilee.

G2581 Κανανίτης, ου, ὁ: a Canaanite. a Canaanite.

G2582 Κανδάκη, ης, ἡ: Candace. Candace, a proper name; the Candace, a dynastic name for queens of the Ethiopians in Abyssinia.

G2583 κανών, όνος, ὁ: rule, regulation, province. (lit: a level, ruler), a rule, regulation, rule of conduct or doctrine, (b) a measured (defined) area, province.

G2584 Καπερναούμ, ἡ: Capernaum. Capernaum, a town of Galilee.

G2585 καπηλεύω: I hawk, trade in. I hawk, trade in, deal in for purposes of gain.

G2586 καπνός, οῦ, ὁ: smoke. smoke.

G2587 Καππαδοκία, ας, ἡ: Cappadocia. Cappadocia, a large Roman province in the central eastern part of Asia Minor.

G2588 καρδία, ας, ἡ: the heart, inner life, intention. lit: the heart; mind, character, inner self, will, intention, center.

G2589 καρδιογνώστης, ου, ὁ: a knower of the inner life. a knower of the inner life (character, hearts).

G2590 καρπός, οῦ, ὁ: fruit, result, gain. (a) fruit, generally vegetable, sometimes animal, (b) met: fruit, deed, action, result, (c) profit, gain.

G2591 Κάρπος, ου, ὁ: Carpus. Carpus, a Christian of Troas.

G2592 καρποφορέω: I bear fruit. I bear fruit.

G2593 καρποφόρος, ον: fruitful. fruitful.

G2594 καρτερέω: I persevere, endure. I persevere, endure, am steadfast, patient.

G2595 κάρφος, ους, τό: a dry stalk, chip of wood. a dry stalk, chip of wood, twig, splinter, chaff.

G2596 κατά: down from, against, according to, throughout, during. gen: against, down from, throughout, by; acc: over against, among, daily, day-by-day, each day, according to, by way of.

G2597 καταβαίνω: I go down, come down. I go down, come down, either from the sky or from higher land, descend.

G2598 καταβάλλω: I cast, lay down. (a) mid: I lay, of a foundation, (b) met: I cast down, prostrate.

G2599 καταβαρέω: I burden, oppress. I burden, oppress, weigh down.

G2600 κατάβασις, εως, ἡ: descent. descent.

G2601 καταβιβάζω: I bring down, cause to go down. I bring down, cast down, cause to go down.

G2602 καταβολή, ῆς, ἡ: a foundation, depositing, sowing. (a) foundation, (b) depositing, sowing, deposit, technically used of the act of conception.

G2603 καταβραβεύω: I decide against, condemn. of the umpire in a contest: I decide against, take part against, condemn (perhaps with the idea of assumption, officialism).

G2604 καταγγελεύς, έως, ὁ: a reporter, herald. a reporter, announcer, proclaimer, herald.

G2605 καταγγέλλω: I declare openly, preach. I declare openly, proclaim, preach, laud, celebrate.

G2606 καταγελάω: I laugh at, ridicule. I laugh at, ridicule.

G2607 καταγινώσκω: I condemn, blame. I condemn, blame.

G2608 κατάγνυμι: I break in pieces. I break down (in pieces), crush, break into.

G2609 κατάγω: I lead down, bring down. I lead down, bring down, either from a high place on land or to a lower (or actually to the sea-coast), or from the high seas to land.

G2610 καταγωνίζομαι: I subdue. I subdue (in warfare); I struggle against, conquer, overcome.

G2611 καταδέω: I bind up. I bind up, bandage.

G2612 κατάδηλος, ον: quite clear. quite clear, evident.

G2613 καταδικάζω: I condemn. I condemn, pass sentence upon.

G2614 καταδιώκω: I hunt down, follow closely. I hunt down, follow closely.

G2615 καταδουλόω: I enslave. I enslave.

G2616 καταδυναστεύω: I overpower, quell, treat harshly. I overpower, quell, treat harshly.

G2617 καταισχύνω: I shame, disgrace, put to utter confusion. I shame, disgrace, bring to shame, put to utter confusion, frustrate.

G2618 κατακαίω: I burn up, consume entirely. I burn up, consume entirely.

G2619 κατακαλύπτω: I veil, cover the head. I veil, cover the head.

G2620 κατακαυχάομαι: I boast against. I boast against, exult over.

G2621 κατάκειμαι: I recline, am lying ill. I recline (at table); more often: I keep my bed, am lying ill (in bed).

G2622 κατακλάω: I break in pieces. I break in pieces, break up.

G2623 κατακλείω: I shut up, confine. I shut up, confine.

G2624 κατακληρονομέω: I give as an inheritance. I give as an inheritance, distribute by lot.

G2625 κατακλίνω: I recline, cause to recline. I cause to recline at table; mid. and pass: I recline at table.

G2626 κατακλύζω: I flood over, overwhelm. I flood over, overwhelm, inundate.

G2627 κατακλυσμός, οῦ, ὁ: a deluge, flood. a deluge, flood.

G2628 κατακολουθέω: I follow after. I follow after.

G2629 κατακόπτω: I beat, wound. I cut up, cut in pieces, mangle, wound.

G2630 κατακρημνίζω: I cast down headlong. I cast down headlong, throw over a precipice.

G2631 κατάκριμα, ατος, τό: punishment following condemnation. punishment following condemnation, penal servitude, penalty.

G2632 κατακρίνω: I condemn. I condemn, judge worthy of punishment.

G2633 κατάκρισις, εως, ἡ: the act of condemnation. condemnation, censure.

G2634 κατακυριεύω: I exercise authority over, overpower. I exercise authority over, overpower, master.

G2635 καταλαλέω: I speak evil of. I speak evil of, rail at, slander.

G2636 καταλαλιά, ας, ἡ: evil-speaking, backbiting, detraction. evil-speaking, backbiting, detraction, slander.

G2637 κατάλαλος, ον: slanderous, back-biting. slanderous, back-biting; subst: a railer, defamer.

G2638 καταλαμβάνω: I seize tight hold of, overtake, comprehend. (a) I seize tight hold of, arrest, catch, capture, appropriate, (b) I overtake, (c) mid. aor: I perceived, comprehended.

G2639 καταλέγω: I enter in a list, register. I enter in a list, register, enroll.

G2640 κατάλειμμα, ατος, τό: a remnant, small residue. a remnant, small residue.

G2641 καταλείπω: I leave behind, abandon. I leave behind, desert, abandon, forsake; I leave remaining, reserve.

G2642 καταλιθάζω: I stone down, stone to death. I stone down, stone to death, overwhelm with stones.

G2643 καταλλαγή, ῆς, ἡ: reconciliation. reconciliation, restoration to favor.

G2644 καταλλάσσω: I reconcile. I change, exchange, reconcile.

G2645 κατάλοιπος, ον: left behind, the remainder. left behind; the rest, the remainder.

G2646 κατάλυμα, ατος, τό: an inn, lodging-place. an inn, lodging-place.

G2647 καταλύω: I break up, overthrow, unharness, find a lodging. (lit: I loosen thoroughly), (a) trans: I break up, overthrow, destroy, both lit. and met., (b) I unyoke, unharness a carriage horse or pack animal; hence: I put up, lodge, find a lodging.

G2648 καταμανθάνω: I understand, consider carefully. I understand, take in a fact about, consider carefully.

G2649 καταμαρτυρέω: I give evidence against. I give evidence (bear witness) against.

G2650 καταμένω: I wait, stay, remain, abide. I wait, stay (with), remain, abide, dwell.

G2651 καταμόνας: alone, apart, in private. along, apart, in private.

G2652 κατάθεμα, ατος, τό: a curse, an accursed thing. a curse, an accursed thing.

G2653 καταθεματίζω: I curse, devote to destruction. I curse, devote to destruction.

G2654 καταναλίσκω: I consume utterly. I use up, spend, consume (as with fire).

G2655 καταναρκάω: I burden, encumber. (properly a medical term: I stupefy, hence) I burden, encumber.

G2656 κατανεύω: I nod, make a sign. I nod, make a sign, beckon.

G2657 κατανοέω: I understand, perceive, consider. I take note of, perceive, consider carefully, discern, detect, make account of.

G2658 καταντάω: I come down, arrive at, reach. (a) I come down, either from high land to lower (or actually to the sea-coast), or from the high seas to the coast; hence met: I arrive at, reach (my destination), (b) of property: I come down (descend) by inheritance to an heir.

G2659 κατάνυξις, εως, ἡ: deep sleep, stupor. deep sleep, torpor, insensibility, stupor.

G2660 κατανύσσομαι: I am pierced, stung. met: I am pierced, stung, smitten.

G2661 καταξιόω: I deem worthy. I deem (count) worthy.

G2662 καταπατέω: I trample under foot. I trample down, trample under foot (lit. and met.), spurn.

G2663 κατάπαυσις, εως, ἡ: resting, rest. (in the Old Testament of the rest attained by the settlement in Canaan), resting, rest, dwelling, habitation.

G2664 καταπαύω: I rest, cause to rest. (a) trans: I cause to rest, bring to rest; I cause to refrain, (b) intrans: I rest.

G2665 καταπέτασμα, ατος, τό: a veil, curtain. (lit: that which is spread out downwards, that which hangs down), a curtain, veil, of that which separated the Holy of Holies from the outer parts of the temple at Jerusalem, also of an outer curtain at the entrance to the Holy Place in the same temple.

G2666 καταπίνω: I swallow, devour, destroy. I drink down, swallow, devour, destroy, consume.

G2667 καταπίπτω: I fall down. I fall down, fall prostrate.

G2668 καταπλέω: I sail down. I sail down (from the high seas to the shore).

G2669 καταπονέω: I ill-treat. I exhaust by labor or suffering, wear out, overpower, oppress.

G2670 καταποντίζω: I sink in the sea, am drowned. I sink in the sea, pass: I drown, am submerged.

G2671 κατάρα, ας, ἡ: a curse, cursing. cursing; a curse; meton: a doomed one.

G2672 καταράομαι: I curse. I curse.

G2673 καταργέω: I bring to naught, sever, abolish. (a) I make idle (inactive), make of no effect, annul, abolish, bring to naught, (b) I discharge, sever, separate from.

G2674 καταριθμέω: I number among. I number among, count with.

G2675 καταρτίζω: I fit together, prepare. (a) I fit (join) together; met: I compact together, (b) act. and mid: I prepare, perfect, for his (its) full destination or use, bring into its proper condition (whether for the first time, or after a lapse).

G2676 κατάρτισις, εως, ἡ: a perfecting. a perfecting, making fit.

G2677 καταρτισμός, ου, ὁ: a perfecting. a bringing to a condition of fitness, perfecting.

G2678 κατασείω: I shake, wave, beckon. I shake (the hand) up and down, wave; intrans: I beckon for silence.

G2679 κατασκάπτω: I dig down under, demolish. I dig down under, demolish, undermine.

G2680 κατασκευάζω: I build, prepare, make. I build, construct, prepare, make ready.

G2681 κατασκηνόω: I encamp, tabernacle, dwell. I encamp, take up my quarters, tabernacle, pitch my tent, dwell.

G2682 κατασκήνωσις, εως, ἡ: a dwelling-place. a dwelling-place.

G2683 κατασκιάζω: I overshadow. I overshadow.

G2684 κατασκοπέω: I spy out, plot against. I view closely, inspect, spy out.

G2685 κατάσκοπος, ου, ὁ: a spy. a spy, scout.

G2686 κατασοφίζομαι: I circumvent by trickery. I deal craftily with, outwit.

G2687 καταστέλλω: I appease, restrain. I let down, lower; I keep down, restrain, pacify.

G2688 κατάστημα, ατος, τό: behavior, conduct. behavior, conduct, deportment, demeanor.

G2689 καταστολή, ῆς, ἡ: garb, dress, attire. garb, clothing, dress, attire.

G2690 καταστρέφω: I overturn, overthrow. I overturn, overthrow.

G2691 καταστρηνιάω: I grow wanton towards. I grow wanton towards.

G2692 καταστροφή, ῆς, ἡ: overthrow, destruction. overthrow, destruction, material or spiritual.

G2693 καταστρώννυμι: I scatter on the ground. I strew or spread over; I lay low, overthrow.

G2694 κατασύρω: I drag down. I pull down, drag away.

G2695 κατασφάζω: I slaughter. I slaughter, kill off, slay.

G2696 κατασφραγίζω: I seal and thus close. I seal up, secure with a seal.

G2697 κατάσχεσις, εως, ἡ: a possession. a possession, holding fast.

G2698 κατατίθημι: I lay down, deposit. (a) I lay down, deposit, (b) mid: I lay down or deposit a favor, with the view of receiving one in return, seek favor.

G2699 κατατομή, ῆς, ἡ: a mutilation, spoiling. a mutilation, spoiling.

G2701 κατατρέχω: I run down. I run down.

G2702 καταφέρω: I bring down, oppress. I bear down, overpower; I give a vote or verdict, bring charges.

G2703 καταφεύγω: I flee for refuge. I flee for refuge (implying that the refuge is reached); aor. indicates moment of arrival.

G2704 καταφθείρω: I destroy, corrupt. I destroy, corrupt.
