G2705 καταφιλέω: I kiss affectionately. I kiss affectionately.

G2706 καταφρονέω: I despise, scorn. I despise, scorn, and show it by active insult, disregard.

G2707 καταφρονητής, οῦ, ὁ: a despiser. a despiser, scorner.

G2708 καταχέω: I pour over. I pour (down) upon.

G2709 καταχθόνιος, ον: under the earth, subterranean. under the earth, subterranean, infernal.

G2710 καταχράομαι: I use up. I use to the full, use up.

G2711 καταψύχω: I cool, refresh. I cool, refresh.

G2712 κατείδωλος, ον: full of images of idols. full of images of idols, grossly idolatrous.

G2713 κατέναντι: opposite, in front of. opposite, in front (of), over against.

G2714 κατενώπιον: before the face of. before the face of, over against.

G2715 κατεξουσιάζω: I have power over. I have (exercise) power (authority) over.

G2716 κατεργάζομαι: I work out, produce, accomplish. I effect by labor, achieve, work out, bring about.

G2718 κατέρχομαι: I come down. I come down from sky to earth, or from high land to lower land (or to the coast), or from the high seas to the shore.

G2719 κατεσθίω: I eat till it is finished. I eat up, eat till it is finished, devour, squander, annoy, injure.

G2720 κατευθύνω: I make straight, direct. (a) I make straight, (b) met: I put in the right way, direct.

G2721 κατεφίστημι: I rush, assault. I rush, assault, rise up against.

G2722 κατέχω: I hold fast, bind, restrain. (a) I hold fast, bind, arrest, (b) I take possession of, lay hold of, (c) I hold back, detain, restrain, (d) I hold a ship, keep its head.

G2723 κατηγορέω: I accuse, charge, prosecute. I accuse, charge, prosecute.

G2724 κατηγορία, ας, ἡ: a charge, accusation. an accusation, charge.

G2725 κατήγορος, ου, ὁ: a prosecutor, accuser. an accuser, prosecutor.

G2726 κατήφεια, ας, ἡ: a downcast countenance, gloom, dejection. a downcast countenance as a sign of sorrow, gloominess, gloom, dejection.

G2727 κατηχέω: I instruct orally. I instruct orally, teach, inform.

G2728 κατιόω: I rust. I rust; pass: I am rusted, tarnished.

G2729 κατισχύω: I prevail against, overpower, am able. I prevail against, overpower, get the upper hand.

G2730 κατοικέω: I dwell in, settle in, inhabit. I dwell in, settle in, am established in (permanently), inhabit.

G2731 κατοίκησις, εως, ἡ: dwelling, abode, habitation. a dwelling, abode, habitation.

G2732 κατοικητήριον, ου, τό: a habitation, dwelling-place. a habitation, dwelling-place, abode.

G2733 κατοικία, ας, ἡ: a dwelling, habitation. a dwelling, habitation, settlement.

G2734 κατοπτρίζομαι: I mirror, reflect. I mirror, reflect.

G2735 κατόρθωμα, ατος, τό: anything happily and successfully accomplished. anything happily and successfully accomplished, a beneficial and worthy deed.

G2736 κάτω: down, below, lower, under, less. (a) down, below, also: downwards, (b) lower, under, less, of a length of time.

G2737 κατώτερος, α, ον: lower. lower.

G2738 καῦμα, ατος, τό: burning heat, heat. burning heat, heat.

G2739 καυματίζω: I burn, scorch. I burn, scorch.

G2740 καῦσις, εως, ἡ: a burning up. a burning up, being burned.

title: Dodson Greek-English Lexicon of the New Testament, G2741 to G2957
source: Jeffrey Dodson, Greek-English Lexicon of the New Testament (public domain), data prepared by Ulrik Sandborg-Petersen. Each entry: Strong number, Greek word, short meaning, fuller meaning.
body:
G2741 καυσόω: I burn up. I burn with great heat.

G2742 καύσων, ῶνος, ὁ: a scorching heat, hot wind. a scorching heat, hot wind.

G2743 καυτηριάζω: I cauterize, sear. I cauterize, burn with a hot iron; hence met: I sear.

G2744 καυχάομαι: I boast, glory. I boast; I glory (exult) proudly.

G2745 καύχημα, ατος, τό: a boasting. a boasting; a ground of boasting (glorying, exultation).

G2746 καύχησις, εως, ἡ: the act of boasting, exultation. the act of boasting, glorying, exultation.

G2747 Κεγχρεαί, ας, ἡ: Cenchreae. Cenchreae, the port of Corinth on the Saronic Gulf.

G2748 Κεδρών, ὁ: Kidron. Kidron, a valley near Jerusalem.

G2749 κεῖμαι: I lie, recline, am laid. I lie, recline, am placed, am laid, set, specially appointed, destined.

G2750 κειρία, ας, ἡ: a bandage, grave clothes. a kind of girdle made of cords; a bandage, grave clothes.

G2751 κείρω: I shear, cut the hair of. I shear, cut the hair of; mid: I cut my own hair, have my hair cut.

G2752 κέλευσμα, ατος, τό: a word of command, a call. a word of command, a call, an arousing outcry.

G2753 κελεύω: I command, order. I command, order, direct, bid.

G2754 κενοδοξία, ας, ἡ: vainglory, empty pride. vainglory, empty pride.

G2755 κενόδοξας, ον: vainglorious. vainglorious, boastful.

G2756 κενός, ή, όν: empty, vain, hollow. (a) empty, (b) met: empty (in moral content), vain, ineffective, foolish, worthless, (c) false, unreal, pretentious, hollow.

G2757 κενοφωνία, ας, ἡ: empty disputing, worthless babble. empty disputing, worthless babble.

G2758 κενόω: I empty, deprive of content, make unreal. (a) I empty, (b) I deprive of content, make unreal.

G2759 κέντρον, ου, τό: a sting, goad. a sting, goad; met: of death.

G2760 κεντυρίων, ῶνος, ὁ: a centurion. a centurion, an officer commanding about a hundred infantry in the Roman army.

G2761 κενῶς: falsely, in vain. falsely, in vain, to no purpose.

G2762 κεραία, ας, ἡ: an apostrophe. a little hook, an apostrophe on letters of the alphabet, distinguishing them from other little letters, or a separation stroke between letters.

G2763 κεραμεύς, έως, ὁ: a potter. a potter.

G2764 κεραμικός, ή, όν: of clay, made by a potter. of clay, made by a potter, earthen.

G2765 κεράμιον, ου, τό: a pitcher, earthen vessel. a pitcher, earthen vessel, jar.

G2766 κέραμος, ου, ὁ: a tile, the roof. a tile; practically: the roof.

G2767 κεράννυμι: I mix, pour out for drinking. I mix, mingle, pour out for drinking.

G2768 κέρας, ατος, τό: a horn. (a) a horn, (b) a horn-like projection at the corner of an altar, (c) a horn as a symbol of power.

G2769 κεράτιον, ου, τό: a husk of the carob. a husk (pod) of the carob.

G2770 κερδαίνω: I gain, win, avoid loss. I gain, acquire, win (over), avoid loss.

G2771 κέρδος, ους, τό: gain, advantage. gain, advantage, profit.

G2772 κέρμα, ατος, τό: a small coin. a small coin; plur: small change.

G2773 κερματιστής, οῦ, ὁ: a money-changer. properly: a changer of large into smaller coins, a money-changer.

G2774 κεφάλαιον, ου, τό: the chief matter, a sum of money. (a) the chief matter, the main point, (b) a sum of money.

G2775 κεφαλαιόω: I wound in the head. I wound in the head.

G2776 κεφαλή, ῆς, ἡ: the head. (a) the head, (b) met: a corner stone, uniting two walls; head, ruler, lord.

G2777 κεφαλίς, ίδος, ἡ: a roll, volume. (lit: little head, then: the knob at the end of the wooden core of a roll of papyrus, then) a roll, volume, division (of a book).

G2778 κῆνσος, ου, ὁ: a poll-tax. a poll-tax.

G2779 κῆπος, ου, ὁ: a garden. a garden, any place planted with trees and herbs.

G2780 κηπουρός, οῦ, ὁ: a gardener. a gardener, garden-keeper.

G2781 κηρίον, ου, τό: a honeycomb. a honeycomb.

G2782 κήρυγμα, ατος, τό: a proclamation, preaching. a proclamation, preaching.

G2783 κῆρυξ, υκος, ὁ: a herald, preacher. a herald, preacher, proclaimer.

G2784 κηρύσσω: I proclaim, herald, preach. I proclaim, herald, preach.

G2785 κῆτος, ους, τό: a sea monster, huge fish. a sea monster, huge sea fish, whale.

G2786 Κηφᾶς, ᾶ, ὁ: Cephas. Cephas (Aramaic for rock), the new name given to Simon Peter, the apostle.

G2787 κιβωτός, οῦ, ἡ: an ark. (properly: a wooden box, hence) the Ark, in which Noah sailed; the Ark of the Covenant.

G2788 κιθάρα, ας, ἡ: a harp. a harp, lyre.

G2789 κιθαρίζω: I play on the harp. intrans. and trans: I play on the harp, I harp, with acc. of the tune.

G2790 κιθαρῳδός, ου, ὁ: a harpist. a harpist, one who sings with harp as accompaniment.

G2791 Κιλικία, ας, ἡ: Cilicia. Cilicia, a Roman province between the Taurus range of mountains and the coast in the south-east corner of Asia Minor, linked up with the province of Syria.

G2792 κινάμωμον, ου, τό: cinnamon. (a Semitic word) cinnamon.

G2793 κινδυνεύω: I am in danger. I am in danger or peril.

G2794 κίνδυνος, ου, ὁ: danger, peril, risk. danger, peril, risk.

G2795 κινέω: I move, stir, excite. I set in motion, move, remove, excite, stir up.

G2796 κίνησις, εως, ἡ: a moving, stirring. a moving, stirring.

G2797 Κίς, ὁ: Kish. Kish, the father of Saul.

G2798 κλάδος, ου, ὁ: a branch. a young tender shoot, then: a branch; met: of descendants.

G2799 κλαίω: I weep, weep for, mourn. I weep, weep for, mourn, lament.

G2800 κλάσις, εως, ἡ: a breaking. a breaking.

G2801 κλάσμα, ατος, τό: a fragment. a fragment, broken piece.

G2802 Κλαῦδη, ης, ἡ: Cauda, Clauda. Cauda, Clauda, an island twenty-three miles south of the western end of Crete.

G2803 Κλαυδία, ας, ἡ: Claudia. Claudia, a Christian woman in Rome; probably a freedwoman of the imperial household.

G2804 Κλαύδιος, ου, ὁ: Claudius. (a) Claudius, the fourth of the Roman Emperors, Tiberius Claudius Caesar Augustus Germanicus, who ruled A.D. 41-54, (b) Claudius Lysias, a tribune at Jerusalem.

G2805 κλαυθμός, οῦ, ὁ: weeping, lamentation. weeping, lamentation, crying.

G2806 κλάω: I break. I break (in pieces), break bread.

G2807 κλεῖς, κλειδός, ἡ: a key. a key.

G2808 κλείω: I shut, shut up. I shut, shut up.

G2809 κλέμμα, ατος, τό: a theft. a theft.

G2810 Κλεοπᾶς, ᾶ, ὁ: Cleopas. Cleopas, one of the two companions of the risen Jesus from Jerusalem to Emmaus.

G2811 κλέος, ους, τό: glory, fame, praise. glory, fame, praise; rumor, report, credit.

G2812 κλέπτης, ου, ὁ: a thief. a thief.

G2813 κλέπτω: I steal. I steal.

G2814 κλῆμα, ατος, τό: a branch, shoot. a branch, shoot, twig.

G2815 Κλήμης, μεντος, ὁ: Clement. Clement, a fellow-worker of Paul in Rome.

G2816 κληρονομέω: I inherit, obtain. I inherit, obtain (possess) by inheritance, acquire.

G2817 κληρονομία, ας, ἡ: an inheritance. an inheritance, an heritage, regularly the gift of God to His chosen people, in the Old Testament: the Promised Land, in NT a possession viewed in one sense as present, in another as future; a share, participation.

G2818 κληρονόμος, ου, ὁ: an heir, inheritor. an heir, an inheritor.

G2819 κλῆρος, ου, ὁ: a lot, portion. (a) a lot, (b) a portion assigned; hence: a portion of the people of God assigned to one's care, a congregation.

G2820 κληρόω: I make a heritage. I cast lots, choose by lot, assign by lot, assign a portion, receive a share.

G2821 κλῆσις, εως, ἡ: a calling, summons. a calling, invitation; in the NT, always of a divine call.

G2822 κλητός, ή, όν: called, summoned. called, invited, summoned by God to an office or to salvation.

G2823 κλίβανος, ου, ὁ: an oven, furnace. an oven, furnace.

G2824 κλίμα, ατος, τό: a territory. a small geographical division, district, or territory.

G2825 κλίνη, ης, ἡ: a couch, bed, mat, bier. a couch, bed, portable bed or mat, a couch for reclining at meals, possibly also a bier.

G2826 κλινίδιον, ου, τό: a couch or litter. a couch or litter of a sick person.

G2827 κλίνω: I rest, recline, make to yield. trans: I rest, recline; I bend, incline; I cause to give ground, make to yield; intrans: I decline, approach my end.

G2828 κλισία, ας, ἡ: a dining couch, group of diners. properly: a dining couch; hence: a group of diners.

G2829 κλοπή, ῆς, ἡ: thieving, theft. thieving, theft.

G2830 κλύδων, ῶνος, ὁ: rough water. rough water, a wave, billow, surge.

G2831 κλυδωνίζομαι: I am tossed by waves. I am tossed by waves, met: I am tossed to and fro.

G2832 Κλωπᾶς, ᾶ, ὁ: Clopas. Clopas, husband of one Mary, who stood by the cross.

G2833 κνήθω: I rub, tickle. I rub, tickle, scratch; pass: I itch.

G2834 Κνίδος, ου, ἡ: Cnidus. Cnidus, a town on the coast of Caria (south-west Asia Minor) near the island of Cos.

G2835 κοδράντης, ου, ὁ: the smallest Roman copper coin. a "quadrans," the smallest Roman copper coin, a quarter of an "as," the sixteenth part of a "sesterius".

G2836 κοιλία, ας, ἡ: belly, womb, the inner man. belly, abdomen, heart, a general term covering any organ in the abdomen, e.g. stomach, womb; met: the inner man.

G2837 κοιμάομαι: I fall asleep, am asleep. I fall asleep, am asleep, sometimes of the sleep of death.

G2838 κοίμησις, εως, ἡ: repose, taking rest. repose, taking rest, sleep.

G2839 κοινός, ή, όν: common, shared, unclean. (a) common, shared, (b) Hebraistic use: profane; dirty, unclean, unwashed.

G2840 κοινόω: I make unclean, regard as unclean. I make unclean, pollute, desecrate, mid: I regard (treat) as unclean.

G2841 κοινωνέω: I share, communicate, have fellowship with. (a) I share, communicate, contribute, impart, (b) I share in, have a share of, have fellowship with.

G2842 κοινωνία, ας, ἡ: participation, communion, fellowship. (lit: partnership) (a) contributory help, participation, (b) sharing in, communion, (c) spiritual fellowship, a fellowship in the spirit.

G2843 κοινωνικός, ή, όν: willing to share. willing to share, sociable, ready to communicate, beneficent.

G2844 κοινωνός, οῦ, ὁ, ἡ: a sharer, partner. a sharer, partner, companion.

G2845 κοίτη, ης, ἡ: a bed, marriage bed. (a) a bed, (b) a marriage bed; plur: repeated (immoral) sexual intercourse.

G2846 κοιτών, ῶνος, ὁ: a bed-chamber. a bed-chamber.

G2847 κόκκινος, η, ον: crimson. crimson, scarlet, dyed with Kermes (coccum), the female coccus of the Kermes oak.

G2848 κόκκος, ου, ὁ: a kernel, grain. a kernel, grain, seed.

G2849 κολάζω: I chastise, punish. I chastise, curtail, punish; mid: I cause to be punished.

G2850 κολακεία, ας, ἡ: flattery. flattery, with a view to advantage or gain.

G2851 κόλασις, εως, ἡ: chastisement, punishment. chastisement, punishment, torment, perhaps with the idea of deprivation.

G2852 κολαφίζω: I strike with the fist, maltreat. I strike with the fist, buffet; hence: I mistreat violently.

G2853 κολλάω: I glue, cleave, keep company with. (lit: I glue); hence: mid. and pass: I join myself closely, cleave, adhere (to), I keep company (with), of friendly intercourse.

G2854 κολλούριον, ου, τό: eye-salve. eye-salve.

G2855 κολλυβιστής, ου, ὁ: a money-changer. a money-changer, who changed heathen into Jewish money, for payment into the Temple treasury.

G2856 κολοβόω: I cut short, shorten. (lit: I maim, mutilate), I cut short, shorten, abbreviate.

G2857 Κολοσσαί, ῆς, ἡ: Colossae. Colossae, a town of the Roman province Asia, in the Lycus valley, near Laodicea and Hierapolis.

G2859 κόλπος, ου, ὁ: bosom, bosom of a garment, a bay, gulf. (a) sing. and plur: bosom; (sinus) the overhanging fold of the garment used as a pocket, (b) a bay, gulf.

G2860 κολυμβάω: I swim. (properly: I dive, hence) I swim.

G2861 κολυμβήθρα, ας, ἡ: a pool, swimming-place. (lit: a diving or swimming place), a pool.

G2862 κολωνία, ας, ἡ: a colony, garrison city. a colony, a city settlement of Roman (soldier) citizens; a garrison city.

G2863 κομάω: I wear the hair long. I wear the hair long, allow the hair to grow out.

G2864 κόμη, ης, ἡ: hair, long hair. hair, long hair.

G2865 κομίζω: I bring, receive, recover. (a) act: I convey, bring, carry, (b) mid: I receive back, receive what has belonged to myself but has been lost, or else promised but kept back, or: I get what has come to be my own by earning, recover.

G2866 κομψότερον: in better health. in better health.

G2867 κονιάω: I whitewash. I whitewash, plaster over.

G2868 κονιορτός, ου, ὁ: dust. dust.

G2869 κοπάζω: I cease, drop. I abate, cease raging, am stilled.

G2870 κοπετός, οῦ, ὁ: lamentation. beating of the breast or head in lamentation, lamentation.

G2871 κοπή, ῆς, ἡ: slaughter. slaughter, smiting in battle.

G2872 κοπιάω: I grow weary, toil. (a) I grow weary, (b) I toil, work with effort (of bodily and mental labor alike).

G2873 κόπος, ου, ὁ: trouble, toil, labor. (a) trouble, (b) toil, labor, laborious toil, involving weariness and fatigue.

G2874 κοπρία, ας, ἡ: manure. manure; a dung-hill.

G2875 κόπτω: I cut off, mourn. (a) I cut, cut off, strike, smite, (b) mid: I beat my breast or head in lamentation, lament, mourn, sometimes with acc. of person whose loss is mourned.

G2876 κόραξ, ός, ὁ: a raven. a raven, crow.

G2877 κοράσιον, ου, τό: a girl, little girl. a little girl, a young girl; a girl, maiden.

G2878 κορβᾶν: a gift, offering. a gift, offering, anything consecrated to God.

G2879 Κορέ, ὁ: Korah. (Hebrew) Korah.

G2880 κορέννυμι: I fill, feed full. I fill, sate, glut, feed full, satisfy.

G2881 Κορίνθιος, ου, ὁ: Corinthian. Corinthian, of Corinth.

G2882 Κόρινθος, ου, ἡ: Corinth. Corinth, in north-east Peloponnese, the capital of the Roman province Achaia.

G2883 Κορνήλιος, ου, ὁ: Cornelius. Cornelius, a centurion of the Roman army, stationed at Caesarea.

G2884 κόρος, ου, ὁ: a dry measure, 120 gallons. (Hebrew) a (dry) measure, equivalent to 120 gallons.

G2885 κοσμέω: I put into order, adorn. I put into order; I decorate, deck, adorn.

G2886 κοσμικός, ή, όν: earthly, worldly. earthly, worldly (belonging to the present earthly world as opposed to the heavenly and future).

G2887 κόσμιος, ία, ον: orderly, virtuous. orderly, virtuous, decent, modest, well-ordered.

G2888 κοσμοκράτωρ, ορος, ὁ: ruler of this world. ruler of this world, that is, of the world as asserting its independence of God; used of the angelic or demonic powers controlling the sublunary world.

G2889 κόσμος, ου, ὁ: the world, universe. the world, universe; worldly affairs; the inhabitants of the world; adornment.

G2890 Κούαρτος, ου, ὁ: Quartus. Quartus, a Christian, brother of Erastus the Corinthian.

G2891 κοῦμι: arise. (Aramaic) arise, stand up.

G2892 κουστωδία, ας, ἡ: a guard. a guard, watch.

G2893 κουφίζω: I lighten. I lighten, make light.

G2894 κόφινος, ου, ὁ: a large basket. a large basket.

G2895 κράβαττος, ου, ὁ: a bed, mattress, mat. a bed, mattress, mat of a poor man.

G2896 κράζω: I cry aloud, shriek. I cry aloud, shriek.

G2897 κραιπάλη, ης, ἡ: drunken dissipation. drunken dissipation, surfeiting.

G2898 κρανίον, ου, τό: a skull. a skull.

G2899 κράσπεδον, ου, τό: the fringe, edge. the fringe, edge, corner, tassel.

G2900 κραταιός, ά, όν: strong, powerful. strong, powerful, mighty.

G2901 κραταιόω: I strengthen, confirm, grow strong. I strengthen, confirm; pass: I grow strong, become strong.

G2902 κρατέω: I lay hold of, obtain. I am strong, mighty, hence: I rule, am master, prevail; I obtain, take hold of; I hold, hold fast.

G2903 κράτιστος, η, ον: most excellent. most excellent, an official epithet, used in addressing a Roman of high rank, and in the second century one of equestrian (as distinguished from senatorial) rank.

G2904 κράτος, ους, τό: dominion, strength, power. dominion, strength, power; a mighty deed.

G2905 κραυγάζω: I cry aloud, shout. I cry aloud, shout, exclaim.

G2906 κραυγή, ῆς, ἡ: a shout, clamor, outcry. (a) a shout, cry, clamor, (b) outcry, clamoring against another.

G2907 κρέας, έως, τό: flesh, kinds of flesh. flesh; plur: pieces of flesh, kinds of flesh.

G2908 κρείσσων, ον: stronger, more excellent. stronger, more excellent.

G2909 κρείττων, ον: stronger, more excellent. stronger, more excellent.

G2910 κρεμάννυμι: I hang up, suspend. I hang, hang up, suspend; mid: I am hanging, hang.

G2911 κρημνός, οῦ, ὁ: a crag, precipice. a crag, precipice, steep bank.

G2912 Κρής, ητός, ὁ: a Cretan. a Cretan, an inhabitant of Crete.

G2913 Κρήσκης, κεντος, ὁ: Crescens. Crescens, a Christian, coadjutor of Paul.

G2914 Κρήτη, ης, ἡ: Crete. Crete.

G2915 κριθή, ῆς, ἡ: barley. barley.

G2916 κρίθινος, η, ον: made of barley. made of barley.

G2917 κρίμα, ατος, τό: a judgment, verdict, lawsuit. (a) a judgment, a verdict; sometimes implying an adverse verdict, a condemnation, (b) a case at law, a lawsuit.

G2918 κρίνον, ου, τό: a lily. a lily growing wild, variously identified with the red anemone, the whole lily, the sword lily.

G2919 κρίνω: I judge, decide, think good. (a) I judge, whether in a law-court or privately: sometimes with cognate nouns emphasizing the notion of the verb, (b) I decide, I think (it) good.

G2920 κρίσις, εως, ἡ: judging, divine judgment. judging, judgment, decision, sentence; generally: divine judgment; accusation.

G2921 Κρίσπος, ου, ὁ: Crispus. Crispus, ruler of the synagogue at Corinth, converted and baptized by Paul.

G2922 κριτήριον, ου, τό: criterion, a law-court. criterion; a law-court; a law-case before an arbiter; a cause, controversy.

G2923 κριτής, ου, ὁ: a judge. a judge, magistrate, ruler.

G2924 κριτικός, ή, όν: able to judge. critical, able to judge or discern.

G2925 κρούω: I knock. I knock, beat a door with a stick, to gain admittance.

G2926 κρύπτη, ης, ἡ: a cellar, vault. a cellar, vault, hidden place, crypt.

G2927 κρυπτός, ή, όν: hidden, secret. hidden, secret; as subst: the hidden (secret) things (parts), the inward nature (character).

G2928 κρύπτω: I hide, conceal, lay up. I hide, conceal, lay up.

G2929 κρυσταλλίζω: I am clear as crystal. I am clear as crystal, brilliant like crystal.

G2930 κρύσταλλος, ου, ὁ: crystal. crystal.

G2931 κρυφῇ: in secret, secretly. in secret, secretly.

G2932 κτάομαι: I win, get, buy, possess. (a) I acquire, win, get, purchase, buy, (b) I possess, win mastery over.

G2933 κτῆμα, ατος, τό: a field, property. a piece of landed property, a field; plur: possessions, property, possibly landed property, property in land.

G2934 κτῆνος, ους, τό: a beast of burden. a beast of burden (generally, a horse or mule) either for riding or for carrying loads on its back, or for yoking to a cart or carriage.

G2935 κτήτωρ, ορος, ὁ: a possessor, owner. a possessor, owner.

G2936 κτίζω: I create, form, shape, make. I create, form, shape, make, always of God.

G2937 κτίσις, εως, ἡ: creation, creature, institution. (often of the founding of a city), (a) abstr: creation, (b) concr: creation, creature, institution; always of Divine work, (c) an institution, ordinance.

G2938 κτίσμα, ατος, τό: a created thing, creature. a created thing, a creature.

G2939 κτίστης, ου, ὁ: a founder, creator, God. (often of the founder of a city), creator, God.

G2940 κυβεία, ας, ἡ: trickery, sleight. (lit: playing with dice, gaming, hence) trickery, sleight.

G2941 κυβέρνησις, εως, ἡ: governing, government. (lit: steering, piloting), governing, government.

G2942 κυβερνήτης, ου, ὁ: a steersman, pilot. a steersman, pilot; met: a guide, governor.

G2943 κυκλόθεν: in a circle round. in a circle round, round about.

G2944 κυκλόω: I encircle, besiege, surround. I encircle, besiege, surround.

G2945 κύκλος, ου, ὁ: a circle. a circle, ring.

G2946 κύλισμα, ατος, τό: rolling, wallowing. a place of wallowing.

G2947 κυλίω: I roll. I roll, roll along, wallow.

G2948 κυλλός, ή, όν: crippled, lame. crippled, lame, especially in the hands.

G2949 κῦμα, ατος, τό: a wave. a wave, surge, billow.

G2950 κύμβαλον, ου, τό: a cymbal. a cymbal.

G2951 κύμινον, ου, τό: cumin. cumin, a plant used as a spice.

G2952 κυνάριον, ου, τό: a little dog. a little dog, a house dog.

G2953 Κύπριος, ου, ὁ: a Cypriote, belonging to Cyprus. a Cypriote, belonging to Cyprus.

G2954 Κύπρος, ου, ἡ: Cyprus. Cyprus.

G2955 κύπτω: I bend, stoop down. I bend, stoop down, bow the head.

G2956 Κυρηναῖος, ου, ὁ: belonging to Cyrene, a Cyrenaean. belonging to Cyrene, a Cyrenaean.

G2957 Κυρήνη, ης, ἡ: Cyrene. Cyrene, a district west of Egypt on the Mediterranean coast, forming with Crete a Roman province.

title: Dodson Greek-English Lexicon of the New Testament, G2958 to G3174
source: Jeffrey Dodson, Greek-English Lexicon of the New Testament (public domain), data prepared by Ulrik Sandborg-Petersen. Each entry: Strong number, Greek word, short meaning, fuller meaning.
body:
G2958 Κυρήνιος, ου, ὁ: Quirinius. Cyrenius or Quirinius, governor of Syria.

G2959 κυρία, ας, ἡ: a lady. a lady.

G2960 κυριακός, ή, όν: of the Lord. of the Lord, special to the Lord.

G2961 κυριεύω: I have authority, rule over. I have authority, rule over.

G2962 κύριος, ου, ὁ: lord, Lord, master, sir. lord, master, sir; the Lord.

G2963 κυριότης, τητος, ἡ: lordship, domination, dignity. (a) abstr: lordship, (b) concr: divine or angelic lordship, domination, dignity, usually with reference to a celestial hierarchy.

G2964 κυρόω: I ratify, confirm. I ratify, confirm, make valid, reaffirm, assure.

G2965 κύων, κυνός, ὁ, ἡ: a dog. a dog, universally despised in the East.

G2966 κῶλον, ου, τό: a limb, bodies. a limb, member of a body; fig: a corpse, carcass.

G2967 κωλύω: I prevent, hinder. I prevent, debar, hinder; with infin: from doing so and so.

G2968 κώμη, ης, ἡ: a village. a village, country town.

G2969 κωμόπολις, εως, ἡ: a large village. a large village, a city which in constitution has only the status of a village; a country town.

G2970 κῶμος, ου, ὁ: a feasting, reveling. a feasting, reveling, carousal.

G2971 κώνωψ, ωπος, ὁ: a gnat, mosquito. a gnat, mosquito, referred to proverbially as something small.

G2972 Κῶς, ῶ, ἡ: Cos. Cos, an island in the Aegean Sea, south-west of Asia Minor.

G2973 Κωσάμ, ὁ: Cosam. Cosam, son of Elmadam and father of Addi.

G2974 κωφός, ή, όν: dumb, deaf. (lit: blunted) dumb, dull, deaf.

G2975 λαγχάνω: I obtain by lot, cast lots. (a) I obtain (receive) by lot, my lot (turn) is, (b) I draw lots.

G2976 Λάζαρος, ου, ὁ: Lazarus, Eliezer. Lazarus, Eliezer, (a) the beggar, (b) the brother of Martha and Mary, of Bethany.

G2977 λάθρᾳ: secretly. secretly, privately.

G2978 λαῖλαψ, απος, ἡ: a sudden storm, squall. a sudden storm, squall, whirlwind, hurricane.

G2979 λακτίζω: I kick. I kick.

G2980 λαλέω: I speak, say. (I talk, chatter in classical Greek, but in NT a more dignified word) I speak, say.

G2981 λαλιά, ας, ἡ: speech, talk, dialect. (in classical Greek: babble, chattering) speech, talk; manner of speech, dialect.

G2982 λιμά: why. (Hebrew), why.

G2983 λαμβάνω: I receive, take. (a) I receive, get, (b) I take, lay hold of.

G2984 Λάμεχ, ὁ: Lamech. (Hebrew), Lamech, son of Methuselah and father of Noah.

G2985 λαμπάς, άδος, ἡ: a torch, lamp, lantern. a torch, lamp, lantern.

G2986 λαμπρός, ά, όν: shining, magnificent, bright. shining, magnificent, bright, splendid.

G2987 λαμπρότης, τητος, ἡ: splendor, brightness. splendor, brightness, brilliancy.

G2988 λαμπρῶς: magnificently, sumptuously. magnificently, sumptuously, splendidly.

G2989 λάμπω: I shine. I shine, give light.

G2990 λανθάνω: I am hidden, escape notice. I am hidden (concealed), lie hid, escape notice, sometimes with acc. of person from whom concealment takes place; I do so and so unconsciously, unknown to myself, I shut my eyes to so and so.

G2991 λαξευτός, ή, όν: hewn out of the rock. hewn out of the rock.

G2992 λαός, οῦ, ὁ: a people, the crowd. (a) a people, characteristically of God's chosen people, first the Jews, then the Christians, (b) sometimes, but rarely, the people, the crowd.

G2993 Λαοδικεία, ας, ἡ: Laodicea. Laodicea, a city in the Lycos valley in the Roman province Asia, near Colossae and Hierapolis.

G2994 Λαοδικεύς, έως, ὁ: a Laodicean. a Laodicean, an inhabitant of Laodicea.

G2995 λάρυγξ, υγγος, ὁ: the throat. the throat, gullet.

G2996 Λασαία, ας, ἡ: Lasea. Lasea, a city in Crete, about the middle of the south coast.

G2997 λάσκω: I burst asunder with a loud noise. I burst asunder with a loud noise.

G2998 λατομέω: I hew stones. I hew stones, cut stones.

G2999 λατρεία, ας, ἡ: service, worship. service rendered to God, perhaps simply: worship.

G3000 λατρεύω: I serve, worship. I serve, especially God, perhaps simply: I worship.

G3001 λάχανον, ου, τό: an herb, garden plant. an herb, garden plant, vegetable.

G3002 Λεββαῖος, ου, ὁ: Lebbaeus. Lebbaeus, a pet-name for Thaddaeus, one of the twelve apostles of Jesus; the full form of the name is not known.

G3003 λεγεών, ῶνος, ἡ: a legion, very large number. properly: a division of the Roman army, numbering about 6,000 infantry with additional cavalry; hence: a very large number; a legion.

G3004 λέγω: I say, speak. (denoting speech in progress), (a) I say, speak; I mean, mention, tell, (b) I call, name, especially in the pass., (c) I tell, command.

G3005 λεῖμμα, ατος, τό: a remnant, remainder. a remnant, remainder.

G3006 λεῖος, α, ον: smooth, level. smooth, level, plain.

G3007 λείπω: I am wanting, am left behind. (earlier: I leave behind, abandon), (a) I am wanting, (b) mid: e.g. with gen: I come behind (in a race), am left behind in, fall short of (some standard), am wanting in.

G3008 λειτουργέω: I minister, serve publicly. I act in the public service, render service, minister, in the widest sense, of some special public religious service, but also of the service of priests and Levites.

G3009 λειτουργία, ας, ἡ: a charitable gift, public service. a charitable gift, public service in the widest sense; service as of priest or Levite ritual.

G3010 λειτουργικός, ή, όν: ministering. given to serving (ministration), ministering.

G3011 λειτουργός, ου, ὁ: a minister, servant. a minister, servant, of an official character; of priests and Levites.

G3012 λέντιον, ου, τό: a towel, apron. a towel, apron, coarse cloth.

G3013 λεπίς, ίδος, ἡ: a scale, scaly substance. a scale, a scaly substance thrown off from the body.

G3014 λέπρα, ας, ἡ: leprosy. leprosy.

G3015 λεπρός, οῦ, ὁ: a leper. a leprous person, a leper.

G3016 λεπτόν, οῦ, τό: a small piece of money. a small piece of money, probably the smallest piece of money.

G3017 Λευΐ, ὁ: Levi. (Hebrew), Levi, (a) an ancestor of Jesus, (b) another ancestor of Jesus, (c) third son of Jacob, the patriarch, and founder of a tribe named after him, (d) son of Alphaeus, and called Matthew, a revenue officer and one of the twelve apostles of Jesus.

G3018 Λευΐς, ὁ: Levi. (Hebrew), Levi, son of Alphaeus, the publican.

G3019 Λευΐτης, ου, ὁ: a Levite. a Levite, properly a man of the tribe of Levi; hence: a priest's assistant, an under priest, as the members of that tribe were charged with this duty.

G3020 Λευϊτικός, ή, όν: Levitical. belonging to the tribe of Levi; Levitical.

G3021 λευκαίνω: I whiten. I whiten, make white.

G3022 λευκός, ή, όν: white, bright. white, bright, brilliant.

G3023 λέων, οντος, ὁ: a lion. a lion.

G3024 λήθη, ῆς, ἡ: forgetfulness. forgetfulness, oblivion.

G3025 ληνός, οῦ, ὁ, ἡ: a winepress. a trough, vat, winepress.

G3026 λῆρος, ου, ὁ: folly, nonsense, idle talk. folly, nonsense, idle talk.

G3027 λῃστής, οῦ, ὁ: a robber, brigand, bandit. a robber, brigand, bandit.

G3028 λῆψις, εως, ἡ: a receiving. a receiving.

G3029 λίαν: very, very much, exceedingly. very; very much, exceedingly, greatly.

G3030 λίβανος, ου, ὁ: incense. (Semitic word), frankincense, incense.

G3031 λιβανωτός, οῦ, ὁ: a censer. a censer.

G3032 Λιβερτῖνος, ου, ὁ: a freedman. a freedman, one of the class of manumitted slaves; a synagogue at Jerusalem appears to have been reserved for them.

G3033 Λιβύη, ης, ἡ: Libya, Africa. Libya, Africa (in the modern sense).

G3034 λιθάζω: I stone. I stone, pelt with stones.

G3035 λίθινος, η, ον: made of stone. made of stone.

G3036 λιθοβολέω: I stone, cast stones at. I stone, cast stones (at), kill by stoning.

G3037 λίθος, ου, ὁ: a stone. a stone; met: of Jesus as the chief stone in a building.

G3038 λιθόστρωτον, ου, τό: a mosaic pavement. (adj: paved with stone), a mosaic pavement.

G3039 λικμάω: I crush to powder. I crush to powder, scatter like chaff.

G3040 λιμήν, ένος, ὁ: a harbor, port. a harbor, port, haven.

G3041 λίμνη, ης, ἡ: a lake. a lake.

G3042 λιμός, οῦ, ὁ, ἡ: a famine, hunger. a famine, hunger.

G3043 λίνον, ου, τό: flax, linen. flax, linen.

G3044 Λῖνος, ου, ὁ: Linus. Linus, a Christian in Rome.

G3045 λιπαρός, ά, όν: rich, sumptuous. (lit: fat), rich, sumptuous.

G3046 λίτρα, ας, ἡ: a Roman pound. a Roman pound, of about twelve ounces.

G3047 λίψ, λιβός, ὁ: the south-west wind. the south-west wind, and thus the quarter from which it comes.

G3048 λογία, ας, ἡ: a collection, collecting. a collection, collecting (of money), particularly of an irregular local contribution for religious purposes.

G3049 λογίζομαι: I reckon, count, decide. I reckon, count, charge with; reason, decide, conclude; think, suppose.

G3050 λογικός, ή, όν: reasonable, rational, metaphorical. (a) reasonable, rational, (b) metaphorical, as contrasted with the literal.

G3051 λόγιον, ου, τό: divine communication. plur: oracles, divine responses or utterances (it can include the entire Old Testament).

G3052 λόγιος, α, ον: eloquent. eloquent, gifted with learning.

G3053 λογισμός, οῦ, ὁ: reasoning, thinking. reasoning, thinking; a conception, device.

G3054 λογομαχέω: I contend about words. I contend about words.

G3055 λογομαχία, ας, ἡ: contention about words. contention about words, an unprofitable controversy.

G3056 λόγος, ου, ὁ: a word, speech, divine utterance, analogy. a word, speech, divine utterance, analogy.

G3057 λόγχη, ης, ἡ: a lance, spear. a lance, spear.

G3058 λοιδορέω: I revile, abuse. I revile a person to his face, abuse insultingly.

G3059 λοιδορία, ας, ἡ: reviling, abuse. reviling, abuse.

G3060 λοίδορος, ου, ὁ: a railer, reviler, abuser. a railer, reviler, abuser.

G3061 λοιμός, οῦ, ὁ: a pestilence. (a) a pestilence, (b) a pestilent fellow.

G3062 λοιπός, ή, όν: left, left behind, the remainder. left, left behind, the remainder, the rest, the others.

G3063 λοιπόν: finally, from now on, henceforth, beyond that. finally, from now on, henceforth, beyond that.

G3064 λοιποῦ: from now on, henceforth, finally. from now on, henceforth, finally.

G3065 Λουκᾶς, ᾶ, ὁ: Lucas, Luke. Lucas, Luke, Christian physician and writer of the Third Gospel and Acts.

G3066 Λούκιος, ου, ὁ: Lucius. Lucius, (a) of Cyrene, an early Christian, in the church of Antioch, by some identified with the evangelist Luke, (b) a Christian with Paul at Corinth, by some identified with (a).

G3067 λουτρόν, οῦ, τό: a bath, washing, baptism. a bath (of water, not the vessel), water for washing, washing.

G3068 λούω: I wash, bathe. (lit. or merely ceremonially), I wash, bathe (the body); mid: of washing, bathing one's self; met: I cleanse from sin.

G3069 Λύδδα, Λύδδης, ἡ: Lydda, Diospolis, Lod. Lydda, Diospolis, Lod (modern Ludd), a city on the way to Joppa within a day's journey of Jerusalem.

G3070 Λυδία, ας, ἡ: Lydia. Lydia, a lady resident of Philippi, native of Thyatira in Lydia (Asia Minor), and engaged in the clothing trade.

G3071 Λυκαονία, ας, ἡ: Lycaonia. Lycaonia, the country of the Lykaones, a district of Asia Minor, comprised within the Roman province Galatia and including the cities of Derbe and Lystra.

G3072 Λυκαονιστί: in the Lycaonian language. in the Lycaonian language.

G3073 Λυκία, ας, ἡ: Lycia. Lycia, a small Roman province on the south coast of Asia Minor.

G3074 λύκος, ου, ὁ: a wolf, jackal. a wolf, of perhaps a jackal; often applied to persons of wolfish proclivities.

G3075 λυμαίνομαι: I ravage, harry, devastate. I outrage, maltreat, corrupt, defile.

G3076 λυπέω: I pain, grieve, vex. I pain, grieve, vex.

G3077 λύπη, ης, ἡ: pain, grief. pain, grief, sorrow, affliction.

G3078 Λυσανίας, ου, ὁ: Lysanias. Lysanias, tetrarch of Abilene.

G3079 Λυσίας, ου, ὁ: Claudius Lysias. Claudius Lysias, a Roman tribune of the soldiers in Jerusalem.

G3080 λύσις, εως, ἡ: dissolution, release. dissolution, release; a loosing, divorce.

G3081 λυσιτελέω: it profits. it is advantageous to, it profits.

G3082 Λύστρα, ας, ἡ, ων, τά: Lystra. Lystra, a Lycaonian city in the southern part of the Roman province Galatia.

G3083 λύτρον, ου, τό: a ransom, an offering of expiation. the purchasing money for manumitting slaves, a ransom, the price of ransoming; especially the sacrifice by which expiation is effected, an offering of expiation.

G3084 λυτρόω: I ransom, liberate, deliver. I release on receipt of ransom; mid: I redeem, release by paying ransom, liberate.

G3085 λύτρωσις, εως, ἡ: liberation, deliverance, release. (in the Old Testament: ransoming from imprisonment for debt, or from slavery, release from national misfortune, etc.), liberation, deliverance, release.

G3086 λυτρωτής, οῦ, ὁ: a redeemer, liberator. a redeemer, liberator, deliverer.

G3087 λυχνία, ας, ἡ: a lamp-stand. a lamp-stand.

G3088 λύχνος, ου, ὁ: a lamp. a lamp.

G3089 λύω: I loose, untie, release, destroy. (a) I loose, untie, release, (b) met: I break, destroy, set at naught, contravene; I break up a meeting, annul.

G3090 Λωΐς, ΐδος, ἡ: Lois. Lois, grandmother of Timothy.

G3091 Λώτ, ὁ: Lot. (Hebrew), Lot, nephew of Abraham.

G3092 Μαάθ, ὁ: Maath. (Hebrew), Maath, an ancestor of Jesus.

G3093 Μαγδαλά, ἡ: Magdala. Magdala, Magadan, a proper name.

G3094 Μαγδαληνή, ῆς, ἡ: Magdalene. Magdalene, a woman of Magdala.

G3095 μαγεία, ας, ἡ: magic. magic.

G3096 μαγεύω: I practice sorcery or magic. I practice sorcery or magic.

G3097 μάγος, ου, ὁ: a sorcerer, magician, wizard. a sorcerer, a magician, a wizard.

G3098 Μαγώγ, ὁ: Magog. (Hebrew), Magog, sometimes as name of a people, sometimes as name of a country in the Old Testament, probably the Scythians; hence: used in apocalyptic literature.

G3099 Μαδιάμ, ἡ: Midian. (Hebrew), Midian, generally taken to mean or to include the peninsula of Sinai.

G3100 μαθητεύω: I make disciples, make into disciples. I make a disciple of, train in discipleship; pass: I am trained, discipled, instructed.

G3101 μαθητής, οῦ, ὁ: a learner, disciple, pupil. a learner, disciple, pupil.

G3102 μαθήτρια, ας, ἡ: a female disciple. a female disciple, female Christian.

G3103 Μαθουσάλα, ὁ: Methuselah. (Hebrew) Methuselah, son of Enoch and father of Lamech.

G3104 Μαϊνάν, ὁ: Menna, Mainan. Menna, Mainan, a proper name.

G3105 μαίνομαι: I am raving mad. I am raving mad, speak as a madman.

G3106 μακαρίζω: I deem happy. I bless, pronounce blessed or happy.

G3107 μακάριος, α, ον: happy, blessed. happy, blessed, to be envied.

G3108 μακαρισμός, οῦ, ὁ: regarding as happy, blessed, or enviable. regarding as happy, blessed, or enviable.

G3109 Μακεδονία, ας, ἡ: Macedonia. (Hebrew), Macedonia, a Roman province north of Achaia (Greece).

G3110 Μακεδών, όνος, ὁ: a Macedonian. a Macedonian, an inhabitant of the Roman province Macedonia.

G3111 μάκελλον, ου, τό: a meat-market. a meat-market, marketplace.

G3112 μακράν: far away. at a distance, far away, remote, alien.

G3113 μακρόθεν: from a distance. from a (long) distance, afar.

G3114 μακροθυμέω: I suffer long, have patience, am forbearing. I suffer long, have patience, am forbearing, perseverance.

G3115 μακροθυμία, ας, ἡ: patience, forbearance. patience, forbearance, longsuffering.

G3116 μακροθύμως: patiently. with longsuffering, patiently.

G3117 μακρός, ά, όν: long, distant. long, distant, far; of long duration.

G3118 μακροχρόνιος, ον: long-lived. long-timed, long-lived.

G3119 μαλακία, ας, ἡ: weakness, illness. weakness, illness, sickness.

G3120 μαλακός, ή, όν: soft, effeminate. (a) soft, (b) of persons: soft, delicate, effeminate.

G3121 Μαλελεήλ, ὁ: Mahalaleel, Maleleel. Mahalaleel or Maleleel, one of the ancestors of Jesus.

G3122 μάλιστα: most of all, especially. most of all, especially.

G3123 μᾶλλον: more, rather. more, rather.

G3124 Μάλχος, ου, ὁ: Malchus. Malchus, a servant of the high-priest at Jerusalem.

G3125 μάμμη, ης, ἡ: a grandmother. a grandmother.

G3126 μαμωνᾶς, ᾶ, ὁ: riches, money, possessions. (Aramaic), riches, money, possessions, property.

G3127 Μαναήν, ὁ: Manaen. (Graecized form of Aramaic Menahem), Manaen, probably a member of Herod Antipas' court.

G3128 Μανασσῆς, ῆ, ὁ: Manasseh. (Hebrew), Manasseh, (a) son of Joseph, founder of a tribe of Israel, (b) son of Hezekiah and father of Amon (Amos).

G3129 μανθάνω: I learn, ascertain. I learn; with adj. or nouns: I learn to be so and so; with acc. of person who is the object of knowledge; aor. sometimes: to ascertain.

G3130 μανία, ας, ἡ: raving madness. raving madness, frenzy, insanity.

G3131 μάννα, τό: manna. (Hebrew), manna, the supernatural food eaten by the Israelites in the desert: of spiritual food.

G3132 μαντεύομαι: I practice soothsaying. I divine, practice soothsaying, suggesting the fraud involved in the practice.

G3133 μαραίνω: I die, wither. pass: I die, wither (like the grass).

G3134 μαρὰν ἀθά: our Lord cometh. (Aramaic), either: Our Lord hath come, or: Our Lord cometh (will come, is at hand).

G3135 μαργαρίτης, ου, ὁ: a pearl. a pearl.

G3136 Μάρθα, ας, ἡ: Martha. Martha, sister of Mary and Lazarus of Bethany.

G3137 Μαρία, ας, ἡ: Mary, Miriam. Mary, Miriam, (a) the mother of Jesus, (b) of Magdala, (c) sister of Martha and Lazarus, (d) wife of Cleopas, (e) mother of John Mark, (f) a Christian woman in Rome.

G3138 Μάρκος, ου, ὁ: Mark. Mark, who also had the Hebrew name John, son of Mary, nephew of Barnabas, coadjutor of Barnabas, Paul, and Peter.

G3139 μάρμαρος, ου, ὁ, ἡ: marble. marble.

G3140 μαρτυρέω: I witness, testify. I witness, bear witness, give evidence, testify, give a good report.

G3141 μαρτυρία, ας, ἡ: witness, evidence, testimony. witness, evidence, testimony, reputation.

G3142 μαρτύριον, ου, τό: witness, evidence, testimony. witness, evidence, testimony, proof.

G3143 μαρτύρομαι: I call to witness, testify, solemnly charge. (properly: I call (summon) to witness, and then absolutely) I testify, protest, asseverate; I conjure, solemnly charge.

G3144 μάρτυς, υρος, ὁ: a witness. a witness; an eye- or ear-witness.

G3145 μασσάομαι: I bite, gnaw. I bite, gnaw, chew.

G3146 μαστιγόω: I flog, scourge. I flog, scourge, the victim being strapped to a pole or frame; met: I chastise.

G3147 μαστίζω: I flog, scourge. I flog, scourge, whip.

G3148 μάστιξ, ιγος, ἡ: a scourge, lash, sufferings. (a) a scourge, lash, of leathern thongs with pieces of metal sewn up in them, (b) met: severe pains (sufferings), disease.

G3149 μαστός, οῦ, ὁ: a breast, pap. the breast, pap.

G3150 ματαιολογία, ας, ἡ: foolish talking. vain speaking, foolish talking.

G3151 ματαιολόγος, ου, ὁ: a vain, empty talker. a vain, empty talker.

G3152 μάταιος, αία, αιον: vain, unproductive, godless. vain, unreal, ineffectual, unproductive; practically: godless.

G3153 ματαιότης, τητος, ἡ: vanity, purposelessness. vanity, emptiness, unreality, purposelessness, ineffectiveness, instability, frailty; false religion.

G3154 ματαιόω: I become vain. I become vain or foolish, am perverted.

G3155 μάτην: in vain. in vain, in an unreal way, to no purpose.

G3156 Ματθαῖος, ου, ὁ: Matthew. Matthew.

G3157 Ματθάν, ὁ: Matthan. Matthan.

G3158 Ματθάτ, ὁ: Matthat. Matthat, an ancestor of Jesus.

G3159 Ματθίας, α, ὁ: Matthias. Matthias.

G3160 Ματταθά, ὁ: Mattatha. Mattatha.

G3161 Ματταθίας, ου, ὁ: Mattathias. Mattathias, an ancestor of Jesus.

G3162 μάχαιρα, ας, ἡ: a sword. a sword.

G3163 μάχη, ης, ἡ: strife, contention, quarrel. (earlier: a battle, conflict, hence) in the sphere of words, etc: strife, contention, quarrel.

G3164 μάχομαι: I engage in battle, fight, strive. I engage in battle, fight; hence: I strive, contend, dispute.

G3166 μεγαλαυχέω: I boast, am arrogant, vaunt. I boast, am arrogant, vaunt.

G3167 μεγαλεῖος, εία, εῖον: grand, magnificent. grand, magnificent, splendid.

G3168 μεγαλειότης, τητος, ἡ: majesty. (divine) majesty or magnificence, glory.

G3169 μεγαλοπρεπής, ές: magnificent, superb, transcendent. magnificent, superb, transcendent, majestic.

G3170 μεγαλύνω: I enlarge, magnify, extol. (a) I enlarge, lengthen, (b) I increase, magnify, extol.

G3171 μεγάλως: greatly. greatly, very much, vehemently.

G3172 μεγαλωσύνη, ης, ἡ: majesty. (divine) majesty, greatness.

G3173 μέγας, μεγάλη, μέγα: large, great. large, great, in the widest sense.

G3174 μέγεθος, ους, τό: greatness, vastness. greatness, vastness.

title: Dodson Greek-English Lexicon of the New Testament, G3175 to G3527
source: Jeffrey Dodson, Greek-English Lexicon of the New Testament (public domain), data prepared by Ulrik Sandborg-Petersen. Each entry: Strong number, Greek word, short meaning, fuller meaning.
body:
G3175 μεγιστάν, ᾶνος, ὁ: a great one, a lord. a great one, a lord; a courtier, satrap, nobleman.

G3177 μεθερμηνεύω: I translate, interpret. I translate (from one language into another), interpret.

G3178 μέθη, ης, ἡ: drunkenness. deep drinking, drunkenness.

G3179 μεθίστημι: I move out of its place, transfer. I cause to change its place, move out of its place; I translate, transfer, remove.

G3180 μεθοδεία, ας, ἡ: scheming, craftiness. (a way of search after something, an inquiry; a method), scheming, craftiness, deceit.

G3181 μεθόριον, ου, τό: confine, border. confine, border, boundary.

G3182 μεθύσκω: I make drunk. I make drunk; pass: I become drunk.

G3183 μέθυσος, ου, ὁ: a drunkard. a drunkard.

G3184 μεθύω: I am drunk. I am intoxicated with wine, am drunk.

G3185 μεῖζον: greater, greatest. greater, greatest.

G3186 μειζότερος, α, ον: greater. greater.

G3187 μείζων: greater, greatest. greater, greatest.

G3188 μέλαν, ανος, τό: ink. ink.

G3189 μέλας, αινα, αν: black. black.

G3190 Μελεᾶς, ᾶ, ὁ: Melea. Melea, one of the ancestors of Jesus.

G3191 μελετάω: I devise, plan. I devise, plan; practice, exercise myself in, study, ponder.

G3192 μέλι, ιτος, τό: honey. honey.

G3193 μελίσσιος, α, ον: coming from bees. belonging to bees, coming from bees.

G3194 Μελίτη, ης, ἡ: Melita, Malta. Melita, now Malta.

G3195 μέλλω: I am about to. I intend, am about to; I delay, linger.

G3196 μέλος, ους, τό: a limb, member. a bodily organ, limb, member.

G3197 Μελχί, ὁ: Melchi. Melchi, one of the ancestors of Jesus.

G3198 Μελχισεδέκ, ὁ: Melchizedek. Melchizedek, king and priest of Salem.

G3199 μέλει: it is a care, it concerns. it is a care, it is an object of anxiety, it concerns.

G3200 μεμβράνα, ης, ἡ: a parchment leaf. a parchment leaf, perhaps for notes.

G3201 μέμφομαι: I blame, censure. I blame, censure, find fault.

G3202 μεμψίμοιρος, ον: discontented, complaining. blaming one's lot or destiny, discontented, complaining.

G3303 μέν: truly, indeed. an untranslatable particle, generally answered by "de", each of the two introducing a clause intended to be contrasted with the other.

G3304 μενοῦνγε: nay rather. nay rather; indeed, truly, really.

G3305 μέντοι: indeed, yet, however. (a) indeed, really, (b) yet, however, nevertheless.

G3306 μένω: I remain, abide. I remain, abide, stay, wait; with acc: I wait for, await.

G3307 μερίζω: I divide, part, share. I divide into parts, divide, part, share, distribute; mid: I share, take part in a partitioning; I distract.

G3308 μέριμνα, ης, ἡ: care, worry, anxiety. care, worry, anxiety.

G3309 μεριμνάω: I am anxious, distracted. I am over-anxious; with acc: I am anxious about, distracted; I care for.

G3310 μερίς, ίδος, ἡ: a part, portion. (a) a part, division of a country, (b) a share, portion.

G3311 μερισμός, οῦ, ὁ: a distribution, separation. (a) a distributing, a distribution, (b) a parting, dividing, severance, separation.

G3312 μεριστής, οῦ, ὁ: a divider, distributor. a divider, partitioner, distributor.

G3313 μέρος, ους, τό: a part, portion. a part, portion, share.

G3314 μεσημβρία, ας, ἡ: the South. (lit: midday, hence, the position of the sun at midday), the South.

G3315 μεσιτεύω: I mediate, interpose. I mediate, interpose, give bail.

G3316 μεσίτης, ου, ὁ: a mediator, go-between. (a) a mediator, intermediary, (b) a go-between, arbiter, agent of something good.

G3317 μεσονύκτιον, ου, τό: midnight. midnight, the middle of the period between sunset and sunrise.

G3318 Μεσοποταμία, ας, ἡ: Mesopotamia. Mesopotamia, the Country between the (two) Rivers, i.e. the Euphrates and the Tigris.

G3319 μέσος, η, ον: middle, in the middle. middle, in the middle, between, in the midst of.

G3320 μεσότοιχον, ου, τό: a middle wall, partition wall. a middle wall, partition wall, barrier.

G3321 μεσουράνημα, ατος, τό: the middle of heaven. mid-heaven, the middle of heaven, the zenith.

G3322 μεσόω: I am in the middle. I am in the middle, am advanced midway.

G3323 Μεσσίας, ου, ὁ: Messiah. Messiah, the Anointed One.

G3324 μεστός, ή, όν: full. full, filled with.

G3325 μεστόω: I fill. I fill.

G3326 μετά: with, after. (a) gen: with, in company with, (b) acc: (1) behind, beyond, after, of place, (2) after, of time, with nouns, neut. of adjectives.

G3327 μεταβαίνω: I leave, depart, remove, pass over. I change my place (abode), leave, depart, remove, pass over.

G3328 μεταβάλλω: I change, change my mind. I change; mid: I change my mind.

G3329 μετάγω: I turn about, change the position of. (usually: transfer, transport, and met: to a better mind), I turn about, change the position of; pass: I am brought back.

G3330 μεταδίδωμι: I share, impart. (lit: I offer by way of change, offer so that a change of owner is produced), I share; sometimes merely: I impart, bestow.

G3331 μετάθεσις, εως, ἡ: change, transformation, removal. (a) change, transformation, (b) removal.

G3332 μεταίρω: I change my position, depart, remove. I change my position, depart, remove.

G3333 μετακαλέω: I send for. mid: I summon to myself, send for.

G3334 μετακινέω: I move away, dislodge. trans: I move away, dislodge, remove.

G3335 μεταλαμβάνω: I share in, partake of. (a) with gen: I take a share (part) of, share in, partake of, (b) with acc: I take after (later) or take instead.

G3336 μετάληψις, εως, ἡ: participation, sharing in. participation, sharing in, receiving.

G3337 μεταλλάσσω: I change, transform, alter. I change, transform, alter, exchange.

G3338 μεταμέλομαι: I change my mind. (lit: I change one care or interest for another), I change my mind (generally for the better), repent, regret.

G3339 μεταμορφόω: I change the form, transform. I transform, transfigure.

G3340 μετανοέω: I repent, change my mind. I repent, change my mind, change the inner man (particularly with reference to acceptance of the will of God), repent.

G3341 μετάνοια, ας, ἡ: repentance, a change of mind. repentance, a change of mind, change in the inner man.

G3342 μεταξύ: meanwhile, afterwards, between. meanwhile, afterwards, between.

G3343 μεταπέμπω: I send for, summon. I send for, summon.

G3344 μεταστρέφω: I turn, change, corrupt, pervert. I turn, change, corrupt, pervert.

G3345 μετασχηματίζω: I change the outward appearance, transfigure, adapt. I change the outward appearance (the dress, the form of presentment) of something, transfigure; I adapt.

G3346 μετατίθημι: I transfer, desert, change. (a) I transfer, mid: I go over to another party, desert, (b) I change.

G3347 μετέπειτα: afterwards. afterwards.

G3348 μετέχω: I participate in, share. I have a share of, participate in, share, partake of, am a member of.

G3349 μετεωρίζομαι: I am anxious. I am suspended, anxious.

G3350 μετοικεσία, ας, ἡ: change of abode, migration, deportation. change of abode, migration, deportation.

G3351 μετοικίζω: I transport, cause to migrate. I transport, cause to migrate, remove.

G3352 μετοχή, ῆς, ἡ: sharing, partnership, fellowship. sharing, partnership, fellowship.

G3353 μέτοχος, ου, ὁ: a sharer, partner. a sharer, partner, associate.

G3354 μετρέω: I measure, estimate. I measure (out), estimate.

G3355 μετρητής, οῦ, ὁ: a measure, amphora. a measure, amphora, about 39.39 liters or 8.75 gallons.

G3356 μετριοπαθέω: I bear gently with, have compassion. I bear gently with, have compassion.

G3357 μετρίως: moderately, greatly. moderately, greatly, exceedingly.

G3358 μέτρον, ου, τό: a measure, measuring rod. a measure, whether lineal or cubic; a measuring rod.

G3359 μέτωπον, ου, τό: the forehead. the forehead, front.

G3360 μέχρι: as far as, until. as far as, until, even to.

G3361 μή: not, lest. not, lest.

G3365 μηδαμῶς: by no means, not at all. by no means, not at all.

G3366 μηδέ: and not, not even. and not, not even, neither...nor.

G3367 μηδείς, μηδεμία, μηδέν: no one, nothing. no one, none, nothing.

G3368 μηδέποτε: not at any time, never. not at any time, never.

G3369 μηδέπω: not yet. not yet.

G3370 Μῆδος, ου, ὁ: a Mede. a Mede, a Median, from east of Assyria.

G3371 μηκέτι: no longer. no longer, no more.

G3372 μῆκος, ους, τό: length. length.

G3373 μηκύνω: I lengthen. I lengthen, extend, grow.

G3374 μηλωτή, ῆς, ἡ: a sheepskin. a sheep's (sometimes pig's) hide, sheepskin.

G3375 μήν: certainly. assuredly, certainly.

G3376 μήν, μηνός, ὁ: a month. a (lunar) month.

G3377 μηνύω: I reveal, inform. (a) I reveal, make known (in a law court), I lay information, inform, (b) I make known, point out.

G3379 μήποτε: lest at any time, lest, perhaps. lest at any time, lest; then weakened: whether perhaps, whether at all; in a principal clause: perhaps.

G3380 μήπω: not yet. not yet.

G3381 μήπως: lest in any way, lest perhaps. lest in any way, lest perhaps.

G3382 μηρός, οῦ, ὁ: the thigh. the thigh.

G3383 μήτε: nor, neither, not even. nor, neither, not even, neither...nor.

G3384 μήτηρ, μητρός, ἡ: a mother. a mother.

G3385 μήτι: if not, unless. if not, unless, whether at all.

G3388 μήτρα, ας, ἡ: the womb. the womb.

G3389 μητραλῴας, ου, ὁ: a matricide. a matricide, smiter of his mother.

G3392 μιαίνω: I stain, pollute, defile. I stain, pollute, defile, corrupt.

G3393 μίασμα, ατος, τό: pollution, defilement. pollution, defilement; a stain.

G3394 μιασμός, οῦ, ὁ: the act of pollution, defilement. the act of pollution, defilement.

G3395 μίγμα, ατος, τό: a mixture. a mixture.

G3396 μίγνυμι: I mix, mingle. I mix, mingle.

G3397 μικρόν, ου, τό: a little, little while. a little, little while.

G3398 μικρός, ά, όν: little, small. little, small.

G3399 Μίλητος, ου, ἡ: Miletus. Miletus, a city on the coast of the Roman province Asia.

G3400 μίλιον, ου, τό: a Roman mile. a Roman mile, measuring 1478.5 meters or 5820.9 feet.

G3401 μιμέομαι: I imitate. I imitate, follow.

G3402 μιμητής, οῦ, ὁ: an imitator. an imitator, follower.

G3403 μιμνήσκομαι: I remember, recall. I remember, call to mind, recall, mention.

G3404 μισέω: I hate, detest. I hate, detest, love less, esteem less.

G3405 μισθαποδοσία, ας, ἡ: reward, due punishment. (lit: repayment of price or payment of price due), reward, due punishment.

G3406 μισθαποδότης, ου, ὁ: a rewarder. a rewarder.

G3407 μίσθιος, ου, ὁ: a paid worker. a paid worker, hired servant, hireling (contrasted with a slave).

G3408 μισθός, οῦ, ὁ: wages, reward. (a) pay, wages, salary, (b) reward, recompense, punishment.

G3409 μισθόω: I hire out, hire, engage. I hire out, mid: I hire, engage.

G3410 μίσθωμα, ατος, τό: a rented house. a rented house, hired dwelling.

G3411 μισθωτός, οῦ, ὁ: a hired servant. a hired servant, hireling.

G3412 Μιτυλήνη, ης, ἡ: Mitylene. Mitylene, the capital of the island of Lesbos in the northern Aegean sea.

G3413 Μιχαήλ, ὁ: Michael. Michael, an archangel.

G3414 μνᾶ, ᾶς, ἡ: a mina. a mina, a Greek monetary unit equal to 100 drachma.

G3415 μνάομαι: I remember, recollect. I remember, recollect.

G3416 Μνάσων, ωνος, ὁ: Mnason. Mnason, an early Christian, native of Cyprus, resident at a place between Caesarea and Jerusalem.

G3417 μνεία, ας, ἡ: remembrance, recollection. remembrance, recollection, mention; commemoration.

G3418 μνῆμα, ατος, τό: a tomb, monument. a tomb, monument, memorial.

G3419 μνημεῖον, ου, τό: a tomb, sepulcher. a tomb, sepulcher, monument.

G3420 μνήμη, ης, ἡ: memory, remembrance, mention. memory, remembrance, mention.

G3421 μνημονεύω: I remember, make mention of. I remember, hold in remembrance, make mention of.

G3422 μνημόσυνον, ου, τό: reminder, memorial, remembrance offering. reminder, memorial; a remembrance offering.

G3423 μνηστεύω: I ask in marriage. I ask in marriage; pass: I am betrothed.

G3424 μογγιλάλος, ου, ὁ: one speaking with difficulty, a stammerer. one speaking with difficulty, a stammerer.

G3425 μόγις: with difficulty, scarcely, hardly. with difficulty; scarcely, hardly.

G3426 μόδιος, ου, ὁ: a dry measure, nearly two English gallons. a dry measure, nearly two English gallons.

G3428 μοιχαλίς, ίδος, ἡ: an adulteress. (a) an adulteress (that is, a married woman who commits adultery), (b) Hebraistically: extended to those who worship any other than the true God.

G3429 μοιχάομαι: I commit adultery. I commit adultery, not only of a married woman but of a married man.

G3430 μοιχεία, ας, ἡ: adultery. adultery.

G3431 μοιχεύω: I commit adultery. I commit adultery (of a man with a married woman, but also of a married man).

G3432 μοιχός, οῦ, ὁ: an adulterer. an adulterer, that is, a man who is guilty with a married woman.

G3433 μόλις: with difficulty, hardly. with difficulty, hardly, scarcely.

G3434 Μολόχ, ὁ: Moloch. Moloch, a god worshipped by several Semitic peoples.

G3435 μολύνω: I soil, stain, pollute, defile. I soil, stain, pollute, defile, lit. and met.

G3436 μολυσμός, οῦ, ὁ: staining, defilement, pollution. staining, defilement, pollution.

G3437 μομφή, ῆς, ἡ: a complaint, fault. a complaint, fault, blame.

G3438 μονή, ῆς, ἡ: lodging, dwelling-place, room. lodging, dwelling-place, room, abode, mansion.

G3439 μονογενής, ές: only, only-begotten, unique. only, only-begotten; unique.

G3440 μόνον: alone, but, only. alone, but, only.

G3441 μόνος, η, ον: only, solitary, desolate. only, solitary, desolate.

G3442 μονόφθαλμος, ον: one-eyed. one-eyed, with one eye only.

G3443 μονόω: I leave alone. I leave alone (solitary), forsake.

G3444 μορφή, ῆς, ἡ: form, shape, outward appearance. form, shape, outward appearance.

G3445 μορφόω: I form, fashion, shape. I form, fashion, shape, mold.

G3446 μόρφωσις, εως, ἡ: form, outline. form, outline, semblance.

G3447 μοσχοποιέω: I make a model of a calf. I make an image of a calf.

G3448 μόσχος, ου, ὁ, ἡ: a calf. a calf, heifer, young bull.

G3449 μόχθος, ου, ὁ: wearisome labor, toil, hardship. wearisome labor, toil, hardship.

G3451 μουσικός, ή, όν: skilled in music, a musician. skilled in music; subst: a musician, singer.

G3452 μυελός, οῦ, ὁ: marrow. marrow.

G3453 μυέω: I initiate, instruct. I initiate, instruct; pass: I am disciplined, learn (a lesson).

G3454 μῦθος, ου, ὁ: an idle tale, fable. an idle tale, fable, fanciful story.

G3455 μυκάομαι: I bellow, roar. I bellow, roar.

G3456 μυκτηρίζω: I sneer at, disdain. (properly: I turn up the nose as a sign of contempt), I sneer at, disdain.

G3457 μυλικός, ή, όν: belonging to a mill. belonging to a mill.

G3458 μύλος, ου, ὁ: a millstone. a millstone, mill.

G3459 μυλών, ῶνος, ὁ: a mill-house. a mill-house, the place where grain was ground.

G3460 Μύρα, ων, τά: Myra. Myra, a port in Lycia, south-west Asia Minor.

G3461 μυριάς, άδος, ἡ: a myriad, ten thousand. a myriad, group of ten thousand, a ten thousand.

G3462 μυρίζω: I anoint. I anoint.

G3463 μυρίοι, ίαι, ία: ten thousand, innumerable. ten thousand; also used for a very large number, innumerable.

G3464 μύρον, ου, τό: anointing-oil, ointment. anointing-oil, ointment.

G3465 Μυσία, ας, ἡ: Mysia. Mysia, a country in the north-west of the Roman province Asia (and of Asia Minor).

G3466 μυστήριον, ου, τό: anything hidden, a mystery. a mystery, secret, of which initiation is necessary; in the NT: the counsels of God, once hidden but now revealed in the Gospel or some fact thereof; the Christian revelation generally; particular truths or details of the Christian revelation.

G3467 μυωπάζω: I blink, see dimly. I am short-sighted, blink, see dimly.

G3468 μώλωψ, ωπος, ὁ: a bruise, stripe. a bruise, stripe, left on the body by scourging.

G3469 μωμάομαι: I blame, slander. I blame, find fault with, slander.

G3470 μῶμος, ου, ὁ: a blemish, disgrace. a blemish, disgrace; blame.

G3471 μωραίνω: I make foolish, taint, make useless. (a) I make foolish, turn to foolishness, (b) I taint, and thus: I am tasteless, make useless.

G3472 μωρία, ας, ἡ: folly, absurdity. folly, absurdity, foolishness.

G3473 μωρολογία, ας, ἡ: foolish talking. foolish talking.

G3474 μωρός, ά, όν: stupid, foolish. (a) adj: stupid, foolish, (b) noun: a fool.

G3475 Μωσῆς, έως, ὁ: Moses. Moses; met: the books of Moses, the Pentateuch.

G3476 Ναασσών, ὁ: Nahshon. Nahshon, son of Amminadab and father of Salmon, and one of the ancestors of Jesus.

G3477 Ναγγαί, ὁ: Naggai. Naggai, one of the ancestors of Jesus.

G3478 Ναζαρέτ, ἡ: Nazareth. Nazareth, a city of Galilee, where Jesus lived before His ministry.

G3479 Ναζαρηνός, ή, όν: of Nazareth. of Nazareth, a Nazarene.

G3480 Ναζωραῖος, ου, ὁ: Nazarene. a Nazarene, an inhabitant of Nazareth.

G3481 Ναθάν, ὁ: Nathan. Nathan, son of David, and an ancestor of Jesus.

G3482 Ναθαναήλ, ὁ: Nathanael. Nathanael, of Cana in Galilee, an early disciple, probably to be identified with Bartholomew.

G3483 ναί: yes, certainly, even so. yes, certainly, even so.

G3484 Ναΐν, ἡ: Nain. Nain, a city south-west of the Sea of Galilee.

G3485 ναός, οῦ, ὁ: a temple, shrine. a temple, a shrine, that part of the temple where God himself resides.

G3486 Ναούμ, ὁ: Nahum. Nahum, an ancestor of Jesus.

G3487 νάρδος, ου, ἡ: spikenard, a perfume. spikenard, a perfume made originally from a plant growing on the Himalayas.

G3488 Νάρκισσος, ου, ὁ: Narcissus. Narcissus, a resident of Rome.

G3489 ναυαγέω: I am shipwrecked, ruined. (a) I am shipwrecked; so (b) fig: I come to ruin.

G3490 ναύκληρος, ου, ὁ: a master of a ship. a captain (master) of a ship, ship-owner.

G3491 ναῦς, νεώς, ἡ: a ship, vessel. a ship, vessel.

G3492 ναύτης, ου, ὁ: a sailor. a sailor, seaman.

G3493 Ναχώρ, ὁ: Nahor. Nahor, one of the ancestors of Jesus.

G3494 νεανίας, ου, ὁ: a young man, youth. a young man, youth; a man in his prime (used even of a man of 40).

G3495 νεανίσκος, ου, ὁ: a young man. a young man, youth, an attendant.

G3496 Νεάπολις, εως, ἡ: Neapolis. Neapolis, a city of Thrace.

G3497 Νεεμάν, ὁ: Naaman. Naaman.

G3498 νεκρός, ά, όν: dead, a corpse. (a) adj: dead, lifeless, subject to death, mortal, (b) noun: a dead body, a corpse.

G3499 νεκρόω: I put to death, render weak. lit. and met: I put to death, make as dead; I render weak, impotent.

G3500 νέκρωσις, εως, ἡ: putting to death, lifeless condition. (a) putting to death, (b) dead or lifeless condition.

G3501 νέος, α, ον: young, new, fresh. (a) young, youthful, (b) new, fresh.

G3502 νεοσσός, οῦ, ὁ: a young bird, young one. a young bird, nestling; a young one.

G3503 νεότης, τητος, ἡ: youth, youthfulness. youth, youthfulness.

G3504 νεόφυτος, ον: newly-planted, recent convert. (lit: newly-planted), newly converted to Christianity, recent convert.

G3506 νεύω: I nod, make a sign. I nod, make a sign, beckon.

G3507 νεφέλη, ης, ἡ: a cloud. a cloud.

G3508 Νεφθαλείμ, ὁ: Naphtali. Naphtali, son of Jacob, founder of a tribe which occupied territory.

G3509 νέφος, ους, τό: a cloud, multitude, great company. a cloud; met: a dense crowd, a multitude, great company.

G3510 νεφρός, οῦ, ὁ: a kidney as a general emotional center. a kidney (as a general emotional center), the reins.

G3511 νεωκόρος, ου, ὁ, ἡ: temple-warden. (lit: temple-sweeper), temple-warden; an honorary title.

G3512 νεωτερικός, ή, όν: youthful, juvenile. associated with youth, youthful, juvenile.

G3513 νή: swearing by. of affirmative swearing: by, with acc. of person or thing sworn by.

G3514 νήθω: I spin. I spin.

G3515 νηπιάζω: I am childish, infantile. I am childlike, childish, infantile.

G3516 νήπιος, α, ον: an infant, child, unlearned. unlearned, unenlightened; noun: an infant, child.

G3517 Νηρεύς, έως, ὁ: Nereus. Nereus, a Christian in Rome.

G3518 Νηρί, ὁ: Neri. Neri, an ancestor of Jesus.

G3519 νησίον, ου, τό: a little island. a little island, an islet.

G3520 νῆσος, ου, ἡ: an island. an island.

G3521 νηστεία, ας, ἡ: fasting, the day of atonement. fasting, the day of atonement.

G3522 νηστεύω: I fast. I fast, abstain from food.

G3523 νῆστις, ιος, ὁ, ἡ: fasting, without food. fasting, not eating.

G3524 νηφαλέος, α, ον: sober, temperate. sober, not intoxicated (with wine), temperate, vigilant.

G3525 νήφω: I am calm, vigilant, sober. (lit: I am sober), I am calm (vigilant), circumspect.

G3526 Νίγερ, ὁ: Niger. Niger, a proper name.

G3527 Νικάνωρ, ορος, ὁ: Nicanor. Nicanor, a proper name.

title: Dodson Greek-English Lexicon of the New Testament, G3528 to G3781
source: Jeffrey Dodson, Greek-English Lexicon of the New Testament (public domain), data prepared by Ulrik Sandborg-Petersen. Each entry: Strong number, Greek word, short meaning, fuller meaning.
body:
G3528 νικάω: I conquer, overcome. I conquer, am victorious, overcome, prevail, subdue.

G3529 νίκη, ης, ἡ: victory. victory, a victorious principle.

G3530 Νικόδημος, ου, ὁ: Nicodemus. Nicodemus, a member of the Sanhedrin.

G3531 Νικολαΐτης, ου, ὁ: a Nicolaitan. a Nicolaitan, possibly a follower of Nicolaus (a heretic at Ephesus).

G3532 Νικόλαος, ου, ὁ: Nicolaus. Nicolaus, a proper name.

G3533 Νικόπολις, εως, ἡ: Nicopolis. Nicopolis, a city of Macedonia.

G3534 νῖκος, ους, τό: victory. victory.

G3535 Νινευΐ, ἡ: Nineveh. Nineveh, a city on the Tigris in Assyria.

G3536 Νινευίτης, ου, ὁ: a Ninevite. a Ninevite, an inhabitant of Nineveh, a city on the Tigris in Assyria.

G3537 νιπτήρ, ῆρος, ὁ: a basin. a basin for washing hands or feet.

G3538 νίπτω: I wash. I wash; mid. I wash my own (hands, etc.).

G3539 νοέω: I understand, consider. I understand, think, consider, conceive, apprehend; aor. possibly: realize.

G3540 νόημα, ατος, τό: a thought, design, the mind. a thought, purpose, design; the mind; the heart, soul, feelings.

G3541 νόθος, η, ον: illegitimate, bastard. illegitimate, base-born.

G3542 νομή, ῆς, ἡ: pasturage, growth. (a) pasture, pasturage, (b) met: growth, increase.

G3543 νομίζω: I think, suppose. I practice, hold by custom; I deem, think, consider, suppose.

G3544 νομικός, ή, όν: about law, one learned in the Law. (a) adj: connected with law, about law, (b) noun: a lawyer, one learned in the Law, one learned in the Old Testament.

G3545 νομίμως: lawfully. lawfully, rightfully.

G3546 νόμισμα, ατος, τό: money, coin. money, coin.

G3547 νομοδιδάσκαλος, ου, ὁ: a teacher and interpreter of the Mosaic Law. a teacher and interpreter of the Mosaic Law.

G3548 νομοθεσία, ας, ἡ: lawgiving, legislation. lawgiving, legislation.

G3549 νομοθετέω: I ordain, enact. (a) I ordain, lay down, give the sanction of law to, enact, (b) I base legally, regulate, direct.

G3550 νομοθέτης, ου, ὁ: a law-giver, legislator. a law-giver, legislator.

G3551 νόμος, ου, ὁ: a law, the Mosaic Law. usage, custom, law; in NT: of law in general, plur: of divine laws; of a force or influence impelling to action; of the Mosaic law; meton: of the books which contain the law, the Pentateuch, the Old Testament scriptures in general.

G3552 νοσέω: I am diseased. I am diseased, hence of mental or spiritual disease.

G3553 νόσημα, ατος, τό: a trouble, disease. a trouble, disease, sickness.

G3554 νόσος, ου, ἡ: a disease, malady. a disease, malady, sickness.

G3555 νοσσιά, ᾶς, ἡ: a brood of young birds. a brood of young birds.

G3556 νοσσίον, ου, τό: a nestling, the young of birds. a nestling, the young of birds.

G3557 νοσφίζω: I rob, purloin. I rob; mid: I set apart for myself, appropriate for my own benefit, purloin.

G3558 νότος, ου, ὁ: the south wind, the South. the south wind, the South.

G3559 νουθεσία, ας, ἡ: a warning, admonition. a warning, admonition, counsel.

G3560 νουθετέω: I admonish, warn, counsel. I admonish, warn, counsel, exhort.

G3561 νουμηνία, ας, ἡ: the new moon as a festival. the new moon, first of the month.

G3562 νουνεχῶς: wisely, discreetly. wisely, discreetly, reasonably, sensibly.

G3563 νοῦς, νοός, νοΐ, νοῦν, ὁ: the mind, reasoning faculty. the mind, the reason, the reasoning faculty, intellect.

G3564 Νυμφᾶς, ᾶ, ὁ: Nymphas. Nymphas, a proper name.

G3565 νύμφη, ης, ἡ: a bride, daughter-in-law. (a) a bride, young wife, young woman, (b) a daughter-in-law.

G3566 νυμφίος, ου, ὁ: a bridegroom. a bridegroom.

G3567 νυμφών, ῶνος, ὁ: a bridal chamber. a bridal chamber.

G3568 νῦν: now, already, at present. adv. (a) of time: just now, even now; just at hand, immediately, (b) of logical connection: now then, (c) in commands and appeals: at this instant.

G3570 νυνί: now, already, at present. adv. (a) of time: just now, even now; just at hand, immediately, (b) of logical connection: now then, (c) in commands and appeals: at this instant.

G3571 νύξ, νυκτός, ἡ: the night, night-time. the night, night-time.

G3572 νύσσω: I prick, pierce, stab. I prick, pierce.

G3573 νυστάζω: I nod in sleep, am drowsy, slumber. I nod in sleep, am drowsy, slumber.

G3574 νυχθήμερον, ου, τό: twenty-four hours. a night and day, twenty-four hours.

G3575 Νῶε, ὁ: Noah. (Hebrew) Noah.

G3576 νωθρός, ά, όν: dull, sluggish. blunt, dull, hence spiritually; sluggish, remiss, slack.

G3577 νῶτος, ου, ὁ: the back of men or animals. the back (of men or animals).

G3578 ξενία, ας, ἡ: lodging, hospitality. lodging, hospitality.

G3579 ξενίζω: I entertain a stranger, I startle. (a) I entertain a stranger, (b) I startle, bewilder.

G3580 ξενοδοχέω: I entertain strangers. I entertain strangers, practice hospitality.

G3581 ξένος, η, ον: new, novel, a foreigner. alien, new, novel; noun: a guest, stranger, foreigner.

G3582 ξέστης, ου, ὁ: a Roman measure, pitcher. a Roman measure, a pitcher or cup of any size.

G3583 ξηραίνω: I dry up, parch, ripen. I dry up, parch, am ripened, wither, waste away.

G3584 ξηρός, ά, όν: dry, withered, dry land. dry, withered; noun: dry land.

G3585 ξύλινος, η, ον: wooden. wooden.

G3586 ξύλον, ου, τό: a staff, cross, anything made of wood. anything made of wood, a piece of wood, a club, staff; the trunk of a tree, used to support the cross-bar of a cross in crucifixion.

G3587 ξυράω: I shave. I shave, shear, cut off the hair.

G3588 ὁ, ἡ, τό: the. the, the definite article.

G3589 ὀγδοήκοντα: eighty. eighty.

G3590 ὄγδοος, η, ον: eighth. the eighth, one of eight, with seven others.

G3591 ὄγκος, ου, ὁ: a weight, burden. (properly: bulk, mass, hence) a weight, burden, encumbrance.

G3592 ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε: this here, this. this here, this, that, he, she, it.

G3593 ὁδεύω: I journey, travel. I journey, travel.

G3594 ὁδηγέω: I lead, guide. I lead, guide; met: I instruct, teach.

G3595 ὁδηγός, οῦ, ὁ: a leader, guide. a leader, guide; met: an instructor, teacher.

G3596 ὁδοιπορέω: I travel, pursue a way. I travel, pursue a way, journey.

G3597 ὁδοιπορία, ας, ἡ: a journey, travel. a journey, journeying, travel.

G3598 ὁδός, οῦ, ἡ: a way, road, journey. a way, road, journey, path.

G3599 ὀδούς, όντος, ὁ: a tooth. a tooth.

G3600 ὀδυνάω: I torment, pain. I torment, pain; mid. and pass: I am tormented, pained; I suffer acute pain, physical or mental.

G3601 ὀδύνη, ης, ἡ: pain, distress. pain, sorrow, distress, of body or mind.

G3602 ὀδυρμός, οῦ, ὁ: lamentation, wailing. lamentation, wailing, mourning, sorrow.

G3604 Ὀζίας, ου, ὁ: Uzziah. Uzziah, son of Joram and father of Jotham, and king of Judah from about 785 to 746 B.C., an ancestor of Jesus.

G3605 ὄζω: I stink, am offensive. I stink, am offensive.

G3606 ὅθεν: whence, wherefore. (a) whence, from which place, (b) wherefore.

G3607 ὀθόνη, ης, ἡ: a linen cloth, sheet. a linen cloth, a sheet, sail.

G3608 ὀθόνιον, ου, τό: a linen bandage. a linen bandage, a wrapping.

G3609 οἰκεῖος, α, ον: of one's family, domestic. of one's family, domestic, intimate.

G3610 οἰκέτης, ου, ὁ: a household servant. a household servant.

G3611 οἰκέω: I inhabit, dwell. I inhabit, dwell, indwell.

G3612 οἴκημα, ατος, τό: a prison. a prison cell.

G3613 οἰκητήριον, ου, τό: a dwelling-place, habitation. a dwelling-place, habitation, abode.

G3614 οἰκία, ας, ἡ: a house, household. a house, household, dwelling; meton: goods, property, means.

G3615 οἰκειακός, ή, όν: one of a family. one of a family, whether child or servant.

G3616 οἰκοδεσποτέω: I manage a household. I manage a household.

G3617 οἰκοδεσπότης, ου, ὁ: a head of a household. a head of a household.

G3618 οἰκοδομέω: I build, build up, edify. I erect a building, build; fig. of the building up of character: I build up, edify, encourage.

G3619 οἰκοδομή, ῆς, ἡ: the act of building, a building, edification. (a) the act of building, (b) a building, (c) met: spiritual advancement, edification.

G3621 οἰκονομέω: I am a steward. I am a steward, manage a household.

G3622 οἰκονομία, ας, ἡ: stewardship. management of household affairs, stewardship, administration.

G3623 οἰκονόμος, ου, ὁ: a steward. a household manager, a steward, guardian.

G3624 οἶκος, ου, ὁ: a house, household. (a) a house, the material building, (b) a household, family, lineage, nation.

G3625 οἰκουμένη, ης, ἡ: the inhabited (Roman) world. (properly: the land that is being inhabited, the land in a state of habitation), the inhabited world, that is, the Roman world, for all outside it was regarded as of no account.

G3626 οὐκουρός, οῦ, ὁ, ἡ: a housekeeper. a keeper-at-home, a housekeeper.

G3627 οἰκτείρω: I pity, have compassion on. I pity, have compassion on.

G3628 οἰκτιρμός, οῦ, ὁ: pity, compassion. pity, compassion, favor, grace, mercy.

G3629 οἰκτίρμων, ον: compassionate, merciful. compassionate, merciful.

G3630 οἰνοπότης, ου, ὁ: an excessive wine-drinker. an excessive wine-drinker.

G3631 οἶνος, ου, ὁ: wine. wine.

G3632 οἰνοφλυγία, ας, ἡ: drunkenness. drunkenness, debauchery.

G3633 οἴμαι: I think, suppose. I think, suppose, expect, imagine.

G3634 οἵος, α, ον: of what kind, such as. of what kind, such as.

G3635 ὀκνέω: I delay, hesitate, am slow. I delay, hesitate, am slow.

G3636 ὀκνηρός, ά, όν: slothful, backward. slothful, backward, hesitating; of things: irksome.

G3637 ὀκταήμερος, ον: belonging to the eighth day. of or belonging to the eighth day, eight days old.

G3638 ὀκτώ: eight. eight.

G3639 ὄλεθρος, ου, ὁ: ruin, doom, destruction. ruin, doom, destruction, death.

G3640 ὀλιγόπιστος, ον: of little faith. of little faith.

G3641 ὀλίγος, η, ον: small, brief, few, soon. (a) especially in plur: few, (b) in sing: small; hence, of time: short, of degree: light, slight, little.

G3642 ὀλιγόψυχος, ον: faint-hearted. faint-hearted, of small courage.

G3643 ὀλιγωρέω: I despise, make light of. I despise, hold in low esteem, make light of.

G3644 ὀλοθρευτής, οῦ, ὁ: a destroyer. a destroyer.

G3645 ὀλοθρεύω: I destroy. I destroy, cause to perish.

G3646 ὁλοκαύτωμα, ατος, τό: a whole burnt offering. a whole burnt offering.

G3647 ὁλοκληρία, ας, ἡ: perfect soundness. perfect soundness, completeness.

G3648 ὁλόκληρος, ον: complete in every part, sound, perfect. complete in every part, sound, perfect, entire.

G3649 ὀλολύζω: I howl, lament loudly. I howl, lament loudly, cry aloud, bewail.

G3650 ὅλος, η, ον: all, the whole, entire. all, the whole, entire, complete.

G3651 ὁλοτελής, ές: perfect, complete. perfect, complete, all.

G3652 Ὀλυμπᾶς, ᾶ, ὁ: Olympas. Olympas, a Christian man in Rome.

G3653 ὄλυνθος, ου, ὁ: an unripe fig. an unripe fig, one which, not ripening in due time, grows through the winter and falls off in the spring.

G3654 ὅλως: wholly, altogether, not at all. wholly, altogether, actually, really; with negative: not at all.

G3655 ὄμβρος, ου, ὁ: a violent rain. a violent rain, a shower.

G3656 ὁμιλέω: I associate with, talk with. I consort with, associate with, commune with; particularly, I talk (converse) with.

G3657 ὁμιλία, ας, ἡ: intercourse, companionship, conversation. intercourse, companionship, conversation, association.

G3659 ὄμμα, ατος, τό: an eye. an eye.

G3660 ὀμνύω: I swear, take an oath. I swear, take an oath, promise with an oath.

G3661 ὁμοθυμαδόν: with one mind, unanimously. with one mind, unanimously, with one accord, at the same time.

G3662 ὁμοιάζω: I am like, resemble. I am like, resemble.

G3663 ὁμοιοπαθής, ές: of like feelings. of like feelings, having similar passions and feelings, of like infirmities.

G3664 ὅμοιος, οία, οιον: like, similar to. like, similar to, resembling, of equal rank.

G3665 ὁμοιότης, τητος, ἡ: likeness, resemblance. likeness, resemblance.

G3666 ὁμοιόω: I make like, liken, compare. I make like, liken; I compare.

G3667 ὁμοίωμα, ατος, τό: a likeness, form, similitude. (originally: a thing made like something else), a likeness, or rather: form; a similitude.

G3668 ὁμοίως: in like manner. in like manner, similarly, in the same way, equally.

G3669 ὁμοίωσις, εως, ἡ: making like, likeness. making like, likeness, resemblance.

G3670 ὁμολογέω: I confess, profess, acknowledge, praise. (a) I promise, agree, (b) I confess, (c) I publicly declare, (d) a Hebraism, I praise, celebrate.

G3671 ὁμολογία, ας, ἡ: a profession, confession. a profession, confession.

G3672 ὁμολογουμένως: admittedly. admittedly, without controversy.

G3673 ὁμότεχνος, ον: of the same trade or craft. of the same trade or craft.

G3674 ὁμοῦ: together. together, at the same place and time.

G3675 ὁμόφρων, ον: of one mind. of one mind (intent, purpose), like-minded.

G3676 ὅμως: yet, nevertheless. yet, nevertheless, even.

G3677 ὄναρ, ατος, τό: a dream. a dream.

G3678 ὀνάριον, ου, τό: a young ass. a young ass.

G3679 ὀνειδίζω: I reproach, revile, upbraid. I reproach, revile, upbraid.

G3680 ὀνειδισμός, οῦ, ὁ: reproach, reviling. reproach, reviling.

G3681 ὄνειδος, ους, τό: reproach, disgrace. reproach, disgrace.

G3682 Ὀνήσιμος, ου, ὁ: Onesimus. (originally adj: useful, hence the play upon words in Philemon 10, 11, and very common as slave name), Onesimus, a slave of Philemon, a Christian of Colossae.

G3683 Ὀνησίφορος, ου, ὁ: Onesiphorus. Onesiphorus, a Christian of the province of Asia.

G3684 ὀνικός, ή, όν: pertaining to an ass. pertaining to an ass.

G3685 ὀνίνημι: I help, profit, have joy of. I profit, benefit, help; mid: I have profit, derive benefit.

G3686 ὄνομα, ατος, τό: name, character, reputation. name, character, fame, reputation.

G3687 ὀνομάζω: I give a name to, mention. I give a name to, mention, call upon the name of.

G3688 ὄνος, ου, ὁ, ἡ: a donkey, an ass. a donkey, an ass.

G3689 ὄντως: really, truly. really, truly, actually.

G3690 ὄξος, ους, τό: vinegar, sour wine. vinegar, sour wine mixed with water, a common drink of Roman soldiers.

G3691 ὀξύς, εῖα, ύ: sharp, swift, eager. (a) sharp, (b) swift, eager.

G3692 ὀπή, ῆς, ἡ: a crevice, cave. a crevice (in a rock), a cave, an opening, hole.

G3693 ὄπισθεν: from behind, after. from behind, after.

G3694 ὀπίσω: behind, after. behind, after; back, backwards.

G3695 ὁπλίζω: I arm, equip. I make ready, arm, equip.

G3696 ὅπλον, ου, τό: an instrument, arms, weapons. an instrument; plur: arms, weapons.

G3697 ὁποῖος, οία, οῖον: of what kind or manner. of what kind or manner, of what sort.

G3698 ὁπότε: when. when.

G3699 ὅπου: where, whither. where, whither, in what place.

G3700 ὀπτάνομαι: I appear, am seen. I appear, am seen (by), let myself be seen (by).

G3701 ὀπτασία, ας, ἡ: a vision, supernatural appearance. a vision, supernatural appearance.

G3702 ὀπτός, ή, όν: roasted, broiled. roasted, broiled.

G3703 ὀπώρα, ας, ἡ: autumn, autumnal fruits. autumn, autumnal fruits.

G3704 ὅπως: how, in order that, so that. how, in order that, so that, that.

G3705 ὅραμα, ατος, τό: a spectacle, vision. a spectacle, vision, that which is seen.

G3706 ὅρασις, εως, ἡ: a sight, vision, appearance. a sight, vision, appearance.

G3707 ὁρατός, ή, όν: visible. visible.

G3708 ὁράω: I see, look upon, experience. I see, look upon, experience, perceive, discern, beware.

G3709 ὀργή, ῆς, ἡ: anger, wrath, passion. anger, wrath, passion; punishment, vengeance.

G3710 ὀργίζω: I irritate, provoke, am angry. I irritate, provoke, am angry.

G3711 ὀργίλος, η, ον: prone to anger. prone to anger, passionate.

G3712 ὀργυιά, ᾶς, ἡ: a fathom, about five or six feet. a fathom, about five or six feet.

G3713 ὀρέγω: I stretch forth, long for. I stretch forth, mid: I hanker after, long for, am eager for, aspire to.

G3714 ὀρεινός, ή, όν: mountainous, hilly. mountainous, hilly, the hill-country.

G3715 ὄρεξις, εως, ἡ: strong desire, lust. strong desire, lust, appetite.

G3716 ὀρθοποδέω: I walk in a straight course, walk uprightly. I walk in a straight course, walk uprightly.

G3717 ὀρθός, ή, όν: upright, straight. upright, straight, direct.

G3718 ὀρθοτομέω: I cut straight, handle correctly. I cut straight; met: I handle correctly, teach rightly.

G3719 ὀρθρίζω: I rise early, come in the morning. I rise early, come in the morning.
