G3721 ὄρθριος, ία, ιον: early in the morning. early in the morning.

G3722 ὄρθρος, ου, ὁ: early dawn, day-break. early dawn, day-break.

G3723 ὀρθῶς: rightly. rightly.

G3724 ὁρίζω: I define, determine, appoint, decree. I separate, mark off by boundaries; I determine, appoint, designate.

G3725 ὅριον, ου, τό: districts, territory. the boundaries of a place, hence: districts, territory.

G3726 ὁρκίζω: I adjure by, charge solemnly by. I adjure by, charge solemnly by.

G3727 ὅρκος, ου, ὁ: an oath. an oath.

G3728 ὁρκωμοσία, ας, ἡ: the taking of an oath, an oath. the taking of an oath, an oath.

G3729 ὁρμάω: I rush. I rush, hasten on.

G3730 ὁρμή, ῆς, ἡ: a rush, violent assault. a rush, violent assault, impulse.

G3731 ὅρμημα, ατος, τό: a rushing on, impulse. a rushing on, impulse, violence.

G3732 ὄρνεον, ου, τό: a bird. a bird, fowl.

G3733 ὄρνις, ιθος, ὁ, ἡ: a bird, fowl, hen. a bird, fowl, hen.

G3734 ὁροθεσία, ας, ἡ: a setting of boundaries, definite limit. a setting of boundaries, definite limit; plur: bounds.

G3735 ὄρος, ους, τό: a mountain. a mountain, hill.

G3736 ὀρύσσω: I dig, dig out. I dig, dig out, excavate.

G3737 ὀρφανός, ή, όν: bereaved, an orphan. bereaved, an orphan, fatherless, desolate.

G3738 ὀρχέομαι: I dance. I dance.

G3739 ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: who, which, what, that. who, which, what, that.

G3740 ὁσάκις: as often as. as often as, as many times as.

G3741 ὅσιος, ία, ιον: holy, pious. holy, pious, godly, beloved of God.

G3742 ὁσιότης, τητος, ἡ: holiness, godliness, piety. holiness, godliness, piety.

G3743 ὁσίως: piously. religiously, piously.

G3744 ὀσμή, ῆς, ἡ: an odor. a smell, odor, savor.

G3745 ὅσος, η, ον: how much, how great, how many. how much, how great, how many, as great as, as much.

G3746 ὅσπερ, ἥπερ, ὅπερ: the very one who. the very one who.

G3747 ὀστέον, ου, τό: a bone. a bone.

G3748 ὅστις, ἥτις, ὅτι: whosoever, whichsoever, whatsoever. whosoever, whichsoever, whatsoever.

G3749 ὀστράκινος, η, ον: made of earth. made of clay, earthen.

G3750 ὄσφρησις, εως, ἡ: the sense of smell. the sense of smell, smelling.

G3751 ὀσφύς, ύος, ἡ: the loins. the loins.

G3752 ὅταν: when, whensoever. when, whenever.

G3753 ὅτε: when. when, at which time.

G3754 ὅτι: that, since, because. that, since, because; may introduce direct discourse.

G3755 ὅτου: until. until.

G3756 οὐ: no, not. no, not.

G3757 οὗ: where, whither, when. where, whither, when, in what place.

G3758 οὐά: ah!, aha!. ah!, aha!, derisive.

G3759 οὐαί: woe!, alas!. woe!, alas!, uttered in grief or denunciation.

G3760 οὐδαμῶς: by no means. by no means, not at all.

G3761 οὐδέ: neither, nor, not even. neither, nor, not even, and not.

G3762 οὐδείς, οὐδεμία, οὐδέν: no one, none, nothing. no one, none, nothing.

G3763 οὐδέποτε: never. never.

G3764 οὐδέπω: not yet, never before. not yet, never before.

G3765 οὐκέτι: no longer, no more. no longer, no more.

G3766 οὐκοῦν: not therefore. therefore, so then.

G3767 οὖν: therefore, then. therefore, then.

G3768 οὔπω: not yet. not yet.

G3769 οὐρά, ᾶς, ἡ: a tail. a tail.

G3770 οὐράνιος, ον: heavenly. in heaven, belonging to heaven, heavenly, from heaven.

G3771 οὐρανόθεν: from heaven. from heaven, from the sky.

G3772 οὐρανός, οῦ, ὁ: the sky, the heaven. heaven, (a) the visible heavens: the atmosphere, the sky, the starry heavens, (b) the spiritual heavens.

G3773 Οὐρβανός, οῦ, ὁ: Urbanus. Urbanus, a Christian in Rome, fellow-worker of Paul.

G3774 Οὐρίας, ου, ὁ: Uriah. Uriah, husband of Bathsheba the mother of Solomon.

G3775 οὖς, ὠτός, τό: the ear. (a) the ear, (b) met: the faculty of perception.

G3776 οὐσία, ας, ἡ: property, wealth. property, wealth, substance.

G3777 οὔτε: and not, neither, nor. and not, neither, nor.

G3778 οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο: this, he, she, it. this; he, she, it.

G3779 οὕτως: thus, so, in this manner. thus, so, in this manner.

G3780 οὐχί: by no means, not at all. by no means, not at all.

G3781 ὀφειλέτης, ου, ὁ: a debtor, sinner. (a) a debtor, one who owes, one who is indebted, (b) one who has sinned against another (an Aramaism), a sinner.

title: Dodson Greek-English Lexicon of the New Testament, G3782 to G4015
source: Jeffrey Dodson, Greek-English Lexicon of the New Testament (public domain), data prepared by Ulrik Sandborg-Petersen. Each entry: Strong number, Greek word, short meaning, fuller meaning.
body:
G3782 ὀφειλή, ῆς, ἡ: a debt, duty. a debt, a duty, what is due.

G3783 ὀφείλημα, ατος, τό: a debt, offense, sin. a debt, offense, sin.

G3784 ὀφείλω: I owe, ought. I owe, ought.

G3785 ὄφελον: O that! I wish! Would that!. O that! I wish! Would that!, followed by indicative.

G3786 ὄφελος, ους, τό: advantage, gain, profit. advantage, gain, profit, help.

G3787 ὀφθαλμοδουλεία, ας, ἡ: service rendered only while the master watches. eye-service; service rendered only while the master watches.

G3788 ὀφθαλμός, οῦ, ὁ: the eye. the eye; fig: the mind's eye.

G3789 ὄφις, εως, ὁ: a serpent. a serpent, snake; used of the devil or Satan.

G3790 ὀφρῦς, ύος, ἡ: the brow, a ridge. the brow, a ridge (of a mountain).

G3791 ὀχλέω: I trouble, torment, worry. I trouble, torment, worry, vex.

G3792 ὀχλοποιέω: I gather a crowd. I gather a crowd, make a riot.

G3793 ὄχλος, ου, ὁ: a crowd. a crowd, mob, the common people.

G3794 ὀχύρωμα, ατος, τό: a fortress, strong defense. a fortress, strong defense, stronghold.

G3795 ὀψάριον, ου, τό: a little fish. a little fish.

G3796 ὀψέ: late, in the evening. late, in the evening.

G3797 ὄψιμος, ον: late in the year. late, latter.

G3798 ὄψιος, α, ον: late. late, evening.

G3799 ὄψις, εως, ἡ: the features, outward appearance. (a) the face, countenance, (b) the features, outward appearance.

G3800 ὀψώνιον, ου, τό: pay, wages. pay, wages, salary, reward.

G3802 παγιδεύω: I ensnare, entrap. I ensnare, entrap, entangle.

G3803 παγίς, ίδος, ἡ: a snare, trap. a snare, trap (especially for catching birds) hence, met: stratagem, device, wile.

G3804 πάθημα, ατος, τό: suffering, passion. (a) suffering, affliction, (b) passion, emotion, (c) an undergoing, an enduring.

G3805 παθητός, ή, όν: destined to suffer. destined to suffer.

G3806 πάθος, ους, τό: suffering, emotion, depraved passion, lust. suffering, emotion, depraved passion, lust.

G3807 παιδαγωγός, οῦ, ὁ: a boy's guardian or tutor. a boy's guardian or tutor, a slave who had charge of the life and morals of the boys of a family, not strictly a teacher.

G3808 παιδάριον, ου, τό: a little boy, lad. a little boy, lad.

G3809 παιδεία, ας, ἡ: discipline. discipline; training and education of children, hence: instruction; chastisement, correction.

G3810 παιδευτής, οῦ, ὁ: an instructor. an instructor, trainer; almost: a chastiser.

G3811 παιδεύω: I discipline, educate, train, chastise. (a) I discipline, educate, train, (b) more severely: I chastise.

G3812 παιδιόθεν: from childhood. from childhood, from early boyhood.

G3813 παιδίον, ου, τό: a little child, an infant. a little child, an infant, little one.

G3814 παιδίσκη, ης, ἡ: a female slave, maidservant, maid.. a female slave, maidservant, maid, young girl.

G3815 παίζω: I play, sport. I play, sport (includes singing and dancing), play in the manner of children.

G3816 παῖς, παιδός, ὁ, ἡ: a boy or girl child. (a) a male child, boy, (b) a male slave, servant; thus: a servant of God, especially as a title of the Messiah, (c) a female child, girl.

G3817 παίω: I strike, smite. I strike, smite, sting.

G3819 πάλαι: of old, long ago. of old, long ago, in times past, former.

G3820 παλαιός, ά, όν: old, ancient, worn out. old, ancient, not new or recent.

G3821 παλαιότης, τητος, ἡ: oldness, obsoleteness. oldness, obsoleteness.

G3822 παλαιόω: I make old, declare obsolete. I make old, declare obsolete; pass: I grow old, become obsolete.

G3823 πάλη, ης, ἡ: a wrestling, struggle. wrestling, a wrestling bout; hence: a struggle, fight, conflict, contest.

G3824 παλιγγενεσία, ας, ἡ: a new birth, regeneration. a new birth, regeneration, renewal.

G3825 πάλιν: again, further, on the other hand. again, back, once more, further, on the other hand.

G3826 παμπληθεί: all at once, all together. all at once, all together.

G3827 πάμπολυς, παμπόλλη, πάμπολυ: very great. very great, very much.

G3828 Παμφυλία, ας, ἡ: Pamphylia. Pamphylia, a Roman province on the south coast of Asia Minor.

G3829 πανδοχεῖον, ου, τό: an inn. an inn, khan, hotel.

G3830 πανδοχεύς, έως, ὁ: an innkeeper. an innkeeper, landlord, host.

G3831 πανήγυρις, εως, ἡ: a festival assembly. a festival assembly.

G3832 πανοικί: with one's whole household or family. with one's whole household or family.

G3833 πανοπλία, ας, ἡ: complete armor. complete armor, panoply.

G3834 πανουργία, ας, ἡ: cunning, craftiness. shrewdness, skill; hence: cunning, craftiness.

G3835 πανοῦργος, ον: cunning, crafty. cunning, crafty, skilful, clever.

G3836 πανταχόθεν: from all sides. from all sides, from all parts.

G3837 πανταχοῦ: everywhere. everywhere, in all places.

G3838 παντελής, ές: complete, forever, entirely. complete, entire, perfect, through all time.

G3839 πάντῃ: in every way. in every way, entirely, everywhere.

G3840 πάντοθεν: from all sides. from all sides, on all sides.

G3841 παντοκράτωρ, ορος, ὁ: ruler of the universe. ruler of all, ruler of the universe, the almighty.

G3842 πάντοτε: always, at all times. always, at all times, ever.

G3843 πάντως: entirely, in every way, certainly. wholly, entirely, in every way, by all means, certainly.

G3844 παρά: from, in the presence of. gen: from; dat: beside, in the presence of; acc: alongside of.

G3845 παραβαίνω: I transgress. I transgress, violate, depart, desert.

G3846 παραβάλλω: I compare, arrive. I compare, arrive, land.

G3847 παράβασις, εως, ἡ: a transgression. a transgression, overstepping, deviation.

G3848 παραβάτης, ου, ὁ: a transgressor. a transgressor, law-breaker.

G3849 παραβιάζομαι: I urge, constrain by entreaties. I urge, press, constrain by entreaties.

G3850 παραβολή, ῆς, ἡ: a parable, comparison. (a) a comparison, (b) a parable, often of those uttered by our Lord, (c) a proverb, an adage.

G3851 παραβουλεύομαι: I expose myself to danger, am reckless. I expose myself to danger; I am adventuresome, reckless.

G3852 παραγγελία, ας, ἡ: a command, charge. a command, charge, injunction; a precept, rule of living.

G3853 παραγγέλλω: I notify, command, charge. I notify, command, charge, entreat solemnly.

G3854 παραγίνομαι: I appear, come, arrive at. (a) I come on the scene, appear, come, (b) with words expressing destination: I present myself at, arrive at, reach.

G3855 παράγω: I pass by, depart, pass away. I pass by, depart, pass away.

G3856 παραδειγματίζω: I put to open shame. I put to open shame, make a public example of, put to disgrace.

G3857 παράδεισος, ου, ὁ: Paradise. Paradise.

G3858 παραδέχομαι: I receive, accept, acknowledge. I receive, accept, acknowledge.

G3859 παραδιατριβή, ῆς, ἡ: useless debate. useless debate.

G3860 παραδίδωμι: I hand over, deliver, betray. I hand over, pledge, hand down, deliver, commit, commend, betray, abandon.

G3861 παράδοξος, ον: unexpected, strange, wonderful. unexpected, strange, wonderful, astonishing.

G3862 παράδοσις, εως, ἡ: an instruction, tradition. an instruction, tradition.

G3863 παραζηλόω: I make jealous. I make jealous, provoke to jealously, provoke to anger.

G3864 παραθαλάσσιος, ία, ιον: by the sea. by the sea.

G3865 παραθεωρέω: I overlook, neglect. I look past, overlook, neglect.

G3866 παραθήκη, ης, ἡ: anything committed to one's charge. a deposit, anything committed to one's charge or trust.

G3867 παραινέω: I admonish, advise, exhort. I admonish, advise, exhort.

G3868 παραιτέομαι: I make excuse, refuse, reject. I beg off, make excuse, deprecate, refuse, reject, decline, shun, avoid.

G3869 παρακαθίζω: I sit down beside. I sit down beside, set beside.

G3870 παρακαλέω: I summon, entreat, admonish, comfort. (a) I send for, summon, invite, (b) I beseech, entreat, beg, (c) I exhort, admonish, (d) I comfort, encourage, console.

G3871 παρακαλύπτω: I hide, conceal, veil. I hide, conceal, veil.

G3873 παράκειμαι: I am present with, rest with. I am at hand, am present with, rest with.

G3874 παράκλησις, εως, ἡ: exhortation, entreaty, encouragement, comfort. a calling for, summons, hence: (a) exhortation, (b) entreaty, (c) encouragement, joy, gladness, (d) consolation, comfort.

G3875 παράκλητος, ου, ὁ: an advocate, comforter, helper, Paraclete. (a) an advocate, intercessor, (b) a consoler, comforter, helper, (c) Paraclete.

G3876 παρακοή, ῆς, ἡ: disobedience. disobedience, imperfect hearing.

G3877 παρακολουθέω: I accompany, follow closely, investigate. I accompany, follow closely, characterize, both lit. and met.; I investigate.

G3878 παρακούω: I refuse to hear, disobey, disregard. (a) I hear carelessly or incidentally, or I pretend not to hear, (b) I refuse to hear; I disobey, disregard.

G3879 παρακύπτω: I stoop, peer in, look down. I stoop, peer in, look down, look intently.

G3880 παραλαμβάνω: I take, receive. I take from, receive from, or: I take to, receive (apparently not used of money), admit, acknowledge; I take with me.

G3881 παραλέγομαι: I coast along, sail along. I coast along, sail along.

G3882 παράλιος, ον: on the coast. adjacent to the sea, on the coast.

G3883 παραλλαγή, ῆς, ἡ: a change, variation. a change, variation, mutation.

G3884 παραλογίζομαι: I deceive, beguile. I deceive, beguile, reason falsely, mislead.

G3885 παραλυτικός, ή, όν: afflicted with paralysis. afflicted with paralysis.

G3886 παραλύω: I relax, enfeeble. I relax, enfeeble, weaken.

G3887 παραμένω: I remain by, abide with. I remain by, abide with; met: I persevere in.

G3888 παραμυθέομαι: I encourage, comfort, console. I encourage, comfort, console, exhort.

G3889 παραμυθία, ας, ἡ: encouragement, comfort. encouragement, comfort, consolation, exhortation.

G3890 παραμύθιον, ου, τό: comfort, consolation. comfort, consolation, an exhortation, persuasion, encouragement.

G3891 παρανομέω: I act contrary to law. I act contrary to law.

G3892 παρανομία, ας, ἡ: a transgression. a transgression, violation of law.

G3893 παραπικραίνω: I embitter, provoke, irritate. I embitter, provoke, irritate.

G3894 παραπικρασμός, οῦ, ὁ: a provocation, irritation. a provocation, irritation, rebellion.

G3895 παραπίπτω: I fall away. I fall away, fall back (into the unbelieving and godless ways of the old time).

G3896 παραπλέω: I sail past. I sail past (without stopping there).

G3897 παραπλήσιον: near to, nearly. near to, nearly.

G3898 παραπλησίως: similarly, in like manner. similarly, in like manner, likewise.

G3899 παραπορεύομαι: I go past. I go past, pass by, pass along by.

G3900 παράπτωμα, ατος, τό: a falling away, sin. a falling away, lapse, slip, false step, trespass, sin.

G3901 παραρρέω: I am lost, perish, drift away. (lit: I flow past, glide past, hence) I am lost, perish, or merely: I drift away (fall away) from duty.

G3902 παράσημος, ον: marked with. marked with; a figure-head.

G3903 παρασκευάζω: I prepare. I prepare; mid: I prepare, make preparations.

G3904 παρασκευή, ῆς, ἡ: the day before the Sabbath. the day of preparation, the day before the Sabbath, Friday.

G3905 παρατείνω: I extend, prolong. I extend, prolong, continue.

G3906 παρατηρέω: I watch. I watch, observe scrupulously.

G3907 παρατήρησις, εως, ἡ: observation. observation, careful watching.

G3908 παρατίθημι: I set before, serve, entrust to. (a) I set (especially a meal) before, serve, (b) act. and mid: I deposit with, entrust to, (c) I bring forward, quote as evidence.

G3909 παρατυγχάνω: I chance to meet. I come by chance, chance to meet.

G3910 παραυτίκα: immediate. adv. with force of adj: present, immediate, for the moment.

G3911 παραφέρω: I turn aside, carry away, remove. I turn aside, carry away, remove, cause to pass away; pass: I am misled, seduced.

G3912 παραφρονέω: I am out of my senses. I am out of my senses, am beside myself.

G3913 παραφρονία, ας, ἡ: madness, folly. madness, folly.

G3914 παραχειμάζω: I pass the winter. I pass the winter.

G3915 παραχειμασία, ας, ἡ: wintering. wintering, spending the winter.

G3916 παραχρῆμα: instantly, immediately. instantly, immediately, on the spot.

G3917 πάρδαλις, εως, ἡ: a leopard, panther. a leopard, panther.

G3918 πάρειμι: I am present, am near. I am present, am near; I have come, arrived.

G3919 παρεισάγω: I bring in secretly. I bring in secretly, am at hand.

G3920 παρείσακτος, ον: brought in secretly. brought in secretly, surreptitious.

G3921 παρεισδύω: I enter secretly. I enter secretly, come in by stealth.

G3922 παρεισέρχομαι: I enter secretly. I enter secretly, come in from the side.

G3923 παρεισφέρω: I contribute besides. I contribute besides, bring in besides, smuggle in.

G3924 παρεκτός: besides, outside, without. (a) adv. used as adj: besides, outside, without, left over, in addition, (b) prep: apart from, except.

G3925 παρεμβολή, ῆς, ἡ: a camp, barracks, army in battle array. a camp, fort, castle, barracks, army in battle array.

G3926 παρενοχλέω: I trouble. I trouble, cause disturbance to, annoy, harass.

G3927 παρεπίδημος, ον: residing in a strange country, a stranger. residing in a strange country; subst: a stranger, sojourner.

G3928 παρέρχομαι: I pass by. I pass by, pass away, pass out of sight; I am rendered void, become vain, neglect, disregard.

G3929 πάρεσις, εως, ἡ: overlooking. overlooking, suspension, remission of punishment for.

G3930 παρέχω: I offer, provide. act. and mid: I offer, provide, confer, afford, give, bring, show, cause.

G3931 παρηγορία, ας, ἡ: solace, consolation. solace, consolation, comfort.

G3932 παρθενία, ας, ἡ: virginity. virginity.

G3933 παρθένος, ου, ὁ, ἡ: a virgin. a maiden, virgin; extended to men who have not known women.

G3934 Πάρθος, ου, ὁ: a Parthian. a Parthian, an inhabitant of the country beyond the eastern boundary of the Roman Empire between the Caspian Sea and the Persian Gulf.

G3935 παρίημι: I neglect, omit, slacken. (a) I let pass, neglect, omit, disregard, (b) I slacken, loosen; pass: I am wearied.

G3936 παρίστημι: I bring, present, come up to and stand by. I bring, present, prove, come up to and stand by, am present.

G3937 Παρμενᾶς, ᾶ, ὁ: Parmenas. Parmenas, one of the original seven deacons at Jerusalem.

G3938 πάροδος, ου, ἡ: a passing by or through. a passing by or through.

G3939 παροικέω: I sojourn. I sojourn, dwell in as a stranger.

G3940 παροικία, ας, ἡ: a sojourning. a sojourning, a dwelling in a strange land.

G3941 πάροικος, ον: a stranger, foreigner. foreign, alien, subst: a foreigner, sojourner.

G3942 παροιμία, ας, ἡ: an allegory, proverb. a cryptic saying, an allegory; a proverb, figurative discourse.

G3943 πάροινος, ον: given to wine, drunken. given to wine, drunken, quarrelsome.

G3944 παροίχομαι: I pass away time. I pass away time.

G3945 παρομοιάζω: I resemble. I resemble, am like.

G3946 παρόμοιος, α, ον: like, similar. like, similar.

G3947 παροξύνω: I provoke, irritate. I arouse anger, provoke, irritate.

G3948 παροξυσμός, οῦ, ὁ: incitement, irritation. stimulation, provocation, irritation, angry dispute.

G3949 παροργίζω: I provoke to anger, exasperate. I provoke to anger, exasperate.

G3950 παροργισμός, οῦ, ὁ: exasperation, wrath. exasperation, wrath, irritation, indignation.

G3951 παροτρύνω: I stir up, incite. I stir up, incite, urge on.

G3952 παρουσία, ας, ἡ: presence, a coming, arrival, advent. (a) presence, (b) a coming, an arrival, advent, especially of the second coming of Christ.

G3953 παροψίς, ίδος, ἡ: a bowl, dish, platter. prop: a dainty side-dish; meton: a plate, dish, platter.

G3954 παρρησία, ας, ἡ: freedom, confidence. freedom, openness, especially in speech; boldness, confidence.

G3955 παρρησιάζομαι: I speak freely, boldly. I speak freely, boldly; I am confident.

G3956 πᾶς, πᾶσα, πᾶν: all, the whole, every kind of. all, the whole, every kind of.

G3957 πάσχα, τό: the feast of Passover, the Passover lamb. the feast of Passover, the Passover lamb.

G3958 πάσχω: I am acted upon, suffer. I am acted upon in a certain way, either good or bad; I experience ill treatment, suffer.

G3960 πατάσσω: I strike. I smite, strike (as with a sword), smite to death, afflict.

G3961 πατέω: I tread, trample upon. I tread, trample upon.

G3964 πατρολῴας, ου, ὁ: a murderer of his father. a patricide, a murderer of his father.

G3966 πατριάρχης, ου, ὁ: a patriarch. a patriarch, head or founder of a family.

G3967 πατρικός, ή, όν: paternal, ancestral. ancestral, paternal, belonging to the fathers (ancestors).

G3968 πατρίς, ίδος, ἡ: fatherland. fatherland, one's native place.

G3969 Πατρόβας, α, ὁ: Patrobas. Patrobas, a Christian in Rome.

G3970 πατροπαράδοτος, ον: inherited. handed down by (from) one's ancestors, inherited.

G3971 πατρῷος, α, ον: hereditary. hereditary, received from fathers.

G3972 Παῦλος, ου, ὁ: Paul. Paul, Paulus.

G3973 παύω: I cause to cease. (a) act: I cause to cease, restrain, hinder, (b) mid: I cease, stop, leave off.

G3975 παχύνω: I fatten. I fatten, thicken; pass. fig: I become stupid, dull, unfeeling.

G3976 πέδη, ης, ἡ: a shackle. a shackle, fetter for the feet.

G3977 πεδινός, ή, όν: level. level, low-lying, flat.

G3978 πεζεύω: I travel on foot. I travel on foot, by land.

G3979 πεζῇ: on foot. on foot, by land.

G3980 πειθαρχέω: I obey one in authority. I obey one in authority, conform to advice, obey, follow.

G3981 πειθός, ή, όν: persuasive. persuasive, enticing, skilful.

G3982 πείθω: I persuade, urge. I persuade, urge.

G3983 πεινάω: I am hungry, needy. I am hungry, needy, desire earnestly.

G3984 πεῖρα, ας, ἡ: a trial, experiment. a trial, experiment, attempt.

G3985 πειράζω: I try, tempt, test. I try, tempt, test.

G3986 πειρασμός, οῦ, ὁ: trial, testing, temptation. (a) trial, probation, testing, being tried, (b) temptation, (c) calamity, affliction.

G3987 πειράω: I try, attempt. mid: I try, attempt, endeavor.

G3988 πεισμονή, ῆς, ἡ: persuasion, conviction. persuasion, conviction, a yielding to persuasion.

G3989 πέλαγος, ους, τό: the sea, the deep. the sea, the deep.

G3992 πέμπω: I send. I send, transmit, permit to go, put forth.

G3993 πένης, ητος, ὁ: poor. one who works for his living; a laborer, poor man.

G3994 πενθερά, ᾶς, ἡ: a mother-in-law. a mother-in-law.

G3995 πενθερός, οῦ, ὁ: a father-in-law. a father-in-law.

G3996 πενθέω: I mourn, lament. I mourn, lament, feel guilt.

G3997 πένθος, ους, τό: mourning, sorrow. mourning, sorrow, sadness, grief.

G3998 πενιχρός, ά, όν: poor, needy. poor, needy.

G3999 πεντάκις: five times. five times.

G4000 πεντακισχίλιοι, αι, α: five thousand. five thousand.

G4001 πεντακόσιοι, αι, α: five hundred. five hundred.

G4002 πέντε, οἱ, αἱ, τά: five. five.

G4003 πεντεκαιδέκατος, η, ον: fifteenth. the fifteenth.

G4004 πεντήκοντα, οἱ, αἱ, τά: fifty. fifty.

G4005 πεντηκοστή, ῆς, ἡ: Pentecost. Pentecost, a feast of the Jews, the fiftieth day after Passover.

G4006 πεποίθησις, εως, ἡ: confidence, trust. confidence, trust, reliance.

G4008 πέραν: over, beyond. over, on the other side, beyond.

G4009 πέρας, ατος, τό: a boundary, limit, an end. (a) a boundary, limit, extremity, (b) an end, conclusion.

title: Dodson Greek-English Lexicon of the New Testament, G4016 to G4263
source: Jeffrey Dodson, Greek-English Lexicon of the New Testament (public domain), data prepared by Ulrik Sandborg-Petersen. Each entry: Strong number, Greek word, short meaning, fuller meaning.
body:
G4016 περιβάλλω: I cast around, clothe. I cast around, wrap a garment about, put on; hence mid: I put on to myself, clothe myself, dress; I draw (a line).

G4017 περιβλέπομαι: I look around on, survey. I look around on, survey.

G4018 περιβόλαιον, ου, τό: a wrapper, mantle, veil. a wrapper, mantle, veil, cloak, covering.

G4019 περιδέω: I bind around. I bind (tie) around.

G4020 περιεργάζομαι: I overdo, am a busybody. I overdo, am a busybody, waste my labor about (a thing).

G4021 περίεργος, ον: a busybody, curious, magical. of persons: over-careful; curious, meddling, a busy-body; of things: over-wrought; superfluous; curious, uncanny; subst: curious arts, magic.

G4022 περιέρχομαι: I move about, make a circuit, tack. I go around, move about, visit; I make a circuit, tack (as a ship).

G4023 περιέχω: I contain, seize. (a) I contain (of a book containing subject matter); hence: it stands (has its content) thus, (b) I encompass, surround, get hold of, seize.

G4024 περιζώννυμι: I gird round. I gird round; mid: I gird myself, generally for active work or travel.

G4025 περίθεσις, εως, ἡ: a putting around. a putting around or on (as of ornaments).

G4026 περιΐστημι: I stand around, avoid, shun. in intrans. act. tenses: I stand around; mid: I avoid, shun.

G4027 περικάθαρμα, ατος, τό: refuse, filth. refuse, offscouring, filth.

G4028 περικαλύπτω: I cover up. I cover up, cover round about, veil round, blindfold.

G4029 περίκειμαι: I surround, am surrounded with. I lie about, surround; I am encompassed, surrounded, or clothed with, am in submission to.

G4030 περικεφαλαία, ας, ἡ: a helmet. a helmet.

G4031 περικρατής, ές: having full power over, mastering. having full power over, mastering, gaining control over.

G4032 περικρύπτω: I conceal, hide. I conceal, hide (by putting something around it).

G4033 περικυκλόω: I encircle, surround. I encircle, surround, encompass.

G4034 περιλάμπω: I shine around. I shine around.

G4035 περιλείπω: I leave behind. I leave behind; pass: I am left behind, remain, survive.

G4036 περίλυπος, ον: very sorrowful. very sorrowful, greatly grieved.

G4037 περιμένω: I wait for. I wait for, await.

G4038 πέριξ: round about. round about, neighboring.

G4039 περιοικέω: I dwell around. I dwell around, am neighboring to.

G4040 περίοικος, ον: a neighbor. dwelling around; subst: a neighbor.

G4041 περιούσιος, ον: costly, specially chosen. costly, treasured, select, specially chosen.

G4042 περιοχή, ῆς, ἡ: a passage of Scripture. a section or passage of Scripture.

G4043 περιπατέω: I walk, conduct my life. I walk, hence Hebraistically (in an ethical sense): I conduct my life, live.

G4044 περιπείρω: I pierce through. I put on a spit; met: I pierce, wound deeply.

G4045 περιπίπτω: I fall into the midst of. I fall into the midst of, am involved in, happen upon a place.

G4046 περιποιέω: I acquire, purchase. I acquire, earn, purchase, make my own, preserve alive.

G4047 περιποίησις, εως, ἡ: obtaining, possessing, possession. acquiring, obtaining, possessing, possession, ownership.

G4048 περιρρήγνυμι: I tear off. I tear off, as of garments.

G4049 περισπάω: I distract, trouble greatly. I distract, trouble greatly.

G4050 περισσεία, ας, ἡ: abundance. abundance, superfluity.

G4051 περίσσευμα, ατος, τό: abundance. abundance, overflow.

G4052 περισσεύω: I exceed, am left over. (a) intrans: I exceed the ordinary (the necessary), abound, overflow; am left over, (b) trans: I cause to abound.

G4053 περισσός, ή, όν: abundant, greater, vehemently, advantage. more, greater, excessive, abundant, exceedingly, vehemently; noun: preeminence, advantage.

G4055 περισσότερος, τέρα, τερον: greater, more. greater, more, even more, more abundantly.

G4057 περισσῶς: greatly, exceedingly. greatly, exceedingly, abundantly, vehemently.

G4058 περιστερά, άς, ἡ: a dove. a dove, pigeon.

G4059 περιτέμνω: I circumcise. I cut around, circumcise.

G4060 περιτίθημι: I put around, bestow. I place or put around, clothe; fig: I bestow, confer.

G4061 περιτομή, ῆς, ἡ: circumcision. circumcision.

G4062 περιτρέπω: I turn, change. I turn round, turn, change.

G4063 περιτρέχω: I run around. I run around.

G4064 περιφέρω: I carry around, am driven to and fro. I carry around; pass: I am driven to and fro.

G4065 περιφρονέω: I look down upon, despise. I look down upon, despise.

G4066 περίχωρος, ον: neighboring. neighboring; subst: the neighboring country, neighboring inhabitants.

G4067 περίψημα, ατος, τό: scrapings, offscourings. scrapings, offscourings, wiped-off filth.

G4068 περπερεύομαι: I boast. I boast, vaunt myself.

G4069 Περσίς, ίδος, ἡ: Persis. Persis, name of a Christian lady in Rome.

G4070 πέρυσι: last year. last year, a year ago.

G4071 πετεινόν, οῦ, τό: a bird. a bird, fowl.

G4072 πέτομαι: I fly. I fly.

G4073 πέτρα, ας, ἡ: rock. a rock, ledge, cliff, cave, stony ground.

G4074 Πέτρος, ου, ὁ: Peter. Peter, a Greek name meaning "rock".

G4075 πετρώδης, ες: rocky, stony. rocky, stony.

G4076 πήγανον, ου, τό: rue, a plant used for flavoring food. rue, a plant used for flavoring or garnishing food.

G4077 πηγή, ῆς, ἡ: a fountain, spring, well. a fountain, spring, well, issue, flow.

G4078 πήγνυμι: I pitch a tent. I fasten, pitch a tent.

G4079 πηδάλιον, ου, τό: the rudder of a ship. the rudder of a ship.

G4080 πηλίκος, η, ον: how large, how great. how large, how great.

G4081 πηλός, οῦ, ὁ: clay, mud. clay, mud.

G4082 πήρα, ας, ἡ: a sack, wallet. a sack, wallet for carrying provisions.

G4083 πῆχυς, εως, ὁ: a cubit. a cubit, about a foot and a half.

G4084 πιάζω: I lay hold of. I lay hold of, apprehend, catch, arrest.

G4085 πιέζω: I press down. I press down, press together, as in a measure.

G4086 πιθανολογία, ας, ἡ: persuasive speech. persuasive speech.

G4087 πικραίνω: I embitter. I make bitter, embitter; pass: I grow angry or harsh.

G4088 πικρία, ας, ἡ: bitterness. bitterness, harshness, hence met: an embittered (resentful) spirit.

G4089 πικρός, ά, όν: bitter, acrid, malignant. bitter, acrid, malignant.

G4090 πικρῶς: bitterly. bitterly.

G4091 Πιλᾶτος, ου, ὁ: Pilate. Pilate.

G4092 πίμπρημι: I am inflamed, I swell. I swell, am inflamed.

G4093 πινακίδιον, ου, τό: a tablet for writing. a tablet for writing.

G4094 πίναξ, ακος, ἡ: a plate, platter. a plate, platter, disc, dish.

G4095 πίνω: I drink, imbibe. I drink, imbibe.

G4096 πιότης, τητος, ἡ: fatness. fatness, as of the olive; richness.

G4097 πιπράσκω: I sell. I sell; pass: I am a slave to, am devoted to.

G4098 πίπτω: I fall, fall under. I fall, fall under (as under condemnation), fall prostrate.

G4099 Πισιδία, ας, ἡ: Pisidia. Pisidia, a country of Asia Minor, being the south-western part of the Roman province Galatia.

G4100 πιστεύω: I believe, have faith in. I believe, have faith in, trust in; pass: I am entrusted with.

G4101 πιστικός, ή, όν: genuine, pure. genuine, pure (of ointment), trustworthy.

G4102 πίστις, εως, ἡ: faith, belief, trust. faith, belief, trust, confidence; fidelity, faithfulness.

G4103 πιστός, ή, όν: trustworthy, faithful, believing. trustworthy, faithful, believing.

G4104 πιστόω: I convince, give assurance to. I convince, establish, give assurance to; pass: I am assured of.

G4105 πλανάω: I lead astray, deceive. I lead astray, deceive, cause to wander.

G4106 πλάνη, ης, ἡ: a wandering, error. a wandering; fig: deceit, delusion, error, sin.

G4107 πλανήτης, ου, ὁ: a wanderer. a wanderer.

G4108 πλάνος, ον: misleading, a deceiver. adj: misleading, deceiving, wandering; as subst: a deceiver, imposter.

G4109 πλάξ, πλακός, ἡ: a tablet, flat surface. a tablet, flat surface.

G4110 πλάσμα, ατος, τό: a thing formed or fashioned. a thing formed or fashioned.

G4111 πλάσσω: I form, mould. I form, mould, as a potter his clay.

G4112 πλαστός, ή, όν: formed, molded, feigned. formed, molded; fig: feigned, made up, counterfeit.

G4113 πλατεῖα, ας, ἡ: a street. a street, public square, broad way.

G4114 πλάτος, ους, τό: breadth. breadth.

G4116 πλατύς, εῖα, ύ: broad. broad, wide; subst: a street.

G4117 πλέγμα, ατος, τό: braided hair, anything interwoven. braided hair, anything interwoven.

G4118 πλεῖστος, η, ον: the greatest, the most. the greatest, the most, very great.

G4125 πλευρά, ᾶς, ἡ: the side of the body. the side of the body.

G4126 πλέω: I sail. I sail, travel by sea, voyage.

G4134 πλήρης, ες: full. full, abounding in, complete, completely occupied with.

G4156 πνικτός, ή, όν: strangled. strangled (i.e. killed without letting out the blood).

G4157 πνοή, ῆς, ἡ: breath, wind. (a) breath, (b) gust, breeze, wind.

G4162 ποίησις, εως, ἡ: a doing. a doing, making, performance.

G4164 ποικίλος, η, ον: various, of different colors. various, of different colors, diverse, various.

G4220 πότερος, α, ον: which of two, whether. which of two, whether.

G4221 ποτήριον, ου, τό: a drinking cup. a drinking cup, the contents of the cup; fig: the portion which God allots.

G4222 ποτίζω: I cause to drink, give to drink. I cause to drink, give to drink; irrigate, water.

G4223 Ποτίολοι, ων, οἱ: Puteoli. Puteoli, the great harbor for traffic with Alexandria on the Bay of Naples.

G4224 πότος, ου, ὁ: a drinking, carousing. a drinking, carousing.

G4225 πού: somewhere. where, somewhere, anywhere; with numerals: somewhere about.

G4226 ποῦ: where, whither. where, in what place.

G4227 Πούδης, δεντος, τό: Pudens. Pudens, a Christian man in Rome.

G4228 πούς, ποδός, ὁ: the foot. the foot.

G4229 πρᾶγμα, ατος, τό: a thing done, a matter. a thing done, a deed, action; a matter, an affair.

G4230 πραγματεία, ας, ἡ: a business, an occupation. a business, an occupation, affair, transaction.

G4231 πραγματεύομαι: I transact business, trade. I transact business, trade.

G4232 πραιτώριον, ου, τό: the official residence of the procurator. the palace at Jerusalem occupied by the Roman governor, or the quarters of the praetorian guard in Rome.

G4233 πράκτωρ, ορος, ὁ: an officer employed to execute judicial sentences. an officer employed to execute judicial sentences.

G4234 πρᾶξις, εως, ἡ: an action, deeds, function. (a) a doing, action, mode of action; plur: deeds, acts, (b) function, business.

G4235 πρᾷος, α, ον: mild, gentle. mild, gentle, meek, kind.

G4236 πρᾳότης, τητος, ἡ: mildness, gentleness. mildness, gentleness, meekness, kindness.

G4237 πρασιά, ᾶς, ἡ: a company formed into divisions. a company formed into divisions (like garden-beds).

G4238 πράσσω: I do, fare, require. I do, perform, accomplish; be in any condition, i.e. I fare; I exact, require.

G4239 πραΰς, πραεῖα, πραΰ: mild, gentle. mild, gentle.

G4240 πρᾳΰτης, τητος, ἡ: mildness, gentleness. mildness, gentleness.

G4241 πρέπω: it becomes, is fitting to. it becomes, is fitting to, is right.

G4242 πρεσβεία, ας, ἡ: an embassy, delegation. an embassy, delegation, eldership.

G4243 πρεσβεύω: I am aged, act as an ambassador. I am aged, act as an ambassador.

G4244 πρεσβυτέριον, ου, τό: an assembly of elders. an assembly of elders, the Sanhedrin, officers of the church assembly, presbytery.

G4245 πρεσβύτερος, α, ον: elder. elder, usually used as subst.; an elder, a member of the Sanhedrin, an elder of a Christian assembly.

G4246 πρεσβύτης, ου, ὁ: an old man. an old man, an ambassador.

G4247 πρεσβῦτις, ιδος, ἡ: an old woman. an old woman.

G4248 πρηνής, ές: falling headlong. falling headlong, prone.

G4249 πρίζω: I saw, saw through. I saw, saw through.

G4250 πρίν: formerly, before. formerly, before.

G4251 Πρίσκα, ης, ἡ: Prisca, Priscilla. Prisca, Priscilla, the former being the more correct and formal name, the latter a diminutive and more familiar; a Roman lady, probably of good birth, wife of the Jewish Christian Aquila.

G4252 Πρίσκιλλα, ης, ἡ: Prisca, Priscilla. Prisca, Priscilla, the former being the more correct and formal name, the latter a diminutive and more familiar; a Roman lady, probably of good birth, wife of the Jewish Christian Aquila.

G4253 πρό: before. (a) of place: before, in front of, (b) of time: before, earlier than.

G4254 προάγω: I lead forth, go before. (a) trans: I lead forth; in the judicial sense, into court, (b) intrans. and trans: I precede, go before, (c) intrans: I go too far.

G4255 προαιρέω: I propose, purpose. I propose; mid: I propose to myself, purpose.

G4256 προαιτιάομαι: I make a prior accusation. I make a prior accusation.

G4257 προακούω: I hear beforehand. I hear beforehand.

G4258 προαμαρτάνω: I sin previously. I sin previously.

G4259 προαύλιον, ου, τό: a porch. a porch, court before a building, vestibule.

G4260 προβαίνω: I go forward. I go forward, advance.

G4261 προβάλλω: I put forth. I thrust forward, put forth (as of branches), produce.

G4262 προβατικός, ή, όν: pertaining to sheep. pertaining to sheep.

G4263 πρόβατον, ου, τό: a sheep. a sheep.

title: Dodson Greek-English Lexicon of the New Testament, G4264 to G4514
source: Jeffrey Dodson, Greek-English Lexicon of the New Testament (public domain), data prepared by Ulrik Sandborg-Petersen. Each entry: Strong number, Greek word, short meaning, fuller meaning.
body:
G4264 προβιβάζω: I urge forward. I lead forward, lead on; met: I induce, incite, urge.

G4265 προβλέπομαι: I provide, foresee. I provide, foresee.

G4266 προγίνομαι: I happen previously. I happen (come about) previously.

G4267 προγινώσκω: I know beforehand. I know beforehand, foreknow.

G4268 πρόγνωσις, εως, ἡ: foreknowledge. foreknowledge, previous determination.

G4269 πρόγονος, ου, ὁ: an ancestor. an ancestor.

G4270 προγράφω: I write previously. (a) I write previously (aforetime); I write above (already), (b) I depict or portray openly, (c) I designate beforehand.

G4271 πρόδηλος, ον: evident. manifest to all, evident, very clear.

G4272 προδίδωμι: I give before, betray. I give before, give forth, betray.

G4273 προδότης, ου, ὁ: a betrayer. a betrayer, traitor.

G4274 πρόδρομος, ου, ὁ, ἡ: a precursor, forerunner. a precursor, forerunner, advance guard.

G4275 προείδω: I see beforehand. I see beforehand, am mindful.

G4276 προελπίζω: I hope before. I hope before, am the first to hope.

G4277 προέπω: I say previously, predict. I say previously, predict, proclaim, foretell.

G4278 προενάρχομαι: I begin before. I begin before.

G4279 προεπαγγέλλομαι: I promise beforehand. I promise beforehand.

G4280 προερέω: I say already, predict. I say already, predict, foretell.

G4281 προέρχομαι: I go before, precede. I go forward, go on, advance; I go before, precede.

G4282 προετοιμάζω: I prepare beforehand, predestine. I prepare or appoint beforehand, predestine.

G4283 προευαγγελίζομαι: I preach the gospel beforehand. I preach the gospel beforehand, foretell good tidings.

G4284 προέχω: I excel, surpass. trans: I hold before; mid: I excuse myself; intrans: I project, excel, surpass, have preeminence.

G4285 προηγέομαι: I lead onward by example. I lead onward by example, go before, prefer.

G4286 πρόθεσις, εως, ἡ: the show-bread, predetermination. a setting forth, the show-bread; predetermination, purpose.

G4287 προθεσμία, ας, ἡ: appointed before. appointed before; a previously-appointed time.

G4288 προθυμία, ας, ἡ: inclination, readiness. inclination, readiness, eagerness, willingness, promptness.

G4289 πρόθυμος, ον: eager, ready, willing. eager, ready, willing, prompt.

G4290 προθύμως: readily. readily, eagerly, with a ready mind, cheerfully.

G4291 προΐστημι: I rule. I preside, rule over, give attention to, direct, maintain, practice diligently.

G4292 προκαλέομαι: I provoke, stimulate. I provoke, stimulate, challenge, call out.

G4293 προκαταγγέλλω: I announce beforehand, promise. I announce beforehand, promise, predict.

G4294 προκαταρτίζω: I prepare beforehand. I prepare or complete beforehand.

G4295 πρόκειμαι: I am set before. I am set (placed, put) before, am already there.

G4296 προκηρύσσω: I preach beforehand. I announce or preach beforehand, announce by herald.

G4297 προκοπή, ῆς, ἡ: progress, advancement. progress, advancement.

G4298 προκόπτω: I advance, make progress. (originally of the pioneer cutting his way through brushwood), I advance, progress, make progress.

G4299 πρόκριμα, ατος, τό: a prejudgment, prejudice. a prejudgment, prejudice, partiality, preference.

G4300 προκυρόω: I establish before. I establish or ratify before.

G4301 προλαμβάνω: I take before, anticipate, am overtaken. I take before, anticipate; pass: I am caught or overtaken, taken by surprise.

G4302 προλέγω: I forewarn. I tell (say) beforehand, forewarn, declare, tell plainly.

G4303 προμαρτύρομαι: I predict. I predict, testify or protest beforehand.

G4304 προμελετάω: I meditate beforehand, prepare. I meditate beforehand, prepare, get up, premeditate.

G4305 προμεριμνάω: I am anxious beforehand. I am anxious beforehand, ponder beforehand.

G4306 προνοέω: I provide for. I take thought for beforehand, provide for, practice.

G4307 πρόνοια, ας, ἡ: forethought, foresight. forethought, foresight, provision for, providence.

G4308 προοράω: I foresee. I see beforehand, foresee, see previously, am mindful of; mid: I pay regard to, set before me.

G4309 προορίζω: I foreordain, predetermine. I foreordain, predetermine, mark out beforehand.

G4310 προπάσχω: I suffer previously. I suffer previously.

G4311 προπέμπω: I send forward, accompany. I send forward, accompany, equip for a journey.

G4312 προπετής, ές: impulsive, rash, reckless. impulsive, rash, reckless.

G4313 προπορεύομαι: I precede, pass on before. I precede, pass on before, go before.

G4314 πρός: to, towards, with. to, towards, with.

G4315 προσάββατον, ου, τό: the day before the Sabbath. the day before the Sabbath.

G4316 προσαγορεύω: I address by name, designate. I address by name, designate, accost.

G4317 προσάγω: I bring near, approach. I bring to, bring near; I come to or towards, approach.

G4318 προσαγωγή, ῆς, ἡ: approach, access. approach, access, admission.

G4319 προσαιτέω: I beg. I beg, ask earnestly, ask for in addition.

G4320 προσαναβαίνω: I go up to, come up to. I go up to, come up to, go up further.

G4321 προσαναλίσκω: I spend in addition. I spend in addition.

G4322 προσαναπληρόω: I supply. I fill up by adding to, supply.

G4323 προσανατίθημι: I consult with. I consult with, communicate, impart.

G4324 προσαπειλέω: I utter additional threats. I utter additional threats.

G4325 προσδαπανάω: I spend in addition. I spend in addition.

G4326 προσδέομαι: I want more. I want more, need in addition.

G4327 προσδέχομαι: I expect, welcome, accept. (a) I await, expect, (b) I receive, welcome (originally: to my house), (c) I accept.

G4328 προσδοκάω: I expect, await. I expect, wait for, await, think, anticipate.

G4329 προσδοκία, ας, ἡ: expectation, waiting. expectation, waiting.

G4330 προσεάω: I permit one to approach. I permit one to approach, permit further.

G4331 προσεγγίζω: I approach. I approach, come near to.

G4332 προσεδρεύω: I wait upon, minister to. I wait upon, minister to, have charge of.

G4333 προσεργάζομαι: I gain. I gain, produce in addition.

G4334 προσέρχομαι: I come near, consent to. I come up to, come to, come near (to), approach, consent (to).

G4335 προσευχή, ῆς, ἡ: prayer, a place for prayer. (a) prayer (to God), (b) a place for prayer (used by Jews, perhaps where there was no synagogue).

G4336 προσεύχομαι: I pray, pray for. I pray, pray for, offer prayer.

G4337 προσέχω: I pay attention to, devote myself to. (a) I attend to, pay attention to, (b) I beware, am cautious, (c) I join, devote myself to.

G4338 προσηλόω: I nail to. I fasten with nails, nail to.

G4339 προσήλυτος, ου, ὁ: a proselyte. (lit: that has come to), a proselyte, that is a non-Jew, who has been circumcised and has adopted the Jews' religion.

G4340 πρόσκαιρος, ον: temporary. for a season, temporary.

G4341 προσκαλέω: I summon. I call to myself, summon.

G4342 προσκαρτερέω: I persist. I persist, persevere in, continue steadfast in; I wait upon.

G4343 προσκαρτέρησις, εως, ἡ: perseverance. perseverance.

G4344 προσκεφάλαιον, ου, τό: a pillow or cushion. a pillow or cushion.

G4345 προσκληρόω: I assign by lot, allot. I assign by lot, allot, associate with, follow as a disciple.

G4346 πρόσκλησις, εως, ἡ: partiality. partiality, an inclination towards.

G4347 προσκολλάω: I join closely, cleave to. (lit: I glue one thing to another), I join (unite) closely, cleave (to), follow as an adherent.

G4348 πρόσκομμα, ατος, τό: a stumbling-block. a stumbling-block, an occasion for falling, a moral embarrassment.

G4349 προσκοπή, ῆς, ἡ: a cause of stumbling. a cause of stumbling, offense, shock.

G4350 προσκόπτω: I stumble. I stumble, strike the foot against, beat upon, take offense at.

G4351 προσκυλίω: I roll to. I roll to, roll up against.

G4352 προσκυνέω: I worship. I go down on my knees to, do obeisance to, worship.

G4353 προσκυνητής, οῦ, ὁ: a worshipper. a worshipper.

G4354 προσλαλέω: I speak to. I speak to, converse with.

G4355 προσλαμβάνω: I take to myself, welcome. (a) I take to myself, (b) I take aside, (c) I welcome.

G4356 πρόσληψις, εως, ἡ: a receiving. a receiving, a taking to one's self, acceptance.

G4357 προσμένω: I remain, persist in. I remain; I abide in, remain in, persist in, adhere to.

G4358 προσορμίζω: I anchor at a place. I anchor at a place.

G4359 προσοφείλω: I owe in addition. I owe besides (in addition).

G4360 προσοχθίζω: I am displeased with. I am displeased or offended with.

G4361 πρόσπεινος, ον: very hungry. very hungry.

G4362 προσπήγνυμι: I fasten to. I fasten to, applied to Christ's being fastened to the cross.

G4363 προσπίπτω: I fall down before, beat against. (a) I fall down before, (b) I beat against, rush violently upon.

G4364 προσποιέω: I pretend, regard. I pretend, regard, make a show of.

G4365 προσπορεύομαι: I approach. I come to, approach.

G4366 προσρήγνυμι: I dash against. I dash against, as waves.

G4367 προστάσσω: I instruct, command, appoint. (a) I instruct, command, (b) I appoint, assign.

G4368 προστάτις, ιδος, ἡ: a female guardian, protector. a female guardian, protector, patroness.

G4369 προστίθημι: I put to, add, do again. I place (put) to, add; I do again.

G4370 προστρέχω: I run to. I run to.

G4371 προσφάγιον, ου, τό: anything eaten with bread. anything eaten with bread, especially fish or meat.

G4372 πρόσφατος, ον: recent, new. (originally: newly slaughtered, freshly killed), recent, new.

G4373 προσφάτως: recently. recently, lately, newly.

G4374 προσφέρω: I bring to, offer. (a) I bring to, (b) characteristically: I offer (of gifts, sacrifices, etc).

G4375 προσφιλής, ές: pleasing, acceptable. pleasing, acceptable, grateful.

G4376 προσφορά, άς, ἡ: an offering, sacrifice. an offering, sacrifice.

G4377 προσφωνέω: I call to, summon. I call to, summon; I call (out) to, address, give a speech to, harangue.

G4378 πρόσχυσις, εως, ἡ: a sprinkling. a pouring upon, an effusion, a sprinkling.

G4379 προσψαύω: I touch lightly. I touch lightly.

G4380 προσωποληπτέω: I show partiality. I favor specially, show partiality.

G4381 προσωπολήπτης, ου, ὁ: one who shows partiality. one who shows partiality.

G4382 προσωποληψία, ας, ἡ: partiality, favoritism. partiality, favoritism.

G4383 πρόσωπον, ου, τό: the face, countenance, surface. the face, countenance, surface.

G4385 προτείνω: I stretch out, tie up. I stretch out, tie up (for scourging), extend before.

G4386 πρότερον: formerly, before. formerly, before.

G4387 πρότερος, α, ον: former, before. former, before, formerly.

G4388 προτίθεμαι: I purpose, design beforehand. I purpose, design beforehand, determine.

G4389 προτρέπω: I encourage, exhort. I encourage, exhort, persuade.

G4390 προτρέχω: I outrun. I run before, outrun, run in advance.

G4391 προϋπάρχω: I have been already. I have been already, have been previously.

G4392 πρόφασις, εως, ἡ: a pretext, an excuse. a pretext, an excuse.

G4393 προφέρω: I produce. I bring forth, produce.

G4394 προφητεία, ας, ἡ: prophecy. prophecy, prophesying; the gift of communicating and enforcing revealed truth.

G4395 προφητεύω: I foretell, prophesy. I foretell, prophesy; I set forth matter of divine teaching by special faculty.

G4396 προφήτης, ου, ὁ: a prophet, poet. a prophet, poet; a person gifted at expositing divine truth.

G4397 προφητικός, ή, όν: prophetic. prophetic, uttered by a prophet.

G4398 προφῆτις, ιδος, ἡ: a prophetess. a prophetess.

G4399 προφθάνω: I anticipate. I anticipate, forestall.

G4400 προχειρίζομαι: I appoint, choose, elect. I appoint, choose, elect, take into hand.

G4401 προχειροτονέω: I designate beforehand. I choose or appoint beforehand.

G4402 Πρόχορος, ου, ὁ: Prochorus. Prochorus, one of the seven original deacons at Jerusalem.

G4403 πρύμνα, ης, ἡ: the stern of a ship. the stern of a ship.

G4404 πρωΐ: early in the morning, at dawn. early in the morning, at dawn.

G4405 πρωΐα, ας, ἡ: early morning. early morning.

G4406 πρώϊμος, η, ον: dawning, early. dawning, early.

G4407 πρωϊνός, ή, όν: belonging to the morning. belonging to the morning, early.

G4408 πρῴρα, ας, ἡ: the prow of a ship. the prow of a ship.

G4409 πρωτεύω: I have preeminence, am chief. I have preeminence, am chief, am first.

G4410 πρωτοκαθεδρία, ας, ἡ: a chief seat. a chief (most honorable) seat.

G4411 πρωτοκλισία, ας, ἡ: the chief place at a banquet. the chief place at a banquet or table.

G4412 πρῶτον: first, before. first, in the first place, before, formerly.

G4413 πρῶτος, η, ον: first, before. first, before, principal, most important.

G4414 πρωτοστάτης, ου, ὁ: a leader, chief. one who stands in the front rank, hence: a leader, ringleader, chief.

G4415 πρωτοτόκια, ων, τά: the birthright. the birthright, the rights of the first-born.

G4416 πρωτότοκος, ον: first-born. first-born, eldest.

G4417 πταίω: I stumble, fall, sin. I stumble, fall, sin, err, transgress.

G4418 πτέρνα, ης, ἡ: the heel. the heel.

G4419 πτερύγιον, ου, τό: an extremity, battlement, parapet. an extremity, battlement, parapet, apex.

G4420 πτέρυξ, υγος, ἡ: a wing. a wing, pinion.

G4421 πτηνός, ή, όν: winged. winged; subst: a bird, fowl.

G4422 πτοέω: I terrify, scare. I terrify, scare, strike with panic.

G4423 πτόησις, εως, ἡ: terror, consternation. terror, consternation, dismay.

G4424 Πτολεμαΐς, ΐδος, ἡ: Ptolemais. Ptolemais, a coast city of Phoenicia, midway between Tyre and Caesarea.

G4425 πτύον, ου, τό: a simple wooden pitchfork. a simple wooden pitchfork; a winnowing-shovel or fan.

G4426 πτύρω: I frighten, terrify. I frighten, terrify.

G4427 πτύσμα, ατος, τό: spittle. spittle, saliva.

G4428 πτύσσω: I fold, roll up. I fold, roll up (as a scroll).

G4429 πτύω: I spit. I spit.

G4430 πτῶμα, ατος, τό: a carcass, corpse. a fall; a carcass, corpse, dead body.

G4431 πτῶσις, εως, ἡ: a falling, a fall. a falling, a fall, ruin.

G4432 πτωχεία, ας, ἡ: beggary, poverty. beggary, poverty, destitution.

G4433 πτωχεύω: I am in poverty. I am in poverty, am a beggar.

G4434 πτωχός, ή, όν: poor, destitute. poor, destitute, spiritually poor, either in a good sense (humble devout persons) or bad.

G4435 πυγμή, ῆς, ἡ: the fist. the fist.

G4436 Πύθων, ωνος, ὁ: a divining spirit. a divining spirit, Python, called after the Pythian serpent said to have guarded the oracle at Delphi and been slain by Apollo.

G4437 πυκνός, ή, όν: frequent, often. frequent, often, much.

G4438 πυκτεύω: I box. I box, am a boxer.

G4439 πύλη, ης, ἡ: a door, gate. a gate.

G4440 πυλών, ῶνος, ὁ: a large gate, a gateway, porch. a large gate; a gateway, porch, vestibule.

G4441 πυνθάνομαι: I ask, inquire. I ask, inquire, ascertain by inquiry, understand.

G4442 πῦρ, πυρός, τό: fire, trials. fire; the heat of the sun, lightning; fig: strife, trials; the eternal fire.

G4443 πυρά, ᾶς, ἡ: a fire. a fire, pile of burning fuel.

G4444 πύργος, ου, ὁ: a tower, fortified structure. a tower, fortified structure.

G4445 πυρέσσω: I am sick with a fever. I am sick with a fever.

G4446 πυρετός, οῦ, ὁ: a fever. a fever, scorching heat.

G4447 πύρινος, η, ον: fiery, glittering. fiery, glittering.

G4448 πυρόω: I burn, am purified by fire. pass: I burn, am set on fire, am inflamed; glow with heat, am purified by fire.

G4449 πυρράζω: I am red. I am red, fire-colored.

G4450 πυρός, ά, όν: red, fire-colored. red, fire-colored.

G4451 πύρωσις, εως, ἡ: a burning, trial, fiery test. a burning, trial, fiery test.

G4453 πωλέω: I sell. I sell, exchange, barter.

G4454 πῶλος, ου, ὁ: a colt, young ass. a colt, young ass, foal.

G4455 πώποτε: at any time, ever. at any time, ever.

G4456 πωρόω: I harden, render callous. I harden, render callous, petrify.

G4457 πώρωσις, εως, ἡ: hardness of heart. hardness of heart, obtuseness.

G4459 πῶς: how, in what manner. how, in what manner, by what means.

G4460 Ῥαάβ, ἡ: Rahab. Rahab, a Canaanitess, who rescued the Hebrew spies at Jericho.

G4461 ῥαββί: Rabbi, my master, teacher. Rabbi, my master, teacher; a title of respect often applied to Christ.

G4462 ῥαββουνί: Rabbi, my master. Rabbi, my master, teacher; a title of respect often applied to Christ.

G4463 ῥαβδίζω: I beat with rods, scourge. I beat with rods, scourge.

G4464 ῥάβδος, ου, ἡ: a rod, staff. a rod, staff, staff of authority, scepter.

G4465 ῥαβδοῦχος, ου, ὁ: a lictor, Roman officer. a holder of the rods, a lictor, Roman officer, judge.

G4466 Ῥαγαῦ, ὁ: Ragau, Reu. Ragau (or Reu), an ancestor of Jesus.

G4467 ῥᾳδιούργημα, ατος, τό: an act of villainy. a careless action, an act of villainy.

G4468 ῥᾳδιουργία, ας, ἡ: craftiness, villainy. craftiness, villainy, recklessness, wickedness.

G4469 ῥακά: empty, foolish. empty, foolish.

G4470 ῥάκος, ους, τό: a piece of cloth. a piece of cloth, a remnant torn off.

G4471 Ῥαμά, ἡ: Rama. Rama, a place in Ephraim, two hours north of Jerusalem.

G4472 ῥαντίζω: I sprinkle. I sprinkle, cleanse ceremonially by sprinkling.

G4473 ῥαντισμός, οῦ, ὁ: sprinkling, purification. sprinkling, purification.

G4474 ῥαπίζω: I slap, strike. I slap, strike, smite with the hand.

G4475 ῥάπισμα, ατος, τό: a slap. a slap, blow on the cheek with the open hand.

G4476 ῥαφίς, ίδος, ἡ: a needle. a needle.

G4477 Ῥαχάβ, ἡ: Rahab. Rahab, a Canaanitess, who rescued the Hebrew spies at Jericho.

G4478 Ῥαχήλ, ἡ: Rachel. Rachel, younger wife of the patriarch Jacob.

G4479 Ῥεβέκκα, ας, ἡ: Rebecca. Rebecca, wife of the patriarch Isaac.

G4480 ῥέδα, ης, ἡ: a chariot. a chariot.

G4481 Ῥεμφάν, ὁ: Rephan, Saturn. Rephan, the Saturn of later mythology.

G4482 ῥέω: I flow. I flow, overflow with.

G4484 Ῥήγιον, ου, τό: Rhegium. Rhegium, a city in the south-west corner of Italy opposite Sicily (modern Reggio).

G4485 ῥῆγμα, ατος, τό: a ruin. what is broken, a ruin.

G4486 ῥήγνυμι, ῥήσσω: I break, break forth. I rend, break asunder; I break forth (into speech); I throw or dash down.

G4487 ῥῆμα, ατος, τό: a thing spoken. a thing spoken, (a) a word or saying of any kind, as command, report, promise, (b) a thing, matter, business.

G4488 Ῥησά, ὁ: Rhesa. Rhesa, an ancestor of Jesus.

G4489 ῥήτωρ, ορος, ὁ: an orator. an orator, public speaker, advocate.

G4490 ῥητῶς: in so many words. expressly, explicitly, in so many words.

G4491 ῥίζα, ης, ἡ: a root, that which comes from the root. a root, shoot, source; that which comes from the root, a descendent.

G4492 ῥιζόω: I root, fix by the root. I cause to take root; met: I plant, fix firmly, establish.

G4493 ῥιπή, ῆς, ἡ: a glance, twinkle (of the eye). a glance, twinkle or flash of the eye; a rush of wind or flame; any rapid movement.

G4494 ῥιπίζω: I toss to and fro. I toss to and fro, fan, blow.

G4495 ῥιπτέω: I throw away. I throw off or away, cast, hurl.

G4496 ῥίπτω: I throw, cast, toss. I throw, cast, toss, set down; pass: I am dispersed.

G4497 Ῥοβοάμ, ὁ: Rehoboam. Rehoboam, son of Solomon, and King of Israel.

G4498 Ῥόδη, ης, ἡ: Rhoda. Rhoda, a maidservant in the house of John Mark's mother at Jerusalem.

G4499 Ῥόδος, ου, ἡ: Rhodes. Rhodes, an island in the Aegean sea, south-west of Asia Minor.

G4500 ῥοιζηδόν: with a great noise. with a great noise, with a rushing sound.

G4501 ῥομφαία, ας, ἡ: a sword, piercing grief. a sword, scimitar; fig: war, piercing grief.

G4502 Ῥουβίμ, ὁ: Reuben. Reuben, eldest son of the patriarch Jacob and founder of a tribe.

G4503 Ῥούθ, ἡ: Ruth. Ruth, wife of Boaz and mother of Obed.

G4504 Ῥοῦφος, ου, ὁ: Rufus. Rufus, a Christian man in Rome, probably to be identified with the brother of Alexander and son of Simon of Cyrene.

G4505 ῥύμη, ης, ἡ: a street, lane. a narrow street or lane in a town or city.

G4506 ῥύομαι: I rescue. I rescue, deliver (from danger or destruction).

G4507 ῥυπαρία, ας, ἡ: filth, pollution. filth, pollution, defilement.

G4508 ῥυπαρός, ά, όν: filthy, defiled. filthy, defiled, dirty.

G4509 ῥύπος, ου, ὁ: filth, dirt. filth, filthiness, dirt, squalor.

G4510 ῥυπαρεύομαι: I am filthy. I am filthy; hence (morally): I am stained with sin.

G4511 ῥύσις, εως, ἡ: a flowing, an issue. a flowing, an issue.

G4512 ῥυτίς, ίδος, ἡ: a wrinkle, spiritual defect. a wrinkle; fig: a spiritual defect, flaw.

G4513 Ῥωμαϊκός, ή, όν: Roman, Latin. Roman, Latin.

G4514 Ῥωμαῖος, α, ον: Roman, a Roman citizen. Roman; subst: a Roman citizen.

title: Dodson Greek-English Lexicon of the New Testament, G4515 to G4783
source: Jeffrey Dodson, Greek-English Lexicon of the New Testament (public domain), data prepared by Ulrik Sandborg-Petersen. Each entry: Strong number, Greek word, short meaning, fuller meaning.
body:
G4515 Ῥωμαϊστί: in the Latin language. in the Latin language.

G4516 Ῥώμη, ης, ἡ: Rome. Rome, the famous city on the Tiber, the capital of the Roman Empire.

G4517 ῥώννυμι: I strengthen, farewell. I strengthen, render firm; imperative at the end of letters: farewell.

G4518 σαβαχθανί: thou hast forsaken me. thou hast forsaken me.

G4519 σαβαώθ: hosts, armies. hosts, armies.

G4520 σαββατισμός, οῦ, ὁ: a Sabbath rest. a keeping of the Sabbath, a Sabbath rest.

G4521 σάββατον, ου, τό: the Sabbath, a week. the Sabbath, a week.

G4522 σαγήνη, ης, ἡ: a fishing-net. a fishing-net.

G4523 Σαδδουκαῖος, ου, ὁ: a Sadducee. a Sadducee, a member of the aristocratic party among the Jews, from whom the high-priests were almost invariably chosen.

G4524 Σαδώκ, ὁ: Zadok. Zadok, an ancestor of Jesus.

G4525 σαίνω: I move, disturb. I fawn upon, flatter, beguile; pass: I am perturbed.

G4526 σάκκος, ου, ὁ: sack-cloth. sack-cloth, a sign of mourning.

G4527 Σαλά, ὁ: Sala. Sala, the name of two of the ancestors of Jesus.

G4528 Σαλαθιήλ, ὁ: Salathiel. Salathiel, son of Jechoniah.

G4529 Σαλαμίς, ῖνος, ἡ: Salamis. Salamis, a city at the eastern end of Cyprus.

G4531 σαλεύω: I shake, excite. I shake, excite, disturb in mind, stir up, drive away.

G4532 Σαλήμ, ἡ: Salem. Salem, doubtless identical with Jerusalem.

G4533 Σαλμών, ὁ: Salmon. Salmon, son of Nahshon and father of Boaz.

G4534 Σαλμώνη, ης, ἡ: Salmone. Salmone, a promontory on the east of Crete.

G4535 σάλος, ου, ὁ: the tossing of the sea in a tempest. the tossing of the sea in a tempest; agitation, rolling.

G4536 σάλπιγξ, ιγγος, ἡ: a trumpet. a trumpet, the sound of a trumpet.

G4537 σαλπίζω: I sound a trumpet. I sound a trumpet.

G4538 σαλπιστής, οῦ, ὁ: a trumpeter. a trumpeter.

G4539 Σαλώμη, ης, ἡ: Salome. Salome, wife of Zebedee and mother of James and John, the apostles.

G4540 Σαμάρεια, ας, ἡ: Samaria. Samaria, a small district of Palestine, bounded by Galilee on the north, and by Judaea on the south, and taking its name from the city of Samaria, the ancient capital of the kingdom of (northern) Israel.

G4541 Σαμαρείτης, ου, ὁ: a Samaritan. a Samaritan.

G4542 Σαμαρεῖτις, ιδος, ἡ: a Samaritan woman. a Samaritan woman.

G4543 Σαμοθρᾴκη, ης, ἡ: Samothrace. Samothrace, an island south of the province of Thrace.

G4544 Σάμος, ου, ἡ: Samos. Samos, an island in the Aegean sea off the coast of Asia Minor, near Ephesus and Miletus.

G4545 Σαμουήλ, ὁ: Samuel. Samuel, a Hebrew prophet.

G4546 Σαμψών, ὁ: Samson. Samson, one of the Judges of Israel.

G4547 σανδάλιον, ου, τό: a sandal. a sandal.

G4548 σανίς, ίδος, ἡ: a plank, board. a plank, board.

G4549 Σαούλ, ὁ: Saul. Saul, (a) the first king of Israel, (b) the Hebrew name of the Apostle to the Gentiles.

G4550 σαπρός, ά, όν: rotten, useless, corrupt. rotten, useless, corrupt, depraved.

G4551 Σαπφείρη, ης, ἡ: Sapphira. Sapphira, wife of Ananias, an early Christian.

G4552 σάπφειρος, ου, ἡ: a sapphire. a sapphire.

G4553 σαργάνη, ης, ἡ: a basket. a basket, generally of twisted cords.

G4554 Σάρδεις, εων, αἱ: Sardis. Sardis, an ancient city of Lydia in the province of Asia.

G4556 σάρδιον, ου, τό: carnelian. carnelian, a precious stone.

G4557 σαρδόνυξ, υχος, ὁ: sardonyx. sardonyx, a precious stone, white streaked with red.

G4558 Σάρεπτα, ων, τά: Zarephath. Zarephath, a town in the district of Sidon in Phoenicia.

G4559 σαρκικός, ή, όν: fleshly, carnal. fleshly, carnal, earthly.

G4560 σάρκινος, η, ον: consisting of flesh. fleshly, consisting of flesh, carnal.

G4561 σάρξ, σαρκός, ἡ: flesh, body. flesh, body, human nature, materiality; kindred.

G4562 Σερούχ, ὁ: Serug. Serug, an ancestor of Jesus.

G4563 σαρόω: I sweep. I sweep, cleanse by sweeping.

G4564 Σάρρα, ας, ἡ: Sarah. Sarah, wife of Abraham.

G4565 Ασσαρών, ῶνος, ὁ: Sharon. Sharon, the maritime plain between Carmel and Joppa.

G4566 Σατᾶν, ὁ: Satan. Satan.

G4567 Σατανᾶς, ᾶ, ὁ: an adversary, Satan. an adversary, Satan.

G4568 σάτον, ου, τό: nearly three English gallons. a large measure equal to nearly three English gallons.

G4569 Σαῦλος, ου, ὁ: Saul, the apostle. Saul, the apostle.

G4570 σβέννυμι: I extinguish, suppress. (a) I extinguish, quench, (b) I suppress, thwart.

G4572 σεαυτοῦ, ῆς, οῦ: of yourself. of yourself.

G4573 σεβάζομαι: I worship. I worship, stand in awe of.

G4574 σέβασμα, ατος, τό: an object of worship. an object of worship or veneration.

G4575 Σεβαστός, ή, όν: august, venerated. (official Greek equivalent of Augustus), venerated, august, a title of the Roman emperors; hence secondarily: Augustan, imperial.

G4576 σέβομαι: I reverence, worship. I reverence, worship, adore.

G4577 σειρά, ᾶς, ἡ: a chain. a chain.

G4578 σεισμός, οῦ, ὁ: an earthquake, storm. a shaking (as an earthquake); a storm.

G4579 σείω: I shake. I shake; fig: I agitate, stir up.

G4580 Σεκοῦνδος, ου, ὁ: Secundus. Secundus, a Christian of Thessalonica.

G4581 Σελεύκεια, ας, ἡ: Seleucia. Seleucia, on the Syrian coast, the harbor of Syrian Antioch.

G4582 σελήνη, ης, ἡ: the moon. the moon.

G4583 σεληνιάζομαι: I am a lunatic. I am a lunatic, am moonstruck, epileptic.

G4584 Σεμεΐ, ὁ: Semein. Semein, an ancestor of Jesus.

G4585 σεμίδαλις, εως, ἡ: the finest wheaten flour. the finest wheaten flour.

G4586 σεμνός, ή, όν: honorable. venerable, honorable, grave, serious, dignified.

G4587 σεμνότης, τητος, ἡ: dignity, honor. dignity, honor, gravity, seriousness.

G4588 Σέργιος, ου, ὁ: Sergius. Sergius, the middle (gentile) name of the proconsul of Cyprus.

G4589 Σήθ, ὁ: Seth. Seth, third son of Adam.

G4590 Σήμ, ὁ: Shem. Shem, a son of Noah.

G4591 σημαίνω: I signify, indicate. I signify, indicate, give a sign, make known.

G4592 σημεῖον, ου, τό: a sign, miracle, indication. a sign, miracle, indication, mark, token.

G4593 σημειόομαι: I note. I note, mark for myself.

G4594 σήμερον: today, now. today, now.

G4595 σήπω: I cause to rot. I cause to rot, make corrupt.

G4596 σηρικός, ή, όν: silken. silken, silk.

G4597 σής, σητός, ὁ: a moth. a moth.

G4598 σητόβρωτος, ον: moth-eaten. moth-eaten.

G4599 σθενόω: I strengthen. I strengthen.

G4600 σιαγών, όνος, ἡ: the jawbone, cheek. the jawbone, cheek, jaw.

G4601 σιγάω: I keep silent. intrans: I am silent, keep silence; trans: I keep secret; pass: I am kept secret.

G4602 σιγή, ῆς, ἡ: silence. silence.

G4603 σιδήρεος, έα, εον: made of iron. made of iron.

G4604 σίδηρος, ου, ὁ: iron. iron.

G4605 Σιδών, ῶνος, ἡ: Sidon. Sidon, a great coast city of Phoenicia.

G4606 Σιδώνιος, ία, ιον: Sidonian. Sidonian, inhabitant of Sidon.

G4607 σικάριος, ου, ὁ: an assassin, murderer. an assassin, murderer, bandit; one of the Sicarii.

G4608 σίκερα, τό: intoxicating drink. intoxicating drink.

G4609 Σίλας, ᾶ, ὁ: Silas. Silas, a pet-form of the name "Silvanus"; a Roman citizen and a helper of Paul.

G4610 Σιλουανός, οῦ, ὁ: Silvanus. Silvanus, a Roman citizen and a helper of Paul.

G4611 Σιλωάμ, ὁ: Siloam. Siloam, a spring within the walls, in the south-east corner of Jerusalem.

G4612 σιμικίνθιον, ου, τό: an apron. an apron worn by artisans.

G4613 Σίμων, ωνος, ὁ: Simon. Simon.

G4614 Σινᾶ, τό: Sinai. Sinai, a mountain in Arabia.

G4615 σίναπι, εως, ἡ: mustard. mustard (probably the shrub, not the herb).

G4616 σινδών, όνος, ἡ: a linen cloth. fine linen, a linen cloth.

G4617 σινιάζω: I sift, prove by trials. I sift, prove by trials, winnow.

G4618 σιτευτός, ή, όν: fattened. fattened, fatted.

G4619 σιτιστός, ή, όν: fattened. fattened; subst: a fatling, cattle.

G4620 σιτομέτριον, ου, τό: a measured portion of grain or food. a measured portion of grain or food.

G4621 σῖτος, ου, ὁ: wheat, grain. wheat, grain.

G4622 Σιών, ἡ: Zion. Zion, the hill; used for Jerusalem or heaven.

G4623 σιωπάω: I keep silence. I keep silence, am silent, either voluntarily or involuntarily.

G4624 σκανδαλίζω: I cause to stumble. I cause to stumble, cause to sin, cause to become indignant, shock, offend.

G4625 σκάνδαλον, ου, τό: a snare, stumbling-block. a snare, stumbling-block, cause for error.

G4626 σκάπτω: I dig. I dig, excavate.

G4627 σκάφη, ης, ἡ: a boat. a boat; any hollow vessel.

G4628 σκέλος, ους, τό: the leg. the leg (from the hip downwards).

G4629 σκέπασμα, ατος, τό: clothing. clothing, a covering, raiment.

G4630 Σκευᾶς, ᾶ, ὁ: Sceva. Sceva, an inhabitant of Ephesus.

G4631 σκευή, ῆς, ἡ: tackle, fittings. tackle, fittings, equipment.

G4632 σκεῦος, ους, τό: a vessel to contain liquid, utensil, tackle. a vessel to contain liquid; a vessel of mercy or wrath; any instrument by which anything is done; a household utensil; of ships: tackle.

G4633 σκηνή, ῆς, ἡ: a tent, tabernacle. a tent, booth, tabernacle, abode, dwelling, mansion, habitation.

G4634 σκηνοπηγία, ας, ἡ: the feast of tabernacles. the feast of tabernacles, the great festival of the Jews, held in October.

G4635 σκηνοποιός, οῦ, ὁ: a tent-maker. a tent-maker.

G4636 σκῆνος, ους, τό: a tent. a tent, tabernacle; fig: of the human body.

G4637 σκηνόω: I dwell as in a tent, encamp. I dwell as in a tent, encamp, have my tabernacle.

G4638 σκήνωμα, ατος, τό: a dwelling. a tent pitched, a dwelling, tabernacle.

G4639 σκιά, ᾶς, ἡ: a shadow, thick darkness, an outline. a shadow, shade, thick darkness, an outline.

G4640 σκιρτάω: I leap for joy. I leap (for joy), skip, bound.

G4641 σκληροκαρδία, ας, ἡ: hardness of heart. hardness of heart, perverseness, obstinacy.

G4642 σκληρός, ά, όν: hard, violent, harsh, stern. hard, violent, harsh, stern.

G4643 σκληρότης, τητος, ἡ: hardness of heart. hardness, hardness of heart, obstinacy, perverseness.

G4644 σκληροτράχηλος, ον: stubborn. stiff-necked, stubborn, obstinate.

G4645 σκληρύνω: I harden. I harden, make hard, make stubborn.

G4646 σκολιός, ά, όν: crooked, perverse, unfair. crooked, perverse, unfair, curved, tortuous.

G4647 σκόλοψ, οπος, ὁ: a stake or thorn. a stake or thorn; fig: a sharp affliction.

G4648 σκοπέω: regard attentively, take heed. I look at, regard attentively, take heed, beware, consider.

G4649 σκοπός, οῦ, ὁ: a goal. a watcher; a goal, a mark aimed at.

G4650 σκορπίζω: I disperse. I disperse, scatter abroad (as of sheep); I dissipate, waste; I distribute alms.

G4651 σκορπίος, ου, ὁ: a scorpion. a scorpion.

G4652 σκοτεινός, ή, όν: full of darkness, dark. full of darkness, dark.

G4653 σκοτία, ας, ἡ: darkness. darkness; fig: spiritual darkness.

G4654 σκοτίζω: I darken. I darken.

G4655 σκότος, ους, τό: darkness. darkness, either physical or moral.

G4656 σκοτόω: I darken. (lit. or met.) I darken.

G4657 σκύβαλον, ου, τό: refuse, dregs. refuse, dregs, dung.

G4658 Σκύθης, ου, ὁ: a Scythian. a Scythian, as typical of the uncivilized.

G4659 σκυθρωπός, ή, όν: gloomy, sad-countenanced. gloomy, sad-countenanced.

G4660 σκύλλω: I flay, trouble, annoy. I flay, trouble, annoy, vex.

G4661 σκῦλον, ου, τό: spoil taken from a foe. spoil taken from a foe.

G4662 σκωληκόβρωτος, ον: eaten by worms. eaten by worms.

G4663 σκώληξ, ηκος, ὁ: a gnawing worm. a gnawing worm; gnawing anguish.

G4664 σμαράγδινος, η, ον: made of emerald. made of emerald, emerald-green.

G4665 σμάραγδος, ου, ὁ: an emerald. an emerald.

G4666 σμύρνα, ης, ἡ: myrrh. myrrh.

G4667 Σμύρνα, ης, ἡ: Smyrna. Smyrna, a great port of the Roman province Asia.

G4669 σμυρνίζω: I mingle with myrrh. I mingle with myrrh.

G4670 Σόδομα, ων, τά: Sodom. Sodom.

G4672 Σολομών, ῶνος, ὁ: Solomon. Solomon, son of David King of Israel, and Bathsheba.

G4673 σορός, οῦ, ἡ: a bier, an open coffin. a bier, an open coffin.

G4674 σός, σή, σόν: yours, thy, thine. yours, thy, thine.

G4676 σουδάριον, ου, τό: a handkerchief. a handkerchief, napkin.

G4677 Σουσάννα, ης, ἡ: Susannah. Susannah, a woman of the retinue of Jesus.

G4678 σοφία, ας, ἡ: wisdom. wisdom, insight, skill (human or divine), intelligence.

G4679 σοφίζω: I make wise. I make wise, instruct; pass: I am skillfully devised.

G4680 σοφός, ή, όν: wise. wise, learned, cultivated, skilled, clever.

G4681 Σπανία, ας, ἡ: Spain. Spain, roughly co-extensive with the modern country of the name.

G4682 σπαράσσω: I convulse. I convulse, throw into spasms.

G4683 σπαργανόω: I wrap in swaddling clothes. I swathe, wrap in swaddling clothes.

G4684 σπαταλάω: I live extravagantly. I live extravagantly, luxuriously; I am wanton.

G4685 σπάω: I draw (as a sword). I draw (as a sword), pull.

G4686 σπεῖρα, ης, ἡ: a cohort. a cohort, the tenth part of a legion; a military guard.

G4687 σπείρω: I sow, spread, scatter. I sow, spread, scatter.

G4688 σπεκουλάτωρ, ορος, ὁ: a body-guardsman, an executioner. a body-guardsman; an executioner.

G4689 σπένδω: I pour out as a libation. I pour out as a libation.

G4690 σπέρμα, ατος, τό: seed, offspring. (a) seed, commonly of cereals, (b) offspring, descendents.

G4691 σπερμολόγος, ου, ὁ: a babbler. a babbler, gossiper, one who picks up seeds and trifles as does a bird.

G4692 σπεύδω: I hasten, desire earnestly. I hasten, urge on, desire earnestly.

G4693 σπήλαιον, ου, τό: a cave, den. a cave, den, hideout.

G4694 σπιλάς, άδος, ἡ: a hidden rock, false teacher. a hidden rock; fig: a flaw, stigma.

G4695 σπιλόω: I defile, spot. I defile, spot, stain, soil.

G4696 σπῖλος, ου, ὁ: a spot, fault. a spot, fault, stain, blemish.

G4697 σπλαγχνίζομαι: I have pity on. I feel compassion, have pity on, am moved.

G4698 σπλάγχνα, ων, τά: bowels, compassion, pity. the inward parts; the heart, affections, seat of the feelings.

G4699 σπόγγος, ου, ὁ: a sponge. a sponge.

G4700 σποδός, οῦ, ἡ: ashes. ashes.

G4701 σπορά, ᾶς, ἡ: seed. seed sown, a sowing.

G4702 σπόριμος, ον: sown, sown fields. sown; neut. plur: sown fields.

G4703 σπόρος, ου, ὁ: seed for sowing. seed for sowing.

G4704 σπουδάζω: I hasten. I hasten, am eager, am zealous.

G4705 σπουδαῖος, α, ον: diligent, earnest. diligent, earnest, zealous, eager.

G4706 σπουδαιότερον: more diligently. more diligently, earnestly, eagerly, zealously.

G4708 σπουδαιοτέρως: more earnestly, more carefully. more earnestly, diligently, zealously.

G4709 σπουδαίως: diligently, earnestly. diligently, earnestly, zealously.

G4710 σπουδή, ῆς, ἡ: haste, diligence. (a) speed, haste, (b) diligence, earnestness, enthusiasm.

G4711 σπυρίς, ίδος, ἡ: a plaited basket. a plaited basket.

G4712 στάδιον, ου, τό: one eighth of a Roman mile. (a) a stadium, one eighth of a Roman mile, (b) a race-course for public games.

G4713 στάμνος, ου, ὁ, ἡ: a jar or vase. a jar or vase.

G4714 στάσις, εως, ἡ: standing, place, dissension. an insurrection, dissension; originally: standing, position, place.

G4715 στατήρ, ῆρος, ὁ: a Jewish shekel. an Attic silver coin equal in value to the Jewish shekel.

G4716 σταυρός, οῦ, ὁ: a cross. a cross.

G4717 σταυρόω: I crucify. I fix to the cross, crucify; fig: I destroy, mortify.

G4718 σταφυλή, ῆς, ἡ: a grape, cluster of grapes. a grape, cluster of grapes.

G4719 στάχυς, υος, ὁ: a head of grain. a head of grain.

G4720 Στάχυς, υος, ὁ: Stachys. Stachys, a Christian man at Rome.

G4721 στέγη, ης, ἡ: a flat roof of a house. a flat roof of a house.

G4722 στέγω: I cover, conceal, bear with. I cover, conceal, ward off, bear with, endure patiently.

G4723 στεῖρος, α, ον: barren. barren.

G4724 στέλλω: I arrange, take care, withdraw from. I set, arrange; mid: I provide for, take care, withdraw from, hold aloof, avoid.

G4725 στέμμα, ατος, τό: a garland. a garland, wreath, crown.

G4726 στεναγμός, οῦ, ὁ: a groaning. a groaning, sighing.

G4727 στενάζω: I groan. I groan, expressing grief, anger, or desire.

G4728 στενός, ή, όν: narrow. narrow, strait.

G4729 στενοχωρέω: I press upon, cramp, restrain. (I keep some one in a tight place), I press upon, cramp, restrain.

G4730 στενοχωρία, ας, ἡ: a narrow space, great distress. a narrow space, great distress, anguish.

G4731 στερεός, ά, όν: solid, firm, steadfast. solid, firm, steadfast.

G4732 στερεόω: I strengthen, confirm, establish. I strengthen, confirm, establish, settle.

G4733 στερέωμα, ατος, τό: firmness, steadfastness. firmness, steadfastness, constancy.

G4734 Στεφανᾶς, ᾶ, ὁ: Stephanas. Stephanas, a Corinthian Christian.

G4735 στέφανος, ου, ὁ: a crown, garland. a crown, garland, honor, glory.

G4736 Στέφανος, ου, ὁ: Stephen. Stephen, one of the seven original deacons at Jerusalem, and the first martyr.

G4737 στεφανόω: I crown, adorn. I crown, adorn, decorate.

G4738 στῆθος, ους, τό: the breast. the breast, chest.

G4739 στήκω: I stand fast, persevere. I stand fast, stand firm, persevere.

title: Dodson Greek-English Lexicon of the New Testament, G4784 to G5030
source: Jeffrey Dodson, Greek-English Lexicon of the New Testament (public domain), data prepared by Ulrik Sandborg-Petersen. Each entry: Strong number, Greek word, short meaning, fuller meaning.
