G5001 τάγμα, ατος, τό: rank, division. rank, division, an ordered series.

G5002 τακτός, ή, όν: appointed, arranged, fixed. appointed, arranged, fixed.

G5003 ταλαιπωρέω: I am miserable, distressed. I endure severe hardship, am harassed, complain.

G5004 ταλαιπωρία, ας, ἡ: hardship, misery. hardship, misery, distress, toil.

G5005 ταλαίπωρος, ον: wretched, afflicted, miserable. wretched, afflicted, miserable.

G5006 ταλαντιαῖος, αία, αῖον: a talent in weight. a talent in weight.

G5007 τάλαντον, ου, τό: a talent of silver or gold. a talent of silver or gold.

G5008 ταλιθά: little girl. (Aramaic), girl, little girl.

G5009 ταμεῖον, ου, τό: a secret chamber. a store-chamber, secret chamber, closet; a granary, barn.

G5010 τάξις, εως, ἡ: order, position, rank. order, (a) regular arrangement, (b) appointed succession, (c) position, rank.

G5011 ταπεινός, ή, όν: humble, lowly. humble, lowly, in position or spirit (in a good sense).

G5012 ταπεινοφροσύνη, ης, ἡ: humility. humility, lowliness of mind, modesty.

G5013 ταπεινόω: I humble, humiliate. I make or bring low, humble, humiliate; pass: I am humbled.

G5014 ταπείνωσις, εως, ἡ: abasement, low condition. abasement (in spirit), low condition (in circumstances).

G5015 ταράσσω: I agitate, stir up, trouble. I disturb, agitate, stir up, trouble.

G5016 ταραχή, ῆς, ἡ: a disturbance, tumult, sedition. a disturbance, tumult, sedition, trouble.

G5017 τάραχος, ου, ὁ: a disturbance, commotion. a disturbance, commotion, trouble.

G5018 Ταρσεύς, έως, ὁ: belonging to Tarsus. belonging to Tarsus, a Tarsian.

G5019 Ταρσός, οῦ, ἡ: Tarsus. Tarsus, the capital of the Roman province Cilicia.

G5020 ταρταρόω: I thrust down to Tartarus. I thrust down to Tartarus or Gehenna.

G5021 τάσσω: I assign, arrange. (a) I assign, arrange, (b) I determine; mid: I appoint.

G5022 ταῦρος, ου, ὁ: a bull, an ox. a bull, an ox.

G5027 ταφή, ῆς, ἡ: a burial. a burial, burial place.

G5028 τάφος, ου, ὁ: a tomb, burial-place. a burial-place, sepulcher, tomb, grave.

G5029 τάχα: quickly, perhaps. quickly, presently, perhaps.

G5030 ταχέως: soon, quickly, hastily. soon, quickly, hastily.

title: Dodson Greek-English Lexicon of the New Testament, G5031 to G5304
source: Jeffrey Dodson, Greek-English Lexicon of the New Testament (public domain), data prepared by Ulrik Sandborg-Petersen. Each entry: Strong number, Greek word, short meaning, fuller meaning.
body:
G5031 ταχινός, ή, όν: swift, quick. swift, quick, impending.

G5032 τάχιον: more swiftly. more swiftly, more quickly.

G5033 τάχιστα: most swiftly. most swiftly, most quickly, as quickly as possible.

G5034 τάχος, ους, τό: quickness, speed. quickness, speed; hastily, immediately.

G5035 ταχύ: quickly, speedily. quickly, speedily.

G5036 ταχύς, εῖα, ύ: quick, swift. quick, swift, speedy, ready, prompt.

G5037 τέ: and, both. and, both.

G5038 τεῖχος, ους, τό: a wall. a wall, especially of a city.

G5039 τεκμήριον, ου, τό: a sign, certain proof. a sign, certain proof.

G5040 τεκνίον, ου, τό: a little child. a little child.

G5041 τεκνογονέω: I bear children. I bear children, beget, rear a family.

G5042 τεκνογονία, ας, ἡ: child bearing. child bearing, the rearing of a family.

G5043 τέκνον, ου, τό: a child, descendent, inhabitant. a child, descendent, inhabitant.

G5044 τεκνοτροφέω: I bring up children. I bring up children, rear young.

G5045 τέκτων, ονος, ὁ: a carpenter. a carpenter, an artisan.

G5046 τέλειος, α, ον: perfect, full-grown. perfect, (a) complete in all its parts, (b) full grown, of full age, (c) specially of the completeness of Christian character.

G5047 τελειότης, τητος, ἡ: perfectness, perfection. perfectness, perfection, maturity.

G5048 τελειόω: I complete, accomplish, make perfect. (a) as a course, a race, or the like: I complete, finish (b) as of time or prediction: I accomplish, (c) I make perfect; pass: I am perfected.

G5049 τελείως: perfectly. perfectly, completely, without wavering.

G5050 τελείωσις, εως, ἡ: completion, fulfillment, perfection. completion, fulfillment, perfection.

G5051 τελειωτής, οῦ, ὁ: a perfecter, completer. a perfecter, completer, finisher.

G5052 τελεσφορέω: I bring to maturity. I bring to maturity.

G5053 τελευτάω: I end, finish, die. I end, finish, die, complete.

G5054 τελευτή, ῆς, ἡ: end of life, death. end of life, death.

G5055 τελέω: I end, accomplish, pay. (a) I end, finish, (b) I fulfill, accomplish, (c) I pay.

G5056 τέλος, ους, τό: an end, purpose, tax. (a) an end, (b) event or issue, (c) the principal end, aim, purpose, (d) a tax.

G5057 τελώνης, ου, ὁ: a collector of taxes. a publican, collector of taxes.

G5058 τελώνιον, ου, τό: a tax-collector's office. a tax-collector's office, toll-house.

G5059 τέρας, ατος, τό: a wonder, portent. a wonder, portent, marvel.

G5060 Τέρτιος, ου, ὁ: Tertius. Tertius, who wrote the Epistle to the Romans at Paul's dictation.

G5061 Τέρτυλλος, ου, ὁ: Tertullus. Tertullus, a barrister acting as professional prosecutor of Paul at Caesarea.

G5062 τεσσαράκοντα: forty. forty.

G5063 τεσσαρακονταετής, ές: forty years of age. forty years of age.

G5064 τέσσαρες, τέσσαρα: four. four.

G5065 τεσσαρεσκαιδέκατος, η, ον: fourteenth. fourteenth.

G5066 τεταρταῖος, αία, αῖον: four days since. of the fourth day, four days since.

G5067 τέταρτος, η, ον: fourth. fourth.

G5068 τετράγωνος, ον: square. square, four-cornered.

G5069 τετράδιον, ου, τό: a group of four soldiers. a quaternion, a group of four soldiers.

G5070 τετρακισχίλιοι, αι, α: four thousand. four thousand.

G5071 τετρακόσιοι, αι, α: four hundred. four hundred.

G5072 τετράμηνος, ον: of four months. of four months, a period of four months.

G5073 τετραπλοῦς, ῆ, οῦν: four-fold. four-fold, four times as much.

G5074 τετράπους, ουν: four-footed. four-footed.

G5075 τετραρχέω: I rule over as a tetrarch. I rule over as a tetrarch.

G5076 τετράρχης, ου, ὁ: a tetrarch. a tetrarch, ruler over a fourth part of a region.

G5077 τεφρόω: I reduce to ashes. I reduce to ashes, consume, destroy.

G5078 τέχνη, ης, ἡ: art, skill, trade. art, skill, trade, craft.

G5079 τεχνίτης, ου, ὁ: a craftsman, artisan. a craftsman, artisan, architect, builder.

G5080 τήκω: I make liquid, melt. I make liquid; pass: I melt (away).

G5081 τηλαυγῶς: clearly, distinctly. clearly, distinctly, plainly.

G5082 τηλικοῦτος, αύτη, οῦτο: so great. so great, so large, important.

G5083 τηρέω: I keep, guard, observe. I keep, guard, observe, watch over.

G5084 τήρησις, εως, ἡ: a prison, observance. a prison; observance (as of precepts).

G5085 Τιβεριάς, άδος, ἡ: Tiberias. Tiberias, a town in Galilee on the western border of the sea called after it.

G5086 Τιβέριος, ου, ὁ: Tiberius. Tiberius, the second Roman emperor (died A.D. 37).

G5087 τίθημι: I put, place. I put, place, lay, set, fix, establish.

G5088 τίκτω: I bear, bring forth, produce. I bear, bring forth, produce, beget, yield.

G5089 τίλλω: I pluck, pluck off. I pluck, pluck off.

G5090 Τιμαῖος, ου, ὁ: Timaeus. Timaeus, father of the blind beggar Bartimaeus.

G5091 τιμάω: I value at a price, honor. (a) I value at a price, estimate, (b) I honor, reverence.

G5092 τιμή, ῆς, ἡ: a price, honor. a price, honor.

G5093 τίμιος, α, ον: of great price, precious, honored. of great price, precious, honored.

G5094 τιμιότης, τητος, ἡ: preciousness, costliness. preciousness, costliness, worth.

G5095 Τιμόθεος, ου, ὁ: Timothy. Timothy, a Christian of Lystra, helper of Paul.

G5096 Τίμων, ωνος, ὁ: Timon. Timon, one of the seven original deacons at Jerusalem.

G5097 τιμωρέω: I punish. I punish, avenge myself on.

G5098 τιμωρία, ας, ἡ: punishment, penalty. punishment, penalty.

G5099 τίνω: I pay. I pay (penalty).

G5100 τις, τι: any one, some one. any one, some one, a certain one or thing.

G5101 τίς, τί: who, which, what. who, which, what, why.

G5102 τίτλος, ου, ὁ: a title, inscription. a title, inscription.

G5103 Τίτος, ου, ὁ: Titus. Titus, a Greek Christian, helper of Paul, perhaps also brother of Luke.

G5105 τοιγαροῦν: consequently, therefore. consequently, therefore, well then, so then.

G5106 τοίνυν: indeed now, therefore. indeed now, therefore, accordingly, well then.

G5107 τοιόσδε, τοιάδε, τοιόνδε: of this kind, such. of this kind, such, such as follows.

G5108 τοιοῦτος, τοιαύτη, τοιοῦτο: of such a kind, such. of such a kind, such.

G5109 τοῖχος, ου, ὁ: a wall. a wall.

G5110 τόκος, ου, ὁ: interest, usury. interest, usury.

G5111 τολμάω: I dare, endure, am bold. I dare, endure, am bold, have courage, make up the mind.

G5112 τολμηρότερον: more boldly. more boldly, more freely, with more confidence.

G5113 τολμητής, οῦ, ὁ: a daring, presumptuous man. a daring, bold man.

G5114 τομώτερος: sharper, keener. sharper, keener.

G5115 τόξον, ου, τό: a bow. a bow.

G5116 τοπάζιον, ου, τό: topaz. topaz.

G5117 τόπος, ου, ὁ: a place. a place, region, seat; an opportunity.

G5118 τοσοῦτος, τοσαύτη, τοσοῦτο: so great. so great, so large, so long, so many.

G5119 τότε: then. then, at that time.

G5121 τοὐναντίον: on the contrary. on the contrary, on the other hand.

G5122 τοὔνομα: by name. by name.

G5131 τράγος, ου, ὁ: a he-goat. a he-goat.

G5132 τράπεζα, ης, ἡ: a table for food or business. a table, (a) for food or banqueting, (b) for money-changing or business.

G5133 τραπεζίτης, ου, ὁ: a money-changer, banker. a money-changer, banker.

G5134 τραῦμα, ατος, τό: a wound. a wound.

G5135 τραυματίζω: I wound. I wound.

G5136 τραχηλίζω: I am laid bare, laid open. I am laid bare, laid open.

G5137 τράχηλος, ου, ὁ: the neck. the neck.

G5138 τραχύς, εῖα, ύ: rough. rough, rugged, uneven.

G5139 Τραχωνῖτις, ιδος, ἡ: Trachonitis. Trachonitis, the north-east of the territory beyond Jordan.

G5140 τρεῖς, τρία: three. three.

G5141 τρέμω: I tremble, am afraid. I tremble, am afraid.

G5142 τρέφω: I feed, rear. I feed, nourish; I bring up, rear, provide for.

G5143 τρέχω: I run, exercise myself. I run, exercise myself, make progress.

G5144 τριάκοντα, οἱ, αἱ, τά: thirty. thirty.

G5145 τριακόσιοι, αι, α: three hundred. three hundred.

G5146 τρίβολος, ου, ὁ: a thistle. a thistle.

G5147 τρίβος, ου, ἡ: a worn path, beaten way. a worn path, beaten way, road, highway.

G5148 τριετία, ας, ἡ: a space of three years. a space of three years.

G5149 τρίζω: I grate, gnash. I grate, gnash (as the teeth).

G5150 τρίμηνος, ον: lasting three months. lasting three months.

G5151 τρίς: three times. three times.

G5152 τρίστεγος, ον: having three stories, the third story. having three stories; subst: the third story.

G5153 τρισχίλιοι, αι, α: three thousand. three thousand.

G5154 τρίτος, η, ον: third. third.

G5155 τρίχινος, η, ον: made of hair. made of hair.

G5156 τρόμος, ου, ὁ: a trembling. a trembling, quaking, fear.

G5157 τροπή, ῆς, ἡ: a turning. a turning, change, mutation.

G5158 τρόπος, ου, ὁ: way, manner, character. (a) way, manner, (b) manner of life, character.

G5159 τροποφορέω: I endure the ways of. I endure the ways of, put up with.

G5160 τροφή, ῆς, ἡ: food, nourishment. food, nourishment, maintenance.

G5161 Τρόφιμος, ου, ὁ: Trophimus. Trophimus, a Christian of Ephesus in Asia.

G5162 τροφός, οῦ, ἡ: a nurse. a nurse.

G5163 τροχιά, ᾶς, ἡ: the track of a wheel, a path. the track of a wheel, a path.

G5164 τροχός, οῦ, ὁ: a wheel, course. a wheel, course.

G5165 τρύβλιον, ου, τό: a platter. a deep dish, platter, bowl.

G5166 τρυγάω: I gather. I gather (as of grapes), harvest.

G5167 τρυγών, όνος, ἡ: a turtle-dove. a turtle-dove.

G5168 τρυμαλιά, ᾶς, ἡ: the eye of a needle. the eye of a needle.

G5169 τρύπημα, ατος, τό: a hole, the eye of a needle. a hole; the eye of a needle.

G5170 Τρύφαινα, ης, ἡ: Tryphaena. Tryphaena, a Christian woman in Rome.

G5171 τρυφάω: I live a luxurious life. I live a luxurious life, live self-indulgently.

G5172 τρυφή, ῆς, ἡ: effeminate luxury. effeminate luxury, softness, indulgent living.

G5173 Τρυφῶσα, ης, ἡ: Tryphosa. Tryphosa, a Christian woman in Rome, perhaps a sister of Tryphaena.

G5174 Τρῳάς, άδος, ἡ: Troas. Troas, a harbor city of Mysia.

G5175 Τρωγύλλιον, ου, τό: Trogyllium. Trogyllium, a promontory somewhat to the south of Ephesus.

G5176 τρώγω: I eat. I eat, partake of a meal.

G5177 τυγχάνω: I obtain, I happen, perhaps. (a) gen: I obtain, (b) absol: I chance, happen; ordinary, everyday, it may chance, perhaps.

G5178 τυμπανίζω: I torture, break on the wheel. I torture, break on the wheel, beat to death.

G5179 τύπος, ου, ὁ: a figure, model, type. (originally: the mark of a blow, then a stamp struck by a die), (a) a figure; a copy, image, (b) a pattern, model, (c) a type, prefiguring something or somebody.

G5180 τύπτω: I beat, strike, wound, inflict punishment. I beat, strike, wound, inflict punishment.

G5181 Τύραννος, ου, ὁ: Tyrannus. Tyrannus, an inhabitant of Ephesus, probably a rhetorician.

G5182 τυρβάζω: I agitate or disturb in mind. I agitate or disturb in mind, trouble.

G5183 Τύριος, ου, ὁ, ἡ: an inhabitant of Tyre. a Tyrian, an inhabitant of Tyre.

G5184 Τύρος, ου, ἡ: Tyre. Tyre, an ancient city, the capital of Phoenicia.

G5185 τυφλός, ή, όν: blind. blind, physically or mentally.

G5186 τυφλόω: I make blind. I make blind, physically or mentally.

G5187 τυφόω: I puff up, make haughty. I puff up, make haughty; pass: I am puffed up, am haughty.

G5188 τύφω: I raise smoke. I raise smoke, smolder.

G5189 τυφωνικός, ή, όν: violent, tempestuous. violent, tempestuous, stormy.

G5190 Τυχικός, ου, ὁ: Tychicus. Tychicus, a Christian of the Roman province Asia.

G5191 ὑακίνθινος, ίνη, ινον: dark purple. dark purple or blue, of the color of hyacinth.

G5192 ὑάκινθος, ου, ὁ: jacinth. jacinth, a precious stone of the color of hyacinth.

G5193 ὑάλινος, η, ον: glassy, transparent. glassy, made of glass, transparent.

G5194 ὕαλος, ου, ἡ: glass. glass, crystal, clear transparent stone.

G5195 ὑβρίζω: I insult. I insult, treat with insolence.

G5196 ὕβρις, εως, ἡ: insult, damage, loss. (a) insult, injury, outrage, (b) damage, loss.

G5197 ὑβριστής, οῦ, ὁ: an insolent, insulting man. an insolent, insulting, or violent man.

G5198 ὑγιαίνω: I am well. I am well, am in good health; I am right, reasonable, sound, pure, uncorrupted.

G5199 ὑγιής, ές: sound, whole, wholesome. (a) sound, healthy, pure, whole, (b) wholesome.

G5200 ὑγρός, ά, όν: moist, green, full of sap. moist, green, full of sap.

G5201 ὑδρία, ας, ἡ: a water pot. a water pot, jar, pitcher.

G5202 ὑδροποτέω: I am a water drinker. I am only a water drinker.

G5203 ὑδρωπικός, ή, όν: afflicted with dropsy. afflicted with dropsy.

G5204 ὕδωρ, ὕδατος, τό: water. water.

G5205 ὑετός, οῦ, ὁ: rain. rain.

G5206 υἱοθεσία, ας, ἡ: adoption. adoption, as a son into the divine family.

G5207 υἱός, οῦ, ὁ: a son, descendent. a son, descendent.

G5208 ὕλη, ης, ἡ: wood, fuel. wood, fuel.

G5211 Ὑμέναιος, ου, ὁ: Hymenaeus. Hymenaeus.

G5212 ὑμέτερος, α, ον: your. your, yours.

G5214 ὑμνέω: I sing, sing hymns to. I sing, sing hymns to, praise.

G5215 ὕμνος, ου, ὁ: a hymn, sacred song. a hymn, sacred song, song of praise to God.

G5217 ὑπάγω: I go away, depart. I go away, depart, begone, die.

G5218 ὑπακοή, ῆς, ἡ: obedience. obedience, submissiveness, compliance.

G5219 ὑπακούω: I listen, obey. I listen, hearken to, obey, answer.

G5220 ὕπανδρος, ον: subject to a husband, married. subject to a husband, married.

G5221 ὑπαντάω: I meet. I meet, go to meet.

G5222 ὑπάντησις, εως, ἡ: a meeting. a meeting.

G5223 ὕπαρξις, εως, ἡ: goods, substance, property. goods, substance, property, possessions.

G5224 ὑπάρχοντα: goods, property. things which one possesses, goods, property, belongings.

G5225 ὑπάρχω: I am, exist, am in possession. I begin, am, exist, am in possession.

G5226 ὑπείκω: I yield. I yield, submit to authority.

G5227 ὑπεναντίος, α, ον: opposite to, adverse. opposite to, adverse; subst: an adversary.

G5228 ὑπέρ: in behalf of, above. gen: in behalf of; acc: above.

G5229 ὑπεραίρω: I raise beyond, uplift. lit: I raise beyond, uplift; mid: I lift myself up, exalt myself, am arrogant.

G5230 ὑπέρακμος, ον: past the bloom of youth. past the bloom of youth, of full age.

G5231 ὑπεράνω: far above. far above.

G5232 ὑπεραυξάνω: I increase exceedingly. I increase exceedingly or beyond measure.

G5233 ὑπερβαίνω: I transgress, go beyond. I transgress; I go beyond, overreach, defraud.

G5234 ὑπερβαλλόντως: beyond measure. beyond measure.

G5235 ὑπερβάλλω: I surpass. I surpass, excel, exceed, transcend.

G5236 ὑπερβολή, ῆς, ἡ: surpassing excellence, exceedingly. excess, surpassing excellence, preeminence; adv: exceedingly.

G5237 ὑπερεῖδον: I overlook. I overlook, take no notice of, disregard.

G5238 ὑπερέκεινα: beyond. beyond.

G5239 ὑπερεκτείνω: I over-stretch. I over-stretch, stretch out beyond the measure assigned to me.

G5240 ὑπερεκχύνω: I pour out so that it overflows. I pour out so that it overflows.

G5241 ὑπερεντυγχάνω: I intercede for. I intercede for, make petition for.

G5242 ὑπερέχω: I excel, surpass. I excel, surpass, am superior.

G5243 ὑπερηφανία, ας, ἡ: pride, arrogance. pride, arrogance, disdain.

G5244 ὑπερήφανος, ον: proud, arrogant. proud, arrogant, disdainful.

G5245 ὑπερνικάω: I am more than conqueror. I am more than conqueror, prevail mightily.

G5246 ὑπέρογκος, ον: immoderate, boastful. immoderate, boastful, excessive, pompous.

G5247 ὑπεροχή, ῆς, ἡ: superiority, excellence. superiority, excellence, preeminence, authority.

G5248 ὑπερπερισσεύω: I abound exceedingly, overflow. (a) intrans: I abound exceedingly, (b) dep: I overflow.

G5249 ὑπερπερισσῶς: beyond measure. superabundantly, beyond measure.

G5250 ὑπερπλεονάζω: I am exceedingly abundant. I abound exceedingly, am exceedingly abundant.

G5251 ὑπερυψόω: I highly exalt. I highly exalt.

G5252 ὑπερφρονέω: I have high notions. I have high notions, am over-proud.

G5253 ὑπερῷον, ου, τό: an upper room. an upper room, the upper part of a house.

G5254 ὑπέχω: I submit to, undergo. I submit to, undergo, suffer.

G5255 ὑπήκοος, ον: listening to, obedient. listening to, obedient, submissive.

G5256 ὑπηρετέω: I minister to, serve. I minister to, serve.

G5257 ὑπηρέτης, ου, ὁ: a servant, an attendant. a servant, an attendant, (a) an officer, lictor, (b) an attendant in a synagogue, (c) a minister of the gospel.

G5258 ὕπνος, ου, ὁ: sleep. sleep; fig: spiritual sleep.

G5259 ὑπό: by, under, about. by, under, about.

G5260 ὑποβάλλω: I suborn, instruct privately. I throw or put under; met: I subject, submit, suggest, whisper, prompt, suborn, instigate.

G5261 ὑπογραμμός, οῦ, ὁ: a writing-copy, an example. a writing-copy, an example, pattern.

G5266 ὑπόδημα, ατος, τό: a sandal. a sandal; anything bound under.

G5267 ὑπόδικος, ον: answerable to. answerable to, liable to (brought under) the judgment of.

G5269 ὑποζώννυμι: I under-gird. I under-gird, as to strengthen a ship against the waves.

G5270 ὑποκάτω: underneath. underneath, below, under.

G5273 ὑποκριτής, οῦ, ὁ: a hypocrite, dissembler. (lit: a stage-player), a hypocrite, dissembler, pretender.

G5274 ὑπολαμβάνω: I take up, receive, answer, suppose, welcome. (a) I take up, (b) I welcome, entertain, (c) I answer, (d) I suppose, imagine.

G5275 ὑπολείπω: I leave behind. I leave behind; pass: I am left surviving.

G5276 ὑπολήνιον, ου, τό: a pit under the wine-press. a wine-vat, pit under the wine-press dug in the ground.

G5277 ὑπολιμπάνω: I leave behind. I leave behind.

G5278 ὑπομένω: I remain behind, endure. (a) I remain behind, (b) I stand my ground, show endurance, (c) I endure, bear up against, persevere.

G5279 ὑπομιμνῄσκω: I remind, remember. I remind; pass: I remember, call to mind.

G5280 ὑπόμνησις, εως, ἡ: remembrance. remembrance, recollection, putting in mind; a reminder.

G5281 ὑπομονή, ῆς, ἡ: endurance, steadfastness. endurance, steadfastness, patient waiting for.

G5282 ὑπονοέω: I conjecture, suppose. I conjecture, suppose, suspect, deem.

G5283 ὑπόνοια, ας, ἡ: a supposition, suspicion. a supposition, suspicion.

G5284 ὑποπλέω: I sail under. I sail under.

G5285 ὑποπνέω: I blow gently. I blow gently.

G5286 ὑποπόδιον, ου, τό: a footstool. a footstool.

G5287 ὑπόστασις, εως, ἡ: assurance, substance, reality. (lit: an underlying), (a) confidence, assurance, (b) a giving substance (or reality) to, or a guaranteeing, (c) substance, reality.

G5288 ὑποστέλλω: I draw back, conceal. I withdraw, draw back, keep back, shun, conceal.

G5289 ὑποστολή, ῆς, ἡ: a shrinking, drawing back. a shrinking, drawing back.

G5290 ὑποστρέφω: I turn back, return. I turn back, return.

G5291 ὑποστρωννύω: I spread under. I spread under, strew under.

G5292 ὑποταγή, ῆς, ἡ: subjection, submission. subjection, submission, obedience.

G5293 ὑποτάσσω: I place under, subject to. I place under, subject to; mid, pass: I submit, put myself into subjection.

G5294 ὑποτίθημι: I lay down, suggest to. I put under, lay down, suggest to, put in mind.

G5295 ὑποτρέχω: I run under shelter of. I run under shelter of.

G5296 ὑποτύπωσις, εως, ἡ: a pattern, example. a pattern, example; a form, sample.

G5297 ὑποφέρω: I endure, suffer. I bear up under, endure, suffer.

G5298 ὑποχωρέω: I withdraw, retire. I withdraw, retire, go back, retreat.

G5299 ὑπωπιάζω: I bruise, worry, exhaust. I strike under the eye, hence: I bruise, treat severely, discipline by hardship, molest, annoy, harass, worry, exhaust.

G5300 ὗς, ὑός, ἡ: a hog, boar, or sow. a hog, boar, or sow.

G5301 ὕσσωπος, ου, ἡ: hyssop. hyssop, a stalk or stem of hyssop.

G5302 ὑστερέω: I am lacking, fall short, suffer need. I fall behind, am lacking, fall short, suffer need, am inferior to.

G5303 ὑστέρημα, ατος, τό: that which is lacking, poverty. (a) of things or persons: that which is lacking, a defect or shortcoming, (b) want, poverty.

G5304 ὑστέρησις, εως, ἡ: poverty, want. poverty, want, need.

title: Dodson Greek-English Lexicon of the New Testament, G5305 to G5560
source: Jeffrey Dodson, Greek-English Lexicon of the New Testament (public domain), data prepared by Ulrik Sandborg-Petersen. Each entry: Strong number, Greek word, short meaning, fuller meaning.
body:
G5305 ὕστερον: lastly, afterward. lastly, afterward, later.

G5306 ὕστερος, α, ον: later. later, latter, last.

G5307 ὑφαντός, ή, όν: woven. woven.

G5308 ὑψηλός, ή, όν: high, lofty. high, lofty.

G5309 ὑψηλοφρονέω: I am high-minded, proud. I am high-minded, proud.

G5310 ὕψιστος, η, ον: highest, most high, the heights. highest, most high, the heights.

G5311 ὕψος, ους, τό: height, heaven. height, heaven; dignity, eminence.

G5312 ὑψόω: I lift up, exalt. (a) I raise on high, lift up, (b) I exalt, set on high.

G5313 ὕψωμα, ατος, τό: height, barrier, bulwark. height, barrier, bulwark; presumption.

G5314 φάγος, ου, ὁ: a glutton. a glutton.

G5315 φάγω: I eat. I eat, partake of food; met: I devour, consume (e.g. as rust does); used only in fut. and 2nd aor. tenses.

G5316 φαίνω: I shine, appear, seem. (a) act: I shine, shed light, (b) pass: I shine, become visible, appear, (c) I become clear, appear, seem, show myself as.

G5317 Φάλεκ, ὁ: Peleg. Peleg, son of Eber, and one of the ancestors of Jesus.

G5318 φανερός, ά, όν: apparent, clear, visible, manifest, clearly. apparent, clear, visible, manifest; adv: clearly.

G5319 φανερόω: I make clear, visible, or manifest. I make clear (visible, manifest), make known.

G5320 φανερῶς: clearly, openly. clearly, openly, manifestly.

G5321 φανέρωσις, εως, ἡ: a manifestation. a manifestation, disclosure.

G5322 φανός, οῦ, ὁ: a torch, lantern. a torch, lantern, light.

G5323 Φανουήλ, ὁ: Phanuel. Phanuel, father of Anna the prophetess.

G5324 φαντάζω: I cause to appear. I cause to appear, make visible.

G5325 φαντασία, ας, ἡ: show, display, pomp. show, display, pomp, imagination.

G5326 φάντασμα, ατος, τό: an apparition, ghost, spirit. an apparition, ghost, spirit, phantom.

G5327 φάραγξ, αγγος, ἡ: a valley, ravine. a valley, ravine, chasm, cleft.

G5328 Φαραώ, ὁ: Pharaoh. Pharaoh, the title of ancient Egyptian kings.

G5329 Φαρές, ὁ: Perez. Perez, son of Judah and one of the ancestors of Jesus.

G5330 Φαρισαῖος, ου, ὁ: a Pharisee. a Pharisee, one of the Jewish sect so called.

G5331 φαρμακεία, ας, ἡ: magic, sorcery, enchantment. magic, sorcery, enchantment.

G5333 φάρμακος, οῦ, ὁ: a magician, sorcerer. a magician, sorcerer.

G5334 φάσις, εως, ἡ: report, tidings. report, tidings, information.

G5335 φάσκω: I assert, affirm, profess. I assert, affirm, profess.

G5336 φάτνη, ης, ἡ: a manger, feeding-trough. a manger, feeding-trough, stall.

G5337 φαῦλος, η, ον: worthless, wicked, base. worthless, wicked, base.

G5338 φέγγος, ους, τό: brightness, light. brightness, light, splendor, radiance.

G5339 φείδομαι: I spare, abstain. I spare, abstain, forbear.

G5340 φειδομένως: sparingly. sparingly.

G5341 φελόνης, ου, ὁ: a mantle, cloak. a mantle, cloak.

G5342 φέρω: I carry, bear, bring, lead. I carry, bear, bring; I conduct, lead; perhaps: I make publicly known.

G5343 φεύγω: I flee, escape, shun. I flee, escape, shun.

G5344 Φῆλιξ, ικος, ὁ: Felix. Felix, third name of (Marcus) Antonius Felix, procurator of the Roman province Judea from an uncertain date (before A.D. 52 ?) till A.D. 59.

G5345 φήμη, ης, ἡ: a report, fame. a report, fame, saying.

G5346 φημί: I say. I say, declare.

G5347 Φῆστος, ου, ὁ: Festus. Festus.

G5348 φθάνω: I anticipate, precede, arrive. (a) I anticipate, precede, (b) I come, arrive.

G5349 φθαρτός, ή, όν: corruptible, perishable. corruptible, perishable.

G5350 φθέγγομαι: I speak aloud, utter. I speak aloud, utter.

G5351 φθείρω: I corrupt, spoil, destroy. I corrupt, spoil, destroy, ruin.

G5352 φθινοπωρινός, ή, όν: autumnal. autumnal, in autumn, when fruit is expected.

G5353 φθόγγος, ου, ὁ: a sound. a sound.

G5354 φθονέω: I envy. I envy.

G5355 φθόνος, ου, ὁ: envy, a grudge. envy, a grudge, spite.

G5356 φθορά, ᾶς, ἡ: corruption, destruction, decay. corruption, destruction, decay, rottenness, decomposition.

G5357 φιάλη, ης, ἡ: a shallow and flat bowl. a shallow and flat bowl.

G5358 φιλάγαθος, ον: loving what is good. loving what is good.

G5359 Φιλαδέλφεια, ας, ἡ: Philadelphia. Philadelphia, a city of the Roman province Asia.

G5360 φιλαδελφία, ας, ἡ: brotherly love. brotherly love, love of Christian brethren.

G5361 φιλάδελφος, ον: loving the brethren. loving like a brother, loving one's brethren.

G5362 φίλανδρος, ον: loving one's husband. loving one's husband.

G5363 φιλανθρωπία, ας, ἡ: love of mankind, benevolence. love of mankind, benevolence.

G5364 φιλανθρώπως: humanely, kindly. humanely, kindly.

G5365 φιλαργυρία, ας, ἡ: love of money, avarice. love of money, avarice, covetousness.

G5366 φιλάργυρος, ον: money-loving, avaricious. money-loving, avaricious, covetous.

G5367 φίλαυτος, ον: selfish. self-loving, selfish.

G5368 φιλέω: I love, kiss. I love (of friendship), regard with affection, cherish; I kiss.

G5369 φιλήδονος, ον: pleasure-loving. pleasure-loving.

G5370 φίλημα, ατος, τό: a kiss. a kiss.

G5371 Φιλήμων, ονος, ὁ: Philemon. Philemon, a Christian man of Colossae.

G5372 Φίλητος, ου, ὁ: Philetus. Philetus, a Christian at Rome.

G5373 φιλία, ας, ἡ: friendship. friendship, affection, fondness, love.

G5374 Φιλιππήσιος, ου, ὁ: a Philippian. a Philippian, an inhabitant of Philippi.

G5375 Φίλιπποι, ων, οἱ: Philippi. Philippi, a great city of the Roman province Macedonia.

G5376 Φίλιππος, ου, ὁ: Philip. Philip, (a) one of the twelve apostles of Jesus, (b) tetrarch of the Ituraean and Trachonitic region, half-brother of Herod Antipas, tetrarch of Galilee, (c) one of the seven original deacons at Jerusalem and a missionary.

G5377 φιλόθεος, ον: loving God. loving God.

G5378 Φιλόλογος, ου, ὁ: Philologus. Philologus, a Roman Christian.

G5379 φιλονεικία, ας, ἡ: love of dispute, contention. love of dispute, contention.

G5380 φιλόνεικος, ον: strife-loving, contentious. strife-loving, contentious.

G5381 φιλοξενία, ας, ἡ: hospitality. love to strangers, hospitality.

G5382 φιλόξενος, ον: hospitable. hospitable, loving strangers.

G5383 φιλοπρωτεύω: I desire preeminence. I love the chief place, desire preeminence.

G5384 φίλος, η, ον: friendly, a friend. friendly; subst: a friend, an associate.

G5385 φιλοσοφία, ας, ἡ: love of wisdom, philosophy. love of wisdom, philosophy, in the NT of traditional Jewish theology.

G5386 φιλόσοφος, ου, ὁ: a philosopher. a philosopher.

G5387 φιλόστοργος, ον: tenderly loving. tenderly loving, kindly affectionate to.

G5388 φιλότεκνος, ον: loving one's children. loving one's children.

G5389 φιλοτιμέομαι: I desire very strongly. I am zealous, strive eagerly, desire very strongly.

G5390 φιλοφρόνως: kindly. kindly, in a friendly manner.

G5391 φιλόφρων, ον: friendly, kindly. friendly, kindly, courteous.

G5392 φιμόω: I muzzle, silence. I muzzle, silence.

G5393 Φλέγων, οντος, ὁ: Phlegon. Phlegon, a Roman Christian man.

G5394 φλογίζω: I inflame, fire with passion. I inflame, fire with passion, set on fire, burn up.

G5395 φλόξ, φλογός, ἡ: a flame. a flame.

G5396 φλυαρέω: I gossip against. I gossip against, talk idly, make empty charges against, talk nonsense.

G5397 φλύαρος, ον: prating, talking foolishly. prating, talking foolishly, babbling.

G5398 φοβερός, ά, όν: fearful, dreadful. fearful, dreadful, terrible.

G5399 φοβέομαι: I fear, am terrified. I fear, dread, reverence, am afraid, terrified.

G5400 φόβητρον, ου, τό: a cause of terror. a terrible sight, cause of terror, an object of fear.

G5401 φόβος, ου, ὁ: fear, terror, reverence. (a) fear, terror, alarm, (b) the object or cause of fear, (c) reverence, respect.

G5402 Φοίβη, ης, ἡ: Phoebe. Phoebe, a Christian woman in the church at Cenchreae.

G5403 Φοινίκη, ης, ἡ: Phoenicia. Phoenicia, a northern coast strip of the Roman province Syria.

G5404 φοίνιξ, ικός, ὁ: a palm tree, palm branch. a palm tree, the date-palm.

G5405 Φοῖνιξ, ικός, ἡ: Phoenix. Phoenix, a bay on the south coast of Crete.

G5406 φονεύς, έως, ὁ: a murderer. a murderer.

G5407 φονεύω: I murder. I murder, kill.

G5408 φόνος, ου, ὁ: murder, slaughter. murder, slaughter, killing.

G5409 φορέω: I carry, wear. I carry, wear, bear constantly.

G5410 Φόρον, ου, τό: Forum, Market. (of Latin origin), Forum, Market, Market-Town.

G5411 φόρος, ου, ὁ: a tax, tribute. a tax, tribute, especially on persons.

G5412 φορτίζω: I load, burden. I load, burden; pass: I am laden.

G5413 φορτίον, ου, τό: a burden, freight. a burden; the freight of a ship.

G5415 Φορτουνάτος, ου, ὁ: Fortunatus. Fortunatus, a Christian of Corinth.

G5416 φραγέλλιον, ου, τό: a scourge, lash. a scourge, lash, whip.

G5417 φραγελλόω: I flagellate, scourge. I flagellate, scourge.

G5418 φραγμός, οῦ, ὁ: a hedge, fence, partition. a hedge, fence, partition.

G5419 φράζω: I declare, explain, interpret. I declare, explain, interpret.

G5420 φράσσω: I stop, close up. I stop, close up, obstruct.

G5421 φρέαρ, φρέατος, τό: a pit, well. a pit, well, cistern.

G5422 φρεναπατάω: I deceive the mind. I deceive the mind, impose upon.

G5423 φρεναπάτης, ου, ὁ: a mind-deceiver. a deceiver, seducer.

G5424 φρήν, φρενός, ἡ: the mind, intellect. the mind, intellect, thought, understanding.

G5425 φρίσσω: I shudder. I shudder, shiver, tremble.

G5426 φρονέω: I think, judge, observe. (a) I think, (b) I think, judge, (c) I direct the mind to, seek for, (d) I observe, (e) I care for.

G5427 φρόνημα, ατος, τό: thought, purpose. thought, purpose, aspirations.

G5428 φρόνησις, εως, ἡ: understanding. understanding (which leads to right action), practical wisdom, prudence.

G5429 φρόνιμος, ον: intelligent, prudent. intelligent, prudent, sensible, wise.

G5430 φρονίμως: wisely, sensibly, prudently. wisely, sensibly, prudently.

G5431 φροντίζω: I am thoughtful, careful. I am thoughtful, careful, give heed.

G5432 φρουρέω: I guard, keep. I guard, keep, as by a military guard.

G5433 φρυάσσω: I roar, rage. I am wanton, insolent; I roar, rage.

G5434 φρύγανον, ου, τό: a dry stick for burning. a dry stick for burning.

G5435 Φρυγία, ας, ἡ: Phrygia. Phrygia, an ethnic district in Asia Minor, the north-western part of which was in the Roman province Asia and the south-eastern part in the Roman province Galatia.

G5436 Φύγελος, ου, ὁ: Phygelus. Phygelus, a Christian of the Roman province Asia who deserted Paul.

G5437 φυγή, ῆς, ἡ: flight. flight, fleeing.

G5438 φυλακή, ῆς, ἡ: a watching, guard, prison, imprisonment. a watching, keeping guard; a guard, prison; imprisonment.

G5439 φυλακίζω: I imprison. I imprison, deliver into custody.

G5440 φυλακτήριον, ου, τό: a phylactery, an amulet. a phylactery, an amulet, a parchment capsule containing little parchment rolls with the Hebrew texts, affixed to the left upper arm or the forehead of men at morning prayer, and regarded as a protection (hence the name) against evil spirits.

G5441 φύλαξ, ακός, ὁ: a guard, keeper, sentinel. a guard, keeper, sentinel.

G5442 φυλάσσω: I keep, guard, observe. (a) I guard, protect; mid: I am on my guard, (b) act. and mid. of customs and regulations: I keep, observe.

G5443 φυλή, ῆς, ἡ: a tribe, race. a tribe or race of people.

G5444 φύλλον, ου, τό: a leaf. a leaf.

G5445 φύραμα, ατος, τό: a mass or lump. a mass or lump, as of bread dough.

G5446 φυσικός, ή, όν: natural, according to nature. natural, (a) according to nature, (b) merely animal.

G5447 φυσικῶς: by nature, naturally. by nature, naturally.

G5448 φυσιόω: I inflate, puff up. I inflate, puff up; pass: I am puffed up, arrogant, proud.

G5449 φύσις, εως, ἡ: nature, inherent nature. nature, inherent nature, origin, birth.

G5450 φυσίωσις, εως, ἡ: a puffing up, pride. a puffing up, pride, swelling.

G5451 φυτεία, ας, ἡ: a plant. a plant, that which is planted.

G5452 φυτεύω: I plant. I plant, set.

G5453 φύω: I grow, grow up. I grow, grow up, spring up.

G5454 φωλεός, οῦ, ὁ: a burrow, hole. a burrow, hole, den, lair.

G5455 φωνέω: I crow, shout, summon. I give forth a sound, hence: (a) of a cock: I crow, (b) of men: I shout, (c) trans: I call (to myself), summon; I invite, address.

G5456 φωνή, ῆς, ἡ: a sound, noise, voice. a sound, noise, voice, language, dialect.

G5457 φῶς, φωτός, τό: light, a source of light. light, a source of light, radiance.

G5458 φωστήρ, ῆρος, ὁ: a light, brilliancy. a light, an illuminator, perhaps the sun; a star; brilliancy.

G5459 φωσφόρος, ον: light-bearing, radiant, the morning-star. (lit: light-bearing), radiant, the morning-star.

G5460 φωτεινός, ή, όν: bright, luminous, full of light. bright, luminous, full of light.

G5461 φωτίζω: I illuminate, bring to light. (a) I light up, illumine, (b) I bring to light, make evident, reveal.

G5462 φωτισμός, οῦ, ὁ: light, luster, illumination. light, luster, illumination, enlightenment.

G5463 χαίρω: I rejoice, am glad. I rejoice, am glad; also a salutation: Hail.

G5464 χάλαζα, ης, ἡ: hail. hail.

G5465 χαλάω: I let down, lower. I let down, lower, slacken, loosen.

G5466 Χαλδαῖος, ου, ὁ: a Chaldean. a Chaldean.

G5467 χαλεπός, ή, όν: hard, harsh, fierce. (a) hard, troublesome, (b) harsh, fierce.

G5468 χαλιναγωγέω: I bridle, curb. I bridle, curb, restrain, sway.

G5469 χαλινός, οῦ, ὁ: a bridle. a bridle, bit.

G5470 χάλκοῦς, ῆ, οῦν: made of bronze. made of bronze, bronze, brass.

G5471 χαλκεύς, έως, ὁ: a worker in brass or copper. a worker in brass or copper; a smith.

G5472 χαλκηδών, όνος, ὁ: chalcedony. chalcedony, a small stone of various colors.

G5473 χαλκίον, ου, τό: a bronze vessel. a bronze vessel, brazen utensil.

G5474 χαλκολίβανον, ου, τό: orichalcum, or frankincense of a yellow color. orichalcum, a fine metal, or frankincense of a yellow color.

G5475 χαλκός, οῦ, ὁ: copper, brass, money. copper, brass, money; a brazen musical instrument.

G5476 χαμαί: on or to the ground. on or to the ground.

G5477 Χαναάν, ἡ: Canaan. Canaan, the whole of Palestine or Palestine west of the river Jordan.

G5478 Χαναναῖος, αία, αῖον: Canaanite. Canaanite, a Biblical and archaic name for Phoenician.

G5479 χαρά, ᾶς, ἡ: joy, gladness. joy, gladness, a source of joy.

G5480 χάραγμα, ατος, τό: sculpture, a stamp, sign. sculpture; engraving, a stamp, sign.

G5481 χαρακτήρ, ῆρος, ὁ: an exact reproduction. an impression, representation, exact reproduction; a graving-tool.

G5482 χάραξ, ακός, ὁ: a mound for besieging. a palisade, mound for besieging.

G5483 χαρίζομαι: I show favor to, forgive. (a) I show favor to, (b) I pardon, forgive, (c) I show kindness.

G5484 χάριν: on account of. for the sake of, by reason of, on account of.

G5485 χάρις, ιτος, ἡ: grace, favor, kindness. (a) grace, as a gift or blessing brought to man by Jesus Christ, (b) favor, (c) gratitude, thanks, (d) a favor, kindness.

G5486 χάρισμα, ατος, τό: an undeserved favor. a gift of grace, an undeserved favor.

G5487 χαριτόω: I favor, bestow freely on. I favor, bestow freely on.

G5488 Χαρράν, ἡ: Haran. Haran.

G5489 χάρτης, ου, ὁ: papyrus, paper. papyrus, paper.

G5490 χάσμα, ατος, τό: a gap, gulf, chasm. a gap, gulf, chasm.

G5491 χεῖλος, ους, τό: a lip, mouth, shore. a lip, mouth, shore, edge, brink; meton: language, dialect.

G5492 χειμάζομαι: I am storm-tossed. I am storm-tossed.

G5493 χείμαρρος, ου, ὁ: a winter torrent. a storm-brook, a winter torrent.

G5494 χειμών, ῶνος, ὁ: a tempest, the rainy season. a storm, tempest; winter, the rainy season.

G5495 χείρ, χειρός, ἡ: a hand. a hand.

G5496 χειραγωγέω: I lead by the hand. I lead by the hand.

G5497 χειραγωγός, οῦ, ὁ: one who leads a helpless person by the hand. one who leads a helpless person by the hand.

G5498 χειρόγραφον, ου, τό: a handwriting, bond. a handwriting, bond.

G5499 χειροποίητος, ον: done or made with hands. done or made with hands, artificial.

G5500 χειροτονέω: I choose by vote, appoint. I elect by show of hands, choose by vote, appoint.

G5501 χείρων, ον: worse. worse, more severe.

G5502 Χερουβίμ: Cherubim. Cherubim.

G5503 χήρα, ας, ἡ: a widow. a widow.

G5504 χθές: yesterday. yesterday.

G5505 χιλιάς, άδος, ἡ: a thousand. a thousand, the number one thousand.

G5506 χιλίαρχος, ου, ὁ: a military tribune. a commander of a thousand men, a military tribune.

G5507 χίλιοι, αι, α: a thousand. a thousand.

G5508 Χίος, ου, ἡ: Chios. Chios (modern Scio), an important island in the Aegean Sea, off the west central coast of Asia Minor.

G5509 χιτών, ῶνος, ὁ: a tunic, garment, undergarment. a tunic, garment, undergarment.

G5510 χιών, όνος, ἡ: snow. snow.

G5511 χλαμύς, ύδος, ἡ: a short cloak. a short cloak, worn by military officers and soldiers.

G5512 χλευάζω: I mock, scoff. I mock, scoff, jest, jeer.

G5513 χλιαρός, ά, όν: lukewarm. warm, tepid; of persons: lukewarm.

G5514 Χλόη, ης, ἡ: Chloe. Chloe, probably with business connections either in Corinth or in Ephesus or in both.

G5515 χλωρός, ά, όν: green, pale. green, pale green.

G5517 χοϊκός, ή, όν: earthy, made of earth. earthy, made of earth.

G5518 χοῖνιξ, ικος, ἡ: a Greek dry measure. a Greek dry measure, equivalent to 1.92 pints.

G5519 χοῖρος, ου, ὁ: swine. a swine, hog, sow.

G5520 χολάω: I am angry with. I am angry with.

G5521 χολή, ῆς, ἡ: gall, bitter herbs. gall, bitter herbs.

G5522 χοῦς, χοός, ὁ: dust. earth, soil, dust.

G5523 Χοραζίν, ἡ: Chorazin. Chorazin, a town of Galilee.

G5524 χορηγέω: I furnish abundantly. I furnish abundantly, supply.

G5525 χορός, οῦ, ὁ: a dance, dancing. a dance, dancing.

G5526 χορτάζω: I feed, satisfy. I feed, satisfy, fatten.

G5527 χόρτασμα, ατος, τό: food, sustenance. food, sustenance, provision.

G5528 χόρτος, ου, ὁ: grass, hay. grass, herbage, growing grain, hay.

G5529 Χουζᾶς, ᾶ, ὁ: Chuza. Chuza, a steward of Herod Antipas.

G5530 χράομαι: I use, make use of, deal with. I use, make use of, deal with, take advantage of.

G5531 χράω: I lend. I lend.

G5532 χρεία, ας, ἡ: need, necessity, business. need, necessity, business.

G5533 χρεωφειλέτης, ου, ὁ: a debtor. a debtor.

G5534 χρή: it is necessary, proper. it is necessary, proper, fitting.

G5535 χρῄζω: I need. I need, have need of, want, desire.

G5536 χρῆμα, ατος, τό: money, riches. money, riches, possessions.

G5537 χρηματίζω: I warn, am publicly called. (originally: I transact business), (a) act. of God: I warn; pass: I am warned by God (probably in response to an inquiry as to one's duty), (b) (I take a name from my public business, hence) I receive a name, am publicly called.

G5538 χρηματισμός, οῦ, ὁ: an oracle. an oracle, divine response.

G5539 χρήσιμος, η, ον: useful, profitable. useful, profitable.

G5540 χρῆσις, εως, ἡ: usage, use. use, manner of use.

G5541 χρηστεύομαι: I am kind. I am kind (full of service to others), gentle.

G5542 χρηστολογία, ας, ἡ: a kind address. a kind address; in a bad sense: plausible speaking.

G5543 χρηστός, ή, όν: useful, gentle, pleasant, kind. useful, gentle, pleasant, kind.

G5544 χρηστότης, τητος, ἡ: goodness, benignity, kindness. goodness, uprightness, kindness, gentleness.

G5545 χρίσμα, ατος, τό: an anointing. an anointing.

G5546 Χριστιανός, οῦ, ὁ: a Christian. a Christian.

G5547 Χριστός, οῦ, ὁ: anointed, the Messiah, the Christ. anointed; the Messiah, the Christ.

G5548 χρίω: I anoint. I anoint, consecrate by anointing.

G5549 χρονίζω: I delay, tarry. I delay, tarry, linger, spend time.

G5550 χρόνος, ου, ὁ: time, a particular time, season. time, a particular time, season.

G5551 χρονοτριβέω: I waste time, spend time. I waste time, spend time, delay.

G5552 χρυσοῦς, ῆ, οῦν: golden. golden, made of gold, adorned with gold.

G5553 χρυσίον, ου, τό: a golden ornament. a piece of gold, golden ornament.

G5554 χρυσοδακτύλιος, ον: adorned with a gold ring. adorned with a gold ring.

G5555 χρυσόλιθος, ου, ὁ: a topaz. a topaz, a gem with a bright yellow color.

G5556 χρυσόπρασος, ου, ὁ: a chrysoprase. a chrysoprase, gem of a golden-greenish color.

G5557 χρυσός, οῦ, ὁ: anything made of gold. gold, anything made of gold, a gold coin.

G5558 χρυσόω: I gild, adorn with gold. I gild, adorn with gold.

G5559 χρώς, ωτός, ὁ: the skin. the skin, surface of the body.

G5560 χωλός, ή, όν: lame, deprived of a foot. lame, deprived of a foot, limping.

title: Dodson Greek-English Lexicon of the New Testament, G5561 to G5624
source: Jeffrey Dodson, Greek-English Lexicon of the New Testament (public domain), data prepared by Ulrik Sandborg-Petersen. Each entry: Strong number, Greek word, short meaning, fuller meaning.
body:
G5561 χώρα, ας, ἡ: region, land, fields. (a) a country or region, (b) the land, as opposed to the sea, (c) the country, distinct from town, (d) plur: fields.

G5562 χωρέω: I make room, go, receive. (lit: I make room, hence) (a) I have room for, receive, contain, (b) I make room for by departing, go, make progress, turn myself.

G5563 χωρίζω: I separate, depart. (a) I separate, put apart, (b) mid. or pass: I separate myself, depart, withdraw.

G5564 χωρίον, ου, τό: a place, piece of land, field. a place, piece of land, field, property, estate.

G5565 χωρίς: apart from, without. apart from, separately from; without.

G5566 χῶρος, ου, ὁ: the north-west wind. the north-west wind, and the quarter of the sky from which it comes.

G5567 ψάλλω: I sing psalms. I sing, sing psalms; earlier: I play on a stringed instrument.

G5568 ψαλμός, οῦ, ὁ: a psalm. a psalm, song of praise, the Hebrew book of Psalms.

G5569 ψευδάδελφος, ου, ὁ: a false brother. a false brother, pretend Christian.

G5570 ψευδαπόστολος, ου, ὁ: a false apostle. a false or pretended apostle.

G5571 ψευδής, ές: false, deceitful, lying. false, deceitful, lying, untrue.

G5572 ψευδοδιδάσκαλος, ου, ὁ: a false teacher. a false teacher, teacher of false things.

G5573 ψευδολόγος, ον: speaking lies. false-speaking, speaking lies.

G5574 ψεύδομαι: I lie. I deceive, lie, speak falsely.

G5575 ψευδόμαρτυς, υρος, ὁ: a false witness. a false witness.

G5576 ψευδομαρτυρέω: I testify falsely. I testify falsely, bear false witness.

G5577 ψευδομαρτυρία, ας, ἡ: false testimony. false testimony, false witness.

G5578 ψευδοπροφήτης, ου, ὁ: a false prophet. a false prophet; one who in God's name teaches what is false.

G5579 ψεῦδος, ους, τό: a lie. a lie, falsehood, untruth; false religion.

G5580 ψευδόχριστος, ου, ὁ: a false Christ. a false Christ, pretended Messiah.

G5581 ψευδώνυμος, ον: falsely named. falsely named, under a false name.

G5582 ψεῦσμα, ατος, τό: a falsehood, lie. a falsehood, lie, untruthfulness.

G5583 ψεύστης, ου, ὁ: a liar, deceiver. a liar, deceiver.

G5584 ψηλαφάω: I feel, touch, handle, grope for. I feel, touch, handle; I feel after, grope for.

G5585 ψηφίζω: I reckon, compute. I reckon, compute, calculate.

G5586 ψῆφος, ου, ἡ: a pebble, a vote. (a) a pebble, small stone, (b) hence, from their use in voting: a vote.

G5587 ψιθυρισμός, οῦ, ὁ: a whispering, secret slandering. a whispering, secret slandering.

G5588 ψιθυριστής, οῦ, ὁ: a whisperer, secret slanderer. a whisperer, secret slanderer.

G5589 ψιχίον, ου, τό: a crumb. a crumb.

G5590 ψυχή, ῆς, ἡ: the soul, life, self. (a) the vital breath, breath of life, (b) the human soul, (c) the soul as the seat of affections and will, (d) the self, (e) a human person, an individual.

G5591 ψυχικός, ή, όν: animal, natural, sensuous. animal, natural, sensuous.

G5592 ψῦχος, ους, τό: cold. cold.

G5593 ψυχρός, ά, όν: cold, cold-hearted. cool, cold; fig: cold-hearted.

G5594 ψύχω: I cool, grow cold. I cool, pass: I grow cold.

G5595 ψωμίζω: I feed, dole out. I feed, dole out.

G5596 ψωμίον, ου, τό: a bit, morsel. a bit, morsel.

G5597 ψώχω: I rub, rub to pieces. I rub, rub to pieces.

G5598 Ὦ: omega. omega, the last letter of the Greek alphabet.

G5599 ὦ: O, an exclamation. O, an exclamation, used in addressing someone.

G5601 Ὠβήδ, ὁ: Obed. Obed.

G5602 ὧδε: here. here, the things here, what is here, what is going on here, the state of affairs here.

G5603 ᾠδή, ῆς, ἡ: an ode, song. an ode, song, hymn.

G5604 ὠδίν, ῖνος, ἡ: the pain of childbirth, severe agony. the pain of childbirth, acute pain, severe agony, a snare.

G5605 ὠδίνω: I am in travail, suffer birth-pangs. I am in travail, suffer birth-pangs.

G5606 ὦμος, ου, ὁ: a shoulder. the shoulder.

G5608 ὠνέομαι: I buy, purchase. I buy, purchase.

G5609 ᾠόν, οῦ, τό: an egg. an egg.

G5610 ὥρα, ας, ἡ: an hour, season. (a) a definite space of time, a season, (b) an hour, (c) the particular time for anything.

G5611 ὡραῖος, αία, αῖον: fair, beautiful. fair, beautiful, blooming.

G5612 ὠρύομαι: I roar, howl. I roar, howl, as a beast.

G5613 ὡς: as, like as, how, while, so that. as, like as, about, as it were, according as, how, when, while, as soon as, so that.

G5614 ὡσαννά: hosanna. (Aramaic and Hebrew, originally a cry for help), hosanna!, a cry of happiness.

G5615 ὡσαύτως: likewise. in like manner, likewise, just so.

G5616 ὡσεί: as if, as it were, like, about. as if, as it were, like; with numbers: about.

G5617 Ὡσηέ, ὁ: Hosea. Hosea, the Hebrew prophet.

G5618 ὥσπερ: just as, as. just as, as, even as.

G5619 ὡσπερεί: just as if, as it were. just as if, as it were.

G5620 ὥστε: so that, therefore. so that, therefore, so then, so as to.

G5621 ὠτίον, ου, τό: an ear. an ear.

G5622 ὠφέλεια, ας, ἡ: usefulness, profit, advantage. usefulness, profit, advantage, benefit, gain.

G5623 ὠφελέω: I help, benefit, do good. I help, benefit, do good, am useful (to), profit.

G5624 ὠφέλιμος, ον: profitable, beneficial, useful. profitable, beneficial, useful.

title: Brown-Driver-Briggs Hebrew Lexicon, part 1
source: Francis Brown, S. R. Driver and Charles Briggs, A Hebrew and English Lexicon of the Old Testament (1906), public domain; XML by Open Scriptures (CC BY 4.0). Entries follow the alphabet from Aleph to Tav; each starts with its BDB code and, where known, its Strong number.
body:
[BDB a.aa.aa] א Āleph, first letter; in postBHeb. = numeral 1 (and so in margin of printed MT); אֿ = 1000; no evidence of this usage in OT times.

[BDB a.aa.ab] אָב v. II. אבה.

[BDB a.ab.aa] אבב (fresh, bright, As. abâbu Dlw, AGl.)

[BDB a.ab.ab] Strong H3. [אֵב] n.[m.] freshness, fresh green (Lag B N 207 inf. ibb; thence concr., cf. Ar. Arabic; above stem & mng. better than √ אנב (spring) cf. As. inbu, fruit, Aram. אִנְבֵּהּ (q.v.) Dl HA 65, Pr 114) עֹדֶנּוּ בְאִבּוֹ while in its freshness (i.e. אָחוּ, reed) Jb 8:12; concr., pl. green shoots בְּאִבֵּי הַנַּחַל Ct 6:11 (∥ הֲפָֽרְחָה הַגֶּפֶן הֵנֵצוּ הָרִמֹּנִֽים׃).

[BDB a.ab.ac] Strong H24. אָבִיב n.m. Lv 2:14 coll. (Lag BN 207 Inf.) fresh, young ears of barley Ex 9:31; indef. Lv 2:14 מִנְחַת בִּכּוּרִים לַיהוָה א׳ קָלוּי בָּאֵשׁ. חֹדֶשׁ הָֽאָבִֽיב month of ear-forming, or of growing green, Abib, month of Exodus & passover, Ex 13:4 23:15 34:18, 18 (JE), Dt 16:1, 1 (1st month = c. April = הָרִאשֹׁן, הַחֹדֶשׁ הָר׳ (q.v.) in P; v. Di Ex 12:2; = postexilic נִיסָן q.v.)

[BDB a.ab.ad] אֲבִגַיִל v. אֲבִיגַיִל sub. II. אבה.

[BDB a.ab.ae] Strong H5. אֲבַגְתָא n.pr.m. (Pers. cf. בִּגְתָא) eunuch of Ahasuerus Est 1:10.

[BDB a.ac.aa] Strong H6. אָבַד vb. perish (M I אבד, As. abâtu Dl W 184 Aram אֲבַד, Syriac).— Qal Pf. א׳ Nu 21:30 +; אָבְדוּ ψ 10:16 + (+ Ez 6:3 𝔊 Co) etc.; Impf. יֹאבַד Jb 3:3 Je 4:9; יֹאבֵ֑ד Jb 20:7 + 2t.; 3fs. תֹּאבַד Dt 22:3 + 4t.; תֹּאבֵ֑ד Jb 8:13 + 3t.; יֹאבְדוּ Ju 5:31 + 3t.; יֹאבֵ֑דוּ Jb 4:9 +; 3fpl. וַתֹּאבַדְנָה֙ I S 9:3; תֹּאבֵדוּן Dt 4:26 +; נֹאבֵ֑ד Jon 1:6, 3:9; נֹאבְדָה Jon 1:14 etc.; Inf. abs. אָבֹד Dt 4:26 + 2t.; cstr. אֲבֹד Dt 7:10 Pr 11:10; אֲבָדְךָ Dt 28:20; אָבְדֶ֑ךָ Dt 28:22; אֲבָדְכֶם Jos 23:13; אָבְדָם Ob 12 Pr 28:28; Pt. אֹבֵד Dt 26:5 + 7t.; cstr. אֹבַד Dt 32:28 (bef. ע? v. Di Bö § 378); etc. perish, die, of individuals (mostly late) Nu 17:27 (∥ גוע & (v. 28) מות), (also Dt 26:5? cf. infr.) Jon 1:6, 14 Jb 31:19 cf. 29:13 Pr 31:6 Est 4:14, 16, 16 Mi 4:9 Je 40:15 cf. Is 57:1 Pr 11:10 28:28 Ec 7:15 ψ 119:92; emphasis on morality Jb 4:20 ψ 146:4 Ec 9:6; Saul & Jonath., under fig. of weapons 2 S 1:27; lion Jb 4:11; caravan Jb 6:18 (cf. Di); cf. אָ׳ חָסִיד מִן־הָאָרֶץ Mi 7:2, וְאָ׳ מֶלֶךְ מֵֽעַזָּה Zc 9:5; perish, be exterminated (judgment for sin), of Israel Lv 26:38 Dt 8:19, 19, 20 28:20, 22 30:18, 18 Je 27:10, 15 cf. 6:21, Ob 12 cf. ψ 80:17 Is 27:13; other nations Dt 7:20 Je 10:15 51:18 ψ 2:12 10:16 83:18 cf. 9:4 Am 1:8 Is 41:11 60:12 cf. Jon 3:9 v. also Ex 10:7 Nu 21:29, 30 (JE) Je 48:46; house of Ahab 2 K 9:8; wicked in general Ju 5:31 Jb 4:9 cf. v 7, ψ 37:20 49:11 68:3 (∥ sim. of melting wax), 73:27 92:10; also Pr 19:9 21:28; לָנֶצַח א׳ Jb 20:7; cf. דֶרֶךְ רְשָׁעִים א׳ ψ 1:6; sq. מֵעַל הָאָ֑רֶץ (of annihilation of Isr.) Dt 4:26, 26 11:17 Jos 23:13, 16 (D); sq. מִתּוֹךְ הַקָּהָל (of Korah’s company) Nu 16:33 (JE); perish, be ruined, destroyed, of inanimate things, e.g. land Je 9:11 (∥ נִצְּתָה כַמִּדְבָּר) cf. 48:8; harvest Jo 1:11; Jonah’s gourd Jon 4:10; riches Je 48:36 Ec 5:13; vessel ψ 31:13; houses Am 3:15 (so oft. As. Dl W); city Ez 26:17 (but del. 𝔊 Co); cf. bamôth Ez 6:3 𝔊 Co; heavens & earth ψ 102:27. fig. perish, vanish, subj. memory Jb 18:17 ψ 9:7; name ψ 41:6 (i.e. be forgotten); vigour Jb 30:2; wisdom Is 29:14; cf. אֹבַד עֵצוֹת Dt 32:28; אֱמוּנָה Je 7:28 (∥ נִכְרְתָה); חָזוֹן Ez 12:22; יוֹם Jb 3:3 (i.e. blotted out); לֵב Je 4:9 (i.e. courage fail); תִּקְוָת ψ 9:19 Pr 10:28 11:7 Ez 19:5 37:11 Jb 8:13; so תַּאֲוַת ψ 112:10 (i.e. come to naught); תּוֹחֶלֶת Pr 11:7, sq. מִן + agent La 3:18; תּוֹרָה + עֵצָה sq. מן + persons negligent Je 18:18 Ez 7:26, cf. Je 49:7; esp. א׳ מָנוֹס מִן־ (i.e. they could not escape) Am 2:14 Je 25:35 Jb 11:20 ψ 142:5. be lost, strayed, asses I S 9:3, 20; sheep Je 50:6 Ez 34:4, 16 ψ 119:176 (fig. of erring men); perh. Dt 26:5. Pi. caus. of Qal.—Pf. אִבַּד 2 K 21:3 + 2 t.; sf. וָֽאַבֶּדְךָ Co Ez 28:16 cf. infr.; אִבַּדְתִּי Je 15:7; וְאִבַּדְתִּ֫י Ez 6:3 (𝔊 Co וְאָֽבְדוּ) etc.; Impf. יְאַבֵּד Ec 9:18; וִֽיאַבֵּד Ec 7:7 Zp 2:13; 1 s. sf. וָאַבֶּדְךָ Ez 28:16 (for וָאֲאַבּ׳ Ew § 72 a Ol § 79 a Kö I 338 Ges § 68 nn; but Co 3 ms.; v. also Co 38 14); תְּאַבְּדוּן Dt 12:2 etc.; Inf. abs. אַבֵּד Dt 12:2 + 3 t.; cstr. id. Ez 22:27 + etc.; Pt. מְאַבְּדִים Je 23:1. cause to perish, destroy, kill, obj. pers. (mostly late) 2 K 11:1 Est 3:9 4:7 8:5 9:24; ∥ הרג 9:6, 12; ∥ הַשְׁמִיד + הרג 3:13 7:4 8:11; ∥ המם Est 9:24; cf. ψ 119:95; obj. נְפָשׁוֹת Ez 22:27 (del. 𝔊 Co); in judgment, subj. י׳ ψ 5:7; cf. Pr 1:32; sq. מִתּוֹךְ Ez 28:16; obj. a people 2 K 13:7 2 K 19:18 = Is 37:19; Jb 12:23; in judgment Dt 11:4 Je 12:17 15:7 Zp 2:13 ψ 9:6 cf. 21:11; obj. inanimate things esp. idols, bamôth etc., Nu 33:52, 52 (J) Dt 12:2, 2 2 K 21:3 Ez 6:3 (but cf. 𝔊 Co supr.); bars of Zion La 2:9 (∥ שִׁבַּר). fig. cause to vanish, blot out, do away with names of idols Dt 12:3; voice of Babylon Je 51:55; memory of dead Is 26:14; substance Pr 29:3; understanding Ec 7:7; good (טוֹבָה q.v.) Ec 9:18. cause to stray, lose; obj. Isr. under fig. of flock Je 23:1 (∥ הֵפִיץ); abs. Ec 3:6 (∥ בַקֵּשׁ). Hiph. Pf. וְהֶֽאֱבִיד Nu 24:19; הֶאֱבַ֑דְתָּ Jb 14:19 etc.; Impf. אֹבִידָה Je 46:8 (Ges § 68, 2 R.1). Inf. cstr. הַאֲבִיד 2 K 10:19 + etc.; Pt. מַאֲבִיד Dt 8:20. destroy, put to death, in judgment, (subj. י׳) obj. pers. Lv 23:30 (sq. מִקֶּרֶב עַמָּהּ; ∥ כָּרַת v 29); Je 49:38 (sq. מִשָּׁם); Ob 8 (sq. מֵֽאֱדוֹם); obj. nation, Ammon Ez 25:7 (sq. מן־הארצות; ∥ כָּרַת), cf. v 16; Canaanites Dt 8:20 (sq. מִפְּנֵיכֶם); Canaan = Philistines Zp 2:5 (∥ כָּרַת); esp. Isr. Dt 28:51, 63 (∥ הַשְׁמִיד), cf. Js 7:7; also abs. Je 18:7 (∥ לִנְתוֹשׁ וְלִנְתוֹץ); = 1:10 (+ וְלַהֲרוֹס) = 31:28 (+ וּלְהָרֵעַ); animals Ez 32:13 (sq. מֵעַל מַיִם רַבִּים); cf. Dt 7:10; ψ 143:12 (∥ תַּצְמִית); (human subj.), obj. servants of Baal 2 K 10:19, obj. nation Dt 9:3, cf. Nu 24:19 (E; sq. מֵעִֽיר); 2 K 24:2; cf. Je 46:8; obj. inanimate, chariots Mi 5:9; idols Ez 30:13 (del. BCo). fig., obj. name of kings Dt 7:24 (sq. מִתַּחַת הַשָּׁמָיִם); hope Jb 14:19; voice of mirth etc. Je 25:10 (cf. 51:55 Pi. supr.)

[BDB a.ac.ab] Strong H8. אֹבֵד n.[m.] destruction, עֲדֵי א׳ Nu 24:20, 24 (JE; on form with abstract sense v. Ba NB 149).

[BDB a.ac.ac] Strong H9. אֲבֵדָה n.f. a lost thing—abs. exc. Dt 22:3 cstr. אֲבֵדַת—Ex 22:8; with מָצָא Lv 5:22, 23; with אָבַד + מָצָא Dt 22:3;—(אבדה Pr 27:20 Kt cf. אֲבַדּוֹ infr.)

[BDB a.ac.ad] אֲבַדֹּה אֲבַדּוֹ cf. אבדון infr.

[BDB a.ac.ae] Strong H12. אַבְדָ֑ן, & אׇבְדַן (cstr.) n.[m.] destruction (Syr. Syriac) Est 9:5 (מַכַּת־חֶרֶב וְהֶרֶג וְא׳), 8:8; (on form v. BeRy; Ol § 215 b.1 Ba NB 49, 487).

[BDB a.ac.af] Strong H10. אֲבַדּוֹן n.f. ? Pr 27:20 abstr. nearly = n.pr. (place of) Destruction, Ruin, ’Abaddôn (cf. Syriac 𝔖 Jb 28:22 etc.)—אֲבַדּֽוֹן Jb 26:6 (+ 4 t.); abbrev. אבדה Kt אֲבַדּֽוֹ Qr Pr 27:20.—Place of ruin in Shᵉʼôl for lost or ruined dead, as development of earlier distinction of condition in Shᵉʼôl (v. שְׁאוֹל). Only in WisdLt; Jb 31:12; ∥ שׁאול Jb 26:6 Pr 15:11 27:20; ∥ מות Jb 28:22; ∥ קבר ψ 88:12.

In favour are pl. אֲנָשִׁים, fem. אִשָּׁה = [אִנְשָׁה], lack of proven √אישׁ, & lack of clear parallels for אישׁ in cogn. lang. Against the deriv. of אִישׁ fr. inš is the vocalization (י ִ, and that fully written, not ֵ), maintained even with suff., the (rare) pl. אִישִׁים, the impossibility of deriving אִישׁ from same √ (אִשָּׁה fr. Arabic), the existence of אֱנוֹשׁ as parallel form, and the (exceptional) parallel Aram. אישׁ (Inscr. of Carpentras), also Ar. Arabic (cf. Frey) ∥ Arabic; MI, SI, Ph. אשׁ are not decisive; Sab. has hoth אסם & אנסם; the former app. = אִישׁ, the latter אֱנוֹשׁ; but on former cf. DHMZK 1884. 360 & Sab. Den km. 37. On the whole, probability seems to favour √אישׁ; Thes gave mng. be strong; Dl HA 9. Pr 161 comp. As. išanu, strong; (Dl W. p. 244), & n.pr. יְהוֹאָשׁ; cf. also Prät LOPh. Feb. 1884; otherwise DHM l.c. & ZMG 1883, 330 & esp. Nö ZMG 1886, 739 Lag BN 68; cf. also Wetzst in De Psalmen. ed. 4. p. 888 al. v. also אנשׁ, אֱנוֹשׁ

Wiss., x. 11, Bibl. Theol. ii. 330). b. אֵל fr. √אלה strong (not אלהּ), & אֱלֹהִים expanded from אֵל, cf. pl. אֲמָהוֹת; fr. אמה etc.; so Di on Gn 1:1; he supports mng. strong by ref. to phrase יֵשׁ לְאֵל יָדִי Gn 31:29 al.; c. similarly, אֵל, being very early & common Shemitic word, formed pl. אלהים, fr. which sing. אֱלוֹהַּ was afterwards inferred, Nes Theol. Stud. a. Württ. 1882. 243 (criticized by Nö SBA 1.c.). 4. אֵל (אֱלוֹהַּ, אֱלֹהִים disregarded) fr. √אלה stretch out to, reach after (cf. prep. אֶל, אֱלִי, also אָלָה swear), God as the one whom men strive to reach, 'das Ziel aller Menschensehnsucht und alles Menschenstrebens,' Lag Or. ii. 3; GN 1882. 173—M 96.—Cf. SB Ak. i.c.).

[BDB a.gn.aa] Strong H854. אֵת, prep. with—prep. denoting proximity Of companionship, together with Of localities אֵת פּ׳ denotes specially in one's possession or keeping in one's knowledge or memory מֵאֵת from proximity with Note. אֵת expresses closer association than עִם: hence while מֵעִם sts. denotes hardly more than from the surroundings or belongings of, מֵאֵת expresses from close proximity to.

[BDB b.ab.aa] בְּ prep. in (Moab. בּ, Syr. Syriac, Ar. Arabic, Eth. Ethiopic) before tone-syllables in certain cases (Ges §102.2) בָּ, with suff. בִּי; בְּךָ (Ex 7:29 2 S 22:30 ψ 141:8 בְּכָה) in pause and fem. בָּךְ; בֹּו (once, Je 17:24 Kt בֹּה) בָּהּ; בָּנוּ; בָּכֶם, [בָּכֶן]; בָּהֶם, בָּם [also בָּהֵ֫מָּה †Ex 30:4 36:1 Hb 1:16], בָּהֵן †I S 31:7 Is 38:16 Ez 42:14 [15 times בָּהֵן (Fr MM 235), and thrice, Lv 5:22 Nu 13:19 Je 5:17, בָּהֵ֫נָּה] Prep. denoting properly in, Gk. ἐν, but applied in many derived and fig. significations. The senses expressed by בְּ are grouped by the Rabbis in three classes, בֵּית הַכּלִי Beth vasculi, בֵּית הַדִּיבּוּק וְהַגְּגִיעָה Beth coniunctionis et viciniae, בֵּית הָעֵזֶר Beth auxilii; and the same arrangement may be followed here, though the limits between the three classes are not clearly defined, and they sometimes overlap one another. In: strictly, of position in a place (which often is expressed more precisely by בְּתוֹךְ ,בְּקֶרֶב), as בַּבַּיִת in the house, בָּעִיר in the city, בַּדּוּד, in the pot, בָּאָרֶץ in the land, etc. constantly. Heb. idiom also says בָּהָר in the mountain Ex 24:18 etc., even in cases where we could hardly avoid saying on, as I K 11:7 19:11: so בְּחֹרֵב Dt 1:16 al.; בְּרֹאשׁ הָהָר Ex 24:17 ψ 72:16. Preceded by a verb of motion (esp. עָבַר) בְּ = through, as Gn 12:6 and Abram passed through בָּאָרֶץ in the land = passed through it, 13:17 2 S 24:2 +; in (= through) a gate, Is 62:10 Je 17:19 Mi 2:13. Fig. to speak בְּאַזְנֵי in the ears of . . . ; to be good (or evil, etc.) בּעֵינֵי in the eyes of. . , of presence in the midst of a multitude, among, Ex 14:28 there was not left בָּהֶם among them even one, Lv 26:36 2 S 15:31 Ahitophel בַּקֹשְׁרִים is among the conspirators, 2 K 18:5 בְּכֹל מַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה. So בְּךָ in thee (of Israel, coll.) Dt 7:14 15:4, 7 18:10 23:11 28:54 (diff. from עִמָּ֑ךְ beside thee Lv 25:35).—Spec. of an individ., implying eminency among: Jos 14:15 Je 46:18 Tabor among the mountains, 49:15 Pr 30:30 Ct 1:6 הַיָּפָה בַגָּשִׁים the fair one (= the fairest) among women, La 1:1: cf. Luke 1:42. On I S 17:12 v. Dr. hence with some verbs, when the action refers to only a part of the object, as הִכָּה בְּ to smite among . . . i.e. to smite some of . . . (diff. from הִכָּה with accus.); הָרַג בְּ ψ 78:31; נָשָׂא בְּ to bear in, i.e. to share in bearing, Nu 11:17 al.; בָּנָה בְּ to build in or at Zc 6:15 Ne 4:4; עָשָׂה בְּ Ex 5:9; אָמֵל בְּ to labour on Jon 4:10; אָכַל בְּ to eat or drink of Ju 13:16 Pr 9:5; חָלַק בְּ to give a share in Jb 39:17. specifying the parts of which a whole consists (esp. in P) Gn 7:21 8:17 9:10.16 17:23 Ex 12:19 Nu 31:11.25 Ho 4:3. with ref. to the limits enclosing a space, within: Ex 20:10 בִּשְׁעָרֶיךָ within thy gates, Is 56:5 בְּחוֹמוֹתַי within my walls. often pregn. with verbs of motion, when the movement to a place results in rest in it, into: after בָּא Gn 19:8 Is 19:23; נָתַן Gn 27:17; שָׁלַח to send Lv 16:22; in among Jos 23:7.12 1 K 11:2.—Ho 12:7 (an extreme case) שׁוּב בְּ to return (and rest) in thy God, 1 Sa 16:3 (unless לַזָּבַ֑ח should be read, as v. 7).—עַיִן בְּעַיִן (with) eye (looking) into eye † Nu 14:14 Is 52:8; פָּנִים בְּפָנִים †Dt 5:4; עֵינֵי פְ' בְּ the eyes of . . . are upon, both in favourable Dt 11:12 ψ 101:6) and hostile Am 9:8 Jb 7:8) sense. applied to time, as Gn 1:1 בְּרֵאשִׁית in the beginning; 2:2 בַּיֹּום הַשְּׁבִיעִי on the seventh day; Ju 10:8 בַּשְָּׁנָה הַהִיא in that year; & constantly. of a state or condition, whether material or mental, in which an action takes place: so oft., בְּשָׁלֹום in peace Gn 15:15; בַּצָּרָה in distress ψ 91:15; הָלַךְ בְּתֻמֹּו to walk in his integrity; Ex 5:19 בְּרָע in evil case. בְּ introduces the predicate, denoting it as that in which the subj. consists, or in which it shews itself (the Beth essentiae,—common in Arabic, esp. with a ptcp. or adj. and in a negative sentence: Qor 2:79 Arabic and God (appears) not as one remiss; 2:7 Arabic and they are not believers [comp. French en—en honnête homme]; v. WAG II. §56a): viz. a primary pred., Ex 18:4 the God of my fathers בְּעֶזְרִי was my help, ψ 146:6 Ho 13:9 (rd.: כִּי מִי בְעֶזְרֶֽךָwith 𝔊 𝔖 Che al.); ψ 68:5 בְּיָהּ שְׁמֹו his name consists in Yah, Jb 23:13 37:10. With the pred. in the pl. (as pl. maj.) ψ 118:7 י' בְּעֹזְרָ֑י J. is my great helper, 54:6 (v. Che), Ju 11:35. a secondary pred., Ex 6:3 and I appeared unto them בְּאֵל שַׁדָּ֑י as God Almighty, Nu 26:53 בְּנַחֲלָ֖ה as an inheritance, 34:2 Ez 46:16 47:14 Dt 10:22 26:14 I have not put away therefrom בְּמָמֵא as one unclean = while unclean, 28:62 Is 40:10 בְּחָזָק יָבֹוא he cometh as a strong one, ψ 35:2 (where v. De) and rise up as my help, v. 16, 39:7 55:19 Pr 3:26 Jb 36:32 (De). a pred. as accus., Is 48:10 I have refined thee וְלֹא בְכָ֑סֶף but not as though silver, Ez 20:41; Nu 18:26 36:2 Jos 13:6.7 23:4 Ez 45:1 47:22.22 (rd. יַפִּלוּ) 48:29 (v. 𝔊 Co) all בְּנַחֲלָה (cf. b), ψ 78:65 & allotted בְּחֶבֶל נַחֲלָה as a line of inheritance (i.e. as a measured inheritance). Is 26:4 כִּי בְּיָהּ יהוה צוּר עוֹלָמִים י' is different—for in Yah there is a rock of ages (cf. Qor 4:7.47 there is sufficiency in God as a patron). in comparisons, ψ 37:20 consume away בֶּעָשָׁן in the form of, as, smoke 78:33 102:4 Jb 34:36 36:14. Denoting proximity— at, by (not very common): 1 Sa 29:1 בָּעַיִן by the spring; Ez 10:15.20 בִּנְהַר כְּבָר by the river Chebar (1:3 עַל). on: Gn 8:20 Nu 23:2 בַּמִּזְבֵּחַ on the altar; Ju 8:21 on the necks of the camels; 1 K 2:5 al. בְּמָתְנָיו on his loins; Is 59:17 a helmet בְּרֹאשֹׁו on his head. often with verbs of touching, approaching, taking hold of, cleaving, etc., as תָּפַשׂ,תָּמַךְ ,פָּגַע ,קָרַב ,נָגַשׁ,נָגַע ,חָשַׁק ,דָּבֵק ,אָחַן (see these words). with words expressing or implying an act of hostility— against: Gn 16:12 יָדוֹ בַבֹּל וְיַד בֹּל בֹּו his hand against all, and the hand of all against him; הָֽיְתָה יַד פְּ' בּ Dt 13:10 1 Sa 5:9 18:17 +oft. Hence after verbs (q.v.) of fighting (רִיב ,נִלחַם), going up to invade (עָלָה), being angry (חָרָה אַף ,אָנַף ,הִתְעַבֵּר), sinning or acting treacherously (כִּחֶשׁ ,כִּזֵּב ,שִׁפֵּר ,פָּשַׁע ,מָעַל ,מָרָה מָרַד ,בָּנַד ,חָטָא), testifying (הֵעִיר ,עָנָה), mocking (הֵתֵל ,הִלְעִיג), feeling loathing (קוּץ), rebuking (גָּעַר: prop. to protest loudly), speaking (דִּבֶּר: Nu 12:8b), etc., & even (an extreme case) Ho 7:14 יָסוּרוּ בִי they turn aside (so as to be) against me. In a weaker sense מַשְׁתִּין בַּקִּיר mingens ad parietem 1 Sa 25:22 al. down to, upon (super with accus.), esp. in such phrases as דָּמָיו בּוֹ Lv 20:9 al. his blood be upon him דָּמֹו בְרֹאשֹׁו his blood be upon his head Jos 2:19; בְּרֹאשֹׁו (הֵשִׁיב י') שׁוּב Ju 8:57 (רָעָה), 1 K 2:33 (דָּם), v. 44 (רָאָה), ψ 7:17 (עֲמָלוֹ ); נָתַן דֶּרֶךְ פּ' בּרֹאשׁוֹ 1 K 8:32 & oft. in Ez, as 9:10 11:21. With— of accompaniment: Nn 20:20 בְּעַם כָּבֵד with much people, Jos 22:8 Ju 11:34 1 K 10:2 2 K 5:9 Je 41:15; Ex 21:22 and he shall give בִּפְלִלִים with arbitrators (arbitrators being employed), Is 8:16; בְּלִמֻּדָֽי with my disciples, i.e. having them present; Ex 8:1.13 Je 11:19 עֵץ בְּלַחְמוֹ a tree with its sap; 1 K 19:19 וְהוּא בִּשְׁגֵים הֶעָשָׂר and he with the 12th. often of what one takes or brings with one: Gn 32:11 בְּמַפקְלִי with my staff I passed over Jordan, Ju 11:34 15:1 1 Sa 1:24 Is 7:24; Mi 6:6 al. קִדֵּם בְּ to go to meet with; בָּא בְּ to come with Lv 16:3 ψ 66:13 71:16. (In Arabic this usage is developed more fully than in Hebrew, and Arabic lit. to come with, Arabic, lit. to go away with, are used idiomatically in the sense of to bring, and to take away respectively: WAG II.§56b.) Hence בְּאֵין ,בְּלֹא ,בִּבְלִי ,בְּאֶפֶס = without. of concomitant (or surrounding) conditions, as בְּחִפָּזוֹן with (or in) haste; בְּצֶדֶק with (or in) righteousness; בִּשְׁגָגָה in error; בִּתְרוּעָה וּבְקוֹל שׁוֹפָר 2 S 6:15; often; in such phrasese as בְּצִדְקָֽתְךָ ψ 31:2 in thy righteousness; בְּחַסְדְּךָ in thy mercy Ex 15:13;—בּאָשְׁרִי with my happiness! = happy am I Gn 30:13; ψ 29:4 the voice of י' is בַּכֹּחַ with power = is powerful; Ex 32:12 בְּרָעָה with evil purpose; ψ 73:8 בְרָע in wickedness; 90:10 בִּגְבוּרֹת with strength. of the instrument or means: as בַּחֶרֶב with the sword Ex 5:3 etc.; בְּרַגְלַיִם with the feet Is 28:3; . . . בְּיַד by the hand of . . . (v. sub יָד); to stone בְּאֶבֶן or בָּֽאֲבָנִים with stones Lv 20:2 Nu 14:10 etc.; שָׁתָה בְּ to drink with a cup Gn 44:5 Am 6:6 (cf. in Aram. Dn 5:2); to cry בְּגָרוֹן with the throat Is 58:1; to burn בָּאֵשׁ in or with fire (oft.); to slay or to perish בָּרָעָב through hunger or בַּדֶּבֶר through pestilence Ex 16:3 Je 21:9 + oft. (cf. Jb 27:15 בַּמָּוֶת יִקָּבֵ֑רוּ); to save with or by Ju 7:7 1 Sa 14:6. idiom., with certain verbs, as שָׁחַק בְּ to play with Jb 40:29; עָבַר בְּ to labour with a person (as with an instrument), i.e. to use him as a slave Ex 1:14 Je 22:13 27:7 al.; עָשָׂה בְּ Je 18:23 Ne 9:24 Dn 11:7; Est 1:15 2:11 3:11 6:6; & perh. דִּבֶּר בְּ (of God) to speak with one Nu 12:2.8a al. (v. Ew §217f. (3); Dr 8m ii. 23, 2). Further הִתְנַבֵּא ביהוה ,בַּבַּעַל to prophesy with or by י' or Baal, י' or Baal being the inspirer; דָּרַשׁ ,שָׁאַל בְּ to inquire or ask by means of a god (or oracle). ביהוה through י', (= by His aid) in many connexions, as ψ 18:30 44:6 56:5.11 60:14 Is 26:13 45:25 Ho 1:7 Ze 10:12; with pass. verbs Dt 33:29 Is 45:17 (to be saved): and even of the immediate cause Nu 36:2 to be commanded ביהוה by י' Gn 9:6 בָּאָדָם by man shall his blood be shed (both unusual), Ho 14:4. allied is the use of בְּ in such phrases as to bless, swear, speak, prophesy, etc., בְּשֵׁם in the name of . . . (i.e. the name being used or appealed to in the act) Dt 6:13 Je 11:21, etc. (so to swear ביהוה by י', Jos 2:12 etc., בִּימִינוֹ Is 62:8; to bless בְּךָ with thee Gn 48:20, to swear with me ψ 102:9, i.e. using my name in oath, Je 29:22); almost = in the authority and power of 1 Sa 17:45 25:5 1 K 21:8 Mi 4:5 Zc 10:12 ψ 20:6 44:6 89:25. בַּמָּה or בַּמֶּה by means of what? how? Gn 15:8 Ju 6:15 16:5.6.10 1 K 22:21 Mal 2:17. בְּזֹאת by means of this Gn 42:15.33 Ex 7:17 Nu 16:28; with this = on this condition Gn 34:15.22 1 Sa 11:2 Is 27:9. of cost or price (the Beth pretii), the price, whether given or received, being treated as the instrumental means by which the act is accomplished, with, for, at the cost of: thus regularly with שָׂכַר hire Gn 30:16, פָּדָה redeem Ex 34:20, אֵרֵשׂ betroth 2 S 3:14, קָנָה buy 2 S 24:24; 1 K 2:23 בְּגַפְשׁוֹ at the cost of his life hath A. spoken this word, 2 S 23:17 who went בְּנַפְשׂוֹתָם at peril of their lives, Pr 7:23 La 5:9 Jos 6:26 בִּכְכֹרוֹ יְיַסְּדֶנָּה at the price of his firstborn shall he lay its foundations, 1 Ch 12:19 בְּרָאשֵׁינוּ to the jeopardy of our heads he will fall away, etc. with מָכַר sell Dt 21:14; עָבַד serve Gn 29:18.20 Ho 12:13; הֵמִיר exchange Lv 27:10 Ho 4:7 their glory I will exchange for ignominy, ψ 106:20; נָתַן בְּנֶשֶׁךְ to give for interest Lv 25:37 ψ 15:5; in other connexions Gn 23:9 47:15f. Is 45:13 La 1:11 Ct 8:7.11; Dt 19:21 נֶפֶשׁ בְּנֶפֶשׁ עַיִן בְּעַיִן life for life, eye for eye; Is 2:22 at what is he to be accounted? 7:23 a thousand vines בְּאֶלֶף כָּ֑סֶף at a thousand (shekels of) silver.—Hence (perhaps) the idiom. usages שָׁנָה בְשָׁנָה year for year, one year like another, annually Dt 15:20 al.; יוֹם בְּיוֹם (late), בְּיוֹם בְּיוֹם † 1 Sa 18:10; בְּפַעַם בְּפַעַם (v. פַּעַם ,יוֹם); חֹדֶשׁ בּחֹדֶשׁ † 1 Ch 27:1. rather peculiarly, in certain cases where the object of an action may be treated as the instrument by which it is accomplishcd: as הֵנַיעַ בְּרֹאשׁ to shake with the head Je 18:6 Jb 16:4 (as well as הֵנִיעַ רֹאשׁ ψ 22:8); to open with the mouth Jb 16:10, with the lips ψ 22:8; to gnash with the teeth Jb 16:9 (to gnash the teeth ψ 35:16); to wink with the eye Pr 6:13 (to wink the eye, ib. 10:10); נָתַן בְּקוֹל to utter with the voice ψ 46:7 68:34 Je 12:8 (but נָתַן קוֹל is more common); to stretch out with the hand La 1:17; הֵרִים בַּמַּשׂטֶּה (unusual) Ex 7:20. So קָרָא בְּשֵׁם to call with the name—in diff. senses, acc. to the context, viz. to proclaim Ex 33:19 34:5 Is 44:5 ψ 49:12; to invoke Gn 4:26 12:8 1 K 18:24-26 Is 12:4; to name honourably Is 43:1 45:3. Cf. Ew §282d Ges §119.8b R. W AGii. §56bβ De Jb 31:12; Pr 29:30. with a causal force, through, on account of: Gn 18:28 הֲתַשְׁחִית בַּחֲמִשָּׁה wilt thou destroy on account of five the whole city? Lv 26:89 Nu 16:26 Dt 9:4.5 24:15: אִישׁ בְּחֶטְאוֹ יוּמָֽתוּ they shall be put to death, each because of his own sin (cf. Je 31:30 Ez 3:18, v. 18:17) 2 S 3:27 14:7 (cf. Jon 1:14) Is 7:4 (∥ מִן) 28:7 (∥ מִן) 50:1 53:5 57:17 Je 51:46 ψ 5:8.11 6:8 (∥ מִן) 31:10 32:3 42:10 90:9 94:23. So in בִּגְלַל , בַּאֲשֶׁר (v. גָּלָל , אֲשֶׁר) & (sts.) in בִּדְבַר at, through, the word of. . . . of the material with which a work is wrought, both absol. עָשָׂה בַזָּהָב to work with gold Ex 31:4 1 K 7:14; and to make a thing with (in our idiom, of) gold Ex 38:8 Ez 7:20 1 K 15:22 (בָּגָה). Without a verb Lv 13:62 2 Ch 9:18. with for falthough, in spite of (cf. Germ. bei alle dem): Lv 26:27 Nu 14:11 בְּכֹל הָאֹתוֹת in spite of all the signs that I have wrought, Dt 1:32 Is 47:9 ψ 27:3; esp. in the phrase בְּכָל־זֹאת for all this Is 5:25 9:11.16.20 10:4 ψ 78:32 al. (Cf. in Ar. Arabic Qor 9:25.) of a standard of measurement or computation, with, by: Ex 12:4 בְּמִכְסַת נְפָשֹׁת by the computation of souls; Lv 5:25 al. בְּעֶרְכְּךָ by thy reckoning; Ez 4:10; בְּמִסְפָּר by number Dt 25:2 +; . . . בְּמִסְפַּר by the number of . . . Lv 25:15.50 Nu 1:2, etc.; בְּשֶׁקֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ Ex 30:13 al. (in P); בָּאַמָּה often (v. אַמָּה); Dt 3:11 בְּאַמַּת אִישׁ by the cubit of a man; 2 S 14:26 בְּאֶבֶן הַמֶּלֶךְ. Of a model Gn 1:26 בְּצַלְמֵנוּ in our image, 5:1.3 Ex 25:40; בְּדֶרֶךְ with the way (= in the manner) of . . . Is 10:24.26 Am 4:10. בְּ is used also with certain classes of verbs, though the explanation of its use may be sometimes doubtful: viz. with verbs of taking refuge, trusting, relying, as בָּטַח ,הֶאֱמִין ,חָסָה ,נִשְׁעַן. with verbs of ruling, governing, restraining, as שָׁלַט ,רָדָה ,עָצַר ,נָגַשׂ ,מָשַׁל ,מָלַךְ. with verbs of rejoicing, feeling pleasure or satisfaction, etc., as שָׂבַע ,רָצָה ,חָפֵץ ,שָׂמֵחַ ,שׂוּשׂ,עָלַץ ,גִּיל (but with this verb מִן is more common). [Prob. a case of III. 5.] with verbs expressive of sensible perception, to denote the pleasurable or attentive exercise of the faculty concerned, as שָׁמַע בְּ to listen to, חָזָה ,רָאָה ,הִבִּיט בְּ, to look upon, הֵרִיחַ בְּ to smell at (see these words). occasionally also with verbs of speaking, thinking, mentioning, knowing, to denote the object of the action, as דִּבֶּר בְּ to speak about Dt 6:7 ψ 87:3 al. (v. sub דִּבֶּר); שִׂיחַ ,הָגָה ,הִלֵּל בְּ ψ 44:9 63:7 69:13; יָדַע Je 38:24; זָכַר once Je 3:16, oft.; ψ 71:6 בְּךָ תְהִלָּתִי of thee is my praise. Followed by an inf. c., בְּ forms a periphrasis for the gerund, though in English it is commonly to be rendered by a verb and conj., viz.:— as a temporal conj., as Gn 2:4 בְּהִבָּֽרְאָם in their being created = when they were created, 4:8 בִּהְיוֹתָם in their being (= when they were) in the field; and constantly. Sometimes it has in appearance the force of after that, as Gn 33:18 Ex 3:12 13:17; but as a rule this is really due to the action denoted by the inf. being treated as extending over a period within which the action of the principal verb takes place: so esp. in the phrase בְּצֵאת יִשׂרָאֵל מִמִּצְרַיִם, even of events at the close of the 40 years, Dt 4:45 23:5 Jos 5:4, the whole period being treated as that in which Egypt was left (comp. 2 K 2:1 where the time included is future). Cases, however, occur in which this explanation will hardly apply, as Dt 27:4.12. as a causal conj. (cf. above III. 5), as Gn 19:16 בְּחֶמְלַת י' עָלָיו through J.'s having compassion upon him, Ex 16:7 33:16 34:29 Dt 1:27 בְּשִׂנְאַת י' אֹתָנוּ through J.'s hating us, etc. (9:28 similarly מִן), 1 K 18:18 (= in that ye have . . .) Ez 9:8 43:8 44:7 2 Ch 28:6. as a concessive conj., when = though: Is 1:15 ψ 46:3 בְּהָמִיר אָרֶץ though the earth do change. Note.—Ex 10:12 בָּאַרְבֶּה can only be rendered 'with the locusts,' the locusts being conceived as implicit in Moses' uplifted hand: but prob. לָאַרְבֶּה should be read. Thrice in late Heb. בְּ is used peculiarly: 1 Ch 7:23 for with misfortune was it in his house (בְּרָעָה chosen for the purpose of explaining בְּרִיעָה); 9:33 עֲלֵיהֶם בַּמְּלָאכָה, it devolved upon them with the work; Ezr 3:3 for with terror (was it) upon them from the peoples of the countries (the sentence without a verb as oft. in Chr.: Dr Intr. 504f.): cf. 8:34. Compo Ew §295f.

[BDB p.cs.ar] Strong H5921. עַל, עָ֑ל subst. height As prep. upon, and hence on the ground of, according to, on account of, on behalf of, concerning, beside, in addition to, together with, beyond, above, over, by, on to, towards, to, against Upon, of the substratum upon which an object in any way rests, or on which an action is performed — of clothing, etc., which any one wears With verbs of covering or protecting, even though the cover or veil be not over or above the thing covered, but around or before it Of what rests heavily upon a person, or is a burden to him Of a duty, payment, care, etc., imposed upon a person, or devolving on him על is used idiom. to give pathos to the expression of an emotion, by emphasizing the person who is its subject, and who, as it were, feels it acting upon him חָיָה עַל to live upon (as upon a foundation or support) Of the ground or basis, on which a thing is done It expresses excess It denotes elevation or pre-eminence It expresses addition It expresses the idea of being extended, or suspended over anything, without however being in contact with it, above, over From the sense of inclining or impending over, על comes to denote contiguity or proximity, Engl. by (or sts. on) In connection with verbs of motion (actual or fig.) By writers of the silver age, על is sts. used with the force of a dative With other particles: As conj. עַל אֲשֶׁר because that עַל כִּי similar in meaning, but less frequent עַל alone: because notwithstanding that, although Compounds: with כְּ (rare and late) as concerning, as upon the like of their deeds is the like of (that which) he will repay מֵעַל from upon, from over, from by
